A unit's [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership is a measure of how valiant and determined they are to continue fighting. For mortal units, if the [[img:icon_morale]][[/img]]leadership level of a unit drops too low then the troops will rout from the [[sl:battle_battlefield]]battlefield[[/sl]] and stop responding to orders. Note that immortal units, such as Daemons, will react differently to low leadership.
The leadership state of a unit is shown on its tooltip.

Siege weapons are large weapons of war constructed on-site. When ready, they are used to attack enemy fortifications during [[sl:battle_major_siege_battles]]major siege battles[[/sl]]. Use rams to breach settlement [[sl:battle_gates]]gates[[/sl]] and siege towers to get your troops on top of the enemy [[sl:battle_walls]]walls[[/sl]].

An attacker may capture a [[sl:battle_victory_locations]]victory location[[/sl]] in a [[sl:battle_major_siege_battles]]major siege battle[[/sl]] to begin earning [[sl_tooltip:battle_victory_tickets]]Victory Tickets[[/sl_tooltip]] over time.
Should the attacker earn enough Victory Tickets they will win the battle.
The defender may stop the attacker earning Victory Tickets by retaking any victory locations they hold.

Factions are tribes, peoples or nations on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] that control [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] and amass [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]].
A faction is destroyed when it controls no more armies or settlements.
The campaign map is the theatre in which [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] can be created, surveyed, commanded and destroyed.
Territory on the map is divided into [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]]. Each province contains multiple [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]].

[[sl:campaign_buildings]]Buildings[[/sl]] within a [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] can be browsed, constructed, repaired, and dismantled from the [[sl:campaign_province_overview_panel]]Province Overview panel[[/sl]].
A building's rollout panel is shown when the mouse cursor is placed over the building icon.
Building upgrades can be browsed and initiated from a building's rollout panel.
Time on the campaign map is advanced in [[sl:campaign_turns]]turns[[/sl]].

Use the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_end_turn_button]]End Turn button[[/sl_tooltip]] to move the game on. Other [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] will then get a turn to move their [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit units[[/sl]] and perform other actions.
Armies are used to attack and defend [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] and fight enemy armies.
An army is always led by a [[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]].
An army can be selected by left-clicking on it.
Selected armies can be moved to a location by right-clicking there.
[[sl:campaign_settlements]]Settlements[[/sl]] contain [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] that provide a variety of benefits.
Settlements and buildings are managed from the [[sl:campaign_province_overview_panel]]Province Overview panel[[/sl]], which appears when a settlement is selected.
The Province Overview panel shows all settlements within the selected [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]], as well as buildings within settlements under control.

Additional [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] can be recruited into a selected [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] from the [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment_panel]]Recruitment panel[[/sl]], which is opened from the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]].
Left-click on a [[sl:campaign_unit_cards]]unit card[[/sl]] on the Recruitment panel to add it to the recruitment queue.
The cost of recruiting each unit is shown on its unit card and is subtracted from the {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl_tooltip:campaign_treasury]]treasury[[/sl_tooltip]].
Researching new technologies can bring a variety of military and civic benefits.
Only one technology may be researched at a time.
Research is undertaken on the [[sl:campaign_technology_panel]]Technology panel[[/sl]].

I will reclaim what has always been mine.

Bless you, my little Nurglings… you fight well, but the stronger the Warband, the more cadavers left in our wake.

To the south, great temple-cities lie in ruin. Be mindful of the verminous threat that inevitably resides beneath them, plaguing and corrupting the ancient spawning pools.
Many are the faces of Chaos!
A scheme of great and terrible destruction has been concocted by your devious engineers, my lord. Laden one with explosives and have him visit your enemy. Doom will come upon them!
Dervingard? How did they get here?
To the south, the Vampire Coast harbours many fleets, primed and ready for war. They could be assimilated into your own, my lord, should you wish to display your dominance and power.
To raider and witch alike, his verdict is the same: none shall pass.
All the while, my Tome ruminates on a way to bypass the maelstrom, so we may enter the Chaos Realms and save Ursun.
Taurox dominate the world, for the Dark Masters!
There, Tzeentch's favoured Daemon Prince, the Librarian, stands sentinel. Slay him to claim his soul.

Ursun growls low in my ear. He tells me knowledge forbidden by the Great Orthodoxy. I now know the names of the Dark Gods and their Daemonic servants. The land warps under the influence of Tzeentch, the Changer of the Ways, the Chaos God of magic and the Architect of Fate. The Skaven run rampant across the wastes of Naggaroth in my absence, plundering its arcane resources.
The Ruinous Powers want to see Be'lakor's gambit thwarted – they send their assistance! Put your reinforcements to work!
As one Skeggi force is defeated, so may others be sent to replace it. Move now to block the route to your capital, lest the warmbloods risk another attack.
The Destroyer of Khorne ensures His enemies are naught but blood-soaked dust!
Remember that you can use your scrap to fashion better weapons and armour for your mobs – some are a rag-tag bunch which could certainly do with them!
Recent events have sown disorder within your temple-city, mighty lord. Take steps to re-establish your will over your Lizard-kin.
You are now Admiral of the Fleet. Position others in seats of influence to improve your naval power.
Time to make some house calls once again! Don't mind me, little Northmen, I only wish to ‘treat’ your lack of ailments…
A target on the horizon I'll claim as a gift for the Seafather. And should there be valuables within, well, a gift to myself!

A burgeoning warherd can only attract a limited number and stature of individuals, but that can be changed as the tribe progresses. Some will not be available unless you have the correct horde buildings or attained sufficient Marks of Ruination.

The Dark Elves flee, my lord, yet they will doubtless return in number - be on your guard. Construct a Waystone as soon as possible to begin collection of the fragments we seek. As you no doubt sense, the strength of the Vortex is fading further.

You have successfully increased Yvresse defences to their maximum. Your allies on the outer regions of Ulthuan thank you, for the Mists now protect their lands too. The enemies of the Asur will now think twice before encroaching on your sacred soil!
Ancient ruins dot the nearby landscape, potentially harbouring more wealth to claim for the Empire. They are prime locations for colonisation, if indeed they are uninhabited.
One still stands in your way, my lord - the chief hunter. Crush him beneath your mighty tread, for you are the Spirit of the Jungle. The Great Plan must prevail!
Cannons fire upon the defenders. When the barrage is over, his warriors will attack. Act swiftly!
There you will find the Gatekeeper, the favoured Daemon Prince of Khorne. Kill him to claim his soul.
Theirs is a struggle helped by faith, gunpowder and steel as well as the charnel magic of those willing to dabble in taboo.

You breached the Brass Citadel, a feat so rare as to draw Khorne’s gaze! Whether that is in ire or respect is yet to be known, for a long shadow is cast over your mighty victory, as Be’lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the third soul, but one more is required to light the Bridge of Shadows.

The Dark Gods have the means to permanently boost many aspects of the tribe in return for your baneful accomplishments. Even your mighty Herdstones, most sacred monoliths of your kind, can be enhanced with greater power.
Plaques of the Old Ones must be sought, for only the wisdom of our ancient forefathers can show us the way.
Rally the soldiers. We hunt the Wolf.

Blessings of filth to you, Queek Headtaker, the Right-Claw of Clan Mors. You and your verminous ilk infest the abandoned mountain strongholds of the Dwarfs, who still fight with the Greenskins for control, seemingly unaware of your power.
I Tretch - I have snuck-sneak into Elf-thing's lands undetected! Lucky, maybe - but I take credit-glory! Yes-yes!
Our forces have met with defeat! Let us retreat and regroup!
The dark knowledge of the Usurper intensifies my power. I must have more! The Black Pyramid shall be mine!
Your Skaven society is a vicious contest. The weak are consumed, and only the strongest survive to serve in arms. Recruit them now, and they will be ready to fight in the battles to come.
Many secrets lie in the hidden places of the world, o Grand Hierophant – perhaps even an end to your eternal exile? You should strike far afield, and explore the terra incognita of the New World.
Wherever you hold court, the land heals, your highness. Even long after you have departed, the land will still glow with your radiant light.
Great riches may flow into your kingdom through trade with the Old World. Appoint and dispatch a caravan, but ensure it is well-protected, for the road west is long and fraught with danger.
I gather all Warpstone, build biggest bomb ever! Time tick-tick-ticks, Sotek’s end comes soon!
The Courtesan appears! We must kill this Daemon Prince and take their soul!
The settlement ahead has large walls - we will need a grand army of brave Kislevites to overcome it. Send a call to muster.
All bow before the Witch King!

The skies beyond the horizon darken, my lord – a Black Ark approaches. The Dark Elves use their mighty floating fortresses of war to support their forces abroad. Such mighty weapons must be engaged with great caution, for they bring doom on those unprepared.

With the most skilled assassins of all Skaven, Clan Eshin have the ability to be anywhere and everywhere at any given moment. You are the Grand Nightlord’s most senior operative, unmatched in subterfuge. Use your oversight of Eshin’s shady network to achieve the clan’s ends.
Arrange our forces at the base of the hill; claim the slopes for ourselves. It will give us an advantage in the heat of battle.

Ahh, my loyal following… They would die for me, if they were not already dead. Still, on occasion I have known rivals to hide their crew within mine. Spies and mutineers. Best to round up such ingrates now!
The High Elves enter the field, my lord! Arrange your defences, for the sons of Ulthuan seek control of the Vortex in a desperate quest to stop their island from sinking beneath the waves.
And beyond that is a greater prize, one the reptiles claim as the first city. It shall be mine.
In this lush and enigmatic land, trespassers are mulch for far older wars.

No boundaries are acknowledged by your kind in the pursuit of warfare, verminous lord. A deadly contagion, concocted by your most skilled incubators, is now ready for use against your enemy. Recruit a plague priest and send him amongst the enemy.
The comet has driven the warmbloods to madness. Turn your keen eyes against those that raze our jungles and steal our relics. Their eradication must come first.
Decisions, decisions… but enough procrastination. My labours must begin!
Let the foul stench of the Greenskins air away with the wind; Black Crag is no more. Turn over every hut, stash and dung pile within the lair to learn of their brutish ways!

The wretches that inhabit these lands must be bent to the customs of the Plague Lord. Spread your pestilent corruption here, for the influence of Grandfather Nurgle is the catalyst for all growth and decay.
Artillery is now available for recruitment. Construct these weapons of war and you may bombard the enemy from great distances, destroying massed ranks of soldiers and fortifications alike.
The legendary Ungol will falters. Our warriors run from the battle. Round them up, and send them back to the fight!

Of all the creatures that walk this world, none are hardier than your Ogre kin, overtyrant. Harness the innate strength and resilience of those you command, and all you survey from your mountains shall be yours!
Hail, dread scourge Malekith! You rule over a splintered people, your realm is in decay, and there are many vile creatures who will attempt to stop your advance.
Across the Great Desert is a most unholy landmark – a pyramid blacker than night, harbouring an ancient, powerful evil. Fate may compel me to end its malevolent taint once and for all.

Once you have identified a foreseen event you would like to oppose, you have the power to instantaneously travel to its location. How you achieve such feats of passage is a mystery known only to you, my lord.
A state capital falls under your control, my lord. This would be a good time to appoint a new Count to benefit from this region's resources.
Warpstone holds key! Much Warpstone found in Reptile-thing cities. Kill Sotek’s creatures, and find-steal their treasures!
The blessings imbued into your weapon – Krakens’ Bane – are weakening, mistress. It is clear your father, Manann, is in need of your assistance.

The court of Slaanesh is sustained by the adulation of His devotees. Its carnival of indulgence is self-perpetuating: acts of debauchery attract a greater following, whose worship fuels further excess.
To the north, the Bretonnian dukedoms fight for honour and Chivalry, yet they have a soft underbelly which could easily be exploited by Skryre’s Under-Empire.
Great insight is gained through recovered plaques, yet revered master Mazdamundi needs more. He prepares a ritual to seek the wisdom of the Old Ones.
All this world will blacken and die!
Liche King, your path is clear – unite with your master and let the world tremble once more.
The Sword of Khaine calls to you. The Shrine of Khaine must be secured if you wish to wield Aenarion's blade.
Seizing the Altar would no doubt lead to war amongst your own kind, yet the Warpstone must be yours. Prepare for an attack!
Hurry to the Beacon. Find the Wolf.
I desire this Altar but the dredges of this backwater claim it. End them.

The Plague Lord's mansion has been sundered! The God of Decay begrudgingly concedes your might, but will no doubt already be concocting a new disease to blight your empire in retaliation. Still, Be'lakor remains the most pressing threat. You have the third soul, but one more is required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
Ancient plaques lost in ruins. Master commands we go now.
Drown this land in a tide of blood! Khorne commands it!
We need weapons, not words of heresy!
The Chaos Gods labour to give you a mighty fortress from which you can begin your reign of terror over this world. All you need do is take it!
Your foolish subjects have taken up arms against you! Crush their uprising, or it may grow to threaten your rule here!
The Worldroots form a network that connects the most important forests of the world. Healing them not only strengthens the Worldroots, but also grants you powerful benefits.
There is a lull in the Winds of Magic – can you sense the calm? Be wary, for the longer it persists, the weaker your Sorcerers become.
And in the utmost north, where Chaos is made manifest, corrupt champions emerge to write their legends in blood.
You have the strength to stop Morghur, Briarmaven!

We searched for our kin fleeing south. We found them travelling the hidden trails to avoid open ground. Some had left Dervingard. They said the stronghold had fallen; that its commander, the Boyar Slavin Kurnz, had abandoned his post.\\n\\nYet others fled from a smaller fort they called the Beacon. They spoke of a tribal chief that thirsted for bloodshed: Skollden, the Wolf of Dervingard.
It is said that the goddess Ladrielle watches over all Asur that enter the Mists of Yvresse. By performing a sacred rite in her name, the Mists’ power will be temporarily amplified.
If I am to return to Nehekhara, I must find safe passage. The coast is guarded by High Elves and the Great Ocean filled with peril.

The Lady of the Lake has appeared before your servant, granting her blessings and gifting them a piece of her own power. Few in this world can stand against those touched by the Lady, so their service to our cause shall be a great boon.
Set your dullard gaze upon the merest fraction of the Horned One's glory, and rest assured that the responsible fool-wretch is torn limb from squirming limb!

The hated Asur of Ulthuan have also struck against you, landing forces on the shores of Naggaroth. Throw them back and, should you feel malicious, invade the kingdoms of Ulthuan to exact your vengeance!
Do not tarry with your whispers, seer. I know what you are, but all that matters is saving Ursun. Let's get on with it!
Run, things, tell all Queek comes!

Khaine's servants threaten the very nature of my realm, having seized the Phoenix Gate. News reaches me of further murderous fleets setting voyage across the Great Ocean, inspired by the Queen of Har Ganeth.
Once the Norscan homelands are under the sway of my Dark Fortresses, the Northmen will answer to me.
Wallow in pointless triumph at your peril, mortal! For your destruction has not been averted, but merely delayed.\\nAnd, for your gall, it will be meted out with fury many times its due.
Having voyaged across the Great Ocean on the Emperor’s command, I shall tame this jungle-infested continent and plunder it for the treasures it holds.
Your kind have the tendency to fill out any place they occupy, my lord. In time your foetid presence begins to increase disquiet within a province.
You have cut the Shaggoth off, my lord, but you should tread with care – Traygard is more ancient and powerful than most others of his kind.
Once your Monster Pens are filled they will serve you well for an invasion southward. The Old World’s realms of men are rich with potential slaves and plunder to seize for your coffers.
The frozen seal is shattered, and initiates may now be sent into the Ice Court. Yet be patient, for apprentices of Ice Magic must complete many trials within the glacial halls.
Trust in Ursun, Gerik. His wisdom guides us.
Great threats plague the southern jungles. Pestilens’ spawn spread disease and corruption.
Add more Daemons to your army, sire. Think of how many more skulls you shall collect!
Advance on those hellish cannons! They must fall silent if we are to save the Beacon.
Scrolls of great power may be found within the deepest vaults and darkest ruins, Krakenlord. The Altar of the Horned Rat is known to house such treasures…
One such guardian is the scarred war-leader Kroq-Gar, unsurpassed in the number of Daemons he has cast back to the abyss.
Control the Crystal of Lore in the labyrinth. This will give you a foothold and grant us supplies to reinforce for the struggle ahead.

As the Dragon Prince, the mighty Drakes you encounter not only understand you, but also have much to offer. You may seek their affiliation or wisdom, but bringing them under your command will take much more.
Dervingard is north of here. March to the stronghold.
The Palace of Slaanesh, where the Dark Prince's harem resides.
There is no escape from the Dark Master.
Distant sounds of cannon fire, my lord – the pirates of the Vampire Coast must be close! Do not suffer these Undead Corsairs upon your lands, for they seek only to raid and pillage.
The last Greenskin invasion of Ulthuan cannot go unpunished, Warden! You have left Tor Yvresse vulnerable, but your pursuit of Grom the Paunch has forced your hand, leading you here to the Badlands.
You take the head of their tribe, my lord, paving the way for a simple and forceful confederation between you both.
My lord, the ratkin have gathered in huge numbers and abandoned the Under-City in their frenzy to attack. The Vermintide should be sent against the ignorant occupiers above!
Brother! You are seriously injured, stay with us… Ungol hearts will be shaken – I cannot keep them in the fight!
Attack in silence, cover tracks. Quick death, they shall have!
We are on land once claimed by your forebears, but now desecrated by Greenskins. There is no need to show them mercy!
They are taking the Warpstone for themselves, Lord Queek! It should rightfully be yours! Attack, and claim it for yourself!
The breach has been sealed, but the task is not yet over. We must sally forth from the fortress and push the invaders from our shores once and for all!
Wherever my walker rig takes me, we will burn to ash. Hashut wills it!
The hinterland territories are overrun with vermin, your majesty. The Skaven first came into your realm beneath Har Kaldra, gnawing for weeks through frozen rock to enter the ruined city from below.

How long did I wander? Hours? Days? Yet finally, I reached the heart of the maze. Dark runes appeared before my eyes, but the journal revealed their secrets: a way for mortals to span the Screaming Chasm and reach the Howling Citadel.\\n\\nI must go to the land of the Blood God. Inscribed upon His Brazen Altar are the words to summon the Bridge-Maker, the one who thirsts for more than blood.\\n\\nWhen I emerged from the maze my army was waiting, but they did not cheer, offering just cold, hard stares and the stink of ingratitude.
There is much to do, Bejewelled One, you require a large fiefdom to sustain the divine hosts required to penetrate the Realm of Chaos. Let us commence…
Keep in mind that you will likely have to fight more than just the Brood Queens themselves. They will undoubtedly have their ravenous hatchlings ready to release and attack!
Anything that stands before me in the hope of defeating the Empire will meet its end by my bow. It is the Emperor’s will!
Battle draws near. Our soldiers are ready.
We march south. Man shall breathe his last!

The Dark Tongue of the Beastmen was barely understandable my lord, but from our interrogations you discovered that it is the disciples of Chaos who know more about what we seek. The source of power now feels close, you just need to find this Ruinous host.
The Brass Citadel! The keep of the Blood God. Home of the Skull Throne.

Beyond the icy plains, wild beasts inhabit the mountain crags, readying themselves for war. But a much closer prize lies at our very doorstep; the secrets of Ghrond have forever been a source of wonder and beauty.
Eminence… the insidious forces of Chaos have located the frozen body of the Red Tzar. They have slain those you set to guard the holy site and now seek to crack open his glacial capsule!
The more skulls you take, the easier it will be to enter the Realm of Chaos and seek the dying god. So… let the blood-harvest begin.
In sweet surrender or bitter misery – I shall have them all.
More of your murderous kin stand ready to take up arms in the name of Malekith. Recruit them now and they will be ready to fight in the battles to come.
The Wolf is cunning. He waited, knowing we would come this way. Now he means to face us in open battle with renewed strength. We deploy on the high ground and make him come to us!
But there an enemy! Kostaltyn rules a pitiful religion–\\n\\n[[col:blue]]…![[/col]]\\n\\nYes, we shall, brother!

It is a momentous day, mighty Dragon Prince, for you have proven your strength to this Dragon and earned its esteem. Power respects power, and now the Drake stands ready to be recruited into your battle ranks.
The soldiers advance! Take this time to practice manoeuvring. Remember, orders are issued only to selected units.
To the south, the 'Elf-things' have overrun several ruined settlements, and established defensive positions in each. Whatever they are seeking remains a mystery.

The Warden’s duties are not for the faint-hearted, but you have done what is necessary and taken action against one of your prisoners. Though your intentions are for the greater good, time will tell whether your chosen measures were justified.
A token force defends the Icon of Ruin. Their position is weak – signal the advance!
The rebels claim the mines – stealing the wealth of Cathay to fund their treason! This cannot stand!
There is plunder and relics hidden from me… But they are mine, even if their current owners do not realise this yet…
The God of War's counterattack has failed, yet still His champion does not appear. Press on into the Blood Pits and seize the Icon of Blood!
The air in this cold, dank enclosure is still, and there is very little ventilation. This will be to your disadvantage – the Mad Titan is notorious for his repulsive flatulence!
This settlement is at your mercy! Claim it for yourself or use it as a lair by establishing a Pirate Cove here.
In this accursed land, neither living nor dead find respite – only the triumphant.
They would call them blasphemous. Unrighteous.
Grom the Paunch, oh ye of the mighty gut, greatest of all Goblins. Your Waaagh! burgeons once more, but the boyz' morale is low, and they will need reinvigorating.
Can you not hear it? The howling? The screaming? Is there no other way?
Clear out these green maggots, my plan must be enacted!
Aranessa Anja Saltspite, daughter of Manann and irascible captain of the Swordfysh – your very name strikes fear into the soft hearts of the men in the Southern Realms!
After we water the earth with our enemy's blood, we will drink whatever's left!
The Frost Maiden is a magic-user. Her spells may be overcast to increase their potency. Yet channelling so much magic at once risks disaster.

My lord, the Northmen were of little use to us, though they did provide another lead. They claimed that rampaging Beastmen they recently encountered have knowledge of the Daemonic power. We should hunt them down and find out what they know.
The Wolf’s marauders begin their advance. Manoeuvre and claim the high ground before they do!
The Skaven approach, Kroq-Gar. Prepare yourself!

With the Herdstone ritual cast, you have increased your standing with the Dark Gods and elevated the brayherd. You may return to these lands later if you wish, but for now you should use your newfound strength. Fresh Bloodgrounds await!
Your treasure trove grows in size, admiral. Yet more can be yours if you so desire it.

Constructed defences are difficult obstacles to overcome head on. We don’t want our kin to die needlessly. However, by capturing supply locations as we find them, we can curtail the enemy’s ability to erect more defences.
The pitiful masses who work these tainted lands must be bent to the customs of your own kind. Despite your recent conquest, you must take additional steps to spread your ways and practises here.
A king must have his crown, my lord. Yours was a repository of such power, and a true reflection of your achievements in life and beyond. Perhaps it is time to don it once more?
Your wealth is unsurpassed, admiral. Others falter as you grow ever stronger.
Facilities are now in place to recruit a Hero, my lord. Such operatives may move behind enemy lines and strike independently of your armies.
The pretence of amity is working – there are rival powers that may be willing to open trade negotiations. Consider making an agreement, for money oils the machine of war.

Be wary, for the Tomb Kings of Nehekhara draw into sight. They stalk the land in perpetual Undeath, seeking to reclaim the world from the living. Keep a watch on their movements, my lord, for they are formidable adversaries still.
One final push, to the Boiling Moat! We must seize the Icon of Torment, and tempt Khorne's Gatekeeper from his lair!
I will guide you to the dying god. You require a grand legion, and for that your traditional lands must be tamed!
Some of your soldiers are fleeing; they will no longer respond to your orders!
Make haste and return to your king, Khatep. Use your knowledge of incantations to grant him his ultimate wish and serve by his side for all eternity.
The weakening of the Vortex has wrought devastation across the magics of the world, mighty lord. The lost wisdom of the Old Ones must be sought if it is ever to be restored.
Yet danger rears its head even closer still, as the savage Norscans descend on Kraka Drak, intent on murder and massacre.
My lady, our men have refilled their waterskins and quenched their thirst. Such things are of grave importance when traversing these scorching desert lands.
Well done, my lord! Now that the threat is neutralised, you may return home, or move on to thwart Chaos elsewhere. Alternatively, explore these new lands as you see fit.

The Liber Bubonicus is an opus of great and terrible power, I see you have hidden it away as bait for unsuspecting Man-things. It appears the trap has been sprung – now it is time to recover your book!
The Altar of the Horned Rat conceals many dark secrets, mighty lord. Yet its latent power is exploited by a rival clan for their own ends. Much Warpstone they are said to have found there.

There it is, Master Runelord! The Lost Vault hums with the call of the Ancestors who recognise your worth to access its treasures. Alas, the Skaven also seek to plunder it for their own ends – show them that they have meddled in your affairs for the last time!
Monsters use their size and strength to dominate smaller foes in combat. Field them in battle and you will decimate vulnerable enemy infantry.
Do not be fooled by this form, Lord Mazdamundi of the Second Generation. I bring you knowledge of the Old Ones, for now is the time to enact the next stage of the Great Plan.
Chaos taints Dervingard. Build a Totem to Ursun.
The fall of man comes none too soon!
A mighty Dragon awaits you in battle, my lord! You know very well that it is no small feat to defeat a Dragon, but doing so will bring recompense, not least its loyalty and service in your army.
This forest may be used to conceal your forces. Arrange your Rat Ogres here, my lord, and they will remain unseen until the enemy draw close.

The fate of the nearby Naggarothi is of little concern, but all vestiges of Chaos in these lands must be eradicated, nonetheless. For it is said that wherever the Dark Gods have worshippers, they also have eyes.
Making war amongst your own kind is unpalatable, but an occupation of the city may be necessary to secure the Way-fragments uncovered there.
And more must be shed, until we reach the Brazen Altar.

Well done! This forest’s health has improved enough to enable a Ritual of Rebirth, which will permanently guarantee its rejuvenation. But beware – hostile forces will attempt to disrupt the ritual once it begins.

However, there is risk in extending far south, exposing your flank to the predations of Skarbrand, Khorne's mightiest Bloodthirster. The Eternal Lagoon forms a barrier that will keep him at bay for now, but it is only matter of time before your armies clash.
Money is the lifeblood of success and glory. Without the means to support your armies you will be powerless to make war. Seek to raise your income.
The counter-attack has failed, but the Lord of Excess will not be still for long. Continue your offensive!
And here, the site of Ironhand's intent - the Great Drill stands, but is not operational… yet.
Civil War! The Electors have banded together to drive you out of the Empire. There is no turning back now; politics must be replaced by blood and steel.
While Naggarond itself remains secure, I regret to inform you that their verminous forces have overrun many smaller cities in the hinterlands of your territory.
Where the Lizardmen shall always reign supreme.
The world will burn, and with it – the false gods!
Glory to you, Wulfrik, Wanderer of the World. You have returned home a slayer of champions. Yet more battles and glory awaits across the Sea of Claws and in the mountains of Norsca.
Much Warpstone may be found at Vaul's Anvil, my lord, a site of great reverence to the Elves. The surface-dwellers yoke the energies of this place to forge weapons of great and terrible power.

Our settlement has been lost to a Doomsphere detonation, my lord, swallowed up in a giant green cloud of devastation! The contemptible Skaven had built an Under-City right beneath us without our knowledge. They must have assembled their infernal bomb right under our noses.

The stronghold we had searched for, longed for, was ours. But I could not rejoice, I felt only the loss of those who had given their lives. At least the Wolf was slain.\\n\\nYet, even in death, his hand reached towards his tainted sword, Wolfbane. Ursun compelled me to take it. A man of faith can withstand its evil and harness its power.
A great victory, brother! The survivors swear allegiance.

The pretence of amity is working, verminous lord. Your new 'friends' may be willing to open trade negotiations. Consider making an agreement, and allowing your merchants to flourish before your sudden but inevitable betrayal.
Be'lakor's forces have failed him! Continue your advance, for the Engine of the Forge lies ahead!
You bless me with your staff, master - its power opens the way to the Black Pyramid! My armies shall vanquish all who stand against you!
To the south, in Lustria, the Lizardmen spawn. Their jungles are squalid and ill-suited for settlement, but the beasts themselves are great sport to hunt.
The army grows! New soldiers, eager to fight.

From the Chaotic north surge the Winds of Magic, from which all minions of the Ruinous Powers draw their strength. Engage the Wu Xing Compass, redirect its energies to the boundless desert, and quell the influence of Chaos in your lands.
But great strength can be found in mysterious places. Great power resides within the Shrine of Khaine, one that can twist the mind of its master, but also slay those who stand in his way.
The land of beasts, ravaged and plundered for its riches.
Along a bleak and embayed shoreline, champions of Ruin vie for dominion over Dark Fortresses. There, they muster to wage war upon all that is sane and good in the Old World.
Yet beyond the Chaos-marked, the wastes harbour a brooding, monstrous cruelty, whose tusked maw gapes before the ramparts of Praag.
The enemy advance! Ready your forces for battle!
Your favourite weapon has been stolen, mighty lord! But by whom? Heads must roll until it is reclaimed!
The hunt is complete; reap the rewards, my lord.
In the Lady’s name I have sailed across perilous seas to these distant lands, far from Bretonnian soil.
There is no end to the diabolical invention of your kind, my lord. Build your most devious minds a place of work, and they may put their terrible creativity to work.
[[col:green]]Cease this childishness! If Ariel cannot seal the Daemon portal, annihilation awaits.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]Don't be tedious, sister. You know I will never fail our Mage Queen.[[/col]]
One hunter has been silenced, but others may still reside in Lustria. See to it that they are gone from these shores.
Total devotion, you give yourself to the Eagle as its mighty champion. Go forth with the gifts of magic and torment in the Eagle's name.

You cannot raise another Herdstone until you have performed a Herdstone ritual, my lord. You should first ensure you have caused maximum devastation in the Bloodgrounds to receive the greatest rewards. As your power grows, you will eventually be able to erect multiple Herdstones.

My brother’s lifeless body fell to the ground. The Bloodthirster roared as he threw Gerik’s screaming skull onto the bridge. I crossed the chasm, the Daemon beside me. My army wavered, yet followed, fearing my wrath.
Gerslev is under the yoke of the Marauders. You already have a victory against this tribe – retake the town and wipe out the defilers once and for all!

A threat to the forest has appeared nearby! Aggressions against the forest are not uncommon, but some threats are more pressing than others. This particular attack is imminent!  Send an army to disrupt these aggressors before they reach full strength.
The dukedoms of Bretonnia lie fractured and weak. Feed from them, my lord, and swell your legions, but be mindful of the Red Duke of Mousillon, for he hungers also... and watches your every move.

Well done, my lord! You have successfully destroyed one of the Waystones Ariel intended to use for her ritual. This disruption to her plans weakens her forces and has given you more time to prepare yourself for the attack.

The acquisition of lands is the surest path to supremacy in war. Through territorial gains comes great wealth and the power to raise forces to defend it. Expand your burgeoning state, and deny your enemies the room to do likewise.
Now that we know what we are up against, the Undead kings must be purged from the surrounding area. Let us go forth and secure their lands so that we may gain a stronger footing here.

Now that you have trampled this settlement’s inhabitants into the blood-soaked ground, you may erect a Herdstone here. These forbidding monoliths mark all the surrounding regions as your Bloodgrounds, where carnage and slaughter will hasten the brayherd’s rise.
What is cut down regrows with more vigour, it seems. Nurgle's forces have mustered a counter-attack – prepare your defences!
The very closest of allies may choose to permanently entwine their fates. Choose to confederate and your two kingdoms will be inseperably joined – under your leadership.
Capture the Canker-Tree in the Garden of Blight. This will give you a foothold and grant us supplies to reinforce for the struggle ahead.
Your investment within the Ice Court bears its first fruit. A master practitioner of Ice Magic now stands ready to serve your cause.
The Brood Queens you seek are here, my lord, but do not underestimate this enemy! Seldom do hunters have to bring down so many giant spiders in a single hunt.
Lustria under threat. Too many trespassers. Must defend.
The Winds of Magic embody the arcane power of Tzeentch. Honour The Changer of Ways through acts of sorcery and his blessings will fall upon you.
The taint of warmbloods infests your sacred jungles, revered Lord of the Second Generation. A great temple must be built, in honour of the Old Ones’ power.
The corruption that tainted this place is being cleansed, the search for the Plaques must commence. Build suitable facilities to support this.
Those that stand before the Queen of Lybaras shall fall!

My scrying fails me... the servants of Tzeentch must be close by! The Changer of Ways blocks my foresight, such are His powers of magic and manipulation. Engage the Great Conspirator or His adherents at your peril!
At the haven's heart, the Great Vortex keeps Chaos from spilling into the mortal realm, as the noble Asur maintain a tenuous grasp of their sacred charge.
Keep your weapons to hand, for the followers of Khorne have been sighted nearby! Those who serve the Chaos God of Rage practice little but pillage and slaughter. Be prepared to meet them in battle.
How can Ursun condone such heresy?
There is beauty in violence, ecstasy in carnage. All that stand before me are mere vermin. They shall feel no mercy as I unleash horror and torment upon them, as with everything in my way.

Challengers approach, but the pitiful fools do not realise they are heading straight into my trap! Victory over these insignificant pretenders will take me one step closer to conquering the beast beneath the sea. Their shanty will be mine!
My sister assumes it is her right to hear the Bear-God's testament. But you will help me reach Ursun first!

The Knights of the Flame voyaged from the north to claim these lands, but they hold too much faith in their Lady to protect them - ha-ha! Their errantry war ends here! I shall lay them to rest in the desert!
Your first encounter with a Dragon outside of Ulthuan was a fruitful one, my lord. Such meetings are rare, however, and it will be some time before another shows itself to convene with you.
It matters not, for the Prophet will protect the jungle from all invaders. Mighty Sotek, we invoke you through our sacrifices, rise up in the blood of our enemies!
Impressive! The bonds with the Eagle grow stronger; the eyes of Norsca watch for new prey to seize.
To the west, Dark Elves prey upon the feral wildlife, bending its fiercest beasts to their will.
By accumulating enough wealth and power, you could even move to gain control of your home city of Karond Kar. Whether it be by diplomacy or force, the choice is yours.
Your warren is well defended, yet the Elves press forward in ever greater numbers. Do not let Yuatek fall, Lord Queek!
The Changer of Ways is the ultimate master of the arcane arts. Yoke His great sorcery and the Winds of Magic themselves may be commanded to blow!
You have gained experience and may now develop your skills accordingly. See for yourself!
The Great Ones have other plans for you...
The Skaven have almost completed their summoning, my lord. One final chance remains to defeat them in battle and foil their scheme. Advance!
The Brood Queens you seek are here, my lord, but do not underestimate this enemy! Seldom do hunters have to bring down so many giant spiders in a single hunt.
There, my lord, it’s coming – it’s in the trees! Can you see it?
The Great Serpent grows stronger, but his arrival requires more sacrifices. Offerings in prodigious numbers are needed to sate the appetite of Lustria’s saviour. There is much more blood to be spilt!
Barron von Heastie, admiral of the Red Dragon, beckons you to combat. He will test your seamanship and arsenal, but the prize that awaits holds the key to defeating Amanar.
Long-forgotten plaques lie hidden and undiscovered amongst the world's ruins. We must recover them before the warmbloods do - a task fit for the preeminent servant of Master Mazdamundi!
My queen, the torrent of the Dark Gods stirs. We must act before this trickle becomes a flood.

I hold but one of your great books, master; it is to their power that the Black Pyramid answers. I have returned to Nehekhara to seek out your further wisdom - grant me the strength so that my search may succeed!
The jewel of the Dwarfs mountain kingdom, Karaz-a-Karak, crumbles into ruin. Turn over every hall, chamber and mine within the Karak to discover their hoards and technological ways!
Then we come to Ulthuan, home of the High Elves and an ever-present thorn in your side. Taking from them will only help bolster your fleet.

But da big prize is on da pointy ‘ead’s island ‘cross da sea. I once had me a good rampage up there, with da crazy Shaman Ol’ Blacktoof eggin’ me on. He said we had to destroy everyfink, as if I wasn’t gonna! Then we ended up at da gates of dat shiny ol’ city…
The gifts are mine. How generous! They are not for you, oaf!
Good! We have all the scrolls required to begin the first ritual. Tell the witch to cast her spell at once. I will not be denied!
The Sword of Khaine drives its wielder onwards, never allowing for weakness or frailty, my queen!
Slayers! It is time to fulfil your oaths made in Karak Kadrin!

Tor Yvresse still reels from Grom’s last invasion, the city a shadow of its prior grandeur. Rebuilding it and improving Athel Tamarha’s facilities will increase Yvresse’s defences, renew the Mists and reinvigorate the city.
What is this? A place of past hope and wonder? Let the Lady rebuild and cleanse here, so it is born anew, for the Errantry War is now!
The path splits. Which way, brother?

You have created new Bloodgrounds, my lord! By razing and sacking settlements in these regions you will amass Marks of Ruination. Once sufficient devastation has been caused, perform a Herdstone ritual to receive the Dark Gods’ rewards in return.
Further afield you'll find plenty more enemies to rip asunder, the forces of hated Slaanesh cower at the monolith, or perhaps seek out more of Khorne's disciples?
The living defile the lands of the dead with their presence, master. They shall be the first victims of my return to Nehekhara.
The population of this place have not yet succumbed to your rule, my lord. Take steps to spread your kind’s customs through these untainted lands.
Get ready for propa mayhem, ladz! Morglor's itchin' for some manglin'!
A foreign Hero dwells nearby, my lord. They are particularly good at spotting signs of espionage and may uncover our presence if we are not careful.
In the west they carry on, living their sadistic lives, ignorant that your vengeance nears. Soon they will fall foul to your blade or bow.
Of course, it is possible to bypass the Dwarfs and head straight for the heart of the Empire, which is ripe for plunder, but perhaps, that's a riskier strategy?
The cannons are destroyed! Yet Skollden's army still attacks the beacon. They're vulnerable from behind. Strike now, while they're engaged!
The Skaven approach, revered master. Prepare yourself!
Sooner or later, all of Norsca shall be consumed in glorious war! But the greater battle lies to the south...

Lord Mazdamundi communes, my lord, yet his words are greatly weakened at this distance. The Geomantic Web, the fundamental power network of your cold-blooded kind, must be accessed directly if his message is to be determined. See that it is done.
Avelorn belongs to you, cruel Blood Queen. The sacred shrines of Isha will soon be soaked in bloody offerings to Khaine!
Yes, Great Matriarch, there is indeed a rupture in the Great Bastion. The forces of Tzeentch invade through the ruins of the Snake Gate and have taken the Terracotta Graveyard.
Once the incursion is resolved, loftier goals can be sought to ensure the dominance of Grand Cathay in perpetuity!
Tzeentch's counter-attack has failed, yet we must assume that this is part of the Great Manipulator's plan. Resume your push in to His fortress.
Do not take these behemoths lightly, my lord, for they are no ordinary Cygors. They hurl clusters of boulders with frightening speed, and will do so with reckless abandon.
Yet these lands of the Dark Elves and the jungles of Lustria may yet still provide what the Mortuary Cult seeks. The path to the Day of Awakening!
The Phoenix and its flock protect each other. When the mother is injured, she will bless her guardians with the power of the flame. Kill her flock, then slay the childless mother!
In Cathay's ordered heartland, threats scuttle in the darkest recesses, sharpening a poisoned dagger, waiting to strike.
The Twilight Sisters, ready for anything!
The vile Skaven and their Northmen allies have seen fit to invade Naggarond in your absence, sire. Attacking from their subterranean tunnels, the ratmen have caught your sentries by surprise.
Against the hordes from the north and the monsters of the Drakwalds, Middenheim stands!

Father Nurgle grants His favour in battle, restoring rent flesh and lending strength to battered limbs, yet His benevolence must be worked for. Task your minions with finding ways to harness the blessings of the Plague Lord!

What has driven the Skaven to such a suicidal attack remains unknown. Yet it remains an affront that cannot stand; exact your terrible retribution, my dread sovereign. Let not one of them escape alive!

The malevolent whispers of the Daemon plague your inner thoughts, my lord, and with them come new targets and pursuits. Heed these dark desires and the rewards may be bountiful, or choose to ignore them until new ones emerge to replace them.
Do we have to fight these creatures? There must be another way!
The weaklings resist, but my host cannot be stopped. Nuln will be my prize; and I will take its rewards!
The Tower of Blessed Dread rests off the Mangrove Coast, but I will not linger here for the jungles are ripe for the pillaging.
Mighty Tree Spirit, the others who walk in your stead can be gifted Aspects of the Elders, granting them benefits that will improve their battle capabilities.
Itza, the sacred first city, faces many dangers. Masters bid me to defend.
Across Grand Cathay, harmony is an aspiration ceaselessly beset by evil.

Blessing of Lileath on you, my kin. We have found many Way-fragments, but more are required. I sense that other powers manoeuvre to exploit the unbalanced magical energies that permeate the world. Let us act in all haste!

Others dwell in these lands – Greenskins of the Blue Viper tribe make war with all and look to steal and loot from battle. They may well have treasures that are more than just piles of dung and bones...
The answers are hidden in the Black Pyramid, but to gain entry, I must seek out the Books of Nagash. These tomes of our arch-enemy are the key to our ultimate purpose and King Settra's grace.
The inhabitants of this place have not yet fully succumbed to your rule and methods. Take steps to quell the vile taint of corruption in these lands.
To the south, the city of Itza is a mere relic of its former glory. Yet a great source of power rests here, one powerful enough to raze an entire city from this world.
Fools! There are those who still dare to challenge my claim upon the seas?! I will not suffer this insult. I shall personally see to their suffering and demise!
Many monsters and urks dare skulk in the shadow of Peak Pass. The Templehof Vampires are such a threat. A grudge on all Zangunaz – do not let the Undead fester in their nests!
Your vicious Skaven army emerges into the theatre of war, Lord Queek. Each rat you command yearns for the taste of Elven blood. It will come soon!

You need not fight your enemies alone, for there are foreign powers who may wish to curry favour with the Black Court. Agreeing a pact of non-aggression will leave you free to focus your furious wrath upon those who dare cross the Witch King.
Those that haven't tasted power, fear it. Do not worry, little brother. Ursun guides us still.
The Bloodfather thirsts for skulls, but souls will provide my passage to Zanbaijin. The stiff-necked Dwarfs will surely put up a good fight before surrendering what I seek.
In the howling north, weakness is unthinkable, yet strength alone cannot endure. One needs conviction, hardened as the endless winter – or madness, unbridled as the coiling skies above.
Your slavers have done well, highness. The pens echo with these wretches' tortured wails! Release them, and let Death Night sweep over the city!
You have cut the Shaggoth off, my lord, but you should tread with care – Traygard is more ancient and powerful than most others of his kind.
Trust not your senses, for the intricate magicks of the Great Sorcerer reshape reality around you.

Across the straits, Elves and the accursed lizards rule the jungle cities. As you well know, much gold can be plundered here and resources gathered to further your fleet – just avoid the cursed treasure…
Nurgle's love embraces those who tread the path of the unclean…

Congratulations, my lord! Your search for the most powerful Dragons in the world is now complete, as the best of them have pledged their loyalty to you. With these mighty allies, your enemies will think twice before drawing the ire of Caledor!
The taming of this wild continent has not been without repercussions.
Raise a Dark Fortress in the ruins of the citadel… once we have an army worthy of the Twisted Twins, then we will march south!
The Grey Seers mount one final attack to seize the Vortex! Keep fighting!
Your highness, Ulthuan once more belongs to the Asur. But beware, foreign interlopers will always covet the riches of our homeland.
All work and no play makes Festus a dull doctor! The Realm of Nurgle awaits…

Although Athel Loren and the Oak of Ages are of utmost importance to your kind, restoring the great forest will require a much greater healing effort than of anywhere else. However, healing other forests will also contribute to Athel Loren’s health.
Send some warriors to meet them.

Khaine's servants threaten the forests of Avelorn, having gained a foothold on Ulthuan at the Phoenix Gate. Further still, they hold the Shrine of Khaine and the source of immense power that resides within it.
Yuri, caution is required. We don’t have walls to contend with, but this settlement is riddled with narrow passages and hidden areas. The enemy will have defences in place. Plan your attack well.
All the while, the savage muster beneath baleful forces, claiming knowledge of the future.

The Elves’ kingdom of Ulthuan is a beacon of civilisation that fans the embers of hatred burning within every Cloven One. Defiling their lands shall prove your kind’s supremacy over all things noble and haughty.
Mighty Skrag! The Gorgers have picked up a scent. There is fresh meat to be had. Follow their trail, and fill your cauldron, for the Maw hungers…
My Lord, Tz'arkan's possession of you grows stronger with time. It is important to be vigilant of its consequences and to ensure that it is kept under control.
Master, you require a larger Daemonic host if we are to dominate this region.

As the main power source of the Forbidden Workshop, Warp-fuel is critical to our research. When Warlock Masters win battles, or if Engineers successfully act against settlements, there is a chance to receive Warp-fuel canisters.

The myriad paths to the Impossible Fortress have been charted. Find the Librarian - Tzeentch's favoured Daemon Prince – slay him and take its soul. Be wary, for you must still face the gauntlet of fractal fires against waves of Daemonic minions.
We have finally found it, my lord! The Daemonic power is trapped within a Dark Elf by the name of Malus Darkblade. We need only to find him and extract it – by any means necessary!
Confound the Great Changer! Refuse to play the part He has written for you, and destroy all who get in your way!
More labour must be found to feed the forges.

You have attained full control, my lord, resulting in increased stability across your regions and higher loyalty from your commanders, as well as granting you the Rite of the Warmaster. However, greater control also reduces your battle prowess.
The Elves of Athel Loren are a rare sight, my lord. These mysterious beings keep their own company and seldom emerge from their forests. Whilst they are not great in number, cross them at your peril.
The time to make our stand is now, sisters. Isha is with us, for I am the mother and the protector of Ulthuan.

You have violated the Dark Prince's defences and defiled His palace. For but a fleeting moment, the Lord of Excess' attention is diverted to your victory. You now have all the souls required to reach the Forge of Souls. Muster your greatest force, but do not tarry, for Be'lakor awaits. Prepare for the ultimate battle!
That revolting beast of a thing Throgg, breathes no more. You are champion-eternal, my lord, for all to fear!
Many plaques hidden in lost ruins. Revered master demands we find them. The Sotek reviled Rat-spawn must not reach them.

Lord Daith, most celebrated of the Elven smiths, dotes upon you in the manner of a proud uncle. He will periodically offer to either craft you new items or upgrade existing ones previously smelted in his forge.
They may yet find their match in an indomitable Greenskin warboss, whose rampage falls first upon the subjugators of his kind.
My path is clear, master. None shall stop me finding your books; I already have one in my possession and the others are bound in your essence and so call out to me.

The Kingdom of Bretonnia is a bastion of honour and virtue against the darkness. Your brave Knights defend the realm against all manner of black-hearted brigands and foul beasts. Rally the dukes to your banner and, with the blessings of the Lady, you shall be victorious!
If Blorgar chooses to relieve himself of his vile wind there will be little escape. Only Lords and Heroes have been known to withstand his foul stench!
My knowledge of the Necromancer grows further! His secrets unravel before me; the vampire children of Lahmia shrink before my power! Bring me more!
No danger lurking in the dark will stay my immortal work!
At once, Hoardmaster. The Bear's roar has made the tribes restless. Other tyrants eye your mighty girth and are envious.
The testament of a traitor. No-one needs to see such heresy.
Advise me, as my brother once did, take me to the Chaos Realms, or suffer his fate!
To the north are more lands of the Undead. Tread carefully here, my lord, for this is Nagashizzar, location of the throne of the supreme sorcerer himself, Nagash.

The warmbloods, or 'Norse' as they call themselves, have seen fit to trespass upon your jungles once again. They seek to ransack your sacred temples and carry off the treasure within to distant lands.

Constructed defences are difficult obstacles to overcome head on. We don’t want our kin to die needlessly. However, by capturing supply locations as we find them, we can curtail the enemy’s ability to erect more defences.
Our warriors rally! Their Kislevite spirit returns. They re-join the fight.
Revered master, Mazdamundi, has sent me across the world pond. Wisdom of the Old Ones must be sought.

Felicion arranges a ritual, yet the power of many scrolls are required to undertake it. My scryers tell me that many such artefacts remain hidden within sites of great antiquity. We must reach them before the Skaven!
While Kroak’s forcefield provides him with some protection, the awakening process leaves him vulnerable to attack.
Rally a great army to your banner, for this world is ripe for conquest! Yet be sure to keep an eye on your expenditure, for any standing army must be maintained from your treasury.
Slaanesh senses your desire to slay His chosen prince. Channel this to your own advantage, not His!
The nearby Vampire Coast teems with the Undead. Purge them, or work around them, but know that greater rivals lie within the jungle interior.
Laws no longer apply. The gates are sealed and only the strongest will survive this deadliest of nights – the tortured screams of your slaves will surely return Khaine's favour!
The princes of Caledor have had much success in finding Way-fragments around their volcano, yet they refuse to contribute to the effort of stabilising the Vortex.
Elf-things sat on much Warpstone, it seems! Get more! Council want Warpstone, Council get Warpstone! Then glory for Tretch!
We must be wary of leaving our eastern flank exposed even as we look south… for hated Dwarfs recolonise Karak Dum, a beachhead in the Chaos Wastes they have no intention of losing.
Bells ring out through the lands, word of your Chivalry has reached Bretonnia with exultation. Many great virtues will be bestowed upon you.
They will serve well. We need all we can for the trials to come.
It is imperative that we gather the Scrolls of Hekarti, my lord. Through them the Witch King’s strength will grow, and no-one will dare oppose the Naggarothi.
There are two other Icons you will need to capture and so dominate the battle.
Be wary, my lord, for the Dark Elves have been sighted! These pitiless killers are as dangerous on the battlefield as they are treacherous round the table. I advise great caution.
Your key structures will bloom, flower and decay like the cycle of life and death. Once seeded, these noxious constructions will proliferate by themselves, if conditions permit.
Yet Mathlann urges caution that far inland. The Dwarfs of these mountains hoard great wealth and shall be stubborn in relinquishing it.
This road is one of the richest trade routes in the world. It is only fitting that you, mighty Greasus, should own it!
Our spears are well suited to engage the enemy riders. Knowing how best to use our forces will bring victory!
To the east of your throne lies Vaul's Anvil, Sorceress. It is a shrine of terrible and unholy power, which the misbegotten rulers of Clar Karond draw for themselves.
I will win my Vlad his throne… by any means!
Grab your blades, Druchii – there is no time for torment, just sever their lives.
The riches in the vaults of Karak Azgaraz will keep your expedition fully stocked… and what you can't spend can be eaten!
We are eager to fight. Bring us to battle!

Mighty leader of Dryads, though you have been exiled from Athel Loren, your purpose here is clear. Men of the Empire brazenly hack and burn woodlands that have stood since the Forgotten Season, heedless of their folly. Nourish the Worldroots with their blood!
The wrath of the Blood God is reserved for those considered weak and cowardly. Be victorious in battle soon lest the disfavour of Khorne fall upon you!
Now the gathered plaques have been studied, a ritual can be prepared. Our revered master compels us to participate!
For you, my Radiant, are the shield of Ulthuan, its protector and mother. Do not let Chaos usurp your rule – an eternal reign for an Everqueen!
Be wary, though, for while the Vortex is weakened the forces of Chaos will slip into this world. Ready your defences, for they will doubtless be drawn to the ritual’s power.

Your arrival at Yuatek comes not a moment too soon, great and powerful Queek. High Elves from across the seas have launched a full-scale invasion of the Southlands, and are pressing fast towards your lair!
Rise, Great White Lizard! The Children of Itza are in need of your martial might, for the enemies of Lustria encroach upon sacred land.

The insidious Skaven seek to bring their terrible god into this world, mighty lord. This must not come to pass! Continue your course of action, crush the noisome ratmen, and take control of the Vortex for yourself!

Niblet’s been badgerin’ me ‘bout these empty places, but it ain’t fun where there’s no fightin’ ta be had. Still, maybe we should go take a look anyway, in case there’s some loot ta swipe, or better yet, sumfink ta eat!
Some things are best left untouched, for they maybe cursed.
Bereft of the singular will that drove them onward, the Undead Legions crumble in their deathless carnage as colour slowly returns to life-deprived realms.\\nThe Great Necromancer is no more.
War between those within the Empire does not serve any benefit. Other Electors now look upon you with disquieted gazes.
The Morathi's spawn infest our cities, harvesting them of relics and scrolls - the legacy of our kin reaped for the traitors benefit! Drive out the Druchii scum, reclaim what they seek to take!
Other enemies loom nearby – Savage Orcs no less, who raid nearby abandoned cities. These ancient places are sure to harbour more riches, so are prime locations for colonisation.
Wissenland stands vulnerable, as Ogres and their gluttonous kin bring death to the Empire’s door.
Rat-spawn hide in fallen temples. We go to kill. Master commands we take back ruins.
Do not celebrate yet, Gerik. First we must deal with the Wolf!

These incursions, and the endless winter, have sown doubt in the subjects of your burgeoning reign. Followers of the Great Orthodoxy resent your rule – pacify such malcontents through diplomatic means or martial might.
Don't be a fool, Gerik. Do I not hear Ursun's voice? Does he not guide me?
Around you the tribes of Norsca hunger for blood, yet they fight amongst themselves. With such rich offerings beyond your borders you must rally these hardened souls beneath your banner.
The rat-spawn hide all around. A long war comes to rid our jungles of them.
Control of the Vortex slips from your grasp, my lord, for another is marching upon the Isle of the Dead! Stop them, before they can bend the Vortex of Caledor to their own devices!
Skrolk will bind Vortex to his will, and spread sickness across the world! All will succumb to the Plague Monks!

You, the Asrai of Athel Loren, live in harmony with the great forest you call home. Yet there are those abroad who would endanger this paradise, my lord. Wield the sublime fury of nature against your foes and protect this woodland against all that threaten it.

The Blood God esteems slaughter above all things, and there is no more fitting tribute to His rage than the skulls of those killed in battle. Send your offering to augment His throne and His favour will fall upon you.
The Elves' desire for power has yielded them many great artefacts, items which contain power you should harvest.
Pirates are fickle, admiral, and are sure to betray you if not kept loyal with gold and trinkets.
We will become more powerful still, we must ensure such chances are not squandered.
Follow in my footsteps, servants of Khorne. Become something eternal… something terrible.
Your current actions are quite unchivalrous. You do not display the virtues you once did.

You have violated the Dark Prince's defences and defiled His palace. For but a fleeting moment, the Lord of Excess' attention is diverted to your victory. But Slaanesh will not be the only sinister entity to have noticed... Be’lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the first soul, but three more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
Chaos will always be brought to order.
Remnants of the mortal civilisation that once inhabited these lands may still be found cowering in caves and hovels. They would make excellent playthings for Slaanesh!
The Great Mawherd of Bloodfjord does not have the vast numbers it once did, my lord! The last of the mighty herd is now just a single family, including a protective mother and her young.
The Druchii invade us in number. No doubt Malekith or his twisted crone of a mother have sensed weakness in the Vortex. Their attack is blatant; they come directly for the sea gates of Lothern.
Unity may be won by winning the hearts of the people. Gain sufficient devotion amongst the common folk and the varied kingdoms of Kislev may peacefully join your cause.
I shall return to Zharr-Naggrund more powerful than those that exiled me!
None would survive crossing its threshold, but the Gardener will come as soon as we trespass upon its outer-defences!
Your recent triumphs will give you faster supplies in due course, my lord. But the Lizardmen grow increasingly restless and hostile towards you.

Council desires I collect Warpstone, yes-yes! Perfect opportunity to look-seem like loyal servant of Council. I take all Warpstone and tell the fools I do it for them. Smart-cunning Chief Warlock Engineer I am!
In the centre lies the Palace of Slaanesh, a monument to perpetual lust, excess and debauchery.
Admiral, treasure can be found throughout the world. Solve the map's riddle and it will lead you to untold riches and wealth.
The Old Ones look upon you with great favour, my lord. Aligning yourself with one of them may prove fruitful to your progress.

This is all just a taster… a pre-show treat to the real performance… For I will dominate the beast; the Merwyrm will be MY prop to see Ulthuan’s doom. Then I will sing to the Elves and see King Finubar DROWN!
The Lizardmen attack, my lord! Their deranged quest to re-establish the order of their ancients would see them use the Vortex to annihilate the world. Drive them back!
The hordes of Chaos come into sight! There can be no bargaining with the servants of the Ruinous Powers – issue a call to arms!
Let us review what destruction the warm-blooded trespassers have wrought on your territory, enlightened lord. Select the temple-city to inspect your province.
Your infamous actions are making waves with others – they will surely fear your name upon the high seas!
The Druchii cannot be allowed to despoil the sanctity of Ulthuan. Draw your weapons, and by Asuryan's will shall we prevail!
A puzzle of the ancients which surely hides great treasure. The coloured lines around the face hold the key to solving this puzzle.
No, Gerik, the lore we need is within that maze.
You are not alone in your fight against the insidious Druchii. Other Asur houses inhabit Ulthuan; they could be allies... or foes, if you will.
Green-skinned vermin! They shall be first to feel my wrath - I shall burn their hovels and flay their worthless husks as an example to all that would trespass upon my realm!

The Druchii are fractured, yet many still know loyalty to your rule. Others, however, do not, and need bringing to heel. If they do not bend the knee to the Witch King then they should be destroyed utterly.
There are two other statues you will need to capture and so dominate the battle.
A second Old One now looks over you. There is untold strength in their guidance and wisdom.
All you have accomplished in your witless meddling, mortal-thing, is to gaze upon the fathomless depths of Skavendom, yes-yes.\\nLet it burrow now in your despair that you cannot comprehend a swarm.

You breached the Brass Citadel, a feat so rare as to draw Khorne’s gaze! Whether that is in ire or respect is yet to be known, but you now have all the souls required to reach the Forge of Souls. Muster your greatest force, but do not tarry, for Be'lakor awaits. Prepare for the ultimate battle!
Couronne, the flower of Bretonnia, wilts beneath your feet. Turn over every stable, armoury and store house in the city to learn of their resourceful and chivalric ways!
The Tomb King's deathless pursuit set in motion the downfall of that golden glory.
The Winds of Magic are weak and fickle – your power has dwindled! Be wary of engaging the enemy while so enfeebled!

The sacred plaques hold knowledge and prophecies long forgotten. The Plaque of Sotek is testament to our power, but other plaques must be sought. We must gather them to begin the Ritual of Prognostication.

Great powers the world over are mobilising for war, Prince Tyrion. The waning strength of the Vortex induces those of evil heart to fight for its control, all while the princes at court deal in gossip...
Grave tidings, your highness! The world cries out in torment as the Ruinous Powers threaten to overturn the Forces of Order.
The population of this province has grown under your care, and such growth may be re-invested in construction at home. In time, your meagre settlements may be developed into mighty fortresses of war.
Great powers may rise and fall by a few whispered words within the court of the Phoenix King. Use your influence to sway events to your advantage, my lord.
The Inner and Outer Kingdoms must unify, but beyond the shores of Ulthuan where should the mighty High Elves go? This question is put to you, Tyrion…
To the west, the White Dwarf crosses the bitter wastes, bearing grudges carved deeper than stone.

Caledor has fallen to you, my lord. The hubris of the Dragon Princes has led to their ruination by your hand. Be sure to begin the search for Way-fragments - the Vortex becomes more unstable with each passing day.

The graveyards of Praag and Volksgraad are testament to your many conflicts with the Ruinous Powers. For millennia, your kin have held the line against the hordes of Chaos – honour your customs and continue that fight.
There is much power yet to reap… no matter the price to wits, minds, or souls.
Do not delay, send us to battle!
The enemy retreats, my prince. How like the curs to flee from the glittering hosts of the High Elves! Aenarion’s blood runs thought your veins - finish them!
Southern jungles dangerous for Skaven, but waters also dangerous! Elves have land here, but I take it from them with big bang soon, yes-yes.

O Brazen One, you are chosen by the Dark Gods to be an unstoppable force of Chaos, gifted with an unholy vitality for slaughter and destruction. Go forth and wreak havoc in the world until it is awash with blood and gore!

The harsh and desolate wastes of Norsca embrace you into its cold and wintery grip, my lord, yet it cannot sustain your appetite for war indefinitely. You will need to voyage from this land to raid and pillage, your Gods will gaze favourably upon you for this. Raze in their name and align yourself with one to be granted their twisted and Ruinous gifts.
Your war cry inspires your soldiers! See how their spirit is renewed!

The Beacon is under attack. Kislevites loyal to the Motherland are within. Our army is small, but we can sway the battle if we are as wise as Ursun. We approach from the south, while Skollden's northmen assault the barricades. Their backs are to us. We should take advantage.
Much wisdom has been gained from those plaques recovered, my children, but many more are required. The search must continue, lest the warmblood plans reach fruition first.
Gates, towers, and other key locations can be captured by our troops. Drive enemy forces away from the nearby capture location then we can gain the benefits it provides.

They are Soul-Eaters, so it may be difficult to wield magic against them. Difficult, but not impossible. Like all Cygors, the brothers see the Winds of Magic through their single eyes, which causes them to be in a constant state of fury.

[[col:green]]The very presence of these emerald horrors imperils our mission, Arahan.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]Don't be so coy, sister. Just come out and say "Let's kill thousands of Orcs."[[/col]]\\n[[col:green]]What matters is cleansing the settlement of threat, not your wearisome bloodthirst.[[/col]]
As the chosen of Nagash, you surely deserve a little of the power he wielded. It is time to retrieve his mighty staff, my lord, and, through you, let the world taste his wrath!
To the south, Kislev. These men of the bear dare to rule your kingdom! Let them feel the power of the monstrous horde; destroy Erengrad and reclaim your rightful throne in Troll Country.
Fateweaver is insidious, and the invasion is only part of His plan – rebellion festers in Nan-yang's mines under the Changer's malign influence. Punishment must be swift to reinforce your authority!
With your victims lying slain on the battlefield, a new rampage has begun! Continue slaughtering your enemies, Brazen One, and your strength shall increase as a result of your growing momentum.
Further south, however, is the witch's nest. She claims the capital and defiles the once-great palace of her revered father!

More Greenskins and Skaven dwell in the mountains to the east, sire. They pose a potential future threat, while regions further south are already occupied by the Necrarch Brotherhood, sucking dry what life there still is in the desert.

You are an insatiable eater, mighty lord, and your minions are no different. Collecting ingredients and throwing them in your special cauldron can imbue you and the tribe with nutritious rewards, with more exotic recipes bestowing even greater powers.

Accumulating Marks of Ruination will pave your way to greatness and tracks the overall progress of the tribe. The more the world suffers your unrelenting wrath, the more Marks you will attain and the stronger you will become.
Those devout fools are not here. We fight in the Chaos Wastes. It is for us to use this knowledge.
My agents return, and the reports are as dire as I feared. This requires my personal attention.
Daemons of the Crimson Skull loiter in the palace that was once claimed by your master-mistress. Return it to Slaanesh.
Enemies have forever been on the doorstep of the Empire, my lord. An Elector requires aid and would surely be thankful for it, but it may be costly to render assistance at this time.
There is much to do, your highness, if the Motherland is to be secured and your god saved. Let us begin!
The treacherous wisdom of the Great Betrayer must be sought if the Black Pyramid is to be opened. Begin your search at once, adherents, for the tomes of the Usurper will be scattered far and wide.
The maelstrom has forced Northmen, worshippers of the Dark Powers, into Kislev lands. They have taken Gerslev. Slay the trespassers!

The Great Vortex is under attack, my lord. The Winds of Magic shriek and eddy about it in strange formations for a mighty ritual is underway in some distant land. The power of the ritual pulls and distorts the Vortex, yet there remains a chance to intervene.
Master, hear me. The world is in turmoil, unstable with its power ours to take. Yet others look to prevent me from returning you to this world.
A rival warlord makes false claims about his greatness in comparison to your own, mighty lord! Perhaps a conquest is in order, the better to remind your kin of the awesome power of Queek!
To the north, sire, savage Greenskins threaten to raid your lands. They defile your mortuary shrines – vengeance must be taken!
Eshin presence, exposed in ruins, spies everywhere! Filthy no-furs will plan attack now. Must not-not let them regroup!
Go forth, Madame Direfin. The sea is your stage, let the world hear your voice!
Life proliferates in the spawning pools, revered lord. More reptilian servants may be spawned into your service. Breed them now, and they will be ready to fight in the battles to come.
Your invocation draws the benevolence of the winter gods upon your people. While it persists, it brings an opportunity to win support in your struggle against your bitter rivals.
Hobgoblin scouts have shown where Greenskin tribes linger.
A foreign power makes demands on your territory! Think carefully before ceding control of your hard-won lands.
The tempest of magic roiling above grants access to spells of cataclysmic power. Use them to wreak destruction on your enemy!
The primal balance of nature is misaligned in your kingdom. Take steps to restore Harmony where it has been lost, for it is the bedrock upon which your majestic empire is built.
Old ruins hold much Warpstone. Don't let the Elf-things take-steal it first! Get it, get it now!
Fear is a powerful weapon to wield in war. Raid the lands of your enemy, terrorise the inhabitants and burn their dwellings. Let them dread your name!
The foul scent of vermin permeates this place, my lord. Do not risk the undermining of your rule by the Skaven – take steps to reduce their chittered lies spreading among your followers.
The time has come to march on Dervingard and free our kin. If you do not strike swiftly, the Wolf will recover. End his reign of bloodshed.
They know me in Norsca and they know me in Sartosa. But I want the world to know my name and my deeds!
The corrupt teachings of the Great Betrayer are powerful indeed. The path to the Black Pyramid begins to clear. Redouble your efforts, cultists, for our redemption beckons us.
I took his journal from Dervingard. It deciphers the symbols.
These lands hot, nasty, too much sand! Must find mysterious power quickly, bring back to Nightlord at all costs!
The Norse warmbloods have advanced too close to your position, revered Lord Mazdamundi. Now is the perfect time to attack. Select your army first.
What trickery is this? The gates are open – you have been sabotaged! Defend the breaches!
Kostaltyn, the Supreme Patriarch of Ursun's cult, is the instigator of this rebellious feeling. He must be dealt with. If left to fester, it shall cause a schism from which Kislev will never recover.
Your 'friends' abroad must want someone pulverised, for a contract has been issued. Fulfil it, and a sizeable bounty will be yours.

Your supremacy is now assured! There is no question that your mighty warherd is feared by all the races of the world. One final battle awaits – with the gaze of the Dark Gods upon you, seize victory and assert your dominance!

The deepest Worldroots are known as the Deeproots, which your forces can uses to travel great distances. Any army in a forest region can travel to another, but after traversing the Deeproots it will be some time before another journey can be made.
Foul Dwarfs in mountains have parts I need. Argh!!! Angry Lizards there too, worship-praise Snake God, hate Skaven. Must make dead, yes-yes, use Doomrockets to zzap-zzap!
