The land yields great riches for those that know where to look. Secure access to resources found further afield, for they may be of use to the Liche Priests of your Mortuary Cult.
Frigustrex is here for the taking, my lord! The weather is fierce in these climes, and is worsened further by the monster’s presence.
You are Settra the Imperishable and all shall obey your rule!
Squirt musk of fear, vermin, for the Headtaker comes before you! I has mission from Council itself! That how important I am-am!
Least of all, the feeble warmbloods.
At last, we have the scrolls for Felicion to commence her ritual. My son shall succeed where his traitorous kin have failed. Let us not waste a moment!

At once, Arch-tempter! It seems the Great Game continues and Khorne makes his next move against your master, for he despises the Dark Prince most of all. Servants of the Blood God surround your capital.
Go now, Damoiselle de Guerre. Lead the Chevaliers forth in the name of the Lady and let your Errantry War be written in glory!
The Great Sorcerer himself summons us to his realm. We have been trusted with a task that will bring us much favour.
Do not take these behemoths lightly, my lord, for they are no ordinary Cygors. They hurl clusters of boulders with frightening speed, and will do so with reckless abandon.
The town of Xen Wu may appear as ruins but it has the stink of ratmen about it!
Bretonnia’s legends were forged in battle. Now they lurch in death.
Even brave Ungols may waver out here in the Chaos Wastes! We must keep an eye on the morale of our warriors. And if it crumbles, so will our battlelines.

After extensive - and delicious - torture, those captured Druchii have confessed that the enemies of the Witch King attack my territory in order to gain control over the very same scrolls that we seek. All such traitors must be brought to ruin.
The Crow caws with distaste for your disobedience, and with it the gifts you once had have been stripped from you!
A prudent course of action, Warden! Every repair and improvement to Athel Tamarha's facilities will aid you in the fight against Ulthuan’s enemies.
Khorne will rage at this desecration! To come before the Brass Citadel and slay His Gatekeeper... you have made an enemy of the Blood God but are victorious nonetheless!

On the northern shores, men ready themselves for conquest in a foreign land, lured by the promise of unimaginable riches. Mired in that same foetid coast, the brine-soaked dead rise to claim souls and plunder for their cursed fleets.
The petty squabbles of the weak and feeble are contemptible to the Blood God. Spread your corrupting influence beyond your realm, for Khorne demands that all must join the cult of war!
The adventurers would not be kept by your side forever, my lord, as there is always a bigger tale that needs to be told. Fear not, for they will return.
Use your mounted troops, such as Horse Archers, to harass the enemy and pull apart their formations.
The traitorous Dreadlords of Bleak Hold have struck in my absence, annexing cities I claim and carrying off the treasures within.
My lord, the enemy field artillery against you! They will be able to strike against your forces at great range!
Mere moments are left to prove your profane book will aid my work and save Ursun, heretic!
A book of lies. Burn it.
We require more vassals. Claim or take these territories so we may erect Dark Fortresses.
Every performer needs their boudoir, a place to prepare for the next performance and rest one's vocals. The rabble call it a cove. They are uneducated morons.
The Winds of Magic howl and rage! The coming battle will be dominated by their fury!
All creation writhes in terror, as Nagash would see the world submit to holy undeath.
Whatever has driven them to such a suicidal attack is irrelevant - all who oppose the Witch King shall die!

With your latest acquisition of Sanctum Gems, you now have enough to unlock a Silent Sanctum in any known region. The Old Ones’ powers enshrined within will be a great aid in your struggle against Chaos.
I require more playthings. These thralls will do, until they bore me.
A dark whisper from the depths of your subconscious has guided you this far, but at what cost? You have been rewarded, but have also paid the price.
Your smiths may reforge enchanted weapons and armour anew. Send armaments to be reduced to their core essences, and combined to forge new items of greater magical power.
Your victory will bolster the hearts of believers across Kislev. Followers of the Ursunite Cult shall flock to the Church's cause if you summon them!
So… let us get what we came for.
Our warriors can hide behind hills and amongst the trees. See for yourself how the troops are concealed.
I am the Governor of the Jade Court! Harmony will be restored… no matter the cost.
Interpret the Tome of Fates; tell us what you believe to know, pawn of the Deceiver.
Should you cross the Kraken Sea and reach Norsca you will find many mortals to tempt and usurp.
Slaughter the mortal insects that infest this region and claim Bloodfire Falls as your own.
The Serpent hisses with distaste for your disobedience, and with it the gifts you once had have been stripped from you!

Well done, my lord! You have successfully completed your Waaagh! and claimed your trophy. Not only do rival Warbosses gaze upon it with envy, but it will also boost the tribe until you claim your next trophy.

You have obtained some Amber. Offer it to the spirits of the Elders through your research of technologies in return for their blessings. Amber can be gained by completing Rituals of Rebirth after healing forests, but is a limited resource, so spend it wisely.
Amanar! The mighty and ancient sea-beast attacks any and all, my lord, leaving destruction in its wake.
The enemy reveal their mounted troops! They have the speed to run our forces down!

Such ingenuity, my lord! Using your scrap, you have successfully improved your battle capabilities. It is the mark of a most resourceful Warboss to not waste good scrap materials, from whomever they may have been pilfered.
The testament of a traitor. He will face justice.
Yet the warmbloods pour forward in great number. Be in no doubt that your capital is gravely threatened, my lord.
I am the mother and the protector of Ulthuan.
This might be your most difficult hunt yet, my lord! You face the Abyssal Shrieker, one of the most terrifying Terrorgheists to haunt the skies.
These enemies are different from what we have faced before.

My lord, there is limited time before Ariel will be laid vulnerable to attack! She channels her power through Waystones nearby – destroying them will grant you more time to gather your strength and will weaken her forces in the final battle.
Yuri, up ahead. Some kind of shelter.
The miasma of Undeath drifts across your lands at night. Corruption is spreading amongst your followers. Intercede quickly, lest they turn to the service of some Undead lord.
It is imperative that you defend him until he has fully risen from his slumber!
Northward, the last of the Slayer Kings leads doomed warriors into battle, forever seeking the death his crown denies him.
Time and again, these beleaguered walls have barred marauders – and worse – from spilling south.

Dead-things spread dead rot in lands, spoiling precious Warpstone! No-no, will not do – all must die-die… Doom-Flayers will cut-slice them into small pieces, before feeding to stupid slave-filth! So dead-things can’t come back!
Workers are needed. I shall harvest the Orc-scum at Howling Rock.
So best beware, for you are surrounded and, if caught, these Elf-things adore torture just as much as your brothers in Clan Rictus...
I advise you to find ways to further your methods of war. Put your best minds to work on research that can improve your knowledge and practices.
Divine blessings may be earned by your kind through the act of killing, cunning lord. Lead your fellow Druchii to slaughter in battle and they will gain great favour from Khaine, Lord of Murder.

Your Imperial Authority has lessened my Lord. Your lesser lords are growing more weary of your inability to command respect within the Empire. You must be more careful when dealing with Imperial matters.
Fort Dervingard! Finally we reach these walls.
You have uncovered a new cooking ingredient, my lord! Extract its benefits by tossing it into the cauldron, or combine it with other ingredients to create more potent recipes.
And here, the Great Drill, built in secret but yet to function. There is much to do…
Sire… Witch King, Lord of the Druchii. I know to you, I am a fleeting thing - a man, a mortal - but you have received the vision. I humbly attest my advice is worthy of your majesty.

Food Merchants are mystical creatures with strange powers and even stranger cooking ingredients. She can sell you her disgusting foodstuffs or meddle in your recipes, but also challenges you to cook for her in return for great rewards.
Ghrond is well defended, but an attack is surely necessary to secure its scrolls for your own cause.
With Tzeentch’s forces scattered, I can walk willingly into the Lucent Maze. The knowledge within can lead us to the Howling Citadel.
Prepare your forces carefully. You can give them precise orders to move into better positions.

The under-vermin concentrate their movements around sites of magic, looting artefacts of great power. Skaven are pitiful cowards; they would not seek war with me without good reason. We must counterattack, and discern their motives!
The cold bites deep. The shelter is not enough.
A new augmentation is available to strengthen your units, my lord! Using certain combinations of augmentations may unlock access to other, more complex procedures.
Further north, your absence from Shang-Yang has left a power vacuum that rebels have now filled. The insolence! They must suffer the Dragon's wrath.
The Cross Clubs tribe plan to take your crown. Remind them who is the Overtyrant – destroy them and subjugate any other tribe that dares to withhold tribute!
Thus from the ashes of the Fallen City will emerge a powerful warhost, fit to drown the world in filth.
Yet both are wary of the Sword of Khaine, tempting all Elves with a power whose ultimate cost is madness.
Up ahead. An army beyond the treeline.
For to the Chaos Dwarfs, Zharr-Naggrund is no mere capital – it is the obsidian heart of their hell-forged empire.
Tzeentch prizes the use of magic in battle over primitive sticks and bludgeons. Your spellcasting draws His eye and His favour – it remains only for you to divine ways to harness it.

Master Runelord! Ancient entries in the Dammaz Kron speak of several revered artefacts long lost to the Dawi. Their whereabouts can be sought out through the Forge – seize control of these locations to take them back.

As you wreak havoc and destruction upon the world, my lord, your allegiance to your God builds. The Norse Gods are a maleficent group – stray from your master now and you will surely feel its wrath. Give yourself fully, however, and you will become their champion, marked for all to see by your pure devotion.
The Dark Lands are a haunt of acrid smog and stygian hunger, shadowed by the Mountains of Mourn. A fitting realm for the Overtyrant of the Ogres – swollen with pillage, the provender of the maw-god.
[[col:blue]]…![[/col]]\\n\\nSilence, fool! I shall summarise our situation. It is my plan after all!

Across the Dwarf-delved jungle cliffs, more rat-filth dwell in ruined cities. Clan Pestilens spread corruption and disease throughout these lands, but we shall spill their pox-ridden blood atop the sacrificial altars!
Join me, men of the Empire. Let us drive back this darkness! For Sigmar!
The map's riddle holds the answer.

The Altar has fallen to you, Lord Skrolk. Those of your kin that stood against you have fled into their burrows. Move at once to put facilities in place to begin Warpstone collection, for the Vortex is vulnerable and you must take advantage before another power does!
A sacred altar is nearby, defiled and overrun. Special place for Slann masters. Must claim and protect.
Frozen peaks and valleys of petrified wood scar Naggaroth’s bleak landscape, homeland of the cold-hearted Dark Elves.
For thralls are required, the mines always need more Labour and this new plan will prove costly.
The enemy recoils before your legions. Let them see your true power Liche Lord, extinguish them.
Further north, the peaks teem with more hated Beard-things. Manifest your obscene fury upon them, and let them discover why you are called "Headtaker".
Prepare your forces quickly, for Slaanesh's vengeance will be swift! The God of Obsession is not known for His restraint!
The Librarian is slain, and his soul captured! A mighty victory!
To arms, then! The enemy enter the field. Scamper forward and claim the hilltop, Lord Headtaker. Its slopes will serve your packs well. Keep your Rat Ogres hidden!
But a greater threat has arrived in Lustria – the plague-spawn Master Engineer Ikit Claw. He brings foul experiments from across the World Pond and is hellbent on destruction. He must be stopped.

Confronting Slaanesh's champion will not be easy, for they are found within the Six Circles of Seduction. As you journey inward, know that you will be lured by temptations beyond any your tepid imagination could conjure.
With additional landholdings comes a greater need for oversight of those that dwell there. Appoint Atamans to manage stretches of the Oblast and you will be free to focus upon the war effort.

To the north, the Coast of Araby is controlled by men of Bretonnia. Be cautious when dealing with them – they fight against the Undead, but also look to profit from these lands, as do the Greybeard Dwarfs.
A watchful eye must be kept over finances for your domain to prosper. Be mindful of your treasury, for your current deficit will run you out of funds entirely if action is not taken to correct it.
An army! Those are Kislev colours. They're allies!
Magnificent! Norsca spreads like a plague on the world with each outpost you establish. All shall succumb to the warriors of the north!
Mazdamundi’s will has been made known. You, Tiktaq’to, must patrol the skies and defend these lands for the Great Plan!
Spies within the occupied cities suggest that the Druchii are on the hunt for ancient scrolls of power. I am no Sorcerer, but this is ill news - they must surely be stopped!

You are a master of monster-splicing, mutation, and unnatural breeding, unclean one! Use your heinous gifts to bring defilement to the vile purity of the surface, shape the dregs of these lands to your heart’s twisted desires!
The insufferable Elves of this wasteland see fit to make war upon me. In Settra’s name, I shall have my legions march and choke their fortresses in sand. None shall stand against the Mortuary Cult!
Begin at the Wall of Twisted Flesh. Disperse its defenders and capture the Statue of Perfection. This will give you a foothold and grant us supplies to reinforce for the struggle ahead.
In the absence of a unified presence in Lustria, warmblood trespassers have come.  As the Great Plan ascribes – do not tolerate their presence!
I Khazrak One-Eye! Bring Ruin to man!
We fight at the Beacon. Save who we can.
The Great Game turns once more; Grandfather Nurgle is now ascendant! Now is the time to make war against the enemies of the Plague Lord!

My torturers report that the rats have made their audacious attacks on Druchii lands purely to hold them while they loot the artefacts they seek. I shall enjoy prying their twitching, dead hands away from the treasures they steal from me. We attack, now!

Tales shall be told of your Chivalric deeds for years to come! As our borders expand so our code of Chivalry spreads with it. Do not relent, my lady, for you are a beacon of light in this ever crumbling world.
Your rampage has reached new heights, Bloodbeast! With this ascension comes new gifts to claim that shall help you continue to gain momentum.

Be warned, the devious Greenskins have advanced towards Tor Yvresse in your absence! The city’s defences can cope for now, but you may want to take steps towards bolstering them or return to deal with the invasion yourself.

The artefacts you seek sit in fallen Holds or looted by men, Greenskins, and other creatures living and dead. By the cold steel of Klad Brakak, take them back, or use diplomacy to gain access to them.
The fractured peoples of Kislev must be united if they are to survive these troubled times. Unite the main population centres under your rule for the greater good of the Motherland.
The Librarian of Tzeentch still fails to present himself. Continue your advance – the Stair Maze lies ahead.
Mighty Prophet, Lustria lies plagued and ruined by the Skaven. It is in dire need of your strength and zeal.
Orcs and Goblins are not the only twisted creatures in this inhospitable place, my lord. Beastmen roam these lands, and the taint of the Undead slowly spreads from the nearby necropolis of Morgheim.
A good choice, my lord. The beast, once caught, will be quite the prize.
Research a Technology to aid our quest.
There, my lord, it’s coming – it’s in the trees! Can you see it?
Warpstone found in old places, Elf-things not know-know! We can reach it first. Get it, get it all for Queek!

The Elves of Ulthuan fancy themselves the noble guardians of this world, upholding it against the ‘lesser races’. Yet in their hubris they fail to see that their star is waning, eclipsed by those they think beneath them – such is their arrogance!
All the Motherland stands behind me.
The inhabitants of these lands worry little due to your recent inaction. Their hostility towards you has decreased.

To the north and stronger tides, the New World offers opportunities for a budding starlet such as myself; there is treasure, spoils and an ignorant yet keen audience. If I cannot sing for the Elves of Ulthuan then I shall dazzle their dark kin instead!
So begins my conquest of Rot and Ruin!

Your kind are known for its backstabbing ways, mighty lord. Yet there remain some hapless fools abroad that will be lured by your honeyed chitterings. Agree a pact of non-aggression, and begin sharpening your knife for when the time comes to break it!

The malevolent nature of the Tree Spirits who lead your forces is accentuated by their accompanying Spites. These mischievous nature-spirits grant benefits and abilities to the Ancient Treemen whose cracks and hollows they inhabit.
I come for you, creatures of the night. It is foolish to think the jungles can conceal your presence from me.
Madame Cylostra, your voice reigns supreme at the Monument of the Moon, yet others are still to hear your performance…

The devious Grey Seers sought to bring the Horned Rat into this world behind your back, mighty lord. Yet their treachery has been repaid – the glory they wished to steal from you shall be rightfully yours! Continue your course of action, and summon the Horned Rat yourself!
And at its centre lies the Mansion of the Plague Lord. The great, sagging edifice where Nurgle himself works to concoct His greatest poxes.
The Eagle shrieks with distaste for your disobedience, and with it the gifts you once had have been stripped from you!
The jungle nexus grows, my lord. See that the horde draws from your great strength and recruits the most formidable warriors.
We must advance and combine our strength. Select your own unit in order to re-join your forces.
Advance with all your warriors at once! Or you risk becoming overwhelmed!
Fortunately, there are allies to be found on our borders to the west and south. Foster alliances with the Empire and those Kislevite tribes who have always been loyal to your bloodline.
The masters of Naggaroth sit idle in their towers bar one; Morathi's pets, the treacherous Druchii of Ghrond. For them, pain awaits.
Bringing him down will be no easy feat! Swarming him with several units at once may not be the best course of action.
The monuments you build shall grant you the powers you require to sustain your armies. Construct more facilities in the cities under your dominion to diversify the forces you command.
My master-mistress summons me back to the dark realm. For there are Elven souls to render. Delightful!
You have fallen victim to the infection of cowardice. Go and wallow in defeat. Remember, without the Daemon Prince's soul, the Forge of Souls cannot be reached.

Oversee this new Season of Rebirth, twin champions of the Asrai. The lesser races pollute, defile, and wantonly take from the forests, causing an imbalance to the Weave that must be righted. Punish them in Ariel’s name and return the forests to full splendour!
Education in the matters of statecraft is available should you desire it. There is no shame in the pursuit of wisdom – the rule of a kingdom is no trivial matter, especially in such troubled times.

The time of brooding is over, sire. Now is the moment to execute your plan, for the Age of Resurrection is upon us. The Great Necromancer shall return with you at his side – rally your legions and sweep aside any who dare challenge the Liche King!
On the eastern coast, the High Elves hold the Dark Elves’ incursions at bay, as both sides hone the blade of their ancient hatred.
Greatness in battle may only be reached through rigorous training. Even the most skilful of generals must practice their craft.

Your allegiance grows, my lord, and can be strengthened further still as you raze further settlements and erect monoliths in their place. Build upon this bond and ascend beneath your God's gaze. The riches of the Old World are at your mercy – feast upon them as you would a suckling pig!
Too enter the Fortress unbidden would be a mistake, but piercing its defences will suffice to summon the wrath of the Librarian.
The Phoenix Court is a hotbed of intrigue, and there are those who would try to use current events to turn the populace against you. Take steps to quell the unrest.

The clamour of sycophants has increased since agreeing a pact of non-aggression, my lord. A trade agreement with your new 'friends' may now be possible. Let your merchants flourish, for industry drives war.
Your forces struggle without you leading them! Join the fight, rally your troops!

The Druchii despoil our beautiful cities. Do they not know they rend at their own souls with such vandalism? This is more than just wanton destruction, they steal Asur relics and lore. We must banish them back to their frozen land.
Eternal vigilance is required, my liege! Three more targets have been marked by Loec. Their lives must be extinguished.
...and beyond the Bastion are such, sweet souls – plenty for my needs in the search for Zanbaijin!
Give the order and we'll build the camp.
My paramour calls. But what gifts await me in His realm?
The Icon of Blood has fallen! Prepare your position, for a counter-attack will surely come!
He will help us. Dervingard will be restored.
Next, I require an abode. I will turn the Red Fortress to a dark one.
The terrain conceals the enemy's movements, Yuri. Keep an eye or they will be on us before we are ready!
The Greenskins have come knockin', Maneaters!
Priests of Asaph rejoice, for a third book of Nagash enters my possession! Those that stand before the Queen of Lybaras shall fall!

The shrine-city is yours, Sorceress. Once word of your attack gets back to Clar Karond you may expect a response, I'm sure. For now, be sure to begin your search for the scrolls you seek. The power of the Vortex dims further.
Nightlord Sneek sends me to scorching sand-place, arghh! Find-seek great source of power here in-in Southlands, must steal-take, return with it!
While others rely solely on brutality to conquer, the followers of Tzeentch have more subtle means.
Use the hills, valleys... and stranger formations of this accursed place to your advantage. The terrain can conceal our forces.
A second book of your wisdom has been found, master! I wield its power in your name, Great Necromancer - direct me, and I will seek out yet more of your knowledge.
The Lady guides me far from Lyonesse, her light a beacon of hope and honour in an arid land of death. Let the people of these lands know my name!
Astromancy may be used by your cold-blooded kin to divine the movements of the enemy, revered master. Your keen senses can make you nearly impervious to surprise.
Be warned that while the Elves are defeated, they are not destroyed, and may seek to attack again. Move now towards your city, my lord.
The Waaagh! has amassed! Every army under your command is now accompanied by additional mobs who will follow your hordes into battle, but only for the duration of the Waaagh!
More rebels infest the mines ahead. Bolster your legion with loyal warriors who rightly revere you.

The reptiles are not all native to these jungles, the aggressors seek mastery of the territory in order to further their collection of artefacts. We must deny them the control they seek; our ritual must go ahead as planned.
A Dark Fortress raised upon their hovels will remind them who their true queen is – and the strength they could wield if they lay themselves at Khorne’s feet!
Adherents of Khorne are skilled at making enemies. Should you need to regain the favour of the Blood God you may call forth combatants from the surrounding tribes.
Lead me to the dying god, or it's your sorrow I shall savour!
The world is a stage, darling, and this region is MY stage!
Yet the High Elf Teclis stands defiant in the present, obscured from the Fateweaver who covets his soul across the Churning Gulf.
Lustria teems with life. Yet I bring only death, and when there is no more blood where will you feed, Vampire?
My crew are loyal, even the dead ones given to me by Father. Yet these Vampires have their own agendas. I had better test their loyalty or throw them into the salt.
Be cautious where you step in this putrid domain. Nurgle's realm is a garden of bloated flora and fauna desperate to spread their infected spores.
Across the spine of the World’s Edge Mountains, forges burn low in the twilight of the Dwarf empire.
Pathetic! You were no challenge for Khorne's servants. Remember, without the Daemon Prince's soul, the Forge of Souls cannot be reached.
I will not rest 'til all who threaten Yvresse are buried.
Khaine! I stand before you seeking the pleasures of war. Blood will flow and I shall bathe this ravaged body anew.
In the jungle interior stands a Golden Tower of great power. Many of the plaques that you seek may surely be found there, mighty lord.
The Great Plan is clear, yet the young races defy its wisdom. As Master of Skies, it is my duty to remove them.
Further north, many great cities now lie in ruin, still rich with antiquities. While many others are but mere cesspits that your audience now calls home.
One of your units has become unstable due to receiving too many augmentations! This will cause it to degrade during battle, after which it may be beneficial to recycle it.
Our allies fire down upon Skollden's army! His forces scatter!
Unleash your Frost Maiden's arcane power! Use her spells to secure victory.
The power of Khaine courses through your veins. A word of caution: remember the curse it laid upon Aenarion. Stay focused or you will sacrifice your sanity to the Sword!
Now you have the attention of the Blood God – His forces approach from all sides! Prepare your defences!
The storehouse is ready. The supplies are safe.
Other children nearby. Need help. Great Plan demands.

You have successfully cooked your first recipe! The benefits of its unique combination of ingredients will wear off once the cauldron is depleted, but a new recipe can be prepared at any time to replace the current effects.
Might and magic are mine to command!
Those who dare defile Ulthuan shall see neither mercy nor future.

The annals of the White Tower tell of how key Waystones were shattered and then scattered across the land during the Sundering, when the Vortex was first attacked by the Witch King. We must seek these Way-fragments if Loremaster Talarian is to remedy the Vortex.
At once, mighty Reaper. The whole region is awash with heads that will easily be parted from their necks.

The Galleon’s Graveyard is my ocean realm, from which I strike at the mortal world. First, I need to slay these High Elf fools who insolently encroach upon my empire. Once they are dispatched, I shall gather my strength and take their homeland for myself!

The Sword of Khaine has been unleashed into the world. However, another has secured it for themselves. Its power cannot be trusted to them – should you get the opportunity, strip the Widowmaker from their grasp!
Slaanesh's counter-attack is defeated! You may continue to the Falls of Frolic. Surely His vainglorious Courtesan will show herself there?
Mutiny is afoot, admiral, teach these dogs a swift lesson.
But Astragoth is absent from the capital, having taken residence upon the Zorn Uzkul.
Chivalry and honour are only words, my lord. Alas, the cold sharpened blade of steel is what counts in war. The Lady's chosen ones kneel before you in their final moments.
Disharmony flares across this region. Bolster your army with more loyal warriors.
At last, Settra awakens – mightiest and cruellest among them, his hubris unabated by the grave – resolved to restore his birthright by drowning the continent in blood.
Every true Kislevite knows: suffer not the Daemon to live!
The ratmen have come for you again, my lord. A coincidence, perhaps, but let us remove this inconvenience and continue on with vigilance.
Across the Great Ocean, Khaine's servants threaten the heart of Ulthuan. They control a source of great power, one that, if claimed, can twist minds and bestow untold strength.
Relations may be strained with your son, the Witch King. Yet the idle tongues of the Black Court have no reason to doubt your power. Crush all that you survey!

Dervingard is reclaimed. Now we embark on a greater quest. Deep in the Chaos Wastes stands the "Citadel that howls". Within its halls lies a hidden portal that leads to my prison. The Citadel cannot be reached by mortal means – the Screaming Chasm prevents it. Journey to the Lucent Maze. Find the secret runes. They hold the knowledge you seek.
You will of course be aware that armed forces cost currency to build and maintain. Be sure to keep watch on your finances, lest ruin overtakes you.
Such effort deserves a blessing, but where to next? I hunger and the Cathayans that cower in the Turtle Gate would provide nourishment...
The Great Mawherd of Bloodfjord does not have the vast numbers it once did, my lord! The last of the mighty herd is now just a single family, including a protective mother and her young.

Once the squatters have been removed, it would be wise to reestablish contact with your home of Karak Azul, where King Kazador has ever sought your counsel. A formal accord with him will be invaluable in the trials ahead.
You have drawn the Blood God's gaze, make sure you are worthy of his attention. Let the slaughter begin!

Every healed forest brings strength to Athel Loren and the Worldroots that reach out from the Oak of Ages. Thus you must ensure the mighty Oak not only endures, but flourishes so that it may continue to send its lifeforce to the forests of the world.

You have gained some Growth Juice, my lord! It is concocted from the bodily extracts of your defeated enemies’ cadavers and fed into the Growth Vat, where abominable things are grown. Over time, Growth Juice gradually increases in quantity of its own accord.
Wary eyes turn northward, for the absence of the Everchosen bodes ill…

We have worked diligently to find the Way-fragments that shall expedite the Vortex’s restoration, but there can be no resting on our laurels. Other powers sit upon places where we know more are located, places we must claim.
Those who withhold the books of the Usurper meet ruin at my hand! Yet still his unholy monument offends my magnificence! Find those tomes, servants! Your indolence angers me!

Word has spread. The tribes hear of my exploits. A Kislevite who subjugates Daemons and emerges from Tzeentch's labyrinth.\\n\\nWhere before they would have ridden out to crush us, now they send an envoy and some piffling tribute to try and buy my allegiance. Gerik urges caution, as usual, but I could turn this to my advantage. Dominate these lands, not just with war, but with words. \\n\\nThrough such base diplomacy, I can further my quest to find Ursun. All I need do is accept their gift.
Not everyone needs such persuasion… The settlements further along should easily fall into your talons through physical might!

Your accumulated Growth Juice has allowed a fully-grown pack of monsters and minions to form within the vat which you can now claim for swift recruitment into your armies. However, collecting even more Growth Juice will allow the growth of more powerful monster packs.
But who will be the first to taste my poison - the Lizardmen perhaps?
The Elector Counts, nay, Karl Franz himself, is a most opportune target for manipulation, impersonation and destruction.
Servants of the Dark Gods… Daemons.
Chosen of Sotek, the time has come to complete the largest sacrificial offering yet in the Serpent-God’s honour. His invocation shall bring doom to the perfidious rat-spawn that remain in Lustria.
Your haunting performances deserve a far greater stage, my lady. After all, only the finest is good enough for the world’s foremost prima donna!
Those infernal Raki thought to challenge you and steal what is rightfully yours! They were no match for you, but it is unlikely this will be the last you see of them.
Ursun woke me to keep this world safe. I intend to do so!
Yuri, the defenders need our help. We must reach them!
And there, the Great Bastion of Cathay. By your design, underlings of the Changer have already taken the Snake Gate and infiltrated the Dragon Empire.
We keep them safe. Build a storehouse.
The Lady looks upon you favourably. Bretonnia rejoices for your courageous acts.

The Prophecy of Sotek is unfolding. Your fellow Red Crests follow you, mighty prophet, but the Slann Mage-Priests are yet to permit the Saurus to aid your crusade. Prove your claim as the Serpent-God’s chosen to earn their support.

As you gather your forces, the Tome of Fates ponders a way to return to the Chaos Realms. Your form remains malleable, so use this to your advantage and wield the Legion of Chaos. A prince will become a king, and then a god!
In the forests far north of the oblasts, an ancient Kislevite outpost sees activity once more.

O mighty Slaughterhorn, this is the greatest rampage the world has ever suffered. The most powerful gifts possible shall be granted to you – none shall be able to oppose your unstoppable wave of death!
Assert your dominance over the seas and expand your crew even further, Corsair King. None can challenge your armada of Black Arks!
There's much to do… much to do… Then get on with it!
Be'lakor sends his Soul Grinders to retake the Engine – arrange your defences!
And here, the site of Ironhand's intent – the Great Drill stands, but is not operational… yet.
In the desolate valleys below, the Greenskin flood may plunge all into final darkness – driven by a warboss whose cunning far surpasses the crude brutality of his rivals.
Once the desert is yours, The Tower of Ashshair shall come under your dominion.
Experiments, ratkin, set-ready! Fight for Moulder clan! Fight for THROT!
Good! Now, issue an order to engage the enemy, my lord. They are scattered and not prepared for an attack so soon.

The water highways of Grand Cathay are its lifeblood, conducting commerce and fuelling growth from the highlands to the major cities. Redirect the Winds of Magic to the Celestial Lake and the rivers it feeds will bloom.
Whether as pawns or as Daemon-fodder, nearby Beastlords and Ogre Tyrants might also play a part in the Changeling’s schemes.

The cities of the Kislevite man-things await subjugation, but be wary, for they wield considerable military power by virtue of their vast lands. Make use of your Growth Vat to strengthen your monstrous ranks before attempting an attack.
Your enemy has failed to contain your advance, my lord. Strike against them once more, and crush them utterly!
But not all are enemies this far north. Allies can be found in the proud city of Praag. They have had their fill of heretics and deviants, so will welcome your sermons and scrutiny by the Orthodoxy.
The Wolf's main pack advance on the beacon!

Various clans seek us out for special contracts, my lord. Completing one of these will increase our reputation with them, making the troops they provide more affordable, but will also anger the targeted clan.
She is a resurgent power, who like many here must rise to the ancient strength of the Southlands and dictate its fate – or succumb to it.

This settlement has yielded more than just its hovels, Beastmaster! Another beast has been acquired and added to your Monster Pens. Other enemy settlements may also harbour rare creatures – you need only to occupy them to claim your monstrous prizes.
Yuri, you have led your kin through the mountain pass. The winds of the Chaos Wastes howl with unmatched fury. Journey north and seek respite.
The books shall be mine, and so will the Pyramid, for I am Settra the Imperishable, I do not serve, I rule!
[[col:green]]Then for the future of our people, we must commence the cleansing, sister.[[/col]]\\n[[col:fabulous_pink]]For the Weave! For Ariel! For Athel-Loren! [[/col]]
Ratmen have always infested the Warpstone Desert but the god's roar has emboldened them. Destroy these Clan Eshin pests!
My lady, Bretonnia has existed under a Chivalrous code for many years. Though you are far from home, honour this tradition and lead the Knightly Orders forward, to glory!
You now have Grandfather Nurgle's full attention! Defend yourself, for the attack comes from all sides!
Ulthuan is befouled by the presence of these green degenerates. They have already overrun Southern Yvresse – I will not sit by and allow them to continue their spoliations.
Da Paunch is baaaack! Had a bit a time off, but enuf rest n’ re-coo-per-ay-shun, now Grom is ready for summore fightin’, lootin’, n’ most importantly, eatin’!
Further south lies sweeter prey... mortals who worship the Ruinous Powers. Inflict upon them pleasure or pain – as is your wont!
Upgrade the Flesh Laboratory whenever possible, my lord.
There are many cohorts of Lizardmen who will aid a Slann of the Second Generation, although some have misinterpreted the Great Plan and may be hostile.

Further afield are ancient ports once under Asur control. We could reclaim them for better communications back to Ulthuan, but must be wary that these deserts are the realm of Undead kings who would sooner go to war than have us annex their lands.
About the savage Steppes circle the servants of Ruin, sorcerous vultures worrying at the viscera of their tangled schemes.

Zhufbar is critical to the success of my machinations! Send the Grey Seer on a Kill-Stab Masterplan to prepare a force against the beard-things – they will join my army and I'll overwhelm their walls!
To the north, beyond the ruins of your hated kin, Teclis resides within the Star Tower. Teach him a lesson for straying too far from home!
The Tower of Blessed Dread rests off the Mangrove Coast. But I will not linger here, for the jungles are ripe for the pillaging.
Beyond Kislev, lies the Empire. Its bickering states of power are ripe with treasures. Take from these soft southern lands and establish new ports on their shores, from which you can raid further.
Do you think as I? The slave pens run near empty. Let blood be spilled this day for all Druchii to savour!
Sooner or later, everything ends up in the Great Maw.
The Altar of the Horned Rat has been cleansed, Krakenlord. Construct facilities at once to enable your search for the scrolls you seek. I sense that the Vortex dims further…
You will need such allies, for it is on the other side of the wall where the threat is strongest. The eternal siege continues, for the Dark Powers are never sated!
You may have heard of me. I am Sigvald the Magnificent, the Geld-Prince of Slaanesh.

First fings first, I gots ta let those Arachnos gits know da Goblin King’s ‘ere, no better way than ta take da stragglas’ strong-‘olds. If they’s got a problem with it, I’ll just have ta make giblets out of ‘em!
Before we can hope to take the fight into the Chaos Realms themselves, we must bring harmony back to Grand Cathay. There is much to do.
Beware the Lizardmen's champion of Itza – Gor-Rok, the Great White Lizard, sent against us. Add him to your illustrious list of bounties.
But beyond the plateaus to the north, the serpent-blessed warrior queen, Khalida, cares only for restoring her dynasty.
Start at the Ruined Fort, defeat its garrison and capture the Icon of Ruin. This will give you a foothold and grant us supplies to reinforce for the struggle ahead.
Rat Ogres, my lord! Hurry them into battle, for they are sorely needed!
A Hero has enrolled in your service, my lord. Be sure to put them to work - their unique skills may solve problems that no amount of money or effort would otherwise be able to crack.
Sudenburg encroach upon these lands, ambitious Empire-men who are also far from home. Expect them to raid the deserts for treasure and gold as they look to gain the favour of the Emperor.
While wise, your Ataman will seek your counsel from time to time. Be sure to offer your guidance where necessary.

Your malign kin are cold-hearted and merciless, mighty Lord, bereft of pity for any so unfortunate as to cross your path. The merest word of your approach is enough to cause lesser beings to flee. All shall fall to the Dawi-Zharr!
Khorne smiles upon blood spilled in His name, yet His blessings are hard-won. Task your minions with finding means and ways to harness His rage to your benefit!
The enemy were not prepared for your arrival, my king; now is the perfect time to attack! Select your army first.

Yea, da loot was good, but the fightin’ was betta, we had us a right good scrap! Then Blacktoof went n’ lost ‘is head, and all da boyz packed it in, da gitz! That grim ol’ pointy 'ead finks 'e won, but it’s time to show ‘im that Grom is still da best!
These so-called guardians are no more. Make use of this time before they regroup and hostility rises again.
A pirate indeed, admiral, for your actions speak ever louder as your infamy grows.
The weak shall toil for us, the rest shall die!
They pour forth from the mountains and should be stopped at all costs.
Well done, my lord, you have completed your first mission. Clan Eshin's notoriety rises once more!
To the west, Beastmen gather in the forests and woods, looking to strike out at the men of Estalia.
The more skulls you take, the easier it will be to enter the Realm of Chaos and seek the dying god. So… let the blood-harvest begin.
Your standing grows within the pantheon of Chaos, and the Ruinous Powers offer gifts that may transform your very being. Choose wisely from among them.
A piece of the Empire falls this day. Others have looked to you to protect the Empire's borders but they now begin to lose trust.
The cur runs, yelping for his Dark Gods. He fears your strength and returns to Dervingard.
Are you the hunter or the hunted?

Your cold-blooded kind are the true guardians of the world, ancient lord. Yet the younger races care little for the designs of the Old Ones. Deploy your ferocious warriors and wield your most potent sorcery – you shall impose the order you seek!
Trespassers defile the Motherland within sight of your capital's walls. Act quickly, and cleanse the nation of these intruders!
I shall perform for the Dreadlords, for alliances - no matter how fleeting - can be made… but if they do not applaud, I’ll simply take their realms!
Upon its blood-strewn ground, armies of Daemons clash in gladiatorial contests of unending slaughter.
There are two other crystals you will need to capture and so dominate the battle.
It will not be without consequence.
Great Poxmaker, an opportunity presents itself to collect more Dwarfen specimens and find out the cause of their frustrating resistance to your concoctions…

You have enough Warp-fuel canisters to put towards a new upgrade, my lord. Take some time to browse the different research divisions and their available upgrades before choosing a new part to develop.
Across the Sea of Claws, a would-be challenger lies in wait aboard his precious ship. Devour him, and do as you wish with his marauding warriors.
The scent of weak and sickly flesh drifts on the wind. The time to spill the mortal blood is upon you! To war!
Be sure to put your Oathgold to good use, my lord. The Forge allows you to craft unique and powerful equipment or mighty runes to bestow upon your most favoured warriors.
You have done well, my lord! Your efforts in quelling the grievances of your kin are being celebrated across the Clans.

You have established a foothold here, but do not rest on your laurels, for Ariel will not reside in Naggaroth forever. You must disrupt her ritual by capturing or razing the settlements containing her Waystones, each of which serves to strengthen her bodyguard.
The foul Dark Lord, Arkhan the Black, terrorises our nearby brethren. The Liche King is a dire threat to us all; our help may be needed to vanquish him.
We, the Asur of Nagarythe have fought with our broken kin for millennia, but now is the Season of Shadow... and I am its king.
Battle is upon you, mighty Witch King! Your Elves are vicious and deadly, but the Skaven have a death frenzy upon them and will offer you no quarter. Prepare your forces for murderous bloodshed!
Those who serve Bretonnia can swear themselves to a solemn vow of duty. Choose a Pledge that will benefit the Lady the most in return for her blessings.
Council commands a ritual – one to ruin stupid Elf-things' Vortex! Such a waste of precious Warpstone, but I must listen to Council’s demands. For now….
The Emperor is grateful for your service, Captain of Scouts, for your elite force represents the finest of the Empire. Go forth and bring civilisation to the savages!
Clear out these green maggots, my plan must be enacted!
Silence! A wealth of power lies in wait within these lands. All shall be harvested before my return to Naggaroth and to my master. I will have my reward!

My beloved Drowned - loyal stagehands and understudies - will need fresh material. For that, we head to the heart of the jungle, away from Stromfels and into the realms of the cold-blooded ones. A difficult audience.
Let’s give Gork a show - get smashin'!
The internal politics of the Empire are never easy my lord, but this is an opportunity to show other Electors your might.
My plagues are as my heralds and the worthy have heard my call.
This is contrary to the Emperor's wishes. Ensure that no other settlements are lost, for reinforcements will not be forthcoming.
Your forces are ready to storm the defences, yet I advise caution. You face an entrenched enemy that has had time to prepare – be wary!
Send the agents of Eshin out into the world, Deathmaster. With the Weeping Blades in claw and tail, you are but a creeping rumour that will cause all to fear the shadows!

Possession of the Circlet of Iron is key in gaining control of the Vortex, Your Majesty. But it must be imbued with ancient power. The hags of Ghrond might be willing to divine the location of such a crux, should you meet their price.
To discover more about the Daemonic power, Eshin must dispatch its best agent. That means you, my lord, for this is a crucial mission that only the Deathmaster can undertake.
Obedience is becoming a problem here. Visit your wrath upon those that inhabit this place, or appease them with trinkets – subservience to your rule must be unquestioned!
Keep in mind that you will likely have to fight more than just the Brood Queens themselves. They will undoubtedly have their ravenous hatchlings ready to release and attack!
One final Pledge now awaits. Once completed, it will be proven beyond doubt to all across the land that your servant is the pinnacle of Bretonnian Chivalry.
The remnants of long-abandoned cities may yet yield uncovered treasure. Send armed forces to search such ruins, my lord, and great riches may be yours.
With the acquisition of the master hunters, you have built up quite the formidable fighting force. Wulfhart's Hunters are truly the elite!
The Dragon with Two Tails brings great turmoil upon the world, my children. Its wake disrupts the Great Vortex - the heart of Ulthuan is exposed!
I see it Bloodfather! Zanbaijin’s glory shall be mine, and the world shall be yours!

Great prophet, the Serpent-God Sotek demands Sacrificial Offerings before he can manifest at full strength. By marking captives for sacrifice, offerings can be made unto him to grant a variety of rewards.
Disloyalty is a dangerous trait – you never know when a mutiny might occur.
The skulls of the vanquished are highly prized by Khorne, your God and master. Butcher your enemies and you shall gain many such tributes to the Lord of Murder!
It is a hostile place, Tretch. Grow Clan Rictus, spread and harvest Warpstone before the enemy know you are here.
All salute you, admiral, for you are the most infamous of men, women and beasts that roam these seas. You are the true Pirate Lord.
The Witch King Malekith rules this realm, though his true ambitions lie in reclaiming his birthright in distant Ulthuan. Yet dangers lurk closer at hand…
Their general is wounded, Yuri! Take advantage while they are unable to lead. No mercy!
Leave it! We have no need of Dark Magic.
Ulthuan’s ruins are a reminder of our cataclysmic history. The victims of the Sundering shall never be forgotten. The artefacts that remain in their desolated cities may help us still.
Hmm, useless dead-things, sands their home. Lizard-things in jungles too, both good prey for assassins to sneaky-stab and gather information!
Across the bay, the Blue Vipers loiter in the jungles to the south. They are a menace and one that should be vanquished before they befoul the realms with their stench.
The Great Game has turned once more, as the Changer of Ways always knew it would. The Raven God is now ascendant! The time to strike His enemies is at hand!
Grom’s Broken Axe tribe are the dominant power in this region. Be sure of your strength before taking them on, and be wary of leaving Tor Yvresse exposed before embroiling yourself in war.
To the east, the icy mountains harbour the Dwarfs of Kraka Drak. They mine great treasures for themselves, but all of this can be yours for the taking or for the Gods.
The Fire Mouth is a sacred site. Claiming it by force or bribery is a powerful act and shall give you a base to expand westwards.

Other heads of the Hydra high on my list to slay reside within these frozen fortresses. They scheme to control the Vortex, which grows unstable. If other Asur will not deal with this then the Isle of the Dead must come under the rule of the Shadowlands.
Fighting to the last, the Blood Voyage has fallen with Khaine's name on their lips. Convenient then that the spoils of their raid should fall to you…
Though your rapid return brings some welcome additional forces, the situation remains grim. See for yourself!
As it always does, the Sword has returned to Khaine's Shrine. Perhaps this is for the best, or might there now be an opportunity?
And here, the Great Drill, built in secret but yet to function. There is much to do…

The Druchii seek to hold our cities while they pick them clean of arcane relics and scrolls. The puppets of the Witch King must be driven out and the treasures they have taken reclaimed, before they are put to evil use.

You, the Druchii of Naggaroth, bring slaughter and cruelty on the lesser races in the name of your Dark God of Bloodshed. Master the arts of sorcery and savagery that come so easily to your merciless kin, and all the world shall be your prize!
The sacred lands of inner Ulthuan are no longer controlled by the Asur! Retaking the fortress gates must be a priority. From there we can seize back control of our lands from the enemy.
Queen Alarielle, Most Serene Majesty. Your radiance shines brightly, even though the darkness is now upon us.
You may switch between your aspects as the battle demands, celestial majesty. Strike against your enemies in Dragon form, or use your human guise to empower the troops.

A number of chambers and totems sit in disrepair within the Silent Sanctums due to millennia of neglect. By restoring these features, their power can be channelled into your local cohorts to help deal with nearby threats.
Your rival calls upon the gods, and they begin to sway the support of the Kislev people against you. Be sure to respond in kind.
Further to the east, an even more despicable threat lurks: the vile ratmen of Hell Pit. If we are to welcome Ursun back to the Motherland, such abominations must be purged!
Even the most formidable war leaders need guidance on the nuances of statecraft. Mastery of such matters is the first step on your road to conquest!
The Skaven approach, Nakai. Prepare yourself!

I do not trust the soft southern mages of Hoeth! Yet, this Talarian speaks some sense. When the Vortex was first attacked by the Witch King during the Sundering, key Waystones were shattered and strewn across the world. We must collect these Way-fragments to repair the Vortex.
The time is right to move on Vaul's Anvil, but be sure to prepare your invasion forces thoroughly - the Elves will fiercely resist a strike against so sacred a site.
Allegiance, my lord! The bite of the Hound can be felt on the icy winds – all shall fear the frenzy that is to come!
Neighbouring Tilea is a source of great wealth and resources, seizing or raiding these settlements will strengthen your fleet for greater voyages.
Admiral, a nearby island may gift you an advantage in seeing off this foe.
Corruption spreads before me, with Al Haikk at its heart. All shall be freed this day from its dark embrace and the dead’s endless march halted once and for all!
Will you savour the tastes of ecstasy with me?
A Storm of Magic rages across the sky! Your Sorcerers – and those of the enemy – will have access to unlimited power!
Across these howling sands, zealots and crusaders alike march in pursuit of Nagash's grimoires – some to plunder their secrets, and others to see them unmade.

The lands beyond the walls of the nine circles are rife with specimens to test your handiwork on. The Dwarfs’ short limbs and simplistic anatomies may offer little to your Flesh Lab, but their cadavers can still be harvested to further your experiments.
They howl for Skollden. A wounded animal.
The soul energy of vanquished enemy Lords and Heroes energises your Daemonic forces. Yet beware of sapping their power through the loss of your own leaders.
Your warriors may perish, yet their spirits are eternally bound to your service. From the Realm of Souls, the power of those that have fallen in battle continues to assist those that remain.
And what if they don't submit to us?
Then, to Norsca… fertile ground for warriors to help turn the Urfather’s gaze. Here my Dark Fortresses shall dominate those who survive the coming plagues!
Having completed their journey in the company of the expedition, this hunter will be ready for anything now.
[[col:magic]]Purge the Witchwood's darkness, restore its ancient glory, strengthen the Weave, etcetera. You handle the details, Naestra. I'll handle the slaughter.[[/col]]
The Skeggi flee before your awesome bulk, Lord Mazdamundi! It only remains to decide the fate of those captured in battle.
He is strengthened by the power of raging storms that can cause significant damage! Something brews in the sky overhead…
The enemy routs! Do we let them retreat? Or run them down?
The taint of Undeath festers in this place, my lord. Take steps to reduce corruption spreading further amongst your followers, or they may turn against you to serve a new master…
The land of the Lizardmen lies in ruin, conquered for the Empire.
Westward, rebel banners threaten the length of the Ivory Road, while the Warpstone Desert gnaws unseen at the mind of its guardian.
Yuri, caution is required. We don’t have walls to contend with, but this settlement is riddled with narrow passages and hidden areas. The enemy will have defences in place. Plan your attack well.
No-fur cities nearby. Stupid man-things not know we’re here, yes-yes. Steal-take what we need from them! Easy!
Your newly-gained armament is magically bound to a number of companion pieces. Combine all parts of the suit and its bearer will wield great power indeed.
Great Plan of the Old Ones must proceed! Death on those who oppose it!
Salutations. Have you come to pry? Good. I thrive on such attention!
The Galleon's Graveyard gives you great strength, but raw power has no loyalty. You should ensure no other can find their way to this ultimate well of power.
Welcome back, mighty Skarbrand – the exile returns!

Tor Yvresse is your ultimate prize, but do not be hasty! First build up your strength and follow the guidance of your Shaman’s head before making the crossing. The Warden will be waiting, protected by the Mists that blanket his realm.

The Loremaster's first ritual looms. My warriors have gathered many Way-fragments, yet more are required. We must act as swiftly as Loec's dance, our dark kin are collecting scrolls for their own rites. They will not beat us again!
Such turmoil brings opportunity, yet it seems, my son is not alone in seeking to bend the Vortex to his will.
No longer can the Dark Lady of Nuln tolerate the Undead scourge. Their impending destruction shall be a warning to *all* who threaten her realm.
Your clan is the dark menace that lurks unseen, warlord. You are masters of concealment and deception, and the oblivious fools that dwell above ground shall all come to know of your power in time!
It is driven by Dark Magic, and will attack with its disease-ridden teeth and claws. It may be difficult to get close to the flying abomination, but killing its minions may weaken it!

The forces of Kislev are close at hand. These frostbitten warriors from the northern edge of the world pride themselves as the hardiest of all the kingdoms of men. You may get to test this claim soon, I sense.
Council sends me on secret mission-task! Must secure territory in Skryre's name, but the dead-things are in my way! First make dead-things die, then make all-things die!
Altdorf, the city of the Reikland Princes, falls, my lord. Turn over every palace, arsenal and college in the city to learn of their magical and military ways!
Cling to the elation of your hollow victory, wretch!\\nBut know that I, too, draw strength from the fallen.\\nAnd as long as I walk the earth, all creation remains damned!
Though Hag Graef remains under my control, the Witch King has dispatched me here to gather the Scrolls of Hekarti... I must quieten my mind and let nothing distract me!

Kurnz, once a Boyar of Dervingard, now a Warlord of Chaos, marshals an alliance of tribes dedicated to the Dark Powers. They will stop at nothing to prevent me from taking the Howling Citadel. The Chaos forces surround us, I must fight.
Lustria has ever been a trove of forgotten lore. Yet its reptilian guardians jealously hoard such knowledge and rarely welcome trespassers.

You now rank amongst the greatest champions of Daemonkind, held in high esteem by the Ruinous Powers. Continue on your path and you may choose to Ascend, permanently aligning yourself with one of the four Gods of Chaos, or as an Undivided Champion of all!
Defilers of Dervingard. What fate do they deserve?
Khorne's Gatekeeper! This is the Daemon Prince whose soul we seek.
Alas, this treasure remains well hidden.
I can see you are eager to begin, Feculent Brewmaster. So, let us conquer in Grandfather's name!
So you see, your grace, we have many heretics to slay. But be ready, for when the time is right we shall fight our way into the Chaos Realm itself!
Yet, perhaps it is wiser to seek out more underlings and establish Dark Fortresses along the Eastern Steppes, bolstering my Ecstatic Legion.
The Rat-spawn hoard plaques wrenched from ancient temples. Lord Mazdamundi bids us to strike. Recover sacred artefacts and discover enemy trespasser schemes.

Grave news, my lord, for a traitor in your midst has turned against you. A subordinate has broken away from your rule, and has convinced a portion of your armed forces into following them. Such flagrant treachery cannot go unanswered – muster your forces, and crush them utterly!
Beyond the northern watchtowers lurk the savage tribes of men, petty worshippers of the Dark Powers. Their ceaseless attacks upon your realm must end with their annihilation.
Queen Khalida, let the power of Asaph envelop you – bring justice to all and vengeance to your enemies!

It is a wonder that the shards of Waystones are scattered as far from Ulthuan as these deserts. The ancient ruins of this land must not be overlooked if we are to aid Loremaster Talarian in restoring the Vortex.
Hail Master Mutator, Lord of Hell Pit. The loathsome creations that inhabit the labyrinthine tunnels of Clan Moulder’s stronghold await your command!
I, Tiktaq'to, Master of Skies must protect what is rightfully ours before all perishes from our ancient lands!

Yet the shadow of a tyrant darker still looms from the Black Pyramid, implacable in his ageless task to subjugate creation. Ascended beyond mere lichedom into peerless necromancy, Nagash would see the world kneel before him.
Savage Greenskins threaten to raid my lands in the east. They have defiled my temples before, I shall ensure their extinction!
Man-things close by, yes-yes. Attack in silence, cover tracks. Quick death, they shall have!
That's it! The necessary Way-fragments are secured, and I sense that Loremaster Talarian stands ready to commence the ritual. Let us begin…

You have exhausted the opportunities for destruction in these Bloodgrounds, my lord. Before you move on to new lands, you should first perform a Herdstone ritual and reap the rewards of your bloodshed.
The more the world suffers from my maladies, the more capacity needed for my otherworldly rewards.
Cold-place full of *other* Elf-things too. Angry Dark Elf-things. Pah! Just mean more food-flesh for Throt! Then big meal! Queen-meal! And me be free-free, AT LAST!
Warpstone found in old ruins, reptiles not get there yet-yet! Search ancient places, my brood - find Warpstone, claim it for Pestilens!
A fifth tome has been secured, my adherents. The great power of the Lord of Undeath courses through me; our return to Nehekhara is at hand. Come, adherents - the Black Pyramid lies open!
We hold captives. Their fate is mine to decide. I pray for Ursun's guidance.
Let him come. He will find us stronger than before.
Hail to you, Slaughterer! Your mysterious Iron Hat has compelled you to march out from Troll Country into the mountains, in search of richer lands to despoil.
Be wary, for your rival has raised much support against you! Take urgent steps to rally the Kislev people to your cause, or look instead to undermine your adversaries through less fair means..
The Overgrown Path has yet to fall. Push on, and take the fight to Nurgle's champion!
The Blood God's servants hem you in, Bejewelled One. Strike quickly!
The Undead kings are a paltry threat, but for the Vortex’s sake we can take no risks. Driving them from their tombs will not be enough – we must claim their nearest necropolis.
Relations with foreign powers may be managed through diplomacy. Even the most ferocious of conquerors would do well to master the art of negotiation.
My Nordlander brethren stray far from home... they and the other Old Worlders will all soon be rotting cadavers reaped of their souls!
Defeat, my lord! The Vortex slips from our grasp! Let us retreat and regroup!

The local Goblins have been lax, allowing the feeble men of Ostermark to secure a foothold here. Drive them out, and their remaining lowland provinces will be yours for the taking, as will all the realms of men.
Your Daemonic kin are empowered by the Winds of Magic blowing strongly across the skies. Their energies course through you!
Brutish Orcs and vile Goblins gather along the coast. Their savagery will not protect them from the blade in the shadows. See to their removal.
Fear the shadows... fear my name, Alith Anar!
Yet above them all looms Archaon, Everchosen of Chaos. He alone can forge this howling discord into one blade.
You are Aenarion reborn, my king! All that stood before Nagarythe have been put to the sword and silenced for good.
The power of the seas can now unite as one and curse Wulfhart's harpoon with the strength needed to fell Amanar.
The Elf-things not suspect of-of rats on Naggaroth, ha-ha! No-furs build their things where Warpstone lies buried-hidden! Take-capture no-fur cities! Smash them down! Claim Warpstone for me!
Death Night is over, my queen, but in the aftermath come the gore-stained survivors. Overtaken by the madness of Khaine, these Blood-Voyaging warriors are intent on continuing their rampage!
Nowhere is this age-old strife more bitter than at Karak Eight Peaks, where malign hordes vie for the prize in the deep – even as gromril-clad vengeance draws near.
In the meantime, you should unify the Druchii, through either statecraft or by destroying would-be opposition. All will bow to the Witch King; all will yield to Malekith!

Ghrond has fallen, my lord - the depraved followers of the Hag Sorceress now bend their knee to you. Nevertheless, be wary of a counter-attack. Be sure to erect a shrine as soon as can be, in order to gain the scrolls you seek.
Strive for balance in all that you undertake. In unsettled times it pays to maintain Harmony amongst the competing forces of nature.
We must follow the path north. Find shelter.

The fears of lesser men must not sway you from the righteous path. You have shown courage. Now, be as brazen as the altar you seek. Enter the lands of Khorne, the Blood God, conquer them, and raid his shrine. Discover the name of the Bridge-Maker.
The hills and valleys of this place conceal the enemy's whereabouts, my lord. This hilltop should afford a good view over the surrounding area.

Disease and decay are the primary weapons of your foetid kin. Those fortunate enough to survive battle with you will return and spread your contagions amongst their own kind. Such is the Plague Lord's bidding!
The Great Game turns to favour Slaanesh! Inflict yourself upon His rivals, for now they will know true pain!
We must use all means in our rise to dominance. Find us lore to make certain our authority is unquestioned!
The forest may be used to conceal our movements. Close with the enemy under cover of the trees to retain the element of surprise!

Bretonnia rejoices for your actions, yet evil still lurks in every corner of the world. Many look to destroy the Forces of Order, and their power grows as quickly as our own. Stave off their advances through yet more Chivalric actions!
Nowhere is their struggle more bitter than the ravaged north, where their Dark Elf kin wage an ageless war to wrest back their birthright.
Further along the pass lie ruins. The Tome of Fates tells me that Skaven hide within. There isn't much flesh on the vermin, so you must slay plenty to fill the cauldron.
At Lustria’s northern throat, the Isthmus strains between Naggaroth’s malice and the sacred geomancy of the jungles.
Many are the vultures circling the fading magnificence of Ulthuan. Yet so long as Tyrion and the Everqueen endure, the High Elves remain unbroken.
The shadow of the Black Pyramid lengthens – and with it, the reach of Nagash.
Strength and purity can still be found in some men of the Old World. Forming bonds with the dukes of Bretonnia will strengthen your position when protecting Ulthuan.
You are one with the Sword of Khaine. Its power consumes you and your every thought. These bonds are now for all eternity and with them, a curse of brutal strength and endless torment!
March to Dervingard. Liberate the stronghold.
Your noxious garden bears more fruit as it grows in size. Seed more cyclical structures, and Nurgle's minions will be available to summon in greater numbers.
The Age of Man-things… or Elf-thing… or Reptile-things is over-dead! Now is the time-time of the rat!
Where Asur sails cut azure waters, the ruthless Sea Lord scours the coast, as others fight among the ruins for the defence of the world.
Your time beckons, Alith Anar. Cut the heads from the Hydra and with it, bring an end to this eternal war!
But take heed – the Treemen of the forest will not sit back while we attack! They will try and save their monstrous champion, just as it saved them in the past.
Perhaps it is better to go north? That is where the forces of Chaos gather. Daemons desperate to scour Kislev. We have a chance to head them off and ensure they never set foot in the Motherland.
Yet these jungles do harbour the grandest of stages; Hexoatl’s great altar rises higher than any other. Take it from the Lizardmen – such ingrates do not deserve to hear you sing!
Your exploits in Ruinous destruction can be used to gain the servitude of savage horde leaders and ruthless champions.
The greater my goodwill, the greater the pain I hold in store!
Fearless and daring Lord Fellheart, your presence here in the lands of Lustria will reap you great rewards, ready to ship back to Karond Kar.
The host will be strengthened once they kneel before me.
The Courtesan is slain. You have defiled the very heart of the Dark Prince's realm to claim your prize. Take it before your army is lured into the Palace, from which no being ever returns!
Zharr-Naggrund, the centre of power, but another grows to challenge it. For in the south lies the Black Fortress.

The blessings of Slaanesh fall on those who bring him captives taken willingly or otherwise in battle. Yet the Prince of Pleasure teases his benevolence – put your minions to work on finding ways to appease the Lord of Excess
The God-Bear roars in pain - a death-rattle felt across the dimensions! Its arcane energy rips across the mortal plane, creating rifts and scarring the world with gateways into the Chaos Realms.
Gates, towers, and other key locations can be captured by our troops. Drive enemy forces away from the nearby capture location then we can gain the benefits it provides.
A fine choice indeed - gods-willing, this state will now be governed well.
Your dedication to the Old Ones has grown again, my lord. Many temples are now protected by the Defenders of the Great Plan.
Ritual must be done. Master says Great Plan requires it.

The Plague Lord's mansion has been sundered! The God of Decay begrudgingly concedes your might, and you now have all the souls required to reach the Forge of Souls. Muster your greatest force, but do not tarry, for Be'lakor awaits. Prepare for the ultimate battle!
Skrolk! Harbinger of Pestilens! You do not need eyes to know you are deep within Lustria – your Plague Monks have infested the very heart of the Lizardmen lands.

But an immediate threat resides within these craggy mountains. The Red Eye Tribe, a vicious horde of Greenskins, sack and pillage the halls of your mighty kin. And they now dare turn their beady eyes on you, my king!
Your minions begin to crumble! Pathetic!
Every skull that decorates this deck adds to my legend! Why should I not take yours...
Temptation, lust and gluttony abound in this realm of desire.

Beyond the jungles lie the barren deserts of the dead. You will find no allies here, and the mountains are not hospitable to your kind. Yet they will need to be crossed if you are to join your Geomantic strands to the nodes in Lustria.
Khorne's Gatekeeper! This is the Daemon Prince whose soul we seek.

There is no word in Khazalid for forgiveness, and the growing number of grudges has the Clans stewing with discontent. Wandering Slayers are now more likely to help right the wrongs committed against the Dawi.
The Elf-things that march against us-us shall pay-pay! Eshin Spies say-say pointy-eared no-furs steal Queek’s treasures - we take-take them back! All things are Queek's!
But while their hearts remain divided between Ice Queen and Patriarch, their vigil cannot.

Yet in Karaz-a-Karak, mightiest of all holds, the torch of hope has not yet guttered. Rather than break beneath the weight of the Great Book of Grudges, High King Thorgrim rallies a waning race to renewed reckoning.
You have lost some momentum, but this minor setback should not hinder you for long. Once you set your sights on another target for slaughter, your rampage shall be back on course.
Not every settlement requires labyrinthine schemes to usurp ownership. More direct and savage action can still get you the best results!
Seizing this region is sure to reward you with many Plaques, mighty lord. Attack and claim it for the Great Plan!

I said its name. The skies rained with blood as a Greater Daemon of Khorne emerged from the Screaming Chasm. Great wings carried it over the edge and the ground shook as the Bloodthirster landed beside me.\\n\\nSkulls dropped from the sky. Each one screamed in agony as they fell into the chasm, forming a bridge.\\n\\nMy brother approached. Loyal Gerik, he trusted me when others would not. Protected me when others could not. He feared the Daemon.

You have recovered all the parts needed to restore one of the ancient artefacts, my lord! Use the Forge to make it whole again and harness its power. Be on guard, however, for skittish eyes will surely look upon your prize with gnawing jealousy.
You have quite the map collection now, admiral!
Sons of Ulthuan - pupils of Hoeth - we do not come upon this place lightly. The world is in dire peril, and it falls to us once more to save it.
Contact with foreign powers is established through exploration. Send your agents to survey beyond your borders and they will bring you knowledge of realms ripe for conquest!
Your occupation forces gain control over new lands, my lord. Further conquest in this province will grant you complete dominion over those that exist there.
Then we pray to Ursun for protection, if he can even hear us.

You need not fight your enemies alone, my lord, for there are foreign powers sympathetic to your cause. Agreeing a pact of non-aggression with a foreign leader will do much to build trust between you. Trade relations or a military alliance may follow.
Master says Geomantic Web is weak. I must lead army and rebuild Web. Conquer province is first step in Master's plan.
The living green tidal wave of destruction crests, ready to sweep over your ill-fated victims! Choose your mark and a trophy shall await you in their capital to claim once it is razed or occupied.

You have chosen to pledge allegiance – the Gods will be pleased. Their favour towards you grows! Keep their gaze upon you by erecting further monoliths in their name and reap the benefits they bestow.
Extra meat rations are a powerful incentive for any force of Ogres. Should you have a surplus of meat you may offer it prior to battle to motivate your warbands.

The Asrai are pretenders, Briarmaven of Woe – it is time to show that your kind are the true sentinels of the forest. Punish your enemies, bring life back to the woodlands, and bloodshed to those who dare oppose you!
They will aid our search for Ursun. Those with the heart to fight, let them join us.
Word has reached those in hiding. They return to us.
The desert kingdoms to the east are controlled by the Tomb Kings. Death does not hold these unrelenting creatures back, but they bicker with one another which can be used to your advantage.

You have made it your personal responsibility to help reclaim the Dwarf Empire of old, Thorek Ironbrow, and your efforts may yet herald a new Golden Age. In time, none shall dare defy the ancient might of the Dawi!
The jungle stirs. Reptilian eyes watch the trespassers. A cold-blooded fury rising to punish the invaders.
Fame is all! But during my time within the depths, THEY have forgotten me; the name of Madame-Captain Cylostra Direfin has been lost… but no longer! My audience awaits!
Me want see-see how nasty Elf-things work. Cut open, take best bit-bits, make many-many new beasts! Take-hold city-place, have big supply of nasty Elf-thing parts, yes?

The herald of an ancient, powerful Dragon has appeared nearby, my lord. This is most fortuitous, for you have long sought to commune with such a creature – in fact, it is the very reason you roam outside of Ulthuan.
Build a camp. Then we can rest.

But they are all mere distractions, I hunger for more; the power of the Black Pyramid! It stands, guarded by a sentinel army, and behind magical bonds that can only be unravelled by owning Books of Nagash.
Stop the vengeful Dwarfs from slaughtering them! The calves are especially valuable; if they are tamed and trained, they will be a great addition to your army.
I yearn to journey back to Khemri, past the bestial hordes that war with us and across the cold mountains harbouring a dark, chaotic magic - as unsubtle as it is destructive.

The armies of the world march upon the ritual site, my lord, for there is still time to prevent its fulfilment. If you cannot intervene in time, however, there may be the opportunity to hire more local forces to strike on your behalf.
The second Shanty is now yours to command – its strength coupled with the first will strike a mighty blow! Yet to summon the Merwyrm a third must be first discovered…
There are crews out on the open sea that are famed for their skills; to recruit these powerful monsters and dead men you must seek them out and bind them to your will.
Meanwhile, the states of the Empire constantly jostle for recognition in an uneasy coexistence. Karl Franz seeks to strengthen his position by dealing with threats to his court.
The trespassers flee. They are warmbloods - it is to be expected. Finish them!
Man-spawn invade. Itza territory wanes. Temple-city must not fall.
We have taken a critically strategic point of this settlement, but we must still defend it.
My lord, we have enough Warp-fuel to research even more complex parts. Some of these advancements may be costly, but will be worthwhile to keep improving our war capabilities.
The enemy are in retreat, mighty lord! The power of the Vortex is in your hands! Use it wisely, for others who seek to control the Vortex converge upon your position!
To the south is the baleful Plaguelord Skrolk. The Skaven are a common enemy of you and the Dwarfs, but it remains to be seen whether the Dawi will march from the safety of their mountain Holds.

This Felicion is no ally of Morathi… yet I should be wary. There is a connection between her and Har Ganeth I have not unravelled yet. In the meantime she requires Hekarti's scrolls to power rituals that will dominate the Asur Vortex. A worthy price to see Ulthuan sink!
Our position on Ulthuan’s eastern coast is a perilous one. The mists provide us some measure of protection, but to adequately fulfil my guardianship of Yvresse, complete control is needed here.
You need a strong powerbase before you can re-take Shang-Yang and invade the Realm of Chaos. Owning the province of Jinshen will grant you such a platform.

This settlement is yours to do with as you please, whether that be the establishment of a camp to recruit and build from, or to devote it to one of the Gods by razing it to ash and ruin, gaining their favour and gifts.
While I bolster my fleet for invasion, the shores of Araby offer other delectable targets, whose riches I will gladly take.
