I have been robbed! My chance to perform for the Phoenix King, stolen! But I WILL have my audience. My star is in the ascendant and the world shall hear me sing again!

Hail, mighty Slaughterhorn! I pray you spare me in this rare moment between rampages, as I wish only to guide you to your purpose. Clar Karond’s Beastmasters have surely been alerted to your presence – show them the true meaning of 'untamable'.

It would seem that your achievements have gained you recognition with the Council of Thirteen, my lord, for they have requested that you build your forces for a purpose as yet unknown. Yet be wary, for you have many rivals who would sooner see you sent to your death than gain further glory.
Your dedication to the Old Ones can be measured here, my lord. Each can bestow a variety of benefits for you to make use of, should you gift them enough temples.

The Witch King’s Sorceress Felicion requires Scrolls of Hekarti for her rituals; though I find myself distrustful of this woman I shall do as Malekith has commanded and aid her in this search. These lands are sure to be filled with these artefacts, one just needs a keen eye and a taste for treasure.
Khorne looks favourably on those that fight with skill and courage. Honour the God of Rage with victories in battle to gain His blessings.
Lord Mazdamundi requires plaques to complete his ritual. As Master of Skies, I am the swiftest means of finding them.
The followers of the Dark Gods grow in ever greater numbers. To do nothing will see your power diminish further!
For the jungle will forever be the Wanderer’s dominion.

My spies report that Felicion requires the power of many scrolls in order to fulfil her ritual. Such artefacts can still be found, buried, within ancient sites of power. We must unearth them while our treacherous foes remain ignorant of their existence.
The army is recruiting new units.

Further south is the Dwarf stronghold of Karak Azorn. It should be cracked open and its riches added to your own, for we will require immense wealth if you are to hire the best Ogres to invade the Chaos Realms!
Marauders of Chaos also roam these lands, often hidden in the fierce ice-shard storms.
Always survey the terrain prior to battle and position your troops to gain an edge. The enemy gave battle so the onus is on them to attack. Use this to your advantage!
Yuri, we should position our troops to best take advantage of our assault. Drag out your formations for the best effect.
First, establish a capital – this will alleviate the attrition from which you currently suffer. Your new fortress is all but complete – claim and dedicate it to one of the Chaos Gods.
Behold, Prince Imrik! You have arrived at the Plain of Bones, ancient graveyard of the Dragons, to honour their dead and seek the wisdom of those still roaming the world.
It is within Canopic Jars that the remains of the dead are preserved, and to which their souls are eternally bound. Seek out more such artefacts, for the essences they provide can prove useful.
And in the southwest lie the lands of the Empire – weaklings who have taken Kislev's protection for granted. Perhaps it is time punish the ungrateful, or see if they are willing to be converted?

Offer vassalage to subordinate warlords, and you agree to extend your protection in exchange for their fealty. Their pride may not recover from such humiliation, but they will at least live to speak of it.
The Tower of Zharr-Naggrund - the dread city where all wealth and sacrifices flow.
Lords and Heroes gain experience as they serve your cause. Be sure to guide their development to your advantage.
Warriors learn more in ten minutes of frontline combat than in ten weeks on the training field. The capability of your combat units will grow each time they have contact with the enemy.
Vermin encroach, daring to block the route between Hanyu Port and Shang-Yang! Remind them what a craven race they truly are!
Your place is amongst the warriors. Your presence grants them courage before the enemy.
It is a gift I'm reluctant to accept, but if I am to face Elves, then a preternatural edge is needed...
Yuri, fellow Kislevites enter the battle to support our attack. We should join with them and surround the enemy.
The enemy draw close, my lord! Be sure to have your troops arranged for battle. Employ all that you have learned; wear them down with missiles, pin them with infantry, then hit them in the flanks!
Beyond the mountains, the pastures of Bretonnia meet with the forest of Athel Loren. The Wood Elves are friends of none and sit idle, protecting their 'mighty tree'.
Battles are fought between armies of fighting troops. Your forces may be eager and ready to fight, yet only through your leadership may your troops gain victory.
Send word, Gerik. We rest there.
See that much of this area lies under your control. Complete the acquisition of this province and you will gain complete dominion over those that exist there.
We have scoured the past… foreseen the future – the present belongs to Tzeentch.
The enemy break from the fight! Press your advantage! Destroy their weapons of war!
The blessings of Grandfather Nurgle are the wellspring of all growth. Increase His influence in the territories you control to gain His fruits in abundance.
Your mighty Tomb Blade lies dormant, my lord. It requires a powerful soul to feed its hunger, and become an instrument of true power. Perhaps it is time to seek a suitable ‘donor’ for the task…
Its arcane energy rips across the mortal plane, creating rifts and scarring the world with gateways into the Chaos Realms.

Your strength grows, mighty lord! You can now spread more despair across the land by raising a new horde and erecting multiple Herdstones for more Bloodgrounds to hunt. New horde buildings and units are also now available.
Other dangers lurk to the north, where greater hardships breed even hardier men of the Wolf and winter… and the fury of Boris Todbringer simmers in hatred for the Beastmen he vows to break.
Put your Skinks to work on improving your methods of warfare, my lord. For this task they will need even grander edifices.
Dark Fortresses shall symbolise Khorne’s hatred and rage, commemorating and foreshadowing His dark glories.
Everyone thought I woz done for after da punch up with da pointy ‘eads, so now I gotta remind all da boyz who’s boss. First I’s gonna smash these runty spider-Goblins, beat ‘em all in ta sub-mish-un!
The long-limbed cretins are ever prepared for invasion, with much of Ulthuan heavily fortified – particularly their ostentatious capital, Lothern.
For too long have the petty warlords of Naggaroth been allowed to defy your will, dark Sorceress. The time is now to remind them, and the world beyond your shores, of the awesome power you wield!

The Palace is within reach. Go there and slay Slaanesh's favoured Daemon Prince, the Courtesan, so you can claim their soul. Protected by waves of Daemonic consorts, this is another gauntlet you must face.
What's that? There, in the trees…
Only those who display a natural aptitude for murder may serve in the Blood God’s Warbands.
Your arrival has caught the 'Elf-things' by surprise, Lord Queek! Now is the perfect time to attack. Select your army first.
Elusive Deathmaster, your enemies here are oblivious of your presence. Use the knowledge you have acquired from the east to secure these lands for Clan Eshin.
A Dragon has appeared nearby, my lord. It appears to be of a lesser ilk than some of the more ancient specimens you have encountered, but still has much to offer should you choose to approach it.
Master, you awaken a truly powerful Bloodline to serve you. Recruit its Lord to your side from the settlement.

Your military might is dominant in your alliance. Such is your strength that you may soon be able to intimidate your allied warlords into a confederation. Such an agreement would see their kingdom dissolved and permanently added to your own.
Traitors and opportunists seek to wrest your crown and claim the mantle of Overtyrant for themselves! Defeat these pretenders!

The foul taint of the rat-spawn once again takes hold over Lustria! Only the mighty Sotek can purge the plague-filth once and for all. To fulfil the Great Prophecy, we must first sacrifice the vermin that infest this place. Then we can recover the Sacred Plaques within!

The cold-blooded beasts of the Lustrian jungles draw near. Be wary of the Lizardmen, my lord, their motives are often hard to fathom, but the ferocity of their warriors and the sharpness of their claws are in little doubt.

At the fringes of the Empire, however, there is no time for petty political squabbling. Few men wield more powerful magic than you, Supreme Patriarch. Show your enemies the true extent of your arcane might!
Relations abroad have blossomed since agreeing a pact of non-aggression, my lord. A trade agreement may now be possible. Let your merchants flourish, for industry drives war.

You need not face your enemies alone, for there are foreign powers who may be sympathetic to your cause. Agreeing a pact of non-aggression with a foreign leader will do much to build trust between you. Trade relations or an alliance may follow.
Those who stood in defiance of the perverse force and prevailed etch their name in glory across the realms.\\nThe Vermintide is stemmed.
Beware, my lord, for the Skaven infest these ruins! Legends told of mighty burrows hollowed out by the ratmen beneath ruined cities – it now seems that these legends were true!

Libraries, when constructed, invariably attract great collections of books from all corners of the world. Tzeentch is said to smile on such centres of learning, for the knowledge He craves may be gleaned from the Grimoires within.
I have communed… I have foreseen… The land speaks to me.
Time will tell whether Karl Franz can unite the provinces and hold them from the brink - or otherwise let monsters inherit this grand realm.
Tomes of great lore lie hidden, scattered throughout the Daemonic and mortal realms. The secrets they contain are highly prized by the Raven God – unearth them to gain the favour of Tzeentch.

The ungrateful inhabitants of this place agitate against your rule, despite your victory over their former masters. Take steps to repress or assuage those whose lives you generously spared, for dissent left unchecked can fester into revolt.

By campfire light, I read the journal to understand why Kurnz abandoned his duty?\\n\\nBefore he left Dervingard, he made forays into the Chaos Wastes. He fought enemies and even gained the allegiance of  tribes. He called such feats "the trials". They allowed him to navigate the hostile lands.\\n\\nIf I am to survive here, I must perform these trials. The journal tells of great rewards if I do.
The beast's lash leaves your settlement in devastation, admiral, I fear it may return to strike further havoc and carnage.
There are myriad monstrous threats in this place. Just to the north are Savage Orcs – these cretins should be hunted down lest they become a greater menace.
I see the Beacon. The fort is under attack.
Make fresh victims, tallymen! May the bells and gongs toll…
Your recent inaction has lowered the Lizardmen's hostility towards you. Should you continue to sit idle, however, the Emperor will send supplies less frequently.
The Old Ones shaped this world, and for too long have their designs been ignored. Their Great Plan must be fulfilled, Lord Mazdamundi, no matter the cost!
The nearby dunes are tainted by the scourge of the Vampires. For all that is good and holy, drive the creatures of the night from these lands.
Find me skulls, little man, or yours is next!
Beware the Great Maw, for the Ogres mistake this pit for a god. Yet even further south you shall find more enemies eager to invade.
The Lady wills that these lands be purified of the Undead menace that blights it. Thus we will litter the sands with the black, charred corpses of our defeated foes. Onwards, for the Lady!
Maintain harmony amongst your forces, even in the most chaotic of battles. The defenders of the Celestial Empire fight best when they fight together.

Your time spent in the Realm of Chaos granted you Visions of the Old Ones, enabling you to foresee Chaos activity around the world and instantly travel to their locations to pre-emptively thwart them.
The Fateweaver returns to the roost, always part of our master's plan.

Dervingard was built to defy the Dark Powers and prevent another Great War Against Chaos. But the stronghold has fallen into ruin, blackened by those that defile its halls. It has become the den of the Wolf.
Ruins of ancient Kislevite forts should be re-taken, but the Orcs bar your way. Make war on the Greenskins and wipe them out!
The leader of Ursun's cult, Kostaltyn, musters a force to enact revenge against you, meet them head on and harvest their miserable lives to power your own vengeance!
Isha cries. Her tears stain the world. Peace evades us, and I will not stand idle - the Everqueen strides beyond Avelorn's borders.
Devotion is low amongst your people. Their malaise has let Chaos into their towns and villages. Now, the forces of the Ruinous Powers mass against you from within!
Here in the Galleon’s Graveyard, the raging power of the Maelstrom makes me all but untouchable. Only a fool would dare challenge me here!
This is a day to strike many grudges from the Great Book
I travel far from my throne, not merely to end you, creature, but for the Books of Nagash. The knowledge they contain will grant me strength over Neferata!
The enemy are holed beneath the waterline, admiral! Sustain your fire, and you may crush them entirely!

The Waaagh! is the will of the boisterous and belligerent brother-gods of the Greenskins, Gork and Mork. Calling one in either of their names will bring their favour, be it brutally cunning or cunningly brutal!
You have captured some monsters of war, mighty Beastmaster! Your aptitude in beast-taming is unmatched, allowing you to add specimens to your Monster Pens to instantly recruit into your armies.
The shifting sands to the east are full of death. Those that dwell here are neither friend nor foe, but they carry a plague of Undeath which must be prepared for.

Have you come, little morsel, to bask and gape-drool before a tide that defies all stemming?\\nBreathe deep now the Warpstone dust, as it builds up beneath a flood of a thousand thousand ratmen feet – unquenched, renewed, and ceaseless – and know your squirm-scrambling has all been for nought.\\nFor I have gazed beyond the Veil, and into the future.\\nIt is a pall of fur-filth drawn over the corpse-ruin of the surface.\\nGnawing on it. FOREVER!
Impressive! Your bond with the Crow grows stronger – the wings of Norsca prepare to smother and suffocate the bountiful pickings on offer!

While across the sea are the lands of former opulence which now lie in ruins deep beneath the sands. And yet, the tomb robbers haven’t stolen everything… there are still plenty of treasures left to plunder.
Infest the rest of this region, Great Brewmaster. It will become the putrid hub from which all your diseases shall spread!
The elusive Radixashen waits, in protection of the Oak! Now all that is needed is for you to trap the flying beast and slay it!

Your cage enables you to temporarily trap a foe in the midst of battle, Warden, holding them still and rendering them vulnerable. Should they be wounded while encaged, they will be taken prisoner and held captive in Athel Tamarha after the battle.
Lord Kroak will be an invaluable ally in the fulfilment of the Great Plan, but his worldly relics are in imminent danger.
The ground is red with blood.
The Librarian is summoned! Execute Tzeentch's favoured Daemon Prince and steal his soul!

Not all Electors are always self-serving - some act with the best interests of their subjects at heart. A count has come to you with an offer of confederation for mutual benefit. Be wary that this will require quite some Imperial Authority to achieve.
This is not Kislev. We learn what we can!
Improve your skills, Yuri. Choose one to gain advantage.
The morale of his raiders shall fail, the rout begins!
At last, the Dark Master appears! Muster your remaining strength to face Be'lakor!
You were gone for some time. Where were you? I was worried.
However, in the north, a crew abandons your command. See them flogged for their lack of loyalty and send a clear message to all would-be mutineers!
See how the enemy scurries away from your might! Show them no mercy, prince of rats - finish them!
There are two other Trees you will need to claim and so dominate the battle.
Hmmm… souls to sacrifice, gifts to take!
The deterioration of your mind is still the greatest danger to your empire, my lord; the time has come to intensify efforts to restore your fractured psyche.

Above all, Athel Loren must be your final goal, for the Oak of Ages will surely wither in the meddling hands of the Elves. Instate yourself as its true guardian and make them rue the day they trespassed upon your sacred home!
On the periphery, the treacherous wastes herald a sandstorm of the Undead. They may become a nuisance, but how you deal with them is for you to decide.
Yuri, we must fight this cur! The way we deploy our army is often key to victory. Position them over here!
Long have I led the great host of Caledor. Now the Phoenix King has sent me to the Southlands to help restore the Great Vortex created by my forebear, the great Caledor Dragontamer.
One of your followers has gained experience and their skills may now be developed accordingly. See for yourself!
But the Seafather hasn't sent me the Undead merely to infuriate the Elves, for there are riches to gather on the coasts of Araby…
Allegiance, my lord! The pecking of the Crow can be heard over the cry of battle; all shall be befouled before it feasts on their decaying flesh!

The prophecy has been fulfilled! The final sacrifice can now be performed before Sotek grants his ultimate blessing. Completion of his Great Sacrifice will enable you to summon the Serpent-God himself to aid you in battle.

Your desire wilted, but there are other challengers with stronger resolve who shall capture the Dark Prince's interest. Remember, without the Daemon Prince's soul, the Forge of Souls cannot be reached.
Naggarond looms, sending constant threats against Ulthuan. Even now, they establish footholds within sacred lands. Others of your kind will surely fight back, but can they be trusted to succeed?

Rejoice, for a Greater Daemon has risen – just as your herald foretold! Once summoned, this exalted lord of slaughter will take their place at the head of your army, and lead the charge against the mortal realms!

A plague has come upon your kind, my lord! Such a virulent outbreak I have never witnessed… Consider isolating those struck down until the disease runs its course. Contact with the unfortunate sufferers will inevitably risk the contagion spreading.
I see no treasure is left untouched by you, admiral. You command all of the Pieces of Eight and the creatures that are cursed by them.
The enemy retreats. How typical of the weaklings. Not that I need to tell a Druchii this, but show them no mercy – finish them!
I will murder anyone to get what I must.
Loec's ravens bring news and names, my king. Three enemies of the Shadowlands have been selected and marked for death by your hand!
Hail, Throgg, King of Trolls! You venture far from your natural lair – these lands are rich with meat and war. Feast upon them, grow in strength and number to bring ruin beyond.
THROT SO HUNGRY! Good-good, lots of specimens here in nasty Elf-thing land-realm. And tasty forest queen here too-now!
My affliction is both a terrible curse and an immeasurable source of power, but soon I will have greater control. I will do what I must to ensure that I return to Naggaroth in triumph!

Arch-Plaguelord Nurglitch, supreme ruler of Clan Pestilens, has decreed that the strength of the Clan must grow, my lord. Yet we cannot merely breed our way out of this! You must ignite the power within the Rod of Corruption.
Yet crown alone cannot gird these fabled lands – and so the Lady’s chosen enchantress wanders, binding a fractured realm to defy a prophesied doom.
The danger here is imminent. Wretched armies of the Undead shamble across nearby scorched sands, led by their twisted Vampire overlords. They must be destroyed.
You have defiled Khorne’s altar. The name of the Bridge-Maker is yours to claim. Summon him at the Screaming Chasm.

We have secured a number of Way-fragments in preparation for Loremaster Talarian's ritual, yet more are required. We must act in all haste; it is clear that Malekith's minions are gathering scrolls of lore for their own fell rites. Time is of the essence!
For these domains fray before the Realm of Chaos, where winds of raw sorcery twist flesh and reason as readily as they warp the pliant earth.

Cast adrift and blown to these humid shores, I thirst for control of my mind as it struggles and bickers with my desires. And now, the wretched mutineers to the north think my affliction holds us back! But we shall show them who truly rules the Vampire Coast!
To the south, the jungles are infested with Greenskins, amongst the most belligerent of the younger races. I must unite the temple-cities if I am to see off their threat.
He is strengthened by the power of raging storms that can cause significant damage! Something brews in the sky overhead…

The Weave here is dangerously out of balance, as is the case in many other forests of the world. Bring life back to these withering woodlands, then traverse the Deeproots to seek out others who require healing in more distant lands.
Grimtop is full of greedy traitors. Give them a visit… remind them who is Overtyrant!

Invocations of great potency may be performed by your most potent wielders of magic, mighty lord. Summon them together, and they may perform rites to grant you considerable powers – albeit at a price.
Master of Skies, you are far from Lustria but the ancient jungles of the Southlands are in need of your protection. For there are many who seek the treasures of the Old Ones.
Elite troops and potent weaponry, honed and enchanted in the Gunnery School, shall bolster our strength.

They are Soul-Eaters, so it may be difficult to wield magic against them. Difficult, but not impossible. Like all Cygors, the brothers see the Winds of Magic through their single eyes, which causes them to be in a constant state of fury.
The Oak of Ages stands strong in the face of adversity.

You have done the impossible by desecrating Tzeentch's fortress and charting his labyrinth. The Changer of Ways notes your success even if it is with contempt, but he is not the only schemer whose machinations are coming to fruition... Be'lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the third soul, but one more is required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
We build a totem to Ursun. Let our devotion banish corruption.
And beyond their violent horde, Valkia and her Warriors of Chaos maraud onwards, soaking the land in blood.

At once, great Oracle, soon a way to bypass the Maelstrom and enter the Realm of Chaos will present itself, that you already know, I'm sure, but to the present, there is much we can do to ensure our forces are optimal.
Should Ulthuan fall... the world will not be far behind.
Push back this green tide, my lord, for you are the last Slayer King of Karak Kadrin!
Good! This enemy of Nagarythe will threaten our lands no longer, your highness.
A tome of the Great Betrayer has been found. Its power bends to my will! Go forth, slaves, and continue the search!

I know I speak to not one, but many who inhabit your fractured mind, Lord Harkon, and that some consider this a weakness and curse, but like gold doubloons more is better than one. Raise anchor and, as one, begin the reaving!
Intruders from the Empire dare to approach your fortress. Destroy them!
Victory in battle affords an opportunity to honour the Gods of Chaos. Yet which of the Ruinous Powers to exalt is your decision.

You have successfully formed an accord with King Kazador of Karak Azul. He is a mighty ruler indeed, and will give you access to your Weapons Shops within the great Dwarfhold. Your combined efforts will surely help you achieve your goals.
YOUR VICTORY WILL TASTE OF ASHES.\\nSHYISH BRINGS A LEGION OF SOULS UNTO ME.\\nI SENSE THE DESPAIR OF YOUR FALLEN, FOR THEY ARE MINE.\\nYOU SHALL FALL.
Ghrond has fallen in a battle of delightful savagery, Blood Queen. Construct facilities at once to enable your search for the scrolls you seek. I sense that the Vortex dims further.

Your kind burns energy – blessed, or perhaps cursed with a high metabolism – they will not fight on an empty stomach. Be sure to keep your forces fed, lest they chitter and conspire to turn on their commanders as a source of nourishment!
The forest lends its fauna to your cause wherever you roam, ancient one. A limited number of wild beasts and forest spirits can be swiftly summoned to your side, even when in enemy territory.
A fine collection you have there, admiral, one that grows ever closer to completion.
The other Norscan tribes should be conquered and subsumed into your burgeoning realm.
More vassals are required; puppets to enact our scheme.
Someone left in a hurry. Carried what they could.
My lord, Tz’arkan is a powerful Daemon that resides within you. His control is strong, but with his curse comes great powers and abilities to use against your enemies.
Frigustrex is here for the taking, my lord! The weather is fierce in these climes, and is worsened further by the monster’s presence.

The spirit of men is frail – so easily corrupted. The northern tribes worship the Dark Gods. The chief of the Gharhars, Skollden, hungers for Kislevite blood. While he lives, he will hinder your search and prey on our people. The Wolf must be tamed.
In the aftermath of victory you may dedicate your conquests to the Ruinous Powers. It remains only to choose which God of Chaos shall earn your allegiance.
Past Troll Country lies Kislev, ripe for the picking…

My lord, your army can bring a Doom-rocket to battle, an advanced weapon that truly makes you a force to be reckoned with. Only a limited number of them can be stockpiled at a time, however, so use their destructive power sparingly.
Hail to you, Lord Balthasar. The Emperor invokes you to defend the Empire’s southernmost borders, for this is a place under great threat in need of your great power.
The Great Plan is in motion! The Old Ones now look upon you favourably.
With such a force behind you, search out your master's fabled books throughout the world. They are artefacts of immense power and are the key to the Black Pyramid and the Great Necromancer's return.
I'm getting hungry, humie. Best start spitting out advice or I'm gonna use ya bones as toothpicks!
As the Lord of Rebirth, Grandfather Nurgle can restore rent flesh and broken limbs. The blessings of the Plague Lord will replenish your forces, even as they are weakened by enemy action.
The plots of Chaos are many, my lord, but through your visions you are able to track all active incursions and impede them before they come to fruition.
The Mirror Pool of Tepok shimmers with undiscovered secrets, mighty lord. The plaques you seek may surely be found there in great number.
Troops bearing missile weapons are invaluable on the battlefield, for they may destroy an enemy from afar. You would do well to strengthen your armed forces with such warriors.
Further along, the Bastion remains under threat from the Changer's forces... or as you know him, the dread power Chi'an Chi.
It is done. I know how to cross the chasm.
All will be overrun, by blight or by conquest!
Skollden runs! The coward is injured and flees battle!
With such Ruinous fiends closing in, Malakai Makaisson expects the Spirit of Grungni to make quick work of the Northmen!
The hapless Luthor Harkon dwells nearby. A fellow Lord of the Night may be a useful ally, but his unstable mind also makes him a potential threat.

Tz’arkan has full possession, my lord, making you unmatched on the battlefield. However, your commanders and warriors are more distrustful of you, resulting in reduced loyalty and troop replenishment. By taking the elixir, you can reduce possession and increase your control.
Only the best and the bravest are fit to face me – the embodiment of Khorne’s furious wrath!
The servants of Khorne thrive on destruction and slaughter. March against your enemies, raze their forts and townships, and the Blood God will surely smile upon you.
Beyond Kislev, lies the Empire. Its bickering states of power are ripe with treasures. Take from these soft southern lands and establish new ports on their shores from which you can raid further.
The Bretonnians also dwell nearby. They have long sought to vanquish the Chaos-worshippers, a purpose which aligns with the Great Plan. Perhaps they can be of some use to you in this struggle?
Show courage, show harmony, and show unity! This is the Cathayan way!
My lord, there has been an unexpected side effect of the Doomsphere's detonation. The creatures in the area have been mutated into vile, irradiated monstrosities. Be wary of their belligerence.
The first of Talarian's is prepared. He needs my blessing to begin. I have prayed to Isha and she assents. Let us commence at once.
Our only option is to fight!

To the east, the mountains contain great labyrinths and lairs that are home to formidable beasts. Hunt down these creatures, ensnare them to do your bidding, whilst being ever-watchful of the nearby Dwarfs.
The adulation of the masses reaches fever pitch – festivities and games may now be held. During such revelries, many will come forth and devote themselves fully to your service.
Ancient power flows through the ruins of Lustria - I can sense it. Let us seek out Way-fragments in these places. They will be needed if Loremaster Talarian is to set right the Winds of Magic.
The enemy look set to begin their attack. Should they drive out your forces or wrest key locations from your grasp then the city will be lost. Man the defences!
Something calls to me from across the seas, a weapon of great power that bears the mark of my lord. With it I will pierce the heart of Ulthuan and seize control of the Vortex!

Relations abroad have blossomed since agreeing a pact of non-aggression, my prince. A trade agreement may now be possible. Furthermore, your kind are known for their skill in placing informants in markets across the world. Let commerce be your eyes and ears.

Your quest ends in defeat, your army destroyed by the forces of the Great Sorcerer and His Daemon Prince. To come so far and yet fall so short… You may not have known the outcome, but Tzeentch surely did.
I shall return to Zharr-Naggrund more powerful than those that exiled me!
The seat of the Phoenix King must not fall! Finubar has entrusted me to lead the counter-attack. Join my cause, brave Asur, and together we shall overcome!
Versatile forces are better equipped to deal with the diverse threats which stalk this world. Expand your facilities, and more troop types will be available for you to rally to your banner.
You are a Daemon Prince, not bound to one aspect - unlike other Daemons in the servitude of their masters.
Finally Amanar is yours to control! Use his power against all those that oppose you!

Could they be a harbinger for the return of the bulbous Grom himself? If so, our darkest nightmares may be realised once more. I should have destroyed him all those years ago along with his foul Shaman.
Morathi's Cauldron of Blood is yours, my queen! Eternal youth and power are now much closer.

The Dark Gods have gifted this creature the power to ruin minds. Be prepared for your army to lose control in the heat of battle – slay this multi-headed beast before it drives all sanity from your forces!
Ancient Nehekhara, once a verdant paradise cradling the first and proudest among the nations of men; now reduced to a sun-scorched necropolis by millennia of wilting sorcery.
For this deceiver of gods is already many moves ahead, pondering more prestigious pursuits.
Some Chaos activities will give you limited time to act. Be wary that allowing them to unfold will have consequences.
No more delays – the glory of Zanbaijin shall be mine. Sweet battle beckons!
Workers are needed. I shall harvest the Orc-scum at Howling Rock.
Patrolling the Lizardmen's former domain, the Master of Skies holds vigil over what remains of the Great Plan.

Greetings Sisters of Twilight, most esteemed emissaries of Queen Ariel. You are deep in the hostile lands of the Druchii, but the forest of the Witchwood provides you with sanctuary in this bleak realm.
Of course, the true treasure is out there, upon the open seas, and only the most infamous will steal it!

Even those surface-dwellers who have heard tales of the Skaven Under-Empire regard them as little more than myths. Few know the true extent of the cities your kind build beneath the ruins of other races, devious lord. Subterfuge is amongst the greatest weapons of the Skaven.
Welcome to Albion, Rakarth, greatest of all Beastmasters. These isles will serve as a steppingstone to the Old World and its many opportunities for beast-capturing and raiding.
Brother, lay siege to this enemy lair. They cower behind tall walls but we can climb them or break down their gates! Drive them out and claim this place for Ursun!
Though your rapid return brings some welcome additional forces, the situation remains grim. See for yourself!

This thing is an even greater abomination than other creatures of the same, vile ilk! Swarms of rats seep from its bilious form! Use your ranged and hostile auras to damage it before you are overwhelmed!

You made it past the Six Circles of Seduction, an epic feat in and of itself, but to march upon the Palace of Slaanesh and claim the twisted soul of the Courtesan was a challenge too far. You are defeated.

[[col:green]]Greenskins are like fungus. While their infection remains, their obscene growth will continue unabated.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]You can do it, Naestra. Say the words I long to hear...[[/col]]\\n[[col:green]]Very well. We must eradicate the Greenskins.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]I love you, sister.[[/col]]
To the bottom of the sea they go! Their Sea Shanty is now yours to wield, and you are a step closer to facing Amanar.
There is the Gardener, Nurgle's Daemon Prince! Slay him!
The clarion calls, my lady, and the masses flock to your banner once more. Make haste in these scorched sands and stride forth in the name of chivalry!
A potent ally has joined your ranks. Embed them in your army.
The spawn of Nurgle may be rapidly summoned, yet it will take time for them to grow to their full strength. Keep this in mind when planning your campaigns.
The strength of our allies has failed! The cause is lost!
The stanitsa of Leblya harbours more Ungol heathens. Cleanse this stronghold of heretics!
Zhatan the Black stands at the Gates of Zharr, sent from the great Ziggurat city by Ghorth the Cruel.

The first step towards regaining my territory has been taken, but it is not enough. We will not rest until we hold sway over the entire Vampire Coast once again, and after that, all of Lustria. The dead shall dominate this continent, and the Pirate King shall be their master!
The Winds of Magic twist into a squall. The Raven God is up to something, and no doubt the Motherland will suffer…
Supreme Warlock Master, your knowledge of science and sorcery is unsurpassed. This is your chance to experiment and make the world your playground of diabolical weaponry!

The pestilent warmbloods are driven from the shrine, mighty lord. The search for plaques may commence there once suitable facilities are constructed. Make all haste - you no doubt sense the decline of the Vortex for yourself.
Your actions have not gone unnoticed, my lord. The local inhabitants watch your every move.
Show no mercy to those who make war against you. Crush your enemies and you send a blunt message to those who may think to cross you in future.
Skrolk has succeeded, my brood, the Warpstone is secure! Now-now, the ritual may begin!
Tyrion and Teclis may consider themselves the foremost defenders of the Vortex, but they shall soon see that the bloodline of the House of Caledor still runs hot with dragonfire!

[[col:green]]At least these glades are rife with foul Greenskins and Beastmen to hold your quarrelsome interest.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]Not to mention the Druchii fools. I so enjoy hunting those.[[/col]]
Even now they march upon your burrows in Yuatek. Skaven control of the Southlands rests upon you holding this warren. Lord Gnawdwell will not look kindly on us if Clan Mors lose this lair!
You will be busy, Mighty Tradelord, but the reward for your efforts is the god-meat of Ursun. Let the feast begin… for the Great Maw hungers!

We are faced with a dire threat. The Greenskins seek to ravage Yvresse and all Ulthuan, putting the Vortex at risk. As the Warden of Tor Yvresse, I shall face them with ruthlessness and brutality – the fate of the world is in my hands.
Warpstone found is not enough, needs more! Find more Warpstone for nasty Grey Seer’s ritual - then more glory for Queek!
In the south, you may encounter greenskins. Then there are the Norse. Mortals who will worship you, if you let them… or introduce them to your twin-axes.
Noble indeed, my lady. Like the Grail Companions before you, you honour the code of Chivalry and will be rewarded for it.
Simple creatures! They search the jungles for their miserable relics, caring not that they encroach against the Khalida, the avatar of Asaph! Death shall find them!
No devastation like Ikit's devastation, yes-yes!
Your finest minds may be put to work in developing new methods of war, but they lack the facilities to do so. Construct these, and they may be tasked with improving your knowledge and practises.
The Empire's grip gains yet more strength; expect greater reinforcements from home. For the Emperor!
Look around you. Dervingard is infested with Chaos.
Take heed, you have been targeted by the deadliest Skaven brood, Clan Eshin, who seek the power of the Daemon Tz’arkan. And they have sent their greatest assassin, Deathmaster Snikch!

Something is amiss, o Queen of Lybaras. Why does the mighty Venom Staff fail to stir at your touch? Asaph is your goddess, my Lady… and you must divine her will. Rouse your priestesses and seek their counsel.
If it is bloody slaughter they want, the Hag shall deliver – the smoke-spirits of her cauldron shall see to that.

My lord, the Forbidden Workshop is ready for your inspection. It is your personal laboratory of death, where new vehicle parts, weapon components, and weapons of mass destruction are prototyped and built.
These are lands of the primitive, war-loving Norscans. Their territory may not be all you will gain from ousting them, as they are known for the monstrous creatures that fight in their ranks.
A search must be made for the lost plaques of Chotec, savage lord. His wisdom will surely provide much illumination in these dark times.

Your skills of war are unmatched, my lord! These so-called champions were but mere lambs to the slaughter – one would think this is just a taste of what is yet still to come. Press forth, my lord, and send what remains of these foes to oblivion!
A labyrinth of tunnels and warrens has been discovered beneath our settlement, crawling with verminous Skaven! This infestation must be dealt with swiftly before they cause us any trouble.
The Lizardmen are not alone here, Lord Skrolk of Clan Pestilens scurries his forces through the various tunnels and caves, corrupting everything he touches!
Heading west across the High Pass may well secure a route back to the Motherland and strengthen the nation… but could undermine your daughter's reign.
Employ your hidden forces, my lord. Advance them through the forest and they will be able to quickly surprise and overwhelm the enemy war machines!
We fight alone. We use whatever we can.
The enemies of Wissenland shall embrace their mortality.
The traitor is slain. His followers flee. Find me, son of Kislev.
You army marches into battle with great powers, my lord. Be sure to make use of them.

The shadow of the Raven God must fall across these lands! Spread the corrupting influence of Tzeentch far beyond your borders. The worship of adherents will lend him strength against the other Ruinous Powers.
March on, brave Dawi, march on!
If the Lore of Death cannot force them back into the darkness, then the guns and blackpowder of the Empire’s greatest armoury shall do it for her.

Unseen by warmblood eyes, the Geomantic Web binds the energies of your most sacred temple-cities together, revered master. Encourage its growth, and its power will surely underpin the restoration of cold-blooded order to the world.
Nurgle is amused you have made it this far. Slay His servants and ensure He will not mock you again!
Well done, my lord! This elixir helps you limit Tz’arkan’s presence and reduces his possession over you. Use it wisely.
Cover your mouths, for the foetid scent that drifts on the air foreshadows the servants of Nurgle! All those who stand against the Chaos God of Pestilence meet with disease and death – beware!
Our soldiers are waiting to build the Storehouse.
Revered master communes, the time of the ritual is at hand. Let us join for its completion.
You have slain the army's leader! But we must fight until the rest of the horde is dead or fleeing!
Skrag, I travel with you rather than the Overtyrant, for who better to seek a god than one who talks directly to them? But first we must deal with these Dwarfs!
Today, we do not fight Northmen. Today, we fight Daemons, but with Ursun's blessing, our blades will bite deep!
The troops that your enemies field are both many and varied. Mastery of their strengths and weaknesses will leave you best-placed to face them in battle.
Gerslev may be liberated, but trouble stirs in this oblast: the Ropsmenn Clan have been subsumed by the Great Orthodoxy and resent your reign…
Where industry is greased by violence, all are fuel for its furnaces.
Your highness! We have news of your father… Boris the Red lives after all. He has returned to save Kislev in its time of need, but we must act fast, for the forces of Chaos surround him.
In this strange land, so far from the forges of Karak Azul, we need the potent fruits of the Runesmiths' labour more than ever. Time to recruit some slack-jawed apprentices and whip them into shape!
Skollden waits for us. Push the attack.
The Wolf limps into his lair. I will not give him a chance to lick his wounds. Draw your weapons – we take Dervingard back in Ursun's name!
Guarding the Mansion's gates is the Gardener, the favoured Daemon Prince of Nurgle. Destroy him to claim his soul.
Impressive! The bonds with the Hound grow stronger, the fangs of Norsca drool for new flesh to harvest!
Emperor Karl Franz sends word of his high praise for you and the expedition. See to it that your progress doesn't falter and the Empire continues to rule supreme.
Your seasonal structures bear ever more plentiful fruit as they flower and grow. More minions of Nurgle are now ripe for recruitment. Summon them to your banner!

I approached the Brazen Altar and quenched my sword in the blood. As I withdrew it, dark runes glowed upon the blade. It was a name – one to speak at the Screaming Chasm, one to summon the Bridge-Maker. A toll would be required, and my faith, tested. Whatever trial awaited, I was ready.
Ogres encroach on our land, and squat in Glut-port, our access point to the Frozen Sea. Get rid of them!
Come, my brothers! Grandfather's gifts are ours to bear, and the Empire below is ripe for a vengeful harvest!
Yet the Lizardmen’s temples lie in disarray, and skulking scavengers claw for opportunity amid the ruins.
The Bowmen of Oreon dwell nearby, fellow Elves of the Asrai who could prove strong allies should we choose to help them.
The Harbinger begins his predictable counter-attack. Prepare your forces!
The altar is but a verminous nest! The Skaven corrupt this place of power – rid them from these ruins and secure the scrolls for your own cause.
The wise respect the land and avoid bringing my hexes to their door!
Consider laying a trap for the enemy. Fall upon them when they least expect it.
I, the Great White Lizard, shall purge the world.
Locations of arcane power are close, where we can gather the Way-fragments we need. Some appear uninhabited, others may require us to remove the primitive creatures that inhabit them.

Blessings to you, Lord of the Solar-City! Your domain is prosperous and powerful, yet the same cannot be said for all realms of the younger generations. Many temples have fallen to ruin or to invaders from afar.
Without the bloodletting of Death Night, the frustrations of our people have boiled over into lawlessness. The nobility openly question your rule; wash away these traitors in a tide of blood!
Much Warpstone found, but more is-is needed. Lizards race towards ritual of their own, Skrolk must get there first!
These peaks may not be the Mountains of Mourn, but there is no reason why an Ogre Kingdom cannot be founded here!
You now have the facilities to begin technological research, my lord. It only remains for you to choose the direction of development.
Black Crag is yours, my brutal lord. The Badlands beyond lay open for conquest.
Black Crag is yours, my brutal lord. The pretender, Gorfang and his pitiful tribe retreat to lick their wounds. The world lays open for conquest.
The Badlands are dominated by tribes of inferior Greenskins. See for yourself!
My snitches tell me that Gorfang has retreated to another of his strongholds at Iron Rock. Even now he will be gathering his strength against you, savage lord!
The Crooked Moon tribe have agreed to stay out of your fight against the Red Fang. Time will tell if they are good to their word, and if not they will feel the wrath of Grimgor!
The Red Fang maintain a fortress at Valaya's Sorrow from which they may launch attacks against you. It must fall!
Gorfang cannot be allowed to sit behind his walls and raise another army. The time to move against his strongholds on the plains is now. Call your "Immortulz" to advance!
Good! No doubt the Red Fang will be alerted to your advance. If it serves to spread panic amongst their forces, so much the better!

Your forces remain depleted by battle, my lord, but yet more lesser Greenskins are drawn to your might. As such, an army becomes a Waaagh! Recruit these new arrivals and they will be ready to fight in the battles to come.
The Red Fangs send out a force to check your advance! It must be crushed. Take the fight to these curs before they can concentrate their forces.
Excellent choices, all. The boyz will begin training immediately.
I hesitate to bring such a mundane matter to your savage attention, my Lord Grimgor, but you should look at improving your infrastructure now you dominate Black Crag.
Upgrading your training facilities will enable you to build better forces, faster. I humbly suggest this should be your next action.
Patience may not be your strongest attribute, my Lord Grimgor, but there is nothing more you can do for now. Let us await Gorfang's next move.
Gorfang may think that his fortress at Iron Rock will provide him cover, but he is mistaken! Drive his forces out, and take another of his strongholds as your own!
Missions may be issued from time to time by those interested in your progress. These can be reviewed at your request, my lord.
Battle is upon us! Study your options carefully, the enemy are close – blood will be spilt.
Your sacred peak is secure, King Grudgebearer. The mountains rumble to the sound of your armies marching. Yet the threat to your kind has scarcely diminished.
The lands around here remain infested with filthy Greenskin scum. See for yourself!

The Greenskins of the Bloody Spearz continue to defile your most sacred monuments. They must be expelled from these mountains with all haste! No Dwarf king should tolerate such a presence so close to Everpeak!
The Dwarfs of Barak Varr look kindly upon your cause, Sire. With sufficient persuasion they would likely join your struggle against the Greenskins.
The Scabby Eye tribe of Greenskins maintain their hostilities against you from their feeble camps upon the plains. Be sure to watch their movements carefully.
Vengeance must be the answer! The Bloody Spearz cannot be allowed to regroup after their defeat. Press forward, and maintain the offensive.
Good! The enemy will no doubt have picked up your movements. They will be frantically barricading their hovels in preparation for your arrival.
More of your proud kin stand ready to take up arms against the invaders, my lord. Recruit them, and they will be ready to fight in the battles to come.
The recruits will make first-rate warriors I'm sure. For now, the throng must remain in place to train them.
Let's also look at improving your infrastructure at home. A solid base of operations will repay itself on the battlefields ahead.
Upgraded training facilities will allow you to better train the Dawi to fight, Sire.
Excellent! Stout hands will be set to work immediately.
You must seek ways to further your methods of war if you are to drive the Orc filth from the mountains. Put the finest minds from the Guilds to work on improving your practices and knowledge.
I thank you for your offer of immortality, Sire, but I shall forgo the Blood Kiss for now - I'm more useful to you alive for there is much to be done.
The Templehof interloper has fled back to his fortress and Drakenhof is secure, but enemies abound on all sides. See for yourself.
Van Kruger has retreated to Castle Templehof, a fortress he wrongly claims as his own. It will take some effort to wrench him out.
Passage to the west is blocked by the Dark Lords of Schwartzhafen, Sire. They have feuded with Van Kruger in the past, and no doubt watch your struggle against him keenly.
The Dwarfs control the mountain passes to the south. They are no friends of your kind, and will strike out at you if allowed.
Van Kruger is nothing more than a feeble liche - a Necromancer that needs bringing to heel. You must advance against Templehof - seize his possessions and turn the dead against their former master!
Excellent! The enemy scries your movements. The Necromancer will no doubt be planning counter-manoeuvres of his own.
Your forces are depleted by battle, Sire, yet such a shortfall is easily solved by your kind. Raise the slain to fight at your banner! March upon the enemy using their own warriors!
Your army must remain in place whilst raising new bodies to fight. Soon it will be swollen with the dead, my lord.
Drakenhof has suffered in your absence, Sire. But now a von Carstein inhabits its halls once more you can restore the castle back to its former majesty.
Provide more room for the dead to rest and you will gain more souls to resurrect. See that the necessary expansion is made.
Seek ways to further even your vast knowledge of the dark arts, my lord. Put your most devious minions to work on improving your methods of war.
The Greenskins run for their burrows, Emperor. Their dead and dying litter the field. Altdorf is safe for now.
The capital may be secure, yet many enemies still surround you. Survey the map for yourself, your Eminence.
Secessionists hostile to your election as Emperor are trying to form a breakaway province to the south. They will mobilise against you, and march against Altdorf when their strength is sufficient.

The lands to the north of the Reik are controlled from Middenheim, my Emperor. Elector Count Boris Todbringer, Graf of Middenheim, was a rival claimant to the throne, and bitter that you have taken the mantle.

The wealthy city-state of Marienburg lies to the west. It seceded over seventy years ago in a corrupt deal that brought shame on the Empire. This city would surely make a glittering prize for your burgeoning reign.
The secessionists cannot be allowed to defy your rule and field their own armies. The time to move against them is now, your Eminence.
Good! Such decisive action will leave the enemy in no doubt as to your intentions. They will be forced to fight, or to capitulate!
More men stand ready to take up arms for your cause, my Emperor. Recruit them, and they will be ready to fight in the battles that are to come.
Excellent choices, all. Be aware that your army must remain stationary to train the new recruits.
Improvements may be made to your capital now that the threat to its security has receded. Altdorf must prosper if the Empire is to flourish, my Emperor.
Your Eminence, I suggest you upgrade the training facilities, allowing you to field better forces to face your enemies.
Excellent! The Imperial Engineers will begin construction at once.
Emperor, by Sigmar's will there is nothing more you can do now. Let us await the enemy's response.
Van Kruger knows his position is weak, and has sent out an army to check your advance! Their strength can be added to your own – attack!
Eschen is vulnerable to attack, dark lord. Seize it from the enemy to open a new front to the north.
The secessionists send out a force to stall your advance! Take the fight to them, and demonstrate the manner in which you will regain mastery of these lands.
Commandments may be issued over territory you rule, my lord. Make the effort to rouse the populace, so that they may better serve your ends.
Our Wolf Rider scouts report a force of Dwarfs to the north, isolated from the safety of their Hold. Slaughter them, and news will soon spread of your intent to break open the mountains!
Those mewling fools that survived the capture of Black Crag now dare to agitate against your rule. Subdue the curs, either with strength or favour.
Obedience is becoming a problem here, my lord. Those that inhabit this place begin to stir against your rule. Appease or suppress them to snuff out dissent.
My lord, a rival power desires a change in your mutual relations.
A rival power comes to parley – demanding a change in your mutual relations. Consider their offer carefully.
Haha! War is declared! A rival power takes up arms against you. Crush them without mercy!
Emissaries from a foreign leader come requesting an alliance, my lord. Fully appraise the situation before accepting any treaty.
Your new workshop opens the possibility of conducting research into better methods of war. Put your most devious Goblin minds to good use, my lord.
Those that serve your cause gain experience over time, my lord. Be sure to guide their development to your advantage.

This area is dominated by tribes of inferior Greenskins. On the plains to the west Rotgut's Red Fangs mass against you, angry at the loss of their stronghold. Proving your utter superiority over Gorfang should be your first calling.

Vanquish the Red Fang and tribes of lesser Orcs will flock to your banner, freeing your mobs to look further afield for lands to conquer. The stunted Dwarfs that dwell in the mountains around you should provide plentiful quarry.
Your enemies are belligerent and won’t necessarily cow down to your indomitable will – they need to be tamed, broken or annihilated!

Castle Drakenhof is back in your hands, my Unliving Sire. Yet you have many enemies – both living and dead – who balk at the threat of a von Carstein reigning from his ancestral stronghold. Much needs to be done.

The Templehof brood control the lands to the north, as far as the River Stir. Conflict with them is inevitable but your will is indomitable: take their lands, burn their crypts, and deploy their own dead against them!
The high mountains to the south are infested with Dwarfs. Your homelands will never be safe with such an enemy so close. Make plans to drive their stunted kind out in time.
Greatness runs throughout the von Carstein bloodline, my lord. Glory shall be yours, if you are ambitious enough to seize it!
I advise you to seek ways to further your methods of war, my lord. Put your best minds to work improving your knowledge and practices.
Reports are coming in of a living expeditionary force close to your territory, my lord. Such a threat cannot be tolerated. Show them that you are master of these lands once again!!
The grobi maintain one of their slum camps beneath the Pillars of Grungni – a sin that cannot remain in the Dammaz Kron any longer! The pillars must be returned to Dwarfen hands.
Karaz-a-Karak is secure, my lord high king. Faced with your terrible wrath, the Greenskins rout – as is typical of their craven nature.

The Bloody Spearz still infest the mountains to the east, setting up their hovels amidst your sacred pillars. Another grudge that must be put right... and soon, for the lords of the other Dwarfholds will not tolerate a High King that cannot secure his own realms.
To the south, yet more vicious urki and grobi lay ready to strike at your kin. Seek allies amongst your own folk, for there are many grudges to settle here.
The world shall be in thrall to the Karaz-Ankor once more, and no creature, Greenskin or otherwise, shall stand in your way!

Gyrocopter scouts report of a Greenskin migration heading northwards. Spies say they intend to meet up and swell the mobs of a dread Orc Warlord who travels towards the Badlands. Whatever they are up to, they must be stopped – summon the throng!
The Greenskin threat is extinguished, sire, yet the fight to secure your rule has only just begun.

The Empire is beset by civil war once more. Secessionists hostile to your election as Emperor are trying to form a breakaway province to the south. Advance, crush them, and bring the lands back to your sovereign rule.

To the north, Boris Todbringer of Middenheim – a bitter rival in the recent election – is openly hostile. A clash with Todbringer and the wolves of Middenland may well be unavoidable if you wish to unify the Empire. Plan for this eventuality.
The Empire has ever been besieged by foes, but you are a prince of Altdorf – greatness runs in your very blood! Make the Heldenhammer proud!

It is important to act quickly if you have any intention of securing lasting authority over the Empire. The people must learn that open dissent cannot be tolerated. Capture Grunburg, and snuff out the resistance there.
Your army suffers in the miserable conditions they find themselves, my lord. Move them on, or more warriors will fall to the elements.
Your army has wandered into the Chaos Wastes! This is no place for your kind – withdraw them with all haste!
The denizens are dangerously agitated, my lord! Soon they will take up arms against you. Move swiftly to crush or appease them!
Your foolish subjects here have taken up arms against your rule, my lord! Move against their uprising, or it may grow to threaten your grip on this place!
A taint of Chaos festers in this place. Take steps to reduce corruption spreading further amongst your followers, or they may turn against you to serve a new master...
Your expenditure is exceeding your income, my lord. Be mindful of your treasury, and try to solve any deficit before you run out of funds entirely.

Commerce! The lifeblood of every nation, even more important than war for some. A trade agreement is being offered by a rival power. Such a deal would foster trust as well as generate income, but you must decide if it's the right thing to do.
A trade agreement may be possible with the rulers of this place, my lord; a rich nation is a powerful one. Let your traders, merchants and guilds flourish, for industry creates war...
Your treasury is running dry, my lord. Soon you will be out of coin. Take action now to mitigate the threat of bankruptcy.
The treasury is bare! Bankruptcy is upon you. Take all action necessary to restore a positive income, or your power and influence will quickly unravel!
Emissaries from a foreign ruler are seeking a pact of non-aggression. Such an agreement will foster trust between your followers. Trade relations or an alliance may follow.
Such an action would surely lead to war! As glorious as that is, proceed only if you desire conflict, my lord.
The Ruinous Powers have been sighted nearby! The forces of Chaos wish to bring about the End Times. Beat them down at every opportunity.
A horde has been observed nearby, my lord. They march with their whole civilisation in tow. Drive them away if they attempt to scour your lands!
Unification with the rulers of this place might be a possibility, my lord. Together you would march under the same banner, and your warriors would become as one. Consider making this request.
Grave news, my lord. Some of your forces have mutinied against your rule: civil war is upon you! They must be crushed, without question – and quickly – else your greater goals will be set back.
Titles are being left vacant, sire, while suitable candidates are ready for promotion. Be sure to examine the available lords for advancement.

The wars to come will be fought using guile as well as brawn. Consider recruiting a Hero to expand the range of military options at your disposal. Heroes can be hired to support your forces, or to strike against the enemy.

That is a Hero serving a foreign power, my lord. Consider recruiting such an operative into your service. One being with the right skills can solve problems that no amount of coin or labour would otherwise be able to crack.
Sabotage, my lord! An enemy power has sent a Hero to disrupt the running of your domain. This act of aggression cannot be left unanswered.
Victory is yours, my lord! But what about the fate of those captured in battle? It can be beneficial to hold them, but sometimes leniency or brutality can be worth more.
At last, the defences have fallen, my lord. The fate of those that remain is yours to determine.
Knowledge of your own strengths is vital if any conquest is to succeed. Your kind are wild and barbarous, my lord. Success will never be won around the table, but on the battlefield.
The boyz' clamour for battle grows with each victory. The fervour of your kind can be a powerful force if harnessed, but an Orc's lust for blood – if left unsated – can be his undoing.
More Greenskins muster in the mountain pass to the east. Attack now, while they remain vulnerable.
Good! In time, the lore they will gain will surely aide your cause.
I know your patience wears thin, my king, but you must temper the need for vengeance with further intelligence of the grobi's actions. There is nothing more to do for now.
The grumblings of Dwarfs never cease! Some that remain in Karaz-a-Karak have the nerve to make trouble in your absence, my king. Take steps to re-assert control over your mountain.

As you know all too well, the power of the Dawi has reverberated through these mountains for millennia. Harness that strength, and you will have all you need to restore the Karaz Ankor to its former glory.
Be sure to make use of the Underway when moving your folk around the mountains, sire. Much time can be saved when travelling below ground.
Good! In time, the knowledge they gain will surely aide your cause.
My lord, there is nothing more you can do now. Let us await your enemy's next move.
Your kind are a nightmare made flesh, sire. Yoke the power of the dead and you shall be unstoppable.
The dead may be summoned to your will, my lord. Rapidly augment your forces by raising the slain to your banner.

Sources report that Middenheim is sending help to the Secessionists in an effort to destabilise the Empire. Intercept their reinforcements, and demonstrate to Todbringer that there is but one master of Reikland!
Despite your recent victories, there are rabble-rousers within Altdorf that agitate against the rightful rule of the Emperor. Take steps to quell the unrest.
Use your armies to exert control over the theatre of war. Place your warriors in passes to control their use, and study the enemy positions to find the best avenues of attack.
Consider varying your tactics when manoeuvring in the face of the enemy, my lord. Placing an ambush, or setting a defensive camp, may bring about victory where a straight engagement would fail.
You need not grow weary of battle, my lord. You do not need to oversee every skirmish in person – there are many gods of war on this world and they will take an interest whether you do so or not...
The enemy bring reinforcements to the fight! Will an attack be wise?
An ambush, my lord! Ready your warriors for battle!
Major enemy cities will be fortified, sire. The capture of such citadels will likely mean a long siege.
Do not neglect the development of your cities, my lord. No great power can flourish by leaving its urban centres to decay.
Buildings within the city remain damaged from the recent siege. Repair them to gain the full benefit they can provide.
Facilities in this city are damaged, my lord. Repair them to gain the full benefit that they can provide.
A vigil on expenditure must be maintained for your domain to prosper. Be sure to keep a close watch on your finances, lest ruin overtakes you.
Your war efforts would be strengthened by the raising of a new army. Appoint another command, and you can open a second front against your foes.

Altdorf is home to the greatest minds in all the Empire. Put them to work on improving your methods of warfare, my lord. For this task they will need even grander edifices – construct these, and unleash their creativity.
You now have the facilities to begin technological research, sire. It only remains for you to choose the direction of development.
A Hero has enrolled in your service, sire. Such operatives can solve problems that no amount of money or effort would otherwise be able to crack.
Congratulations are due, my lord, as it is not every day that weaponry of such significance falls into ones hands! Your enemies will shrink before its tremendous power!
Your appointed lord has fallen in battle, sire. A replacement must be chosen to lead what remains of his army. Let us hope they don't meet with the same fate.
A new army has been raised under the command of your appointed lord. It only remains for you to issue them orders, sire.
Troops may be exchanged between armies in the field if necessary. Have your forces rendezvous in order to transfer warriors between them, then let the wars continue!
Your armies must grow to meet the challenges ahead, my lord. Be sure to recruit more fighters, lest our enemies overtake us.
Be sure to diversify the warriors you recruit, my lord. Versatile armies are better able to prevail against your various enemies.
The boyz grow restless for battle, savage lord. Their bloodlust is causing them to turn on each other! Find something for them to fight, please, before the whole army beats itself to a pulp!
A Waaagh!, mighty lord! The bloodlust of your boyz has attracted more of your kin to their banner. Your forces are unstoppable!
A Waaagh!, my lord! These Greenskins have worked themselves into such a frenzy that their foul kin travel from far and wide to join their banner.
My lord, the enemy raid your lands and slaughter your denizens! Take up arms against them, make them pay dearly for their transgressions!
Your armies can take to the seas should you wish it, sire. Have them build boats upon the shore or set sail from a nearby port.
Your army will be joined by reinforcements in battle, my lord, should you decide to fight. All the better to surround the enemy and drive them off the field.
Consider linking your forces against the enemy here, my lord. The combination may be enough to seize victory.
The enemy have encircled your city, my lord! Send a force to aid the city defenders before they are starved into submission.
The enemy city is fortified, my lord. Weapons will be needed to bring down the walls. Prepare your warriors for a long siege.
Consider laying an ambush for the enemy, sire. Fall upon them when they least expect it.
The enemy garrison join the fight against you, my lord. Take note of their additional contribution to the city defences.
The enemy threaten your city here, my lord! The garrison stand ready to defend it, but consider sending extra troops.
An enemy port, my lord. From here, they ply trade across the water with allies on distant shores. Capture it, and you may do the same.
Population growth within a province necessarily leads to an expansion of facilities, my lord. The cities here are ready for development.
Greenskins! A barbarous race of savage killers. They think of nothing except violence. Keep your weapons close at hand in any dealings with them.
Dwarfs, my lord. These runts rarely emerge from under their mountains. Don't be fooled by their stunted height – they are hardy, stubborn creatures and are not to be underestimated in battle.
The forces of the Empire, my lord. The men of the Old World are weak but great in number. They should be no match for your warriors.
The Undead, my lord, under the thrall of their Vampire masters no doubt. Stay alert when dealing with the Midnight Aristocracy, lest their treachery overtake you.
Your army has marched all it can, my lord. They must rest.
The enemy are upon you! To battle!
Natural resources are abundant in this place, my lord. Capture it, and its riches would be yours.
A strategic overview can be useful in such uncertain times, sire.
The terrain here is difficult, my lord. The progress of your army will be slow.
Consider merging some units in this army, my lord. They will be better placed to survive the glorious battles to come.
The Winds of Magic blow across the land, my lord. Those who can harness it gain access to formidable power.
Your prestige grows, my lord! News of your conquests spreads far and wide. Your developing power is noted by even the most distant of kings and bestial Lords.
Your conquests strike fear into the hearts of your enemies, mighty lord! The wisest amongst them will know that fate is on your side. I have foreseen it.
Oh, mighty lord, the fates have surely selected you for greatness! Thanks to my guidance, your tremendous power grows – as if driven by some divine power. Your enemies tremble before you!
Your reach grows yet further, great lord. Your endless victories are changing the very fates themselves! The world falls before your incredible power!
Destruction and death precede your armies, great lord! Your power is incalculable – it surely rivals even that of the Chaos Gods!
Be sure to make use of the Underway when moving your boyz through difficult terrain, mighty lord. Much time can be saved when moving below ground.
Position your most heavily-armoured troops at the front, commander. There they will be best-placed for the enemy to waste their ammunition on.
The enemy bring mighty weapons of war to the battle! Have them destroyed, commander, or they will decimate your troops from afar.
Your missile weapons may prove decisive in the coming battle, commander. Bring them to bear against the enemy from afar, but be sure to protect them as well.
The enemy are taking the walls, commander! Drive them back!
Send troops to capture the enemy defences, commander. They can be turned to our service.
The enemy approach on mounts, commander! Keep your vulnerable units close at hand.
Be sure to use your mounted soldiers to full effect, commander. Harass the enemy formation and strike at their weakest points.
Your soldiers are ready to deploy for battle, my lord. They await your orders.
The enemy general is slain, my lord, cursing your name with his dying breath! Send his army after him!
The enemy general has been wounded in battle, my lord, and can no longer lead his troops. Press home your advantage!
The enemy commander runs from the field, my lord, and a sorry spectacle it is too! His army will surely follow!
Your army has marched long and hard, commander. The troops have little strength left to fight - use it wisely!
Your warriors tire, mighty lord, their exertions dull their ability to fight. Give them time to rest, even amidst the thickest of battles.
Your troops will fire-at-will without orders to the contrary, commander. Have them conserve their ammunition if you so wish.
The enemy attack your flank, commander! Drive them off!
The enemy field flying troops, my lord. Bring them down if they approach your forces.
Your flying units afford you great flexibility, commander. Scout and harass the enemy as they manoeuvre.
The forest may be used to conceal your movements, commander. Close with the enemy under cover of the trees to retain the element of surprise.
The enemy use the forests to conceal their movements, my lord! Approach with caution.
Group your units for best effect, commander. Formations may be useful when manoeuvring before the enemy.
Your commander has been killed in action, my lord! Word has already spread amongst your troops; they will surely lose heart!
Your general has been wounded in the fighting and carried from the field, sire! His loss will be keenly felt by those left fighting.
Your general flees the field, my lord! A shameful display!
A Giant, commander! Take it down from afar! Don't let it near your massed infantry!
Your Giant terrorises the enemy, great lord! Send it into the main body of the enemy, and watch the carnage unfold!
The high ground is yours, commander. Be sure to use it to best advantage.
The enemy command the high ground. Attack with caution, my lord.
Be sure to use the maps available to assist your tactical planning, commander.
Your troops come under fire, commander! Have them find cover, or eliminate the source!
Your warriors begin to rally, sire! Steady their nerves, and they will be able to re-join the fight.
Allied reinforcements are arriving in support, commander! Link up with them and surround the enemy.
Enemy reinforcements are approaching! Attack with caution, commander.
My lord, word reaches us that your reinforcements are delayed! Stall the enemy until they arrive.
The enemy wavers, my lord, and their troops begin to flee! Run the cowards down!
Your craven warriors run from the battle, my lord! Round them up, and send them back to the fight!
The enemy advance towards the city, commander! Do all you can to stop them breaching the walls.
The siege weapons are ready, my lord! Deploy them against the enemy so we can see them in action!
The siege weapons are in position, my lord, and are ready to begin their assault. Begin your advance!
The enemy have captured the city centre, commander! Retake it quickly, before the entire settlement falls!
The city is falling to the enemy, commander! Intercept them before it is taken!
The heart of the city is within sight, my lord! Press forward!
The centre is yours! Defend it against the enemy that remain, my lord. The city will surely fall soon.
The terrain conceals the enemy's movements, commander. We must be wary!
You may use the hills, valleys... and stranger formations of this place to your advantage, commander. The terrain can conceal your forces.
The Winds of Magic blow strongly in this place, commander. Harness its power and channel it against your enemy.
The enemy use magic against us, commander. Damn their sorcery!
You are the Everchosen – the Chaos Gods call you to action, mighty champion. Their lust for Ruin must be sated.
You shall go into the lands of the mortals to spread fear and destruction. The Norse tribes to the west shall fall easily before you: bind those willing to join your cause, and slay the rest.
Further to the south lie the nations of men. They will resist your advance, and for good reason. You will bring them annihilation, mighty lord.
Devour the mortal souls to bring the favour of the Chaos Gods. March forth, and spread oblivion in their name!
Your kind are the will of the Dark Gods made manifest, mighty lord. Harness the gifts afforded to you by the Ruinous Powers and you shall be unstoppable.
Your warriors live their lives on the march, mighty lord. The hordes have no need for towns or cities. Raze all that you find in the name of the Dark Gods!
Your grip on Drakenhof is not yet secure, dark lord. Pacify those that stir against your rule before they take arms and rise up.

The Goblins are getting lazy, you need to keep them busy or they will get up to mischief! Build them a place of work. Within suitable facilities the craftiest of their kind may be tasked with researching new methods of war.

Your empire is a beacon of civility in a savage world, sire. It is your task – nay, your privilege, to see that it does not fall to the countless evils that threaten its borders. Study your own strengths, and those of your enemy, carefully.
Battle is upon us, my lord! The enemy mass in great strength, see for yourself. You may wish to consider whether an attack would be wise.
Your forces meet with defeat! Gather the survivors, rebuild your strength, and take the fight back to the enemy!
The city has been reached and your warriors are prepared for battle, mighty lord. Study your options, nevertheless – encircling the enemy and starving them out may be the wisest course of action.
Raid the lands of the enemy, mighty lord! Send your warriors out to slaughter the peasants and burn their villages. Make the enemy fear you!
Consider raising a camp in the lands of the enemy, savage lord. It shall become a base from which your warriors can raid these pathetic lands.
Relations with foreign powers may be managed through diplomacy, my lord. Consider your situation carefully before accepting any agreement.
Pillage and burn all you find here, mighty lord. The lands are not suitable for your kind to settle.
You can’t let that Black Orc, Grimgor, have all the fun. There is a reason they call you "the Slaughterer" – show them all why!
The sacred peak of Karaz-a-Karak is secure, sire. The spineless Greenskins shrink before your might and have run for their burrows.

The Bloody Spearz still infest the mountains to the east of Karaz-a-Karak, setting up their hovels amidst sacred pillars. Before you can return to the Slayer Keep of Karak Kadrin, the trespassers must be destroyed. Summon the throng, and march against them.

The von Carsteins have risen once again, mighty Lichemaster, and you are to march into the world as their chosen champion. Let them believe you are their willing puppet… for now. There is much to be done.
A great destiny awaits you, Kemmler, it has been foreseen… Bring about eternal night and you shall be rewarded!
The Greenskins scurry back to their dirtholes, lord. However, it remains a time of crisis for the Empire.

Secessionists hostile to the election of Emperor Karl Franz are trying to form a breakaway province to the south. We need a stable Empire if you are to study the arcane texts – you must put an end to their senseless revolt.

To the north, Boris Todbringer of Middenheim – a bitter rival of the recent election – plots openly against the Emperor. Be warned that, should diplomacy fail, war with Todbringer will be unavoidable. Be sure to build your forces.
In all the Empire, there is none more powerful than you, Supreme Patriarch. Show the Emperor’s enemies your arcane might!
You have slumbered long, Shaggoth. Arise, mighty Kholek – it is time to bring ruin to the earthly realms!
Your adopted father calls you, Sigvald. The Dark Prince desires destruction and perversion of the world. Let it begin!
The Age of Reckoning has begun, Slayer King. You are no stranger to oaths, Ungrim, so swear that the Karaz Ankor will be great again!

Your territory expands, savage lord, yet there are many lands to conquer. In time, I foresee war with the greater tribes of the Badlands, as well as the stunted kind that dwell beneath the mountains. Keep your axe sharp, for Mork and Gork watch your progress with interest!
