What wretches dare intrude and loot my artefacts of power? We must counter-attack at once, before they can draw the power of the Vortex for their own ends. They will pay for their treachery - words of pain shall be spat!
My queen, your subjects grow restless. Blood running in the streets is but a distant memory. To show restraint would be seen as weakness, and weakness seldom lasts long in Naggaroth.
You must brave the storm but be mindful of your approach. When you decide to charge the beast, the extreme winter conditions will slow the movement of your warriors!
The camp protects us, but what of our supplies?

Well done, my lord! The Marks of Ruination accumulate at your Herdstone, awaiting your ritual. The dread felt by this land’s denizens delights your Dark Masters, who shall reward you in turn. The stronger a Bloodground’s vanquished settlements, the greater the rewards.
The fates reveal much, it is your will that will weave them into a powerbase, that shall take us into the Realm of Chaos and to the dying god. Let us begin!

The Forbidden Workshop has been upgraded, granting research access to new experimental parts. This expansion also enabled us to formulate an extra batch of Warp-fuel, granting precious extra canisters.
Across the Dwarf-delved Black Mountains, a brutish horde of Savage Orcs prepares to enter the southern pass; a prime opportunity to test the newly-built fortifications at Fort Soll.
Twin-tailed comet brings great opportunity for-for Pestilens. Great Vortex of Ulthuan vulnerable, much power to be had, mmm.
Traitors within the Black Court make trouble in your absence, my king. Take steps to re-assert absolute control over your city. Any dissent must be crushed!
The air in this cold, dank enclosure is still, and there is very little ventilation. This will be to your disadvantage – the Mad Titan is notorious for his repulsive flatulence!
They scheme. They plot. We will show them that it was all for nothing.
Just off these shores, a Black Ark stands ready to unleash devastation upon my enemies here and across the waters in the Southlands.
Now the jungle sends its final challenger.
New seas, new enemies. There are challenges to be won...\\n\\nSet a course!
Allegiance, my lord! The talons of the Eagle strike with ferocity like the lightning storms from the wastes – all shall fear the shadow that looms over them!
Fresh supplicants are needed to bolster your host for the many wars to come.
My lord, these lands grow ever more hostile towards you. Tread carefully or risk the wrath of the Lizardmen.
You are a creature wholly purposed for war, mighty one, war which you must bring to all invaders. For you are the rock upon which Itza’s enemies shall be broken!
Be'lakor's minions are defeated, yet the Dark Master himself fails to appear. An attack upon the Throne Room will surely lure him out – forward!

Hail, illustrious scion of Hag Graef! Though you are far from home, I will serve you just as you serve the Witch King. You are in unfamiliar climes, do not allow your dark ambitions to remain suppressed.
To the south, the remnants of the Red Eye tribe currently harass the Slayer King. Such a formidable and proximate Dawi should be watched, for he may soon become your problem too.
You have successfully captured one of the enemy, Warden! The prisoner is being detained in Athel Tamarha, where you can act against them to help your cause.

The slaves and minions that scrape an existence beyond your borders will surely have heard of the legendary pleasures of Slaanesh. The Promise of Perfection, when offered to the followers of the enemy, may be enough to sway their allegiance before battle.
Fight elf-things, kill Elf-things! More stuff, more heads, more glory for Queek!
You have made valuable progress, my lord. The Emperor will look upon the expedition favourably and reward you with greater supplies in due course.
Expand Under-Empire I must, yes-yes. Much secret plans-schemes to carry out here. Nightlord Sneek's plan in effect, hunt Daemon, take power!
Skollden hides in Dervingard. Slay the Wolf.
The shrine will be well-defended, yet a strike against it is vital if enough Way-fragments are to be secured to prevent the collapse of the Vortex.
Disharmony blights Grand Cathay, mighty Zhao Ming, if you are to find Ursun you must restore the balance. Only then will the Dragon-Emperor look upon you with fondness.

On the surface, the ratmen were assisted in their attacks by their barbarian allies from the north. These brutes are a frequent hindrance to your dark schemes; the time for their eradication may be at hand.
The Eye of Tzeentch is drawn – He begins to move against your incursion. Prepare your defences!
Not all beasts you seek will be available nearby, my lord, but it is possible to send your hunters into the wider world to seek them out for you – at a cost, of course.
The Courtesan appears! We must kill this Daemon Prince and take their soul!
He may not be of the ilk of Caledor Dragontamer, but Talarian’s first ritual is the first step towards bolstering the Vortex. Word has reached us that he is ready. Good! Let him do what is necessary.
All the while, Slaanesh's minions glut themselves upon Elven souls, scheming to drag Asur and Druchii alike into the thrall of the Dark Prince.
Take advantage, and invade before the Bastion's powerful guardian can plug the gap!
Elf-things come from sea fortress. In time we take that-that too. Good base for Queek, maybe-yes!

You can now request assistance from the Witch King himself by presenting him with a gift of slaves. Perform the rite and a Hero of your choice will be sent to aid you. The larger Malekith’s realm, the more powerful the Hero sent.
I fear no evil, for I am guided by the Lady's divine will. She watches over me and shows me the way.

I see them. Morsels writhing around in the dirt, trying to steal what is mine, taking relics in an attempt to save their precious Vortex. How amusing… Send my thralls to stop them, let them taste Asur blood - this is but the start of what is to come!
Dark are these times and dark my mood.
A new map, admiral – can its riddle can be solved?
And in the east, the Ogre Kingdoms are entrenched in their mountain camps. Your ability to teleport will allow you to scour the mountains of their hungry souls.
I, Settra the Imperishable - King of Kings, Lord of the Shifting Sands, Eternal Ruler of Mankind - rest no longer. Nehekhara will be restored to greatness!
I need a hideaway; a place for the Swordfysh to dock and to stash our spoils.
The innocent are spared from the Wolf’s vicious pack. The Beacon is under our control – a sanctuary in the cold, harsh wastes – but this is not Dervingard. Kislev’s northern stronghold awaits.
To the west are harsh mountains. Although their insides are ripe for burrowing, there are Beastmen that claim this territory too.
A larger territory is needed from which to launch air patrols. This will help us save the Great Vortex!
Where to go, and who to be?
A servant of Bretonnia has completed their Pledge. They may now take up a new one to further prove their loyalty to the Lady.
The twisted Dark Elf admiral known as Lokhir Fellheart has also landed on our shores, seeking to pillage holy sites.
The forces of Cathay are most effective when fighting in an ordered formation. Be wary of disrupting them, and breaking the harmony on which their fighting strength depends!
This region will fall under Kislevite rule once more. The Red Tzar returns!

Beware, too, of the living. The warmbloods that dwell in these lands make constant war upon one another, and will be hostile to your cohorts also. Build your strength, then move against them in force.
Despite its imperfections, the Empire stands strong against the encroaching Forces of Destruction.
The fulfilment of a dark prophecy beckons, my subjects. All have felt the unravelling of the Great Vortex by the twin-tailed comet.
Welcome to Lustria, Huntsmarshal. The Emperor has made the necessary arrangements to establish a base of operations for you here on the north coast.
We’ve marched as far as we can Yuri, the soldiers need rest.

The sea offers wealth and power, but Lustria is home to the abandoned cities of the Lizardmen and their many mysterious treasures. Using their artefacts, we will surely be able to uncover some way to repair my damaged psyche! We must!
We'll show them, Boneripper… The Council! Verminking! Skavenblight! All will know Thanquol's name!
Push forth, my lord. Destroy these ratmen and leave these squalid lands, so that you may take the collected scrolls back to the Witch King to claim your long-awaited reward.
The fabled Fallen City… what sublime scenery. First, the Dark Prince’s tribute, then the world.
Yet a scent of contagion surrounds its waters. Approach with caution, for such a focus of power will surely have drawn other, more malign forces to its shores.
My return shall ensure their agonising deaths, yet the Vortex remains the greater prize. It shall be mine!
Come then, before I change my mind and cast you into the ice… Advise me!

You have violated the Dark Prince's defences and defiled His palace. For but a fleeting moment, the Lord of Excess' attention is diverted to your victory. But Slaanesh will not be the only sinister entity to have noticed... Be’lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the second soul, but two more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
Yuri, we cannot be everywhere. What if we entrust a veteran to lead a new army – one to help enforce your will?

Your foreign barracks are in place, and you may now begin recruitment from within the warrior class of your martial ally. Take this opportunity to strengthen your military with warriors ordinarily unavailable to you.
For now you retreat and regroup, but fate is a fickle thing – there might be a chance to return. Remember, without the Daemon Prince's soul, the Forge of Souls cannot be reached.
Warmblood cohorts near. They hunt lizards. Nakai hunt them.
Your camps may be extended to provide greater support to your marauding forces. Give the word to erect more facilities from which hungry mouths may be fed.

The jungle-continent of Lustria lies west across the Great Ocean. The first men to land upon these shores ransacked an ancient temple, filling their ships with golden treasures. Word spread of their wealth and others were eager to follow.

Your forces have secured the province, my lord. Any contesting claim to this territory has been eliminated. Now that your rule is unquestioned, you may consider issuing a commandment to rouse the populace, so that they may better serve your ends.
Your recruitment facilities are at maximum capacity, my lord. Training of additional recruits will begin as soon as possible.
A puzzle of the Old Ones – solving it will grant you many riches. It appears that this is a numeric grid where the rows and columns are of great importance.
The minions of Slaanesh are defeated and His Courtesan slain – an incredible victory!
Total devotion, you give yourself to the Crow as its mighty champion. Go forth with the gifts of life and decay in the Crow's name!

O mighty Kroq-Gar, you find yourself far from home on an expedition to the Southlands. Yet you are not alone, here. Other Lizard-kin may be found nearby, although their interpretation of the Great Plan may differ from yours. I advise caution.
Ursun guides me. Dervingard is close.
The blasphemous teachings of the Nagash shall be mine, and mine alone! His power belongs to me, and his unholy monument shall crumble to dust at my command!
Only the strongest will survive the coming bloodshed!
Danger lurks beyond the bounds of Kislev, where Chaos lingers in a perilous landscape ripe with adventure.

I have dreamt of Loremaster Talarian, he informs me the first ritual to save Ulthuan is all but ready. Yet, a few more Way-fragments are required. We must be as fast as quicksilver for the Druchii are preparing their own dark rite…
All the while, hordes of Chaos-addled savages break upon the walls of the Great Bastion, where the Storm Dragon stands resolute and braces for war grimmer still.
In the untamed south, scant wardens stand vigil – preyed upon by unseen stalkers beneath the vast Mountains of Heaven.
Master, your search for the blade lost in the Sea of Dreams has borne fruit. The prize is close – recover the sword before the hated Elves of Ulthuan realise what you seek.
It is a momentous day, Master Runelord! All the lost artefacts are now back in Dawi hands and with them, a new era of prosperity is all but assured. Let the new Golden Age of the Dwarfs begin!
The ritual is underway, my lord. Even working together, it will take your greatest adepts some time to complete. Such is the ritual’s power that the Great Vortex itself distorts under its pull.
You have displayed noble action and good intent. Good things will come to those that possess these virtues.
By Gromril and steel, it’s their doom, or mine!
The mounted foes charge our position. Spears, engage! Quickly!
These Soul Grinders are forged here! The only way to stop them reinforcing is to find Be'lakor – keep pushing forward!
Further south, our kin do battle across the great ocean, but another threat lurks deep beneath this very fortress; a verminous horde seeks to bring a plague and destruction to all Druchii!
Yuri! You are a prince of Kislev – let your kinsmen hear your roar; fill them with Ursun's courage!
The region under the volcano's shadow is yours, mighty Skarbrand. Slaughter the fools that dawdle and trespass within its borders.
Grow your empire, great one! Sunder this province and your rivals will be forever wary of your burgeoning power!

Well done, Warden! You have increased Yvresse’s defences and restored the Mists' effects. Your forces can now move through your capital’s region with greater ease, while enemies will suffer casualties there as they lose their way in the murk.
The treacherous Grey Seer Skaven assemble at the eye of the Vortex, my lord. Their bid to summon the Horned Rat must fail – attack, and gain control of the Vortex yourself!
Without the Asur, the world is lost. Ulthuan must prevail!
Order the infantry to form a line, facing the enemy. Have your archers remain behind the line to protect them.
Our forces have been defeated. They run from the battle! Let us retreat and regroup!
Lustria lies vulnerable before you, Lord Skrolk. In the name of Clan Pestilens, and the Great Horned Rat, spread your noxious disease across the world. Leave none alive!
But take heed – the Treemen of the forest will not sit back while we attack! They will try and save their monstrous champion, just as it saved them in the past.
Keep the enemy in front of you! Do not let yourself become surrounded!
Revered Master Kroak slumbers in Itza as enemies surround. I, the Great White Lizard, shall protect. All invaders shall fall!
The path to the Plague Lord's Mansion is clear. The Gardener, Nurgle's favoured Daemon Prince, lurks there. That is who you must slay, but he will be protected by swarms of Daemonic minions.
My lord, your allegiance grows ever stronger. Show you have devoted yourself completely and you will not be able to form other alliances thereafter.
Formidable as they are, your war leaders fight on foot in battle. Equip them with mounts and their reach will extend the length and breadth of any battlefield.
Pointy-eared no-furs will plan attack now Skaven presence is-is revealed-exposed. Must not-not let them regroup! Keep attacking, nyaargh!
The Beacon is safe. Many lives have been spared. The survivors look to me for leadership. I will need them, for the Wolf still lurks in the shadows.
The harsh environment of the desert claims many souls and cities beneath its sands, in exile, your tower has also succumbed to others. Reclaim it, and grow your master's followers.
If you continue your trail of destruction south then even richer lands shall be in reach. The fragile souls of Kislev and the Empire will fuel your rise to ultimate power!
New job, new start. Nice.\\n\\nSo, who’s doin’ the payin’, and who’s doin’ the dyin’?
Take heed of the surroundings, brother. The battlefield is a weapon we can use against the foe. The enemy gave battle, so the onus is on them to attack. Use this to our advantage!
Missile weapons will prove decisive in the coming battle, Yuri. Target the enemy from afar, but make sure they are protected, as our enemies will try and pick them off.
The Dwarfs of Karak Ziflin reside here. They are strong and stubborn – leave them to drool over their gold, but be ready, for they will despise you as their neighbour.
Few dare tread creation’s ragged edge, save those who crave the Dark Gods’ favour.
Clan Fester of the plague-spawn encroach, they dare to challenge us. They shall be the first to be taught the word of Sotek and suffer His indomitable wrath.
Fuelled by greed, men of the Empire venture deeper into the jungle’s heart.
Long have I fought and suffered for my people.

Alas, your Waaagh! has failed, my lord. You did not conquer your target’s capital in time, so the mobs have dispersed. There will be no trophy this time, so now you must gather your destructive momentum once again.
Other children of Sotek hold out against the ratmen’s plague. They protect a great power within Itza and may prove to be valuable allies in the Skaven purge.
Yet there are places where no Ruinous Power claims influence. In the Forge of Souls, Be'lakor lurks, and Ursun dies.
You have gained a great deal of favour from the Old Ones. Use it to recruit a unit blessed by their mighty power.
Sudenburg have been sending expeditions into the jungle, trespassing on our ancient temples and taking what is not theirs. I shall strike them from these lands.
The sites of recent battles may bear many fresh prizes to adorn the Skull Throne. Send your minions to search these places, for the Blood God's skull-hunger is insatiable.
You are the Lichemaster – strike at the heart of your hated Bretonnia and bring death to all those that stand before you!
You doubtless foresaw that your stronghold would come under attack. Confront the misbegotten fools who march against you, and put a swift end to their wretched lives!

You have bravely upheld Bretonnia's reputation as the protector of honour and chivalry in the world, yet the Lady demands one last challenge of you. I ask you now to bestow your great virtues upon us and lead the Chevaliers to their final victory over our enemy!
My lord, the Dark Elf still wields the Daemonic power you seek. We must go to him and extract it before it is too late.
Your highness, there are enemies close by that threaten your throne. If we are to save Ursun, they must be dealt with first.

The Forbidden Workshop contains multiple research divisions. Each set of upgrades improves a War Machine or Weapons Team, with a division dedicated to the construction of Doom-rockets. With enough Warp-fuel and food, available upgrades can be researched.
My infernal Master’s gifts will empower us to serve His ends, lest death or damnation take us first.

Your allegiance and devotion is unmatched, my lord, but take heed of your actions and watch the horizon carefully, for you have enraged the other Gods and they come for you now, sending their most prized champions to challenge you!
The anvil has fallen to you, Lord Tretch. Move at once to secure the Warpstone abundant in the local area. Facilities must be constructed to begin extraction.
Pirates have been spotted close by. Showing them your broadside would be a good way to further your Infamy or gain a Treasure Map, should you wish to attack them.

You have done the impossible by desecrating Tzeentch's fortress and charting his labyrinth. The Changer of Ways notes your success even if it is with contempt. You now have all the souls required to reach the Forge of Souls. Muster your greatest force, but do not tarry, for Be'lakor awaits. Prepare for the ultimate battle!
My search bears fruit, master, for a third book of your great wisdom is mine! Your irresistable power courses through me - I shall seek more!
Despair all ye realms, the Leechlord has come, the sad days of this world are nearing their sum!
The Garden of Blight lies ahead. Order the advance!
Yet this threat will be of little consequence once the Great Drill is operational and fully powered!
Perhaps you know the intrepid adventurers well; a drinking establishment will not go unnoticed by them.
Your actions have sent shockwaves throughout the jungles of Lustria. No temple-city will feel safe now that the Huntsmarshal has defeated the Great White Lizard.
For in this harsh land of zealotry, prayer speaks only in the tongue of war.
Fiddle-dee-dum, fiddle-dee-dee, souls for the Fly Lord, his favour for me! The veil between worlds grows thin… great things await beyond Zanbaijin!
Our faith can purify Dervingard. Give the order to build a Totem.
The fruits of manipulation ripen so nicely.
The Druchii have murdered and enslaved the Asur for long enough! Their day of reckoning is now! Fear the shadows... fear my name: Alith Anar!
You gonna 'elp Grom conquer da world or wot?
You must act quickly, regain the Shard Lands from the Crimson Skulls. Their pain will give you meagre sustenance, but it is a necessary step to reach riper fruits.
A Frost Maiden. We are fortunate to find a magic-user.

Beneath skeins of sorcerous mist, the host of Athel Loren, too, stirs at dire rumblings. Led by their hunter-king beyond the rune-marked weald, the Wood Elves march in reluctant aid of a world they mistrust.
Feckless tribes of the north! Do they know who they face? There was a time when I led their best into battle.

By gathering Way-fragments, scattered across the world during the events of the Sundering, we may gain means to avert the collapse of the Vortex. This search takes us far from home, to the rich jungles of the lizards.
Trust built between diplomatic parties opens the door to further co-operation. A trade agreement may be possible with your foreign partners. Let your merchants flourish, for industry drives war.
Elves and humans are such venal creatures, so easily lured by the promise of decadence. Tempt them enough, and they will all become playthings of Slaanesh!
Brace yourself, admiral, for the ancient Merwyrm surfaces once more!
An upstart Dreadlord approaches, Your Dark Majesty, claiming to know where a lost artefact of great power may be found. He has even been so bold as to named a price...
Yet, despite the enemy assaults, there remain brave defenders, ever-loyal to you. Bolster them and they will gladly confederate with a revered Dragon!
The Librarian is summoned! Execute Tzeentch's favoured Daemon Prince and steal his soul!

You breached the Brass Citadel, a feat so rare as to draw Khorne’s gaze! Whether that is in ire or respect is yet to be known, for a long shadow is cast over your mighty victory, as Be’lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the first soul, but three more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
The ritual is ready. Let us commune for its initiation.
Your Highness, a victory so close to the capital strengthens your rule, but the Marauder threat remains. Recruit more warriors to your banner while you are in friendly territory.
Behold, the Fallen City calls to us! Nurgle’s prepotency is at hand!
Secrets hide in these texts. Choose a Technology to research.
The skulls of vanquished Champions adorn my vestments and cede their strength to me!
The path to glory, only the true chosen may step upon it!
Quite the acquisition, my lord. Their unique skills will certainly bolster the expedition.
They will see battle soon enough.
The Elector Counts of the mighty Empire! Each may have their own agenda, but perhaps you can convince them to unite as one.
The Black Ark will serve as a battlefield upon which to fight and crush your enemy!
The time of men and Dwarfs is over, Azhag. The crown whispers desires of death and destruction, and you will oblige!
Atop the Tower of Prophecy in Ghrond, the Sorceresses of the Dark Convent commune with the malign powers of Chaos. Such energies could be directed towards control of the Vortex, dark lord.
The grounds before the Plaguelord's mansion are ever-hungry for nutrients, and the bodies of your army will fester and fertilise the rancid soil. Defeat was inevitable.
The world is an increasingly dark place, Oxyotl, but you are the one who hunts unseen. Cleanse the corruption one threat at a time, and may the blessings of the Old Ones continue to guide you.
For I am the Hag Queen of Har Ganeth! Let the screams of Death Night echo across the world!

[[col:green]]It is as our mistress says, Arahan. The Weave here is dangerously out of balance.[[/col]]\\n[[col:magic]]Yet there is much prey. Glorious![[/col]]\\n[[col:green]]This is no game, sister! We must prepare for Ariel's arrival.[[/col]]
Ulthuan's walls cannot protect the greater world. I shall do it!
Despite your recent conquest, the population of this place has not yet succumbed to your rule. Spread the customs of your kind through these untainted lands.
The enemy come upon your homeland, mighty sorcerer. A war chest would prove useful should the need arise to provide assistance to your kin in Ulthuan.
There is blood to let and skulls to collect! Let the reaping commence!
In the temple-cities of Lustria, the Lizardmen enact a ritual to call upon their mighty guardian.
No new-fangled technology can better the ways of old! But to relearn the forgotten techniques of our past? That is a goal to be admired.
Savage Orcs have already started sending raiding parties against us from their stronghold in Galbaraz. More will surely follow if we do not dispatch them immediately.

Loremaster Talarian is a credit to the sages of the White Tower. Teclis has chosen his allies wisely. The Loremaster bids we seek out Way-fragments - the broken spirit stones of the Sundering. Such precious shards can be used to stabilise the Vortex. I will make it a priority.
The Undead now rest and their capital Castle Drakenhof is yours to plunder. Turn over every tomb, mausoleum and tower in the city to learn of their necromancy and unnatural ways!
Yet at Hexoatl stands Mazdamundi, eldest and mightiest of the living Slann, his patience worn thin by centuries of desecration.

Be warned, my lord – the Under-City may be hidden from those above, but it will be detected if we are not cunning in its expansion. Keep a close eye on which buildings you construct to ensure it stays undiscovered.
No lucid ambition survives the Blighted Marshes – where Skavenblight festers amid foetid pools, and ratmen as canny as they are malevolent devise contraptions to crack the world open.
For once harmony shatters, malice will flood through the cracks.
But it is through Black Blood Pass where frail Kislev lies supine and ready for infection. You shall bring misery upon its people before defiling their god!
The world belongs to the dead, and you are the admiral to usher in this age, Count Noctilus. Roth can no longer stop us – the seas are yours for the taking!
You must brave the storm but be mindful of your approach. When you decide to charge the beast, the extreme winter conditions will slow the movement of your warriors!
The survivors of your defeated enemy have been rounded up, my lord, their fate now in your hands. If you wish, these captives can be set aside as sacrifices to Sotek in return for his many blessings.
The foul scent of vermin permeates this place. Do not risk the Skaven undermining your rule. Take steps to reduce their chittered lies spreading among your followers.
Heroes of the ancient Dynasties may be awakened if you desire it, my lord. Once resurrected, such warriors may be of assistance to your cause.
We must have accidentally stumbled upon a Skaven breeding ground, my lord. No matter – we will deal with these rodents swiftly before continuing with our task.
Greetings, Arch Grand Commodore. The oceans are ripe for piracy and you, as the founder of the Vampire Coast, should take to the seas at once!
The wargrove stands ready. Let the spirits of the forest empower you – rid the world of these foul creatures forever!
The Wolf's army flees! Victory is ours!
Your Druchii forces dominate any battlefield they enter, King Malekith. Direct your Dreadspears against the Skaven enemy - see how they run!

Nor is hers the only rapacity drawn south; even now, reaving sea-wolves muster along the Isthmus coast. In thrall to savage gods and feral appetites, they gouge a foothold into a wilderness that would rather swallow them whole.
Such a magnificent specimen! I am unworthy to be in your presence, yet I risk my neck and approach you, Warlord Headtaker, for I have many secrets that will bring you success and even greater status.

The Druchii – Dark Elves, to the ignorant races – are an insidious threat, Prince Tyrion. Left unchecked, their cunning and malevolence will infiltrate High Elf society to its very core. Take steps to ensure this does not come to pass!
The Vampire Coast is, and always will be, OURS! For we are the terror of the seas. WE are the Pirate King!
The warmbloods spread themselves throughout our sacred jungle to raid lost treasures for their nefarious masters. They must be driven back, and those plaques they have stolen returned to us.
Dominating the heart of the Old World is Order's covenant against the hungering dark – the Empire of Men.
Finally, you have found the dwelling of the colossus known as Blorgar the Mad Titan, my lord!
The nearby peaks are beset with grobi, who must be ousted to clear the safest passage north through the mountains. For the relics of the old Dwarf Empire lie beyond, scattered throughout the world.
The City of Pillars, your traditional haunt, is but a skitterleap north. This lair is fought over by Dwarf and Goblin things but is rightfully yours!
Do you pray to the God-Bear?
Khaine! I stand before you seeking the pleasures of war!\\t
I must congratulate you, Lord of the Druchii, although your victory was never in doubt. The fate of those taken captive from the battle is now yours to decide.

Witless mortal! You march eagerly unto your end.\\nDrunk on shallow exploits, you forget who you face. Know then – now, and forever.\\nAt my feet, the eight points intersect into the mark of boundless Chaos! Through my fist, your guts will drain like the fleeting sands of hope! At the tip of my sword, your world will meet its end!\\nFor I am Archaon! And you are NOTHING!
Your endeavours have received great acclaim. You now have a wide array of reinforcing troops and ordnance to choose from.

The ancient Undead kings of this land constantly bicker with one another. You may decide to rid these lands of their foul taint, but joining this conflict may gain you unwanted favour from these unholy creatures.
Warriors that take to the skies afford a commander great flexibility in battle. Consider recruiting such troops, as they can scout, harrass, and quickly strike where the enemy is weakest.
Enemy riders approach! Tackle them head on with our spears; employ our archers to strike at range. Don't let them charge our rear!
Hunt with me, Tiger Warriors! Through honour, we persevere!
Tremble before me, foul creatures of the night, for I hold the wisdom of your master and the keys to your undoing! Let all who stand against me know true death!
Your kind suffer on these untainted lands. Take steps to spread the influence of Undeath across them.
You have secured a state capital, my lord. Such an act may have ruffled the other Electors, but you may now appoint a new Elector of your own.
Their doubt cannot stop us. We fight those who worship blood and fire. Match their rage with our own.
Your kind are notorious for their intricate schemes. You have at your clawtips a range of stratagems to inflict harm upon your enemies – be sure to make use of them!
Be wary, Yuri, enemy reinforcements are approaching!
'Ave you come to follow me to greatness?
My scrying suggests that some among your Daemonic kind debase themselves in service to another Lord of Chaos. Do not idle, for such corruption can fester and turn your minions against your rule!
We shall shower our foes in plague, pox, virus and sickness, then revel in the rot!
The scheming Lizardmen of Xlanhuapec have been trespassing! If not for the promise of their magical relics we would have wiped them out already! For now, we watch them.
Ursun confides in me. We must journey through the Chaos Wastes and find the Lucent Maze. The next step to save Ursun.
All the while, other warmbloods also wantonly take from our lands, with the Elves having already established colonies here.
In this roiling hellscape of bone-strewn plains, rival champions leave slaughter in their wake as they climb towards darker mastery.

Powerful rites may be enacted in your centres of magic which can tilt the balance of power on the world stage. Task your most potent Sorcerors to perform such incantations and empower your war effort.
Mighty Ungrim, Slayer and king, prevail in your Ancestor’s woes and carve a path of red ruin in the lost name of Drakebeard.

Tireless work, unclean one! The destruction of Ariel’s Waystones has weakened her forces. She can now be provoked into attempting her ritual early, which will leave her open to attack. Should you destroy more Waystones first, however, her bodyguard will be weakened even further.
Where rare green still defies the desolation, hidden hands toil to coax life from this forbidding land.

Cursed trinkets, admiral, that have twisted and altered the minds of those that first claimed them. Now the servants of others, these puppets will be yours to command should you claim the Piece of Eight which corrupted them!
The Caravan routes under its control will give you the riches required for the dread expedition into the Chaos Realm.
Envelop the enemy as best you can! They have their backs to us. A fatal mistake!
Your kind are not well-suited to this country, my lord. Do not rush to establish a permanent presence here: it may be wiser to pillage all that you can and fall back to more hospitable lands.
The wisdom of many lost plaques must be sought to begin the Ritual of Prognostication. Such artefacts can still be found in the most ancient of jungle ruins.
Master… there is a rift – a paradox – in the weave of fate. Your staff is the locus of this anathema. It must be excised or our plans will suffer.
Throgg, you are the Wintertooth; cunning and all-powerful. Let the realms of man suffer in horror and pain as your monstrous horde lays waste to all.
Must be ready-ready to take-steal Elf queen-thing. Not enough Clanrats! Not enough Rat-Ogres! Moulder must rule whole cold place, quick-fast, make big clan-pack here!
If you not follow the Crowfather, then the Crowfather will subjugate you!
Hmm yes-yes… Warpstone is there - my suit can detect it! Great veins waiting to be mined! Must grab-snatch before lesser clans find it and take what is mine-mine!
Your gun lines are primed. Admiral, you have the ability to decimate your enemy should you have a plentiful amount of ammunition at your disposal.
No other rules my coasts, except me!
The primaeval jungles of Lustria once sheltered the mightiest bulwark of Order against the tides of Chaos. Now that power stirs from ageless slumber to enact the Great Plan.
To the south, Kislev. Ruled by overconfident Tzars, these lands are rich with wealth. Tear these men of the bear limb from limb, opening a path for your masters to aid you in due course.
The wreck of the Vengeance has been found, admiral, yet not by us it would seem. A Corsair fleet has been sighted where the vessel went down. They must not be allowed to salvage her!
The forsaken rubble of vanquished civilisations may yet hide treasures worth unearthing. Be sure to dispatch Lords and Heroes to examine ruins as you find them.

An Ogre's stomach is the centre of their world, and flesh is what they most like to fill it with! Your armies march with stockpiles of meat – be sure to maintain these, for hungry Ogres do not make effective soldiers.
The Warmbloods squabble, trespass upon our hunting grounds. If they not yield, then our claws shall be their fate.
Your workshop awaits you, my lord. Let the power of Warpstone be felt by all through the explosive experiments of Ikit Claw!
Your kind are known for stalking your foes, my lord. Approach unseen, and you may bring them to battle unprepared.

Exercise caution, my lord, for your scouts bring word of Chaos Dwarfs nearby. The Legion of Azgorh are a callous and black-hearted foe, bearing little resemblance to their untainted cousins to the west. Keep your weapons close at hand.
Scrolls of great power may be found within the deepest vaults of the enemy capital, Blood Queen. Yet the Dark Convent of Ghrond squander these energies in service to their pitiful sorcery.
A worthy Boyar. The new lord needs an army.
The champion of the Blood God has fallen! His soul is yours – victory!
Banners recovered in the aftermath of combat may be awarded to your own units to enhance their abilities in battle. Be sure to equip these banners whenever and wherever you find them.
As Archaon goads the disparate tribes of the Wastes, his dark muster gathers strength…
Some Warp-fuel has been gained, my lord. The canisters of this potent concoction enable you to research improvements in the Forbidden Workshop.
Do not falter at this late hour. One more act of faith is required.
There are pestilent machinations afoot, for you have become a target of Skaven aggressions at every turn. Stay alert, my lord, there are unseen schemes stirring in the shadows.
My lord! A Skaven host has burrowed out from beneath our settlement and is threatening to attack. You must prepare for battle!
The nearby Vampires surely sense the power of your crown and could be open to an alliance, though such an arrangement goes against your baser instincts. Overrun their lands, if you prefer.
An attack on the shrine will mean making further enemies amongst your Druchii kin, but would secure the scrolls regularly uncovered there for yourself.
This is quite the treasure and certainly more than meets the eye! You now have control over an elite unit to serve you should you wish, admiral.
Emissaries from a foreign leader come requesting a defensive alliance. Such a treaty would bind you to come to their aid should they be attacked.
The Citadel is guarded by eight hundred and eighty-eight Bloodthirsters, but we need only breach its outer-defences to draw out the Gatekeeper.
The enemy recoils before your legions. Destroy these idealistic pretenders!
Brother, please, do not take us down this path.
Bring forward those who wish to lead. Let me see who is worthy.
Order your units forward. Our allies have not gone far.
Nothing, however, is as important as the magic I draw from the Galleon’s Graveyard. I shall harness its strength and dominate the seas. All shall bow to my Necromantic supremacy!
They will know our power, MY power! Raaarrr!
Amid ruins far older than the Dark Elves who now haunt them, the Witch Queen gathers exiles and devotees – her eyes set southward upon a canopy she would strip bare.

This artefact is back in the rightful hands of the Dawi at long last, just as it should be. The Ancestors smile upon your efforts this day, but more heirlooms are yet to be reclaimed. Your work has only just begun.
You have chosen well, my lord. Behold the benefits on offer for fully aligning yourself with your chosen Old One.
It is a wonder to observe how the incurious deny themselves the pleasures of excess. Bestow a Gift of Slaanesh upon a rival and they will begin their journey towards submission and ecstasy.
Hunting the Bloodgrounds is not the only way to attract the gaze of the Dark Gods, my lord. Answering their direct challenges can enhance the brayherd in other ways.
Great energy radiates from this place – can you feel it? Capture the surrounding territory, and its power shall be yours.
Listen… the wolves howl in the north. Something disturbs them.
We should be cautious. Darkness covers this land.

Plagues! Corruption! Filth! The verminous rat-spawn push far into Lustria. Only a merciless co-ordinated assault will relieve us of their presence. The Great Serpent’s rise is foretold, but his strength comes at a price. We must take the rat-spawn's territory and sacrifice them. They will not survive Sotek's wrath!
Yuri, we should build a Camp.
Two victories Yuri! The more we fight, the greater our skill.
The guardians of the Lucent Maze are defeated. Enter the labyrinth and discover the forbidden knowledge. I will guide you, protect you, from Tzeentch's tricks.
A full-on incursion is not desired or warranted – we need only penetrate its outer-defences and the Courtesan shall reveal themselves.
A Hero serving with an army will fight in battle alongside the regular troops. Such warriors are formidable and will significantly increase the potency of your armed forces.
Further south lies an infestation of bubonic proportions, ready to corrupt any bounty we gain. This vermin must be driven from their nests.
Fellow Asur, rally to my banner! Ulthuan is under attack, and the Great Vortex imperilled like never before!
The soldiers are ready. Give the order.
Elf-things to the east don't know I'm here-here, kill-slay them and find Warpstone!
Send troops to capture enemy defences, brother. We can then use them against the foe.
While Khorne cares not from who the blood flows, the Daemonic guardians of the Brazen Altar want it to be ours. Hungry for war, they will come at us directly. This knowledge must inform my strategy.
Yuri, Kislev soldiers emerge from the trees. They're from the beacon! Our allies!
Noble Dragon Prince, these are wild and untamed lands infested by greedy Dawi, twisted Greenskins and other, more secretive vermin. Come what may, the Knights of Caledor must prevail!
You, my lord, are both elegant and brutal in the mists of combat, yet one still mocks you. Rid the world of this grotesque Troll that calls himself "King".
Your general flees, brother. He shames Kislev!

The screams of the vanquished echo across Naggaroth, for the lives of those conquered in battle are forfeit to servitude. Slaves contribute significantly to your treasury, and may be sacrificed to please the gods of the Cytharai. Crush your enemies, and keep the supply flowing!
Deep within the realms of men, the Empire prepares to battle Tzeentch’s Trickster – but to what end?
The natives of this land, the hated Reptile-things, are thus far unaware of your arrival amongst them. Work quickly, spread your influence, and destroy them all!
Let us review what destruction the 'Elf-things' have wrought on the surrounding territory, mightiest of lords. Select your city to inspect the province.

Deception and trickery have served in seizing a foothold here in Naggaroth. The Dark Elves' seat of power lies tantalisingly close. Just across the Sea of Malice, where in Naggarond another king, a feeble one, tallest of the Hydra's heads, needs silencing.

You have done the impossible by desecrating Tzeentch's fortress and charting his labyrinth. The Changer of Ways notes your success even if it is with contempt, but he is not the only schemer whose machinations are coming to fruition... Be'lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the second soul, but two more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
The time has come, my lord, to signal to your people that Nehekhara is truly an empire resurgent! Perhaps some grand civic project is in order, if I may be so bold?
The other Princes of Ulthuan are scattered and distracted, embroiled in the eternal conflict with the Druchii. It is likely we will stand alone in our struggle, at least for now.
I claim your Pyramid, master. It is yours and always has been. Let Settra and the lesser kings try and take it - all will perish!
Those warmbloods that attack us do so with purpose. Let us strike back against them, reclaim what is ours, and discern their motives.
In the north lies a mass of ancient ruins, holding untold treasures and secrets within.
What have you discovered, Yuri? What Technology can help us?
One still stands in your way, Huntsmarshal. See that your arrow strikes him true and be rid of the Spirit of the Jungle once and for all.
Your devotees may be called into martial service as your whims demand. Once summoned, your fanatical army will be eager to expand the dominance of Slaanesh by force.
You have scores to settle with your hated cousins in Ulthuan, so they should not be spared from your predations. Perhaps there may be a Dragon egg or two to help burgeon your collection of beasts…
The near-unimaginable wealth of these lands is dispatched home through the coastal colonies, but recent raids by the lizard-beasts have set the Empire back, and I expect further attacks.

This settlement is yours to do with as you please, whether that be the establishment of a camp to recruit and build from, or to devote it to the Gods by razing it to ash and ruin, gaining their favour and gifts.

The oceans of this world are a ferocious and deadly place, but nothing compares with the Galleon's Graveyard. Sail carefully here, my lord, for it has devoured many great ships that have strayed too close.
Still the Plague Lord's foetid Gardener does not appear. Press on and capture Nurgle's Swamp!
And southwards, just across the sea, are tribes of mortals, followers of the Dark Gods, easy to corrupt and make puppets of, or even vanquish – food for your Plaguebearers.
Go forth and take the angry beasts down!
Your military is mighty, but expenditure on unit upkeep is becoming ruinous. You should consider disbanding some of your troops.

We have only begun to scratch the surface of what the Forbidden Workshop can offer, my lord. As upgrades are purchased within a research division, your engineers also prototype and develop other advancements. Once all research has been completed within a division, special units will be built or equipped to serve you in battle.
Nor is the eastern coast spared, for the tendrils of a great kraken unfurl across the shores, as Dark Elf reavers strangle the land in terror.
Heathens that stray from the teachings of the Great Orthodoxy surround us. Punish such unbelievers with fire and fury!
The men of Kislev, so renowned for their mettle, will be the worthy adversaries. Their souls shall be Khorne’s, but some will fight on in His realm.
Only Nan-Li remains in the hands of the Rebel Lords. Bring the entire province back under your control.
Listen to your gut, great one, let its rumble guide you and together we will seek Ursun and finally sate the Great Maw!
Shown also are those cities in the province that were lost to the enemy - a reminder of the need to reclaim them, my lord.

The followers of Slaanesh are impulsive, hedonistic creatures, motivated by pride, decadence, and excess. Their vainglory may be turned to your advantage, however. Strive to please the masses and they will commit themselves utterly to your cause.

I tamed the tribes. The Northmen bow to me. Fear me.\\n\\nIt should have been a time of triumph, yet I heard my soldiers sniping behind my back!\\n\\nI ordered Gerik to round up the seditious ones. They were Ungols who came with me from Kislev, and supposedly my most loyal. They stand before me, griping and whining about returning to the Motherland. I let them go, but stripped of everything – armour, weapons, even their boots!\\n\\nIf they cast me in the role of warlord, then I will play the part!

Once these misguided warmbloods have been dealt with you will be well positioned to infiltrate the Norscan heartland. With the Northmen’s attentions occupied with warmongering southward, they will not expect your approach. For too long they have been allowed to worship their Ruinous Idols – oblivion awaits those who seek the gaze of the Chaos Gods!

The prophecy cannot be denied, its events foretold by Sotek himself. The Serpent-God’s blessings shall help deliver Lustria from certain doom. First the Lizardmen must unite – only then can the rat-spawn menace be defeated.
I have come for you Asur – you are weak here, so far from home. Your powers dwindle while mine grow!
Recruit a Hero to expand the range of military options at your disposal. Heroes may be assigned to strengthen and support your forces, or may be sent as lone operatives into hostile territory.
Wizards trained in the Celestial Court are stronger when united on the battlefield. More hands allow the Winds of Magic to be wielded with greater potency.
To the cape's gnarled tip, such premonitions drive Daemon oracles to weave the tapestry of war.
All we have done… ordered by you… in Ursun's name. Are you still my brother?
I, Settra the Imperishable - King of Kings, Lord of the Shifting Sands, Eternal Ruler of Mankind – rest no longer. Nehekhara will be restored to greatness!
Be sure to position your troops accurately in battle, my lord. Drag out your formations for best effect.
Mother Ostankya emerges, for she senses that Daemons of Khorne muster against the Motherland in this place.
In King Kazador's name, I will unearth the lost relics of our Ancestors and bring glory to the Dawi once more.
The Lizardmen you command are perhaps the most ferocious warriors that stalk this world, mighty lord. Their fangs and talons will make short work of the enemy!
You must punish their Gold Lust and purge them from their mountain Holds, but be on your guard – other nearby Dawi will not take this lightly and may seek vengeance.

For horrors shamble unabated amid the northern peaks, where an ancient Lichemaster musters the dead beneath shadowed crags. Every fallen knight is another oath stolen; every defeat, another corpse for his court.
The ruined Lizardmen city of Yuatek dominates this province, my lord. The reptiles have long-since abandoned their holdings here. Now your Clan Mors contest control of the ruins that remain.
As the last enemy drew their final breath, a single ray of sunlight broke through the greyest of clouds. Dervingard was free.

It is clear that the Skaven intend some twisted sorcery to exploit the weakened Vortex. They must not interrupt my plans: the scrolls we have found so far are not yet sufficient for Felicion to begin the ritual. More must be found.
In the lands beyond, cohorts of Lizardmen worship the sun within their vast temple cities. They hold many treasures in their vaults; they shall be yours soon enough, my lord!
Whilst an attack on the Druchii will open another front, they must not be permitted to wield such power. Move against them, and claim the energies of this place for Ulthuan.
We found supplies in the snow, from Dervingard.
But there is much to do, and little room for error. With the power of the Jade Court at his call, Yuan Bo sallies forth.
The time has come to venture from your workshop once again, Master Runelord. Contact has finally been made with the lost Dawi of Karak Zorn, who stand ready to lend their aid to your great cause.
Here you reside within the realms of the Northmen of Norsca. Their Chaos-worshipping ways are an affront to the Great Plan, and cannot be tolerated.
Prince of Daemons… god-slayer… the Ruinous Powers watch, waiting for you to make your mark on this world. The deeper the scar, the easier it will be to wrest Ursun's remnants from Be'lakor!
The Harbinger throws the last of his minions at you – they come from all sides! Prepare yourselves!
Many unscrupulous actions have taken you down a dark and unchivalrous path. You will no doubt feel the Lady's wrath for this.
The Undead rise on the River Ruin and production is disrupted. Call my legion!
The enemy still threaten your black citadel, sire. March now towards the capital and block any possibility of attack.
The Knights of the Flame invade in some petty errantry war. Such fools should perish beneath the burning sun.
The Damned Prince stalks these realms once more!
When the Dreadfleet sails, all shall know the horror that Count Noctilus brings.
The Southlands are in grave peril, its temple-cities under threat. I will not fail Lord Mazdamundi and the Geomantic Web.
There is the Gardener, Nurgle's Daemon Prince. Slay him!
The War Crown of Saphery has gone missing, mighty sorcerer. An artefact of such incredible power cannot fall into the wrong hands. A ritual must be conducted to help discover its location.
The time to summon the Horned Rat is now! The High Elves of Ulthuan have moved to defend their precious Vortex, yet they are easy prey. Attack!
The High Elves may have driven you from Ulthuan’s shores before, but you are not defeated. Your momentum gathers, mighty Goblin King – soon you shall become an unstoppable force once again!
They must be annihilated, along with the Tzeentchian scourge lurking before Zanbaijin!
Your unstable units degraded during battle and now suffer from detrimental effects! Fortunately, recycling degraded units yields a greater amount of Mutagen than units without degradations.
The Brass Glacier is inhabited by mere mortals from the Gharhar tribe. Cover the walls with their blood!
While beast-herds would trample it beneath stampeding ruin.

The Forbidden Workshop has been put to good use, my lord. However, some parts remain unavailable due to the current limitations of the facility. By increasing the Forbidden Workshop's level, more upgrades can be unlocked.

Our travels from the Gallows Tree to the Sunken Sewers place us much closer to mortal lands. All the better for you to unleash your brews and ensure we are powerful enough to breach the Realm of Chaos when the time comes.
Other more verminous beings lurk here too. Skaven corruption spreads like a case of scurvy, although it’s an affliction even the dead can succumb to if left to fester.
Prepare your defences quickly, for the furious passion of Slaanesh and His minions is at fever pitch!
Global recruitment is available to boost your armies far from home, my lord. Yet such flexibility comes at a price – build your forces close to home, where possible.
Move quickly through the land of the living, dark lord. The dead should not linger in untainted country.
I have been informed that Loremaster Talarian has prepared the ritual. He awaits our word to begin the invocations. Only fools and southerners hesitate. Start it!
Your slaves uncover more chambers and charnel pits, full of long-dead servants that are quickly resurrected. See that the expansion continues, so that you may further develop your realm.
Bringing him down will be no easy feat! Swarming him with several units at once may not be the best course of action.
Though your rapid return brings some welcome additional forces, the situation remains grim. See for yourself!
You've kicked the hornets nest and released untold horrors, my lord. Make ready for war, the expedition will surely now come under attack.
The Great Vortex is vulnerable, and those of dark intent would seek to draw its power for themselves. This cannot come to pass.
Instead, the hunter becomes the hunted.
Only the spineless occupy such settlements, followers of Khorne bring slaughter – razing everything until there is naught but blood-stained ruins!
You have strayed from your master. The bonds you formed are weakened by forming new allegiances with others.
Glorious! You now wield the Sword of Khaine. Use its immense power to annihilate your enemies!

The population of your province grows, my lord. Over time, this growth will permit the expansion of your cities into mighty fortresses of war. See that it continues, so that you may further develop your realm.
The mighty protector of the jungle is nothing more than a hunter’s trophy.
I pray Ursun can absolve the stronghold.
The time has come! The first of many rituals is prepared. By stabilising the Vortex, we shall guarantee Sotek’s return!
But we must be aware that the lizard-beasts dominate these jungles. For our colonies to survive their threat, reinforcements will be needed from home.
If the colonies are to prosper, we must know more about the dangers that lurk in these lands. Abandoned ruins may contain useful information about past threats that may yet return in the future.

Your Dark Elf foes have also settled in this continent, my lord, far from their homelands in Naggaroth. Sources indicate that they have located a cache of great power, which they no-doubt intend to direct against the Vortex.
The Elves controlling Lustria’s coastline are another formidable threat that should not be ignored. They battle with Skaven Warlords and the Vampire Coast for dominance over these lands.

Many apologies your great bulkiness, but I bring news. The Black Orc Warboss seeking to take these mountains for his own has been lured to the Fire Mouth as you requested. Now is the time to crush him!
The mightiest of the warmblood hunters have been defeated. Soon they will all meet this fate, and the Great Plan shall come to fruition.

In the glacial halls of the Ice Court your hardiest warriors are forged. Yet they may not enter unprepared – assign your finest minds to compile the foundational knowledge that will underpin all training!

In the pantheon of Chaos, it is Slaanesh's influence that spreads most easily amongst the venal and weak mortal races. With a little intervention, you may ensure that the reach of Slaanesh eclipses that of His rivals.
Glory to you, mighty protector! Your instincts have brought you to the mysterious, fog-shrouded isle of Albion, a place of great power and ancient secrets.
Even greater sacrifices and rewards are now available to you, my lord. Sotek’s power grows with every offering, as do the blessings he bestows upon his most fervent followers.

Such is the devastation wrought upon Archaon’s vile host, that hope has been rekindled, setting in motion an unthinkable counter-offensive.\\nThe Everchosen is cornered. He must be destroyed before he can recover his strength – once and for all.
Violent murderess, Queen Hellebron, the sounds of torment and death ring out throughout your city of Har Ganeth.
Total devotion, you give yourself to the Serpent as its mighty champion. Go forth with the gifts of corruption and seduction in the Serpent's name!

More treasure-hungry living inhabit these realms; they shall not stand in my way as I march to you, my master. Any artefacts stolen by these mortals will be returned to their rightful home within the Black Pyramid.

The Plague Lord's mansion has been sundered! The God of Decay begrudgingly concedes your might, but will no doubt already be concocting a new disease to blight your empire in retaliation. Still, Be'lakor remains the most pressing threat. You have the first soul, but three more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.

The defenders of the Celestial Dragon Empire have been sighted nearby. You may scoff, yet I advise caution: while the forces of Cathay may be individually weak, when united their powers in battle are quite formidable.
Along the Mountains of Mourn, other forces of nature dwell, perhaps to be of use – or simply to meet their end in the cataclysms to come.
There is great wealth to pillage here in the Dragon Isles. The strange beasts that thrive in its jungles have yet to encounter a tyrant such as you, my lord.

Magnificent! The Doomsphere’s detonation has reduced the settlement to rubble! Such levels of destruction are unrivalled, although the weapon's uncontainable power also caused the entire Under-City to cave in.

Yuri, your scent grows strong, saturated in the power you have gained. I am close, but I grow weak.\\n\\nConfront the traitor Slavin Kurnz. Offer no mercy, only blood. Slay him and the Howling Citadel is yours. Together we will roar to melt the snows. Together we free Kislev of this winter.\\n\\nMake war, Yuri, seek your true god.
The enemy recoils before your legions, Great King. End these pests once and for all.

Your kind thrive on the machinations of statecraft, noble lord. Influence won amongst your peers in the halls of the Asur is a currency like no other, and can be spent on favours both home and abroad.
The Flesh Laboratory is where you can augment your minions by mutating, splicing, or surgically altering them to improve their performance in war – at the risk of certain instabilities, of course.
Southlands under attack from Elf-things! Clan Mors sent to-to kill Elf-things and find Warpstone. Warpstone essential!
The jungles and mountains of this place appear to house many sites of arcane power. I shall harness them for my lord Malekith, and he will grant me what was promised.
The Elves are scattered, Lord Queek! All of Skavendom shall chitter of your magnificence. It only remains to decide the fate of those captured in battle.

That perfume, those screams... the forces of Slaanesh must be close at hand! Be wary, for these decadent, amoral sadists will seek to tempt your followers into the service of the Chaos God of Pleasure.
Agents of Fateweaver fan the flames of rebellion. We cannot risk such sedition reaching Nan-Gau.
These towns fall under the Ice Queen's influence, but can be won over... or trodden underfoot if they refuse to see the truth.
The artisans of the Mortuary Cult stand ready to assist your cause, my lord. Employ them to craft powerful artefacts that may aid you in your conquests.
When Naggaroth stirs, no shore is safe.

Challenging and defeating another mighty Drake has brought it into your battle ranks, Dragon Prince! Many more exist out in the world, some more formidable than others, but all worth convening with to gain their wisdom and loyalty.

The Sorceress is ready to unleash her first ritual against the Vortex of the Asur; but Felicion is not alone in trying to influence the magic maelstrom. We must hurry, I will not lose to some foreign cur. More Scrolls are needed to dominate the Vortex and we shall find them!
I'm da Warlord of Eight Peaks, yoos remember that!
We have constructed siege weapons. They're in position. We're waiting on your order to attack.

We came upon ruins. A village of hide tents dominated by a totem of a white crow. They belonged to Northmen, enemies of Kislev, who worshipped Tzeentch. On the ground, smeared in blood, was the emblem of the traitor Slavin Kurnz. His army had slaughtered the tribe. No mercy was given, but I felt no pity. In these unforgiving lands, would the Northmen have treated us any different?
Uzkulak is the city that dominates this region. Taking it from the Orcs will send a strong message.
Your subjects persist in their agitation against you rule. Repression is the fastest way to silence dissent: garrison an army within your unruly province, to quell this dissent.
Just like the Druchii, the vermin are vicious and opportunistic killers. They are doubtless working tirelessly to undermine your fortress.
Your kind is fabled for its fireside revelry. Set up a camp to serve as a base for operations far from home. From such camps come a re-supply of meat, fresh forces, and control of the local terrain.

With the vanguard of his forces ground to dust, Nagash withdraws to his sable dominion among the barren wastes.\\nWhoever dares follow him there must steel their resolve and ward their soul, for a liche is most lethal when cornered in his sepulchre.

You have obtained some scrap, my lord! The spoils of war are not just the looted wealth of defeated foes, but also scrap materials from their weapons and armour, which can be repurposed to equip your own troops.
Clan Rictus find Warpstone best of all! Ritual is ready now, ha-ha! Go-go!
This mighty predator is a worthy challenge; when it is enraged it becomes invincible. Prolonged combat will trigger such a rage, so time your attacks well and avoid its full fury!
Cease your chittering, adherents of decay, for Skrolk speaks! By will-will of Council we set paw in Lustria to visit ruin upon the Reptile-things - yes-yessssss.
The full tombs of the desert kings to loot, as well as Greenskin hordes to raid!
Riders from the White Tower report that the ritual is prepared, and Loremaster Talarian stands ready to perform the ceremony. Let us not waste a moment!

Here we may see the state of the province that surrounds your capital. The enemy raids have caused considerable unrest; obedience is suffering as you can see, my lord. The agitators will need suppressing in time, but matters of defence are more urgent.

You would do well to strengthen your armed forces, for in such dangerous times it pays to be prepared to meet the enemy. Yet be sure to keep an eye on your expenditure, for any standing army must be maintained with gold.

And where the Grey Mountains end is the true treasure, Marienburg – a city rich in gold and supple flesh. Beyond lies the Empire. So much blood for your pot… enough to summon the rifts and hunt for god-meat in the Realms of Chaos.
Your son has sent you south, away from your traditional stronghold of Ghrond, to reinforce the loyalty of those who defy the Witch King. Destroy or subjugate them, according to your whim.
These mortals yearn for death, oblige them!
Attack, my Lord Mazdamundi! Attack! Drive the barbarous warmbloods from your sacred jungles!
Move to attack Skollden. Kill the Wolf and liberate Dervingard.
The Skaven approach, mighty prophet. Prepare yourself!
The forces of blood and murder stir, courting their demise at the hands of Tamurkhan's horde.
The deluded Caledorian Elves have launched patrols into the Great Ocean – for this, they shall feel my wrath!
The nearby armies of Nurgle may prove useful in the march of conquest... if the Maggot Lord can prove his crushing dominance.
One of your subordinates shows questionable devotion to your cause, it would seem. Consider taking steps to appease or otherwise deal with them. Disloyalty cannot be left to fester.
The dead wash against the hull of the Swordfysh and Vampires come to consort... sent by my father in preparation for the challenges to come.
Somehow, the Greenskins have returned to Yvresse, the rotten stench of their dung piles hanging thick in the mists.
Once within Cathay, you and your minions can tear it apart. But that is just one destiny open to you…
For this land is not short of evils. In accursed Sylvania, the Vampire Count plans his designs for the Imperial throne by the terror of his Dark Magic and shambling, Undead hosts.
Verminous reinforcements may occasionally be summoned from below the battlefield, mighty lord. It is not for nothing that your kind are infamous for the employing the element of surprise in war.

But it is the sea, not the sand that calls – the Seafather would have you sit upon a throne of coral and rule the world and so sends Undead allies to aid your cause. You are the Queen of the Tides – all shall bow to your piratical majesty!
I will reclaim these hovels for old Kislev! Trespassers be cursed!
Winds of Shyish, usher our enemies into the deathly halls of doom!

Its power may be the key to staving off the evil that spreads through the world. Across the frozen seas, savage men – followers of Chaos – voyage to war and destruction. These are the very acts which sap your strength, my queen.
Rejoice, for the battles to come will offer numerous chances to spread your contagions. Engorge your Daemon host with more drones.
Devotion to the Motherland is highly prized in your society. Strive in all you do to promote fidelity to your customs amongst your people.
Go forth and take the angry beasts down!
Proceed into the valley. Select your entire army, so any order is given to all.
These seas harbour many infamous pirates. The mighty Wavebreaker has been spotted, admiral, its captain looks to sink you with haste.
Mortals approach. Those who do not willingly come to my side shall be rent apart.
Once more the light of Kislev shines in the darkness of the Chaos Wastes. Dervingard is free from tyranny.
You know why we're here. Meat! Loot! It all belongs to us.

Well done, my lord. You have made great progress in reclaiming the lost artefacts of your kin. But beware, for it is certain that there are more malevolent forces chittering in the deeps who covet the treasures you seek.

Gradually, the evidence you have gathered starts to make some semblance of unholy sense.\\nWhat loathsome knowledge you have gathered, you hope to soon forget. For now, however, it may prove key to shattering the Vermintide.
The Dragon Isles to the south hide many powerful monsters, some unknown in nature. Such threats should be dealt with carefully, but ruthlessly.
The glorious word of the Darkling Prince must be spread beyond your borders. Convert the wretched prudes that dwell beyond your realm, and free them in mind and body.
Leave these trees, for they are exposed and the enemy will press us in great numbers. The high ground here will serve well as a defensive position.
Find the whereabouts of those that channel the ritual and attack before its completion, my lord. Control of the Vortex must not fall into enemy hands!
The world trembles before me, for they see that Settra eclipses the Betrayer! Bring me more of his power! Those that stand against me shall perish!
The Under-City has been established! You can now extend the Under-Empire into this region by building warrens directly underneath the unsuspecting settlement.
When the Wastes descend, all will be slaughter for the thirsting gods.
…to the south are many scattered tribes who serve no master; tools to expand your influence across the Chaos Wastes.
Deeds of uncommon strength or courage are celebrated amongst your kin with the conferral of a Big Name. Such accolades are highly prized within your culture, for Ogres respect a leader with guts.
The elusive Radixashen waits, in protection of the Oak! Now all that is needed is for you to trap the flying beast and slay it!
Great Plan of the Old Ones must proceed. Death on those who oppose it!
With every tide my power grows, but even I must begin in humble surroundings... Men from the Old World make their colonies in the south - they shall become willing patrons of the arts...
More godless Orcs dwell in the mountains to the south. But a much greater threat squats within my kingdom. The Necrarch Brotherhood leech upon my realm. A parasite that must be purged.

Many plaques remain hidden, harboured by the pox-ridden vermin! The rat-spawn are only fit for one purpose – for sacrifice to Sotek! He compels us to chase them from their burrows and onto the sacrificial altars. May the Great Serpent rise again!
Nowhere is the trial bloodier than Zanbaijin, where the damned butcher one another for the right to lead ruin south.
The Greenskin scourge already have a foothold here, overrunning the former trading town of Steingart and threatening to expand northwards.

You have done the impossible by desecrating Tzeentch's fortress and charting his labyrinth. The Changer of Ways notes your success even if it is with contempt, but he is not the only schemer whose machinations are coming to fruition... Be'lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the first soul, but three more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.
The local Dawi Clan here have long been cut off from the rest of our people. Bringing them under my banner can only strengthen us, and hasten the search for the artefacts I seek.

Those wretched curs dare to go against me, Luthor Harkon! This place gained its name on the back of my exploits; the Vampire Coast is mine and I will not tolerate mutineers. These treacherous dogs will beg to walk the plank when we are through with them!
But these, Great King, are but more distractions to a grander plan. The Black Pyramid stands guarded for now by a Sentinel army; control it and claim its dark secrets and with it unimaginable power.
The odds are scarcely more favourable westward, where the stark Estalian plains harbour a braying incarnation of pure Chaos – a terror whose mere presence unmakes flesh and mind.

Even the greatest structures of this land cannot outlive me; all that remains of this former city are its decaying ruins. Ancient secrets may be buried under the rubble and there may be great benefits in uncovering them. I must be careful, however – we cannot suffer another trap, for my mind would struggle to survive another assault.
Now is your chance, my lord. Have the great adventurers join you and witness their legendary might for yourself.
Obedience is becoming a problem here. Those who inhabit this place begin to stir against your rule. Appease or suppress them to snuff out dissent.
Hail Khalida, mighty warrior-queen. Darkness falls upon your kingdom once more.
These pitiful mortals are near-helpless against the temptations of Slaanesh. Press them further, into mindless servitude!

The knowledge to reach Ursun lies hidden in the Lucent Maze. The servants of Tzeentch defend it, but it's not them I fear. Mortals that enter the labyrinth rarely emerge with their mind intact. I pray Ursun protects me.
The Druzhina Enclave are especially keen to show fealty. Look to confederate with them early on.
We leave Dervingard at first light.
The vile sourcery of the Great Betrayer empowers me! Yet more books elude my grasp - redouble your efforts, minions! Do not test my patience further!
Chief Warlock, we have enough resources to build a Doom-rocket. By investing in this destructive, but finite, ballistic weaponry, your enemies shall think twice before facing you on the battlefield.

A word in your ear: despite the great power you command, the loyalty of your followers cannot always be presumed. Keep a close watch on your subordinates, lord, and be sure to bring those that lack a little faith into line, either through strength or favour.
My capital requires labour – I will seek it.
Lord, we have brokered an alliance with your… brothers… They lie in wait as the enemy approach the Brazen Altar. All it requires is your attendance.
Many ruins and reptile-things here in jungles. I take Warpstone from all, yes-yes, much power to have. Other Skaven here too, must not trust them, make them serve Clan Skryre.
The Bridge of Shadows lies ahead! The fight against Be'lakor's minions begins there. Onwards!
Far to the west lies the Druchii shrine of Vaul's Anvil, my lord. From it emanates a great and terrible power, yet the grounds around the shrine are surely rich with the Way-fragments you seek.
The Monstrous Arcanum houses a collection of the mightiest beasts and monsters that roam the world. Seek them out and hunt them down to acquire their gifts!
Wipe out the Ungol Kindreds, and seed their settlements with followers who share the ideals of the Great Orthodoxy.
Greenskin tribes must be routed, while Skaven and Vampires are purged from their nests before the High Priest can enact his scheme.
The vile taint of Chaos festers in this place. Take steps to stop corruption spreading amongst your followers, or they may turn against you in service of the Ruinous Powers.
The cold bites. We should head north and find shelter.
Those foolish enough to contest this powder-keg realm must brave waves haunted by drowned corsairs, whose demands for gold and blood thunder from the black berths of Sartosa.
To end the Everchosen’s threat is to thwart prophecy itself. The End Times are no more.
But queen-thing not fool-fool. Many-many Elf-things protect stone-things. Not problem, me make big-strong creature-beasts to smash-crush puny Elf-things.
Not to ally with, of course, but to kill! For your father cares not from where the blood flows!
Sigmar is no god of yours, or indeed the Empire's today, my lord. They burn in the fires of Norsca and the destruction you leave.
Hey! What was that? Someone had better investigate!

You breached the Brass Citadel, a feat so rare as to draw Khorne’s gaze! Whether that is in ire or respect is yet to be known, for a long shadow is cast over your mighty victory, as Be’lakor remains in the Forge of Souls with the prize. You have the second soul, but two more are required to light the Bridge of Shadows.

Long have your kind existed in tormented Undeath, mighty lord, prematurely raised by Nagash’s dark sorcery. Rally the Undying legions to your banner and the world can belong to the Tomb Kings once again!
Take-steal Naggaroth and the Vortex for Clan Rictus! Then Council will have seat for Grand Chieftain of the Deep Warrens! Yes-YES!
All trespassers will die. Jungle to reclaim. I protect Lustria for Old Ones!
How brother? How do we purge Chaos from these walls?
The Ogres approach – creatures prone to gluttony, a symptom to exploit!
Yes, master, your benevolent wisdom enriches me! The search for your tomes continues - those who oppose your power shall know only service in Undeath!
An Ogre camp has been sighted nearby! Such brutish creatures are generally best kept at the sharp end of a sword, yet on occasion it has been known for outsiders to yoke their strength.
Fighting the pretentious Bretonnians will likely improve their mood. Their lands surround you, but like all men of the Old World, they are weak and will easily fall to your horde.
The Icon of Torment is in your hands! The Blood God's rage boils over – defend yourself!
Relations with your diplomatic partners have flourished, and a defensive alliance may soon be achievable. Such an agreement will bind each party to come to the others aid when attacked.
You may construct training facilities in the territory of your war allies. Do this, and you will be able to recruit from amongst their warriors.

You have violated the Dark Prince's defences and defiled His palace. For but a fleeting moment, the Lord of Excess' attention is diverted to your victory. But Slaanesh will not be the only sinister entity to have noticed... You have the third soul, but one more is required to light the Bridge of Shadows.

In return for the Dread caused by your destruction, the Dark Gods offer myriad gifts – the means to improve your armies, recruit better champions, find new gear, or even augment your Herdstones. Long may fear surround you!
The Skaven approach, Master of Skies. Prepare yourself!
The Hound snarls with distaste for your disobedience, and with it the gifts you once had have been stripped from you!

But your true enemy will always be the Asrai. They claim to be the forests’ allies, but are as unreliable as any interloper and are not to be trusted. Tear down their halls, finish what Coeddil started!
Your Majesty, it is wise to begin your quest to rescue Ursun far from the Motherland, in territory once claimed by Kislev centuries ago.
Beyond these isles, an ancient desert kingdom of the Nehekharans lies across the sea. Your Black Ark stands ready to support any invasions you wish to instigate in these lands.

Mighty prophet, we have gained access to new sacrifices. Their rewards may be greater, but Sotek demands offerings of greater numbers in return. Thousands more will have to be sacrificed in the Serpent-God’s name.

The Season of Murder has come early it seems! Druchii attack and dominate my realm in order to seize the Scrolls of Hekarti, the very lore I seek. My wrath will be swift, their blood will be collected for my personal unguents.

The Golden Tower is secure, mighty lord. Its misbegotten defenders have fled into the continent's interior. The search for plaques may begin once suitable facilities are constructed. Make haste, for the Vortex diminishes with the passing of time.

Weapons or armour may be found in the aftermath of battle. Such artefacts are much-coveted by warriors of high status such as yourself, for they endow the bearer with great strength or abilities in combat.

Across the straits are the desert lands of the Liche King. He has always been an ally to Vampires, but his fate depends on whether he wants to make an enemy of me. There is only room for one king in these parts!
