Foolish manlings! The Dawi will never reach accord with the likes of you!
Nuf! That's Khazalid for no, Bretonnian!
I have to say nai, on this occasion.
We may work together in the future, but not now, umgi.
It will be, but make no mistake, dumal-scum, I despise this as much as your fell Gods.
So be it, but do not cross me, Dum-kin. I swear on my oath stone you will regret it!
Just because our interests align this once do not mistake it as an alliance, spawn!
I do this for the greater good of the Karaz Ankor!
It is an accord, but my Reckoners will be watching, Chaos scum.
I will not sully the High King's mantle by speaking to Chaos things!
Chaos, how dare you entreat me! Filth! Spawn! Thagi-Kin!
Chaos! Even saying it burns my throat. Speak, scum, and be quick!
I will not parley with thralls of Dark Gods, so choose your words carefully.
I will listen, spawn, but don't expect me to act on anything your vile masters request.
Say what you must, puppet of Chaos…
Never, vile filth! To even suggest such a thing will bring your death!
Take this message back to your unbaraki masters. The Dawi will scour the mountains of you!
The next we see each other it will be in battle and Grimnir's axe will taste your blood!
By the Dragon Crown, the Dawi will never side with Chaos!
Ha! To think... to dare such a thing! Be gone!
No, as I breath, there will be no accord with Chaos filth.
Very well then Skruff-kin, but I don't like it.
An accord then, but your ledgers are marked!
You are banished from my halls. Never show your beards again!!!
You shame your ancestors! Get out of my sight!
No, my kin, my orders stand. This will not be.
You have been appraised by my Reckoners and found wanting.
I cannot, the Great Reckoning begins.
It saddens my heart, but no.
You dare! There is no greater authority!
Bow to the Throne of Power!
Welcome kin! How may the High King serve thee?
Fellow Dawi, it is an honour.
I have no time, for you foolish, manlings, spit out your demands!
The old alliance is dead, so don't come here asking favours!
Hail to your Emperor! What can I do for you?
Don't mumble, manling, I can't stand mumblers…
Now then, manling, what brings you here this day?
We have an accord, but don't cross me, manling!
I agree, but I'll be keeping a close eye. I don't trust umgi anymore – you are too fickle.
Very well, the Dawi and umgi will work together.
The runes favour it, so we shall ally again.
We shall strike an alliance, just as our ancestors did!
I think not. Get out, and tell Franz I'll have him!
Ni, your Empire is no match for mine.
No, the Dammaz Kron is too full of manling grudges!
I'm afraid not, tell Franz it is a nai!
Alas, I cannot agree, you're on your own this time, umgi.
No, we walk different roads on this occasion, manling.
For this moment and this thrice-cursed moment only, we side with urk-scum.
I will take the Slayer Oath myself, but we must work with these vile creatures!
Although it causes me to gag to even say it, we agree with the Greenskins.
Then we work with the grobi, pray to the ancestors it is not for long!
Let the chroniclers record this – Dawi and urks working together!
Ai, I'll work with the Greenskins if it means the Reckoning will prevail.
Ni! I would rather hug an elgi than work with Orc-spawn.
Bring me my axe, so I may slay this wretched grobi filth for even suggesting such a thing!
I will not shame the Royal Clan by agreeing to anything with urks.
Get out of my presence, Orc, before my Hammerers smash you in twain.
Ha! Work with the grobi! You must think I'm a wattock!
Do not sully my presence any longer than you must!
I am the High King, I will hear you beg now!
Talk then, but I make no oath for the surety of your life…
What brings you to the halls of my ancestors?
Greetings… what do you require of the Karaz Ankor?
Ask your favour and I will check with the Dammaz Kron that you are worthy…
Why is there grobi scum in my presence?
I thought I smelt urk stench!
Orc scum! Here? Speak, then, in your bestial tongue…
You bring urks before the High King?!
Urks, here!? I didn't even realise they could talk let alone reason…
You catch me in good humour, Greenskin, I'll hear your proposal.
Ha-Ha! Never! Now, be gone from my halls, my realm, my kingdom!
Nai, you have made a grave mistake coming here. One that shall be marked in the Dammaz Kron.
It seems you have wronged us! We cannot do business.
We will not strike any deals with you this day or ever!
It is with regret, but nai!
Not this time, have your sires return in several generations.
I cannot accept on this occasion.
Get my axe! Why should I hear you speak, Zangunaz!
Vampire! …why do you darken my halls with your foul presence?
Now then, Blood Drinker, this had better be good…
I despise the Unliving, so state your case while I'm still inclined to listen.
Speak, Zangunaz, then I will decide if you keep your head.
I will hear you, Vampire, this once.
Cover the eyes of the ancestor statues… I agree.
Curse all Uzkular! For the good of the realm I accept.
Very well, Zangunaz. To the eternal shame of the Karaz Ankor, I agree.
I do this because I must…
It is an accord, be it one I find repellent.
A dark day for the Dawi, but we shall ally.
Never! Get ye gone, Undead thing!
The High King would never deign to parley with the likes of you, creature!
Get out Uzkular! Never darken my presence again!
I will not sully my ancestors by talking to the likes of you!
I will not parley with the Undead.
Blood drinkers and tomb robbers, be gone!
Fine! I accept but you’re still in the book!
Sign the contract and be done with it!
Don’t disappoint me, Urki, or it’ll be another grudge!
This is no Dwarf before me! I see only a short, short, little gibal-bearded maggot…
Take your ufdi hat off, when you stand before the High King! Dawi-scum! Frundrar!
I already have little patience, and less so for the traitor-kin of the east. So be quick and spit out your offer.
Never mind your threats! You and your alleged god don’t scare me one whisker, Frundrar.
Let me stop you there! Whatever you offer, it is insignificant compared to the grudges recorded in our book!
Careful, Frundrar, for you approach a true Dawi, best keep your head lower than it already is.
So the flies that hover around the arse of the Bull-God dare to approach me.
Mingol-Zharr-Naggrund sends us its emissary. Does diplomatic immunity override centuries of grudges?
The Ancestors look upon you with scorn, traitor-Dawi. What could you possibly offer us?
You stand before real Dwarfs now, Dawi-Zharr, all of them wish to take your Dawazbak, so get on with it!
I am used to taking conflicting oaths, so I will accept your offer while despising you!
I do not break oaths so I accept, but don't mistake that for liking it.
My axe thirsts for your blood… but we have an agreement.
We have an oath of agreement, pray you don't break it.
My Drengi would rather fight you… but this time I'll accept.
I am the last Slayer King. There is an accord in place, do not betray it.
Let us drink to this. Break out the Bugman's!
Then it is done. We will celebrate by matching blades!
Very well, manling, I hope your nags are up to the job.
Very well, Bretonnian, but my Slayers will take convincing.
A tacit agreement it is. Keep your side, umgi.
Let us toast to an accord, but not with that donkey drek you consider drink.
Our Ancestors will sing about this for many generations!
Ai, men and Dwarfs will ally again with the Slayer throng!
So, Bretonnian, you come all this way. Your message better have more substance than the wine you drink!
Deliver the message from your king, manling, but your view of chivalry differs from mine.
The men of Bretonnia, what brings your noble behinds to Kadrin?
I see horse lords of the Bretons approach me. What could they want?
Bring forth the beer, the Bretonnians have arrived to save the day!
Come forth, men of fair Bretonnia, Kadrin welcomes you.
We don't need your help, Bretonnian. We are the Slayers of Karak Kadrin!
I think not, manling, tell Leoncoeur he is on his own.
No umgi, nai, take your armoured nags and do one!
If I was purely Drengi, then it would be yes, alas, I'm also king, so the answer is no.
No, manling, what you propose is no benefit to my Slayer-kin.
As king, I must make tough choices. This is one, Bretonnian, I decline.
I do not like it! Working with Chaos... Grimnir will shun me for this!
A dark day, but it must be done.
It is something I must consider, but it galls me!
The Slayers will work with Chaos scum but this is one day I wish to forget.
The Throng agrees, for Kadrin and the Karaz Ankor. May our sires forgive us!
I thought it stank of skruti – what do you want, pawn of Chaos?
Vile creature, do not dare to enter my halls – do not dare to even talk to me!
Say what you have to say, spawn-kin, but do not taint Khazalid, I'll hear you in the common tongue.
My axe yearns for your throat, dumal-umgi, so you'd better speak quickly.
Stay where you are, servant of Chaos. Take not one further step, I'll hear you there.
I will hear you out, but I warn you, my blood runs hot for your death!
I would rather lop off my dongliz than work with this scum!
By all the Slayers of Karak Kadrin, nai!
Never will the Dawi ally with Chaos!
It is a fine and foolish thing you suggest, Spawn. One I gladly decline.
Ni – you take me for a fool instead of a king, Chaos filth?
Ani, we have an accord, but your clan is not one I take pleasure in working with.
Your clan has never been a friend of Kadrin, but I accept on this occasion.
We will join our throngs and the Urks will quail!
Speak then, clans-Dwarf, but don't expect my response to be to your liking.
Your beard is short, Dawi; it makes you untrustworthy in my eyes.
Hail to the Holds! How may I aid your clan this day?
The Slayers of Karak Kadrin, greet you, clans-Dwarf.
My kin, the throng of Kadrin welcomes you.
Our kin have come. Fetch the Brewmaster, we drink!
Nai, you are kin, but your actions have the ilk of an oath-splitter to me.
No, this cannot be. Now take your gold and leave my presence, clans-Dwarf.
Nai, serve your clan as you must, the way I will serve mine.
I decline your fair offer, kin, but not out of spite – never out of that.
The Holds will stand – that is a certainty, but this offer is not.
An agreement – but not one that best serves my subjects.
As the King of Karak Kadrin let it be recorded in the Hold's records: I agree.
A binding contract?! Send in the reckoners!
You come at a difficult time, umgi… speak quickly.
I have little patience so this better be of import.
What brings you to the halls of my Ancestors?
Come then, let's hear what Franz wants.
Greetings, manlings, are you ready to slaughter the enemy?
Will you join me, men of the Empire, in finding death in glorious battle?
I think not, manling. Be gone!
Do not approach a Slayer with such meek-minded foolery!
Has the Empire lost its mind since I was last there?
Your words are foolish, manling, nai!
Not this time. Come back when your pitiful mannish beards have grown.
Come then, Grobi, the Slayers and Orcs will work together but when this is done, I kill every last one of you…
Urk scum! We have an accord, but a temporary alliance at best!
It is mutually agreeable, but this is a one-off, urk.
Grungni won't be happy; nevertheless, we have a deal with the Greenskins.
An alliance with the Greenskins?! Valaya will be laughing at me!
Very well, we will treat with the Grobi for now.
Grobi scum! Do you expect us to break stone bread and drink your watery grog?
Urk, I have slain so many of your kin, what do you have to say to me!
What have we here, the urks come before the king of the Slayers?
Speak, Orc, but I reserve the right sever your foul head from your neck if I think you lie.
Let the Orc speak, if it can. Usually I never let them live long enough to find out.
This is novel – urks here in my presence, and still breathing!
Nai, urk, nai, now the Axe of Dargo will have its say!
No, my Dawi will never agree to your terms as long as I live, and the halls of Karak Kadrin still stand!
The grobi are enemies, and we shall never ally with their ilk!
You dare approach the Ironfist with such a notion? Get out of my sight, grobi scum!
Haha, to even suggest it would have the longbeards draining their flagons.
No, grobi, but I am in a sporting mood... you have a few minutes to get away…
Urks! Talk fast, for you are my enemy…
You are not welcome, so I won't pretend otherwise. Now spit out your proposal!
My Slayer Oath would have me kill you where you stand, but I am also a king, so I'll hear you out…
Hail! Do not be intimidated by the throng of Drengi, they wish only to die in battle…
Greetings. Let us speak quickly, for I wish to fight.
Ai, I'll have yer words, before you take my ale.
I am Ironfist. Some call me a king, you are welcome here.
Greetings. You'll no doubt have a request – I'll hear it now.
You are a fool to approach a Slayer with such a notion!
I wear a cloak of Dragon-hide! Did you expect me to be accommodating?!
Nai, I must find my death in battle, not waste my time signing treaties!
The throngs of Karak Kadrin disagree.
I have sought advice in the Slayer shrine. And so I must refuse.
Nai, not for all the treasures in Everpeak!
Pray to your gods that I die, so you may return and entreat my sire.
Only as it serves Karak Kadrin!
I don't like it… Betray me, Vampire, and your head will be skewered on my gate!
Make no mistake, I don't do this as a kindness, Vampire!
I trust this agreement as much as you enjoy the sun, beast!
Ai, I will work with the Uzkular. Keep your enemies close. 'Tis sage advice!
Very well, although it sticks in my craw to do so.
How dare you darken my hall, Uzkular!
I have no time for such filth. Your words better carry weight, fiend.
You defile my realm, creature, spit out your words and then the Axe of Dargo will speak!
I don't see any reason why I should address something that cannot breathe in fine mountain air.
I'm an oath-bound to slay you, Zangunaz, but let's hear your pathetic plea first.
The Undead come to parley! Your Necromancers must be incompetent!
Don't try and manipulate me, Uzkular. I am king of the Slayer Keep!
Ha! You think I would betray my Ancestors so easily? You will die again, beast!
To even suggest this! Prepare to face my wrath, Vampire!
Nai, the Drengi of Karak Kadrin will never work with your kind.
Ha! Do you think I would forsake my oath so easily?
Work with the Undead! I'll chew on their bones!
You have our thanks, this will be placed in the vaults under Altdorf.
Even Volkmar would not refuse such a gift.
A wise decision, perhaps we can overcome our differences after all?
Sigmar be praised! You will not regret this.
The drums of war will beat soon enough.
How disappointing - the Runefangs will soon be unsheathed I fear.
I might have known signing anything with you was not worth the parchment.
If you do not want our aid then so be it!
Reject us? Sigmar damn you then!
We call to Ulric - the God of Battle, Wolves and Winter!
You will not find us cowering from a fight, we are Sigmar's sons!
Alas we can no longer align our interests to yours. A word of warning - do not let pride lead to rage.
The treaty is ended! A regretful decision but one that had to be made.
The Arch-Lectors counsel against continuing this treaty. It is finished.
Muster your armies! Sigmar and all the gods demand blood!
War has come, time to answer Ulric's summons.
What are you waiting for? The End Times? To battle!
Payment is due on the debts owed to my people, scum!
Gold is owed. The choice of payment is yours, we take Imperial Crowns as a preference.
The Imperial treasury must be replenished. Alas, I must call in the debt.
Do not pretend to be deaf, Bretonnian, or we will cross the Grey Mountains and make you listen!
I'm not asking for an audience with the king, I demand one!
We have an offer that should benefit both great nations of men.
It is time for the Lady and Sigmar to work together.
Many times have Bretonnia and the Empire been allies. Hear our request.
We have an offer that the people of Bretonnia should hear.
Although it fills my heart with hatred, we have a proposal, Chaos filth!
Listen carefully, northern scum, so your master can hear our offer!
It is a dark day when we must parley with Chaos, but these days are the darkest yet.
I am sure we have been played by the Great Changer, but an offer must be made.
Come, minion of Chaos, why not accept our offer?
Do the Ruinous Powers hesitate? This offer scares them then?
We have an offer for the Dwarfs - surely pride will not be your downfall yet again?
Stop your incessant grumbling Dwarf and listen to what we have to say…
The Karaz Ankor could be great again, with the Empire's help…
A message - an offer for your High King - hear it or remain stuck in the past and hidden in your mountain burrows.
Dwarfen hospitality has always been welcome, and will you share a mug of Bugman's with us as we make our humble request?
Welcome honoured guests, our longest allies. We ask you listen to our proposal…
You bring shame on the Empire, let us end such hostility!
Sigmar weeps bitter tears! You will hear us out, or the Cult of Sigmar will come upon you in a burning crusade! Do you want an Empire in flames?
Come, let us rest our swords and hammers and speak for the good of the Empire.
I know you have not forsaken Sigmar, prove it to us by hearing our proposal.
The Empire should be united under Ghal Maraz. Hear us out, friend.
You do not doubt who is the true Emperor. That is progress, so I make this offer.
Are you capable of listening to our terms, Greenskin? I doubt it!
I demand you listen, Orc scum!
I despise talking to Orcs as much as I enjoy killing them, yet we have terms to broker.
Hear me, Orcs, listen to my offer, you may find it favourable for your tribes.
Perhaps man and Greenskin can work together after all? Our offer…
Will you put down that crude weapon and listen? Will you hear me out, Orc?
I speak for the Empire! You will listen!
I have the ear of the Grand Theogonist and if you don't accept my proposal I will send a hundred thousand flagellants upon your cursed lands!
By Ghal Maraz, you will take notice of what I have to say!
This is what I offer… Think carefully and be prudent.
We deem it wise to make this offer. You, in turn, will be wise to consider it.
By Ranald, I swear no trickery here, listen to my offer…
Be welcome, and hear what we have to say.
By the blessing of the Prince of Altdorf, I bring good tidings and an offer.
Let us talk, perhaps it will bear rich fruit for both nations.
We do not treat with the Undead! But for now we must…
Know that you will never take the mantle of Emperor, corpse-creature - still we have a proposal…
Morr will shun us for such heresy, but there are terms…
Keep your fangs behind your lips, vile thing! Here is our offer.
Perhaps one day we will recognise Sylvania as a rightful province. Until that doomed time, we may be able to strike a deal.
It is our sad duty to engage with such abominations… never-the-less, we have a proposal…
The wisdom of Verena guides us to co-operation…
It is Festag! We should consider a treaty between us.
I offer a hand of peace and co-operation across the Grey Mountains.
Come, followers of the Lady - let lance and hammer work as one.
Sigmar damn us all, but a treaty with the Ruinous Powers is the only way!
I cannot believe I ask this… a treaty with the Northmen is sought.
As we fought together many times in the last two and half millennia, I ask again - will you join us?
The Empire and Dwarfs should march together as they once did?
As Magnus the Pious taught us, a united Empire is better than one riven by spite and jealously…
Come, men of the Empire, let us fight under one banner again.
Though it pains me to consider it, consider it I must - a pact?
Come, Greenskins, you seek war. Work with us and I promise you battle!
Although I know it will end in me being declared a heretic by Volkmar, I seek a treaty, Vampire…
If you can stop feeding on our citizens for a while we may be able to hammer out a treaty to suit both living and dead…
It is a simple gift, gold. Sigmar preferred such things also.
We offer a small token, blessed by the Arch-Lector and worthy of your status.
Here is a gift with Sigmar's blessing - use it as you will. Now, to business!
Your foes are also the enemies of Sigmar - we fight together, yes?
We offer our hammers, let us fight with you!
The Empire hears your call and comes ready to make war!
The sword becomes blunted from constant use, the hammer weighs heavy. Now is the time to consider peace.
A strong nation does not mean one constantly at war. Peace is achievable.
Peace in our age? We can but hope…
Put down your lances, there is no need for war.
Come Bretonnian, would you not rather drink wine than make war?
We wish to broker peace, Northman, are you even capable?
We are not at the End Times yet, Chaos scum. It is time to fight on a different front.
Come Dwarfs, let us be allies again.
Together we can help rebuild the Karaz Ankor.
Unite with us friends, make Magnus the Pious proud of our generation.
This is no Age of the Three Emperors, we must sue for peace.
Fight amongst yourselves, Orcs. Keep us out of this!
Do the Greenskins even understand… peace?
Von Carsteins - you have had your tally of corpses. The war must end.
We seek peace. Even the Undead must rest at some point.
These are Sigmar's people and nobody else's!
There will be no alliance while I draw breath!
I swear by Sigmar's comet and the wolves of Ulric that we will never join with you!
No, my men crave glory, and I plan on giving it to them.
There is no peace - there is only war!
Sigmar is a warrior's god; I cannot appease him with talk of peace.
The king has gone too far, we must teach him a lesson.
Bretonnia must be chastised for its actions - the war continues!
Peace with the followers of the Dark Gods? No, scum, never!
Get from my sight, Chaos filth, and know we will fight on!
We have been shackled by the Dwarfs for long enough, let them bear us a grudge!
The Dwarfs will know that their time is over!
A lesson must be taught, so the usurpers know who is the true Emperor.
No, these brigands will feel the wrath of Reikland.
The Greenskins have no notion of peace and so neither will we!
Get back to your mud huts, savage - the Empire comes to wipe you out!
Back, Vampire! We will not rest until the sun blazes upon your open tomb!
There can be no peace with the Undead - the priesthood of Morr has ordained it!
The Twin-tailed Comet burns in the sky, a sign to take up arms - it is war!
The Celestial College augurs war - muster the State Troops!
War comes to the Empire once again, make ready the men.
Bretonnia will not see sense - they must be taught the hard way.
We will set these Bretonnians right - with hammer and shield.
The Blood God demands blood, let us ensure it comes from His followers.
We fight the Northmen, the true enemies of Sigmar - it is war!
If the Dwarfs won't listen to reason then they must be persuaded with blade and hammer!
We go to war against the Dwarfs. Make them pay for this folly!
You leave me no choice but to declare war, and Sigmar damn your hides for making it so!
Magnus weeps, for we must make war within this once-great nation!
The Greenskins crave war, let us give it to them!
We go to war with the Greenskins, as fathers have always done!
We cannot - must not - let the Undead triumph - it is war!
We will make the Vampires pay for every Empire corpse that Morr has been deprived of - to war!
Have you seen what a master of the Gold Order can do to an armoured man? I can only surmise not.
So your serfs have spared you the gallows jig for now, lordling? Perhaps I will treat with them some day?
Let us joust with words for now.
Yours is a long ride home through the Grey Mountains, so let us get to business.
Hail to you, Lord of the Lance!
Honour to you, and to the Lady's Realm.
Have you heard of the Slaughter at the Six Spikes? That was one of mine. Speak!
That armour is fused to your body, no? Think how it would be if it were to grow searing hot…
I am the Supreme Patriarch, Northman, and your power does not overmatch mine.
Artefacts of power I bear. Pray to your Dark Gods that our truce holds.
Circumstance dictates that I listen to your words, Dark One.
Expediency makes for strange bedfellows, servant of Chaos.
A grudge is as an axe with two blades. Have a care lest you cut yourself, Dwarf.
Dwarfs grumble, rain falls, the sun rises and sets. There is nothing new in this world.
What would your High King have of me?
What errand brings the Dwarfs from their mountain holds?
Hail, mountain lords! May your hoard increase.
Might and magic are mine to command! On your knees lest I unleash my wrath!
Your traitor-count's mewlings are as pitiful as those of a kitten!
The time of the Supreme Patriarch is not to be wasted lightly. Say your piece then!
As a fellow countryman, I trust you will not tax my time overly.
The Empire's unity is the surest shield against our enemies.
Interesting. The Bright Order are seeking targets for their initiates to practice on. And here you are...
A face such as yours would make for an interesting gilded statue. I have a spell for that, you know…
You stand before the Supreme Patriarch, like an ant before the descending boot.
I will set aside my studies for a moment to hear your words.
What brings you here to disturb my work?
Time is gold. Let us not waste either in idle chatter.
I trust our dealings will bear fruit, friend.
Friendship is more valuable than gold. Or so they tell me.
Welcome to my private study. Wine of palest gold will wet our palettes whilst we speak.
Yes, yes, "Raaar raaaar, smash, kill!" You have until the sand runs from this glass to bark your nonsense.
Tell me, Greenskin, once I have endured your rantings, what is to prevent me reducing you to a pile of smoking ash?
Your primitive posturing does not impress me, Greenskin. Save it for the Snotlings.
My brothers in the Celestial Order could make an interesting study of the gulf between our intellects.
Let me hear what you have to say, Greenskin.
I will do my best to interpret your grunts as best I can.
Give me a reason why Gehenna's Hounds should not pursue you back to your accursed master!
Many are the methods by which I could give you a true death, carrion-thing!
I will have an initiate open a window I think, to disperse the grave-stench in here.
Strange days these in which I must parley with the dead.
Even though this is against the Grand Theogonist's will, I accept.
I agree to this pact, but betray me and suffer the wrath of the Empire!
Be warned - I spit blood at this agreement and expect you to break it!
I have the authority to sign such a treaty.
Sigmar was not just a warrior but a diplomat too. I take his example and agree.
If the Emperor bids, then it is so.
Very well - we have an agreement.
A solemn pact. Sigmar will decide if this is wise.
It is late in the day for Bretonnia to come running on their ponies demanding aid.
Here come the embodiment of mounted arrogance, the Bretonnian Knights!
Greetings, Lords, I hope the lakes of Bretonnia run clear this day.
So what can the Empire do, that the mighty flower of Bretonnia cannot?
Greeting neighbours, how fair the lands beyond the Grey Mountains?
Honourable Knights come to parley with the Empire on this fine Aubentag.
Yes, we will aid as we always do when you come crying for the mother's milk of the Empire.
Very well, we have an agreement. Do not betray us, "noble" Knights, you are not fooling anyone with your claims of chivalry.
We will work together. You'll have to get over your disdain for black powder!
I accept the terms - on the acknowledgement that our Knights are superior to yours, of course.
We will sign a treaty and toast our king and emperor!
Man allies with man - there is hope for the Old World yet!
No - at least with the Orcs, you know what you are getting. I despise Bretonnians because you are weasels in armour!
Get from thee, messenger, I have no patience for the bumpkins of that festering hole you call a country today.

Nurgle will forgive Cathay's past naughtiness if you will do the same.
A handshake is all it takes to bring about glorious Ruination!
We Daemons must scratch each other's backs, must we not?

Blood and pus! Let it be so!
Nurgle can move on from all that past unpleasantness if Kislev can.
Might the Fly Lord shake Ursun's great paw?

Do you have the appetite for a partnership of sorts?

This ancient grudge match of ours has gone on for far too long.
We servants of Ruin should surely not be at odds.

Let us solve the riddle of peace together, changeling.
The Raven's tiresome games have wasted enough of Nurgle's time!
Take this small allotment of Nurgle's Garden and leave me be.

Will this land pacify you? It is only lightly diseased, I swear.

Will it be compliance, or will it becoming a festering pool of blood and pus?

I can spread plague and pox quite well without you, thank you very much.

Make war not love, say I.
Had your fill of suffering, have you? Well, tough luck!
The Urfather and the hated meddler may never know peace!

Good news! The Urfather has chosen you to receive the gift of destruction and decay!

A pox upon your people! They will love it, I promise.

The Dragon has impeded Tzeentch's great scheme for far too long.
The grand design remains a world without Cathay in it.
Nay, Tzeentch has no patience for would-be gods.
A mortal's cowardly heart still beats within you!
No peace between Kharneth and Tzeentch. Only war!
The Well of Eternity shows only Kislev's looming destruction.
We could say yes, mortal, but it would be a lie.
Beg all you like, but there can be no more stagnation.
Nay, Nurgleth's dour cycle must be broken.
No peace for you, brute. Only madness!
Unmaking Ogres entertains the Raven far too much.
Oh come now, Slaaneshi, there is no fun in that.
That is not what you truly desire.
You may not corrupt the Changer's scheme so.
You know as well as we that Tzeentch's design requires your destruction.
The wheel of fate turns, and foretells your annihilation.
Your mind must be unmade. Tzeentch requires it!
You were fated for destruction since the moment of your creation.
This is but a game, and one you have already lost.
Tomorrow, you will be Tzeentch's friend. Today, you are His foe.
Your Great Bastion interferes with our design. It shall fall.
The Dragon dies. Tzeentch wills it.
You shall play with the toys of Chaos no longer.
Your immortality is a deception. Allow us to demonstrate.
We will cast your skull into the infinite void!
There shall be slaughter. There shall be blood. It is written.
Stoic, unchanging Kislev shall be transformed into ash.
You are a passing distraction in need of removal, mortals of Ursun.
Dull Nurgleth must retire from the Great Game.
We will tear your brutish mind asunder!
What little reason you have shall be stripped from you.
Rejoice, for the Raven grants you torment!
The Prince of Pleasure has had his time. He must be removed from play.
You are superfluous to our master's ineffable design.
Kin falls upon kin! Such is Tzeentch's unknowable will!
You send us trinkets when we require flesh.
A gift… to seal an Unholy pact perhaps?
An amusing present, but such fripperies bore me.
I am glad you accept, mayhap there are more pacts we could bind you with?
Good… good, now let us discuss other requirements…
Think carefully before making an enemy of me!
You break a pact with us, you forfeit your soul!
You think this contract doesn't bind you to me? Then you are a fool!
Reject us and reject your petty lives.
You decline? Not unexpected, but supremely foolish nonetheless.
War with us, you think that wise?
It makes little difference to us.
We will make such charnel pits that your dead will choke the lands and then rise on my command!
Contracts with the dead are always invalid…
No earthly binds can hold the Undead!
Come and join us, we will slay the foe together!
We march to war. Join us!
War is an inevitable as death, we shall create it together.
Do not think death releases you from your debt.
Death protects, Bretonnian filth - if you don't accede to our demands we will bless you with it.
Your lake-witch hides in the Silver Pinnacle. She won't shroud you from us, so accept our offer.
This is the Age of Shadow and your lights will dim, so best listen to our demands.
The nights draw in, Bretonnian, are you ready? We could help…
How do our kin in Mousillon fair? We have an offer that could ensure they stay within the city walls.
We have a request for the king. Surely he will hear a fellow noble?
We don't need your pathetic Gods, just as we don't need Nagash. Thy power lies with us, so hear our demands.
You think yourself the true threat to this world? All you do is reap death, and that is our realm. We hold the keys to this plane and we have demands.
Here is our offer, puppet. Take that to your masters, let them know true power awaits their answer.
You'll hear us, Chaos, for our bat swarms will not cease screaming our demands until you have answered.
Together we can rule the mortals, accept our offer and let the terror commence!
Yes, sign the pact and let us bring damnation to the living.
Come, beardling, you think to refuse? We will crush the remnants of your race and make it as dust if you do not heed us.
Dwarf-scum, you are in position to refuse our demands. All your petty grudges are nothing compared to the true power of Necromancy.
Let us into your Holds, take the offer and a new era of Dwarf and Vampire shall begin!
Come Dwarfs, you may be long-lived but do you not crave immortality? Think how that would aid your Karaz Ankor?
We can work together, Dwarf. Forget the past, your grudges are immaterial. What matters is the future of your empire.
Take the offer, Dwarf, seal the pact and enjoy the riches such a deal brings us.
Your true Emperor speaks! Obey me and your miserable lives will endure. Meet our demands or suffer the consequences.
Sigmar was a fraud, a mere barbarian who could not better Nagash. Bow to your true masters, cattle - these are our demands!
Tell the Prince of Altdorf that the true sovereign awaits his answer.
This Emperor, he speaks as if all voted for his ascension, yet  the true Counts of Stirland did not. But we can soften our stance should he consider this offer...
We may have had differences in the past, but every Emperor has quarrelled with his Elector Counts, yes? May this offer help?
We have a request, a small trifling matter in the grand scheme of things.
This is our demand, Orc-spawn, I advise you to take it and keep your filthy blood in your vile bodies.
Do not test me, Orc. To reveal my full majesty will seal the doom of your entire tribe. Now hear our demands and pray for my mercy.
You low-born savages may rule the Badlands, but I have a way for you to move into more ripe nations… make the pact.
Now Greenskins, unleash your true potential and accept the pact before you.
Orcs are unlikely allies, but if you are content to murder and maim, then we are happy to claim the corpses in your wake.
A great boss such as yourself will consider this arrangement, as the offer is a good one.
Fool! Our bloodlines ascend the centuries. Hear our demands!
You will take our offer, for your bodies will wither and your souls be tortured for eternity if not.
Cower, for the darkness comes and we will have what is ours!
We have demands, for the night is eternal and we seek succour.
We have an offer, do not make the mistakes of your predecessors and shun the Unliving.
We both want something, breather, let us not sully ourselves in meaningless threats to get to it!
Oh, to be so young, virile and warm again! An offer then?
We come bearing gifts of life ever-lasting; it is the greatest gift - the Blood Kiss. Surely, it is worth adequate compensation?
We have an offer, not one usually given to those whose hearts still beat…
Get back, thrall, know thy place! I will leech your essence should you disobey my will. Now receive my demand and know thy place!
Your crippled bloodline is of no use to me, but there is a place in my legions should you bow to these demands.
As a servant of darkness, you should consider an offer from those that shroud the light.
The von Carsteins will march. Surely you wish to be part of such unholy majesty?
Well, my kin, let us unite and bring eternal darkness to the world. There's just the small matter of this contract to sign...
If the Vampire Counts unite then none of the mortal filth can stop us. Make the pact and let the Age of Shadow begin!
Perhaps a pact, or even a treaty if that sounds more agreeable?
Should we ally, you have my blood oath that your corpse shall be left in peace.
Let us co-operate - a treaty between those that live and those who have lived?
A treaty will ensure that your smallfolk will be the only corpses we use. Your nobles will be for Morr only.
Let the Lords of Mousillon charge with the flower of Bretonnia once more!
A pact with powers as determined as we are to snuff out life? It makes sense.
Bring forth your contract, Chaos filth. We will sign for there is no soul to lose.
Do we have an agreement, Dwarfs? It will earn you access to our tombs, where valuables and other trinkets could make this a most profitable venture.
Consider an alliance. Have we ever desecrated your dead like we do the humans? Have you ever seen a Vampire Dwarf?
Come, let us truly unite the Empire. Bring Sylvania to your bosom and we will repay such loyalty in kind…
We were all men once, perhaps a vestigial of sentiment still remains that will allow us to come to terms?
If you like carnage so much, Greenskin, then join us and we will ravage the world!
Now is the time of darkness, when Orc and Necromancer shall inherit this rock they call a world.
Let us unite, my kin, with a signed treaty - and together our blood line shall take throne.
The Vampire Counts shall inherit the Old World. Its tombs and gardens of death will open for us - together!
What is your greatest desire? Riches, trinkets, power… eternal life?
If you prefer I can give you the gift of my blood, a few drops is all it takes. Or you may choose anything in my vaults if your tastes are more… mundane.
I have a gift for you, best not to refuse and repeat the tragedy of McDeath.
We have a mutual enemy. Let us march with you and we will ensure victory.
This is a war you cannot win alone.
Add our unholy might to yours, and victory will come. We can then unpick the consequences of any pacts.
Our magicks weaken, so perhaps a cessation of the war is best?
We return to our graves and ready ourselves for Geheimnisnacht. You have peace until then.
You have peace, Bretonnian. Bury your dead for they will not rise... for now.
We are fed up of your rotten peasants, Bretonnian. There is peace because we crave fresh, wholesome bodies.
Peace it is, Northman. Let Khorne worry about constant war, for we have all the time in the world!
We know all too well what it is to desire blood. The difference between us, Chaos scum, is that we can control our thirst, so let peace reign.
No, Dwarf, there is no need to war. We return to Hunger Wood and the surroundings of Corpse Run, where we shall slake our desire for bloodshed.
Take the offer of peace, Dwarf. Forget your grudges and serve your race's interests for once.
Vorhexen approaches. Go in peace, and have Morr's Priests prepare for the Night of Witches. Expect us to call then - Morrslieb shall be our sign.
I can say it in any language you wish - Khazalid, Queekish, Reikspiel? It is an offer of peace from the Midnight Aristocracy - I suggest you take it.
Peace, Orc - set your filthy minions on weaker prey, for we tire of you.
We will stop despoiling your filthy corpses if you stop attacking our lands. There are plenty of other, breathing creatures to annoy.
Peace, my blood kin. Instead of war, let us drink a fine vintage - I have particularly arrogant Bretonnian noble in my cellar, with ripe veins.
We offer peace. There will be a place at my table, should you accept.
There is only the Vampire Counts!
No! Why would I walk in the light when I can stride alone at night!
The only confederation will be when you have turned and are my willing thrall!
There is no rest, no peace - just Undeath!
Peace? That is what Otto von Drak begged for one night long ago, do you think our kind would revel in such power now had we granted such a feeble request?
Beg, Bretonnian. Lay down your lance, sully yourself in the mud and then beg for peace. The answer will still be no.
There is no reason for peace. We despise your pitiful nation and will not stop until its people are part of my legions.
Peace with the puppets of Chaos? Proof that the Ruinous Powers fear us - they know the true Dark Lords hail from Sylvania.
You betray your brass god do you not, by asking for peace? How delicious! The answer is no.
We reject peace, Dwarf. Go back to your Holds, seal your gates, and know they will become your tombs.
Yours is a foetid race, one cursed with undeserving pride, which would be better purged from the world - that is the task I have set my tireless legions.
The only peace will be when the true Emperor sits upon the throne and wields Ghal Maraz. The Empire of Night will come!
The lambs of the Empire call for peace but all I hear is their bleating!
No peace, Orc, your race are pests that need eradicating.
There can be no peace with Greenskins. They are not mentally able, so we will wipe them out.
I dominate the von Carsteins. You should have bent your knee earlier; now you will pay with the loss of your head.
There can only be peace in Sylvania when these petty squabbles between kin are ended. And I will end it, for I am the true Lord of the von Carsteins.
The Undead march forth, it is war!
We declare war, let night come forth!
War, mortals! All will die and rise again.
Time to end your pitiful nation once and for all, Bretonnian!
The peasants will revolt. But as my minions - war comes to Bretonnia!
War is as inevitable as the grave. Prepare thyselves, Chaos filth!
It is war! Surely your Blood God will rejoice?
We will bring death to the Dwarfish realms - war!
War! The Age of the Dwarf is over, the Age of Undeath has begun!
Sigmar cannot protect you, mortals, war comes!
It is war, then, Orc filth.
We will bring ruin on your tribes, Orc!
Sylvania will be overcome with war, it is time the lesser Vampires realised who is in charge.
It is war! I am Undeath Ascendant, my will alone and no other!
There is a stain on the world, and that blight is called Bretonnia. But please, do go on!
Ahh, my old stomping ground, so many deaths… is this a parley to stop me returning, I wonder?
The minions of a King! Come to take my tally no doubt. Let us haggle for souls!
I see no great Bretonnian flower here, what has become of my adopted nation?
Ahh, it is good to be back in Bretonnia, how fair's the abbey at la Maisontaal?
Greetings, messenger, tell Leoncoeur that my services are always open to him.
Little messengers from the far lands, what lovely toys you will make!
A fate so dire the Dragons seek out Kemmler? Too bad!
Your killing contraptions leave so little for the humble scavenger!
What do you seek a Lichemaster for, dragon-child?
Chaos… you think you control me… bah! I am Kemmler, the Lichemaster, my destiny is my own!
Lickspittles approach me thinking they're in control. But I am the one that holds life or death in his hands.
Agents of Chaos, free me from these invisible obligations so I may cause my own mayhem!
The Dark Gods petition me, but they shall realise that I am no being's puppet!
Greetings, how do my true masters fair in these gloriously dark days?
At last the Chaos Gods come to me directly. What is their desire?
Approach me Dwarfs, envoys of your stunted kin, your offer better tickle me or I will damn you all!
Oh, how I enjoy the pleading, mewling bray of Dwarfs! It makes all this worth while!
Stunted beard-creatures, what have we here? You reach out to me, how wonderful!
There's desperation in your voice, Dwarf, be reassured that I find great pleasure in that!
Ah, the Dwarfs come to treat, to plead perhaps? To beg I don't reanimate their precious ancestors?
The Dwarfs - I have met your kind when I was wondering the mountains, you are beasts of burden are you not?
Your Emperor’s mewling entreaties are as insufferable as the cries of a new-born child – and as easily choked off.
Death comes to all eventually, and no pathetic Soldier-God may forestall that meeting. Time passes: speak!
Oh, look, it's Sigmar's weak-willed progeny - I have dealt with you before it will take little effort to do so again.
Your Empire is finished! So it is wise that you seek out my children and I.
Ahh, Sigmar's children are my favourite vessels, I'm sure we can come to some arrangement, yes?
Your eminence's emissaries are always so wary of me, I am but a humble old man looking to extend my miserly lot.
Careful now, to summon me is all but an invite to join my hordes.
Say what you must - but know you play a dangerous game, and I am no pawn!
My minions are restless, this had better be important… for your sake!
Obscurity can have your souls, I will take the bodies!
You are brave to barter with a Necromancer who does not like you!
What is this...? Aha! The Staff says I should kill you!
Only a brainless fool would not suspect you of deceit!
Krell thinks you are up to no good. I'll leave you two alone to discuss your intentions.
Think quickly, I might let you live if you leave now.
Shall I send you back to your people to wreak havoc for a new master?
I will hear your words - your riddles! - but best not displease me, Krell would not like that!
A message, for me? Then best deliver it, my children may not be impatient, but I am.
Go on then, speak your words, but don't mistake for some hedge-wizard - I have more important masters than you.
Your fear is noted; your proposal may follow.
I don't take to strangers, but if you have what I want, well, that is a different matter.
I offer audience, not warmth, and never safety.
Speak, and then Krell will decide if he likes you!
Go on, impress this old Lichemaster. Maybe there will be trade after all.
Ohoho such confidence, or is it arrogance? My servants will find out.
Have you come to aid me in my crusade of decay?
My Skull Wand cackles in my ear… it tells me you have a proposition, yes?
Excuse the tomb-breath, now, what is it you want?
You summon the Lichemaster, I see, I see. A pact is it?
Pleasantries, pleasantries! Now, offer me something dead!
A treatise? Very well – do pardon the mess, the cadavers get everywhere!
I always distrust Orcs that come to barter when they should be here to kill - weak specimens of their race.
Greenskins - it is better say something interesting or I'll curse their whole sorry race.
Orcs approach - how delightful! Should I have my thralls gut you now, or after you have spoken?
The Greenskins are indeed a blight on the lands, mayhaps I can tame them?
Greenskins, another of my favourites, what is it you desire?
You know, many of my kin, cannot bring the Greenskin form back to life. I have no such trouble!
Remember Krell? Look closely, and think about how far threats will get you!
Violence is dull. Tell your Dark Gods to send a conversationalist instead!
If you've finished with the bodies, barbarian, I'll find a use for them!
You're dripping blood on my cloak. And you wanted..?
Ursun shares your fates, how sad for him!
Maybe I raise your pet bear as my thrall?!
The Great Bear seeks a Necromancer?
A message from the cold lands? Well? Read it out!
Krell is mine, Nagash! Find yourself another helper.
I have no time for a would-be Lord of Undeath. Kemmler holds the power here!
I like to see a bit of emaciation in my allies!
The Lichemaster does not readily take orders from a barebones!
Keep your rot; I prefer obedient, silent decay.
Ugh, you turn even the stomach of a corpse master!
Keep your distance, I have no wish to catch anything!
I hope you have not brought me any little gifts, plague-envoy.
If you bite me like the vermin you are, I'll skin you for a tasteless hat!
The rat ventures from its nest! What say you, creature?
How interesting, vermin calling at Kemmler's door. Well? Chitter your piece!
Let me hear it, temptation itself pleading for Kemmler's assistance!
You would not want me to give in to temptation, Daemon. You would make such a fuss!
Temptation is a young man's game, what do you plan to offer me?
Deviancy and seduction – all very appealing, but I have my own plans.
Games are won by he who holds the most pieces, Changer. My supply is endless!
Do we understand one another? Disturb my plans, and yours will fare no better!
Your trade and mine are not all that dissimilar. What can you offer a fellow meddler?
I've seen a good trick in my time, think twice before you try any on me.
Oh, should I bow and scrape? The great vampire blood lines deign to call upon humble me…
Vampires and Necromancers both, they think they can raise the dead! But there is only one Lichemaster!
We will parley - for now, fellow immortals, you have the ear of the Lichemaster.
You will deliver your message to me and I will then decide on its worthiness, my lord.
My lords von Carstein, how may thy humble Liche, serve you this night?
I am always open to furthering the course of Unlife, please, please let's discuss plans.
Krell is overjoyed. Can't you tell?
Civility demands you share some secrets, hm?
We are allied, cease your suspicious looks!
Chaos whispers in my good ear.
Dark Gods lead you. Kemmler decides!
I'll kneel down to sign, shall I?
Your ancestors can keep sleeping, for now.
Too late to change my mind?
You demand, I happen to agree anyway.
Your breath stinks of carrion. Lovely.
I give in this much, no more!
Your delusions are in my favour.
The pact is signed, pray it has only cost what you believe it has! Haha!
So mortal, we have an agreement. Do not cross me, for that will be the last mistake you make.
Mortal, we will accept but do not mistake this for anything but a convenience - we are not your allies, we are your masters!
I accept, now you must fulfil your promise or I bring eternal darkness upon you!
We will bind this treaty in blood. The cost if you renege? Just your immortal soul!
Only the well-prepared or the very foolish join a pact with a Vampire. Now the deal is done, which one are you?
A pact then! My services for what I desire, the price maybe too dear?
An agreement - mine hordes shall rejoice, for I will command them to.
Yes, there is a way we can both claim what we need from this understanding.
You come with Lady's tidings? What does that lake-hag want?
Before we can begin, I must slaughter all the low-born in your ranks. They are your gift, yess?
Impress me then, Bretonnian. What favour does your impuissant nation deign to ask?
Bretonnia must be in trouble to come here. Does Mousillon fare badly?
Bretonnians! Come then, let us eat and talk - once the meal is over I’ll decide if you shall live.
What message do you bring, Bretonnian? Do the living still delude themselves?
Your folk taste of desperation and sorrow - it is a fine vintage, so let's agree terms.
Yes, you will do as I say, Bretonnians - if you value your pathetic lives!
Agreed, but do not risk offending me by asking for further quarter, Knight.
As a show of favour I require the company of your damsel... no "permanent" harm shall come to her.
Very well, Knight, we have an accord, pray to the Lady that you do not disappoint me.
I'll take your word, mortal creature, but if you do not deliver I will find you.
No, your insignificant country is finished, fools! Your only choice is to bow before me and pray on my mercy.
I reject this and any such offer, why would I need the aid of such living, feckless cowards?
Haha, Bretonnia is a mongrel nation and I have no desire to help it.
Never - tell your lake hag I will drink her life force, should we ever meet.
No, this won't do, not this day or ever, Knight.
Get from my sight, Bretonnian, you are lucky that I am sated.
So be it - a union with the Archaon's insipid followers is a small price to pay for mine own domination.
Yes, a pact, but do not betray us, even your gods will cower before my wrath!
Good, this is a pact, the forces of Chaos and Undead will join and those of Order will pay.
Agreed, Northman, do not fail me.
Good - the Dark Gods shall work in concert with mine own designs.
Very well, creature, tell your true masters we have a deal.
Careful, Warrior, for you know not who you treat with. My power is death; my will absolute.
I have no more patience for the maggots of Chaos, they are nought but scavengers in my wake!
Spit your hate at me, Chaos creature, I care not for your Gods or their threats!
Rage all you wish, minion, but know that I am no peon, I create them!
What is your message, Chaos pawn? Mark that you do not address some quivering mortal!
Welcome, messenger of the Dark Gods, if your terms intrigue me, we could work together.
You think me weak, Chaos scum? I am a Lord of Darkness and answer to no god!
Your Gods cannot touch me, thrall, my will is stronger than any atrophied deity's!
No. I do not fear you or your Gods for my soul has already been claimed.
Chaos creature - go back north to thy foetid realm, tell your masters these mortals are mine.
No Chaos thrall, my destiny will not be tampered by Tzeentch.
Alas, I must reject this notion, although we may join our damned forces in the future.
Sign your precious contract, bearded creature, parchment will do you no good when I bore of it.
I demand a sacrifice to prove your willingness to this endeavour, but what will it be? A life or your so-called honour?
We have a blood pact then, Dwarf. It will cost you more than dishonour if you break it.
Very good, I know such a treaty raises the hairs in your beard, Dwarf. That thought alone makes this worth it.
Very well Dwarf. Show me your contract and I will sign it… in beardling blood!
Good, Dwarf, you'll do as I say!
You think your broken empire can be repaired, Dwarf? You are wrong and my legions will prove it!
Never! My Crypt Ghouls will gnaw on your ancestors' foetid bones!
I think not, stone-gatherer! Your desolate mountain slums offer nothing for my host.
There is no pact! Your arrogance will be your undoing, Dwarf scum!
No, stone-gatherer. Back to your mountain holes.
Don't be foolish, Dwarf, I care not one bit for your barren halls.
Why do the Dwarfs pester me so? I have had my fill of their stunted forms and baseless pride!
The last time I killed a Dwarf, I sucked the marrow from his iron-flecked bones, but do go on…
Dwarfs… Rarely can you get a clean bite of their neck, far too hairy, what do you want?
Tell me Dawi, why should I not leech you of life whence you stand?
Why Dwarfs! How amusing of you to deign to talk to me. What do you wish?
Here come the Dwarfs to sour my mood, what do the stone-gatherers want?
I wonder which one of your party is a Witch Hunter? He shall die first.
So, Franz sends his sheep to bargain for their own lives. A pity it is harvest time.
Welcome to the midnight realm, pray to your Man-God we come to an accommodation.
Greetings, only noble blood should deign to negotiate and we are the noblest of all!
Then we have a pact - betray this and I'll bleed every Sigmarite priest from here to Altdorf!
What a strange night! Me allying with the bags of flesh I call food!
Do not be afraid - you will find me a benevolent lord, as long as you do not fail me.
Sign the treaty in blood, mortal. I wish - I need - to see you bleed!
Sigmar's heirs shall ally with Vlad's progeny - truly a match worthy of legend!
Yes, we have a pact, Empire-men. Do not disappoint me.
You come in the name of 'Sigmar', a mere mortal man born of camp whores, yet called himself a 'god' - what, mortals?
The Empire is finished, you mortals just wont accept it. Speak then…
What fools Ulric's progeny are! If you leave here alive you will do so as my puppets!
No! I will never signs pacts with Karl Franz' inbred brood - you are not even fit to drink!
Curse all the living, and their fruitless attempts to remain so.
Your Empire is doomed - it will be Sylvania that rises from the ashes.
No, I find your kind - breathers - too disagreeable.
Thank your Man-God that I don't feed on you right now! Be gone!
It will do I suppose. However, I bore easily these days, so keep your stinking minions on-side or else.
It is an accord, creature, but only while our ends walk the same path, once we diverge you shall be exterminated.
Yes, Orc, we have a deal. Pray to whatever disgusting gods you worship that I don't change my mind.
I accept your terms, Orc. Should you fail then your body is mine to take.
Very well, the crude beasts shall rampage and our silent armies will follow in their wake.
Good, an agreement. Let us hope the Orcs are capable of remembering it is in place.
A strange notion - mine noble blood line allying with such base creatures. No, better to destroy you.
Even Nagash, balked at allying with Greenskins. For once I agree with him - not ever, Orc scum!
No, my bloodline is pure, I will not sully it by working with such creatures.
I will not consider such an alliance. You are base creatures and I only feast on the finest.
No, Orcs, I don't trust you - I despise free will.
Foolish Orc, just because I prefer to drain humans doesn't mean I cannot snack on beasts!
Morrslieb glows… I can tell, for you come thinking to bargain, but I have already won!
There is desperation in your pitiful eyes! That knowledge alone will be leveraged against you!
You reek of anguish, or hopelessness, haha! Yes, let us parley!
Mannslieb wanes and Morrslieb waxes, of course I was expecting you.
Ahh, you come here in desperation, yess? Good, I can deal with desperate mortals.
To stand before me and ask, proves you are no craven… but cowards often live longer!
Why, do come - what can we help you with this night?
Ahh! You seek out the von Carsteins, a bold action…
I'll have you speak now, pray to your gods I like what you say.
What could you possibly offer me, Orc, I cannot even drink your abhorrent blood!
Greenskin, I cannot tame you, so tell me, why I should not wipe you out?
How vile… what could you possibly offer me, Orc?
Greenskin, you are stood before me alive for I despise the taste of your fell blood, so speak.
I will address the Orc creature, I hope I can understand its guttural tongue.
Deliver your message, Greenskin, just maybe we can work together.
Never! You are to be dominated, not appeased!
Foolish mortals, why would we treat with cattle?
No, prepare your armies, ready your defences - it will do no good!
No, why should I make pact when I can take what I need from you?
No! You offer me baubles! I will take what is rightfully mine!
There is nothing as foolish as a mortal with a shred of power. I can show you true power!
No… and thank your pathetic gods my attention is pulled elsewhere.
Not this time, but should you desire something more then call on me.
Dawn approaches and mongrel blood lines come to leech off me. What do you want, half-breed?
Call yourself von Carstein? I have seen Strigoi more noble than you! Your offer then?
Welcome, kin. You must want something, it better not be my head!
It is always a pleasure - a dubious pleasure - to welcome a fellow Lord of the Night to my domain.
Greetings, brothers, what does mine Blood Line require?
Very well, let us hold a conclave, my kin.
Very well, cur, but betray me and I'll take your head and gift it to Volkmar's minions.
Agreed then, parasite, for that is all you are!
Yes, we will swell the von Carstein hosts, and the living shall fear us!
With Morrslieb so high in the sky, it makes sense for a union.
Yes, together we will feast on mortal flesh!
Agreed, kin, this will end mortal dominion.
No, do not mistake us, we are not the same. You are a vessel of filthy blood, mine is pure and I shall wipe you out.
Parasites are drawn to me like fleas on some mangy cur! Get thee from my sight or I'll end you!
I don't think so. I do not need your shambling hordes, I have access to much better stock.
With callous respect, I reject your offer... it lacks bite.
As the true master of this realm, I disagree.
Please - challenge me, feel my power and realise you are outmatched.
You come with Lady's tidings? What does that lake-hag want?
Before we can begin, I must slaughter all the low-born in your ranks. They are your gift, yess?
Impress me then, envoy. What favour does your impuissant king deign to ask?
Bretonnia must be in trouble to come here. Does Mousillon fare badly?
Bretonnians! Come then, let us eat and talk - once the meal is over I’ll decide if you shall live.
What message from your king, Bretonnian? Do the living still delude themselves?
Careful, Warrior, for you know not who you treat with. My power is death; my will absolute.
I have no more patience for the maggots of Chaos, they are nought but scavengers in my wake!
Spit your hate at me, Chaos creature, I care not for your Gods or their threats!
Rage all you wish, minion, but know that I am no peon, I create them!
What is your message, Chaos pawn? Mark that you do not address some quivering mortal!
Welcome, messenger of the Dark Gods, if your terms intrigue me, we could work together.
Why do the Dwarfs pester me so? I have had my fill of their stunted forms and baseless pride!
The last time I killed a Dwarf, I sucked the marrow from his iron-flecked bones, but do go on…
Dwarfs… Rarely can you get a clean bite of their neck, far too hairy, what do you want?
Tell me Dawi, why should I not leech you of life whence you stand?
Why Dwarfs! How amusing of you to deign to talk to me. What do you wish?
Here come the Dwarfs to sour my mood, what do the stone-gatherers want?
I wonder which one of your party is a Witch Hunter? He shall die first.
So, Franz sends his sheep to bargain for their own lives. A pity it is harvest time.
Welcome to the midnight realm, pray to your Man-God we come to an accommodation.
Greetings, only noble blood should deign to negotiate and we are the noblest of all!
You come in the name of 'Franz', a man born of dock whores, yet calls himself a 'prince' - what, mortals?
The Empire is finished, you mortals just wont accept it. Speak then…
Morrslieb glows… I can tell, for you come thinking to bargain, but I have already won!
There is desperation in your pitiful eyes! That knowledge alone will be leveraged against you!
You reek of anguish, or hopelessness, haha! Yes, let's us parley!
Mannslieb wanes and Morrslieb waxes, of course I was expecting you.
Ahh, you come here in desperation, yess? Good, I can deal with desperate mortals.
To stand before me and ask, proves you are no craven… but cowards often live longer!
Why, do come - what can we help you with this night?
Ahh! You seek out the von Carsteins, a bold action…
I'll have you speak now, pray to your gods I like what you say.
What could you possibly offer me, Orc, I cannot even drink your abhorrent blood!
Greenskin, I cannot tame you, so tell me, why I should not wipe you out?
How vile… what could you possibly offer me, Orc?
Greenskin, you are stood before me alive for a despise the taste of your fell blood, so speak.
I will address the Orc creature, I hope I can understand its guttural tongue.
Deliver your message, Greenskin, just maybe we can work together.
Dawn approaches and mongrel blood lines come to leech off me. What do you want, half-breed?
