To ferment further epidemics then a sizable horde of plague-carriers is needed. Swell your Daemonic host with more drudges and festerlings to bring the greatest of gifts to those that fight upon the mortal plane.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units_nurgle}}

The Mines of Nan-Yang are held by Rebel Lords, under the sway of Chi'an Chi. Their continued existence defiles Cathay and risks further sedition in the region. They must be eliminated.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}

The Snake Gate is breached and under the control of [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]]! Re-take the fortress-gate to secure [[sl:campaign_cathay]]Grand Cathay[[/sl]] and maintain your honour as the Great Bastion’s sentinel.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_great_bastion}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_great_bastion_learn_more}}

The Gunpowder Road is a major throughfare of the northern [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]], allowing the artificers of Nan-Gau to transport their wares and weapons across the Empire. No part of this region should remain under rebel control!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_complete_province}}

Under the malign influence of Chi'an Chi, rebels from the Mines of Nan-Yang approach with hostile hearts. They are Fateweaver's puppets to ensure strife as he attacks through the Great Bastion. Not that this exonerates such disobedience. They must face the Dragon's wrath!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Fateweaver's minions defile lands under your protection. Leaving them to fester risks a loss of standing with your siblings and father, the Dragon Emperor himself!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_factions}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_factions_learn_more}}

Powerful [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] such as the Astromancer can act independently. For now, get them to join your army.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_movement}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_learn_more}}
Send messengers to Nan-Gau that you require more warriors as you continue to purge Grand Cathay of rebellious taint.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units}}

The Palace of Princes was created by a Slaaneshi troupe as a venue for the Masque. But now it is in the hands of Khorne's servants. See it is returned back into the loins of Slaanesh's attendants.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}

Uniting the Shard Lands under one dominatrix will not only rid you of the immediate threat from Khorne, but give a strong powerbase from which to launch southwards, where the richest quarry lies.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_complete_province}}

The [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Blood God[[/sl]] has always hated [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] above his other kin. His servants approach the Palace of Ruin, now is the time to strike out or risk destruction.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Powerful [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] such as the Alluress can act independently. For now, get them to join your army to bolster your host.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_movement}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_learn_more}}
Swell your host with fresh warriors. All will be required to inflict both pleasure and pain upon the enemy. Start recruiting.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units}}

We must be ready for the travails to come. If our [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] goes through the [[sl:campaign_chaos_rifts]]rifts[[/sl]] then our homelands will be undefended. Muster another army.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_raising_forces_learn_more}}

Additional [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] may be recruited into an [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] on the [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment_panel]]Unit Recruitment panel[[/sl]]. Recruitment takes [[sl:campaign_turns]]time[[/sl]] and costs [[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]]. Once recruited, units cost {{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}} to maintain each turn.\\n\\nRecruitment is cheapest when the army is in home territory.\\n\\nLearn more about unit recruitment [[url:script_link_campaign_unit_recruitment]]here[[/url]].

The Brass Glacier has been the site of many murders in your father's name. The mortals within think to summon Daemons to aid their cause. Well, they have indirectly summoned you, but not to aid them…\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement_khorne}}

The Gharhar tribe have tried to conquer all of the Bloodfire Falls, and perhaps they would have managed it if you had not been lurking under the volcano. But now they have raised your anger…\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_complete_province_khorne}}

A Chaos Lord and his retinue seeks to make a name for himself and draw the eye of the Gods. The only thing he is good for is fodder! Slaughter them!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Powerful [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] such as the Bloodreaper can act independently. For now, get them to join your army to bolster your host.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_movement}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_learn_more}}

Skarbrand needs no help. Skarbrand can kill anyone… but old man says is best to summon more Bloodletters! Skarbrand will comply… then Skarbrand will RAGE!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units}}

The vaults of the Dwarfen Karaks are famous for their hoarded wealth. Such riches should be yours, and while gold sustains many Ogres the rest can feast on bearded meat! Break it open and take the good stuff within.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}

Once you have rid these mountains of Dwarfs, you can then establish a powerful base to launch attacks against the human nations. Just think of all that meat!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_complete_province}}

Guided by the Great Maw you have travelled far from the Ogre Kingdoms, and into the Grey Mountains. The trouble is, it's full of Dwarfs. One of their throngs approaches. See them off!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Powerful [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] such as the Butcher can act independently. For now, get them to join your army to bolster your host.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_movement}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_learn_more}}
There will be many big fights to come. Best to swell your hoard with some fresh meat. Get recruiting!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units}}

Xen Wu was a thriving town of loyal Cathayans not long ago, and now it is ruins. Abandoned… or is it? Occupy the settlement and find out what happened to your people.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}

To become master of Shang-Yang once more you must do so from a place of strength. Ruling over the Wastelands of Jinshen will give you resources and martial might needed to placate other regions.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_complete_province}}

The Skaven have always lurked in the Warpstone Desert but they have been emboldened of late, and now directly challenge you. Exterminate these pests!\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Powerful [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] such as the Alchemist can act independently. For now, get them to join your army.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_movement}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_learn_more}}
Send messengers to Hanyu Port that you require more warriors as you require a grander legion to fight in the battles to come.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_recruit_units}}

As a [[sl:campaign_daemons_of_chaos]]Daemon Prince[[/sl]] of [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]], you are untethered to the will of the Ruinous Powers. Yet through them great power may be gained... in return for your servitude.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_daemonic_glory}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_daemonic_glory_add_02}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_daemonic_glory_learn_more}}

Strive to gain further glory from the Gods of [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]]. Through servitude to the Ruinous Powers may be found boundless power.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_5_daemonic_glory}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_daemonic_glory_learn_more}}

[[sl:campaign_daemons_of_chaos]]Daemon Princes[[/sl]] differ from other daemonic creatures as they were once mortal - a soul still withers within them. This also allows them, and you, agency over their form. Continue your evolution into a shape that shall please you.\\n\\n[[sl_tooltip:campaign_daemonic_gifts]]Daemonic Gifts[[/sl_tooltip]] are unlocked as [[sl:campaign_daemonic_glory]]Daemonic Glory[[/sl]] is earned with each Chaos God.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_daemonic_glory_add_01}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_daemonic_glory_learn_more}}

For so long have you exalted the pantheon of [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]] with your deeds that the Ruinous Powers now vie with one another to secure your fealty. Dedicate yourself to the service of a particular god of Chaos, or as an Undivided champion of all.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_description_dedication}}\\n\\nDedications can be made on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_daemonic_glory_panel]]Daemonic Glory panel[[/sl_tooltip]].\\n\\nLearn more about Dedications [[url:script_link_campaign_dedication]]here[[/url]].

{{tr:hp_campaign_description_bloodletting}}\\n\\nKeep winning [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]] to gain the approval of the Blood God and to stir his followers into a mighty fervour.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_bloodletting}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_bloodletting_learn_more}}

A [[sl:campaign_chaos_cults]]Chaos Cult[[/sl]] has been established in [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]]'s name! Rage and hate begin to spread amongst the local population.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_construct_chaos_cult_building}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_skulls}}\\n\\nSelect an army or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero and right-click a Skull Pile when one appears to harvest Skulls from it.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_skulls_learn_more}}
{{tr:hp_campaign_point_5_skulls}}\\n\\nSend Skulls to the Skull Throne to please [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]] and gain his mighty favour.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_skulls_learn_more}}

The [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Blood God[[/sl]]'s thirst for Skulls cannot be quenched. Bring Skulls! Bring them now!\\n\\nBlood for the Blood God! Skulls for the Skull Throne!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_skulls_learn_more}}

Spread word of the glory of Khorne beyond your borders to gain His favour, unlocking more [[sl:campaign_unholy_manifestations]]Unholy Manifestations[[/sl]] and making it more likely that the Blood God will become ascendant in [[sl:campaign_the_great_game]]The Great Game[[/sl]].\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_spread_chaos_corruption}}

Khorne [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] can summon a short-lived Daemonic [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] when they [[sl:campaign_razing]]raze[[/sl]] a captured settlement.\\n\\nThis [[sl:campaign_post_battle_options]]post-battle option[[/sl]] allows a Khornate faction to greatly increase its military strength for a short time.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_khorne_learn_more}}
{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_atamans}}\\n\\nCapture two complete provinces to be able to appoint an Ataman.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_atamans_learn_more}}

News of victories against the forces of Chaos is especially well-received by the various peoples of Kislev. Meet the Ruinous Powers in battle, and win, to gain their Devotion.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_devotion_add_01}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_devotion_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_10_motherland}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_motherland_add_01}} The method of gaining Supporters is different for each invocation.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_11_motherland}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_supporters_learn_more}}

The Gods of [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]] are said to be aspects of the Motherland, masters of the freezing winds and wild tundra. Those with sufficient [[sl:campaign_devotion]]Devotion[[/sl]] may seek their blessings.\\n\\nBlessings of the Motherland may be viewed and invoked on the [[sl:campaign_motherland_panel]]Motherland panel[[/sl]].\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_devotion_learn_more}}

Despite not being involved in the struggle for [[sl:campaign_supporters_track]]Support[[/sl]] taking place between The Ice Court and The Great Orthodoxy, other powers within [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]] ruling classes may draw strength from performing Invocations of the Motherland. See to it that the Kislev people receive ample blessings from their gods.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_motherland_learn_more}}

A [[sl:campaign_chaos_cults]]Chaos Cult[[/sl]] has been established in service to [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]]! Mysterious diseases begin to circulate amongst the local population already.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_construct_chaos_cult_building}}

Once a cyclical [[sl:campaign_buildings]]building[[/sl]] reaches its final stage, it returns to its base level and the Lifecycle begins again.\\n\\nSome stages of a [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]] building’s Lifecycle may only be passed if the [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] building is at a certain level. This is indicated on the icon for that stage.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_cyclical_buildings_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_5_nurgle}} Take steps to increase the amount of Nurgle corruption present in controlled provinces to ensure that [[img:icon_growth]][[/img]]growth is high.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_nurgle_learn_more}}

Spread the pestilent corruption of Grandfather Nurgle to gain His favour, unlocking more [[sl:campaign_unholy_manifestations]]Unholy Manifestations[[/sl]] and making it more likely that He will become ascendant in [[sl:campaign_the_great_game]]The Great Game[[/sl]].\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_spread_chaos_corruption}}

A Plague that afflicts no-one is no use to Grandfather Nurgle! Ensure its spread amongst your unfortunate enemies, proliferating malady and malaise for all to despair!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_plagues_of_nurgle}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_plagues_of_nurgle_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_plagues_of_nurgle}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_2_plagues_of_nurgle}}\\n\\nUnlock three symptoms so that future concoctions may be yet more potent.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_plagues_of_nurgle_learn_more}}

By building a virulent arsenal of ingredients for disease, you will fulfil the wishes of Grandfather [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]] and gain the power to spread pestilence and death the length and breadth of the mortal world. Such joy!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_plagues_of_nurgle}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_2_plagues_of_nurgle}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_plagues_of_nurgle_learn_more}}

Big Names draw the admiration of [[sl:campaign_ogre_kingdoms]]Ogres[[/sl]] the length and breadth of the Mountains of Mourn. Even the lesser [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]] recognise the power that Tyrants with titles wield.\\n\\nEarn many Big Names for your Tyrants [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and Hunter [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] to project your power far beyond your borders.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_big_names_learn_more}}
{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_ogre_camps}}\\n\\nSelect an Ogre Camp to see available construction options.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_ogre_camps_learn_more}}

The hunger of the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_offer_to_the_great_maw_panel]]Great Maw[[/sl_tooltip]] is insatiable. Make plentiful offers to gain the full blessings of the [[sl:campaign_ogre_kingdoms]]Ogre[[/sl]] god.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_meat}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_meat_learn_more}}

Continue to develop your [[sl:campaign_ogre_camps]]Ogre camps[[/sl]], for they are the bedrock of [[sl:campaign_ogres]]Ogre[[/sl]] power. {{tr:hp_campaign_ogre_camps_add_01}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_ogre_camps_learn_more}}

Your mightiest [[sl:campaign_ogre_camps]]Ogre camps[[/sl]] may become great engines of war, the home bases of conquering armies that roam far and wide. Continue to develop your camp facilities to the fullest extent.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_ogre_camps_add_01}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_ogre_camps_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_description_settlements}}\\n\\nProvince capitals are fortified, and will be harder to capture than unfortified settlements. Province capitals appear as the first settlement on the [[sl:campaign_province_overview_panel]]Province Overview panel[[/sl]] when selected.\\n\\nLearn more about settlements [[url:script_link_campaign_settlements]]here[[/url]].

While fighting against your master’s rivals furthers the [[sl:campaign_the_great_game]]Great Game[[/sl]], the true prizes lie south – the fertile lands and souls of mankind. Send your armies to destroy and despoil!\\n\\nSack or [[sl:campaign_razing]]raze[[/sl]] settlements belonging to any [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_cathay]]Cathay[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_empire]]Empire[[/sl]] faction.

The [[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]] Gods crave souls above all else. Head south into the so-called civilised lands and reap their pitiful lives. ‘Conquer your Daemons’ – we’ll put that phrase to the test!\\n\\nDefeat [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] from any [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_cathay]]Cathay[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_empire]]Empire[[/sl]] factions in the field.

Rather than using the rifts as ingress, close this gateway lest the Daemons – frenzied by the maelstrom – burst forth and lay your domains in Ruin!\\n\\nLearn more about Chaos Rifts [[url:script_link_campaign_chaos_rifts]]here[[/url]].

You control one province, but more land must be acquired if you are to fund a successful war machine. Send out your armies to seize more territory from your enemies.\\n\\nLearn more about provinces [[url:script_link_campaign_provinces]]here[[/url]].

It is only through conquest that true power may be achieved. Build your forces, take the fight to your enemies and capture their settlements for yourself. The additional facilities and income brought under your banner will afford you yet greater power to wage war.\\n\\nLearn more about provinces [[url:script_link_campaign_provinces]]here[[/url]].
[[sl:campaign_factions]]Factions[[/sl]] can research technologies over time, which bring a variety of civic and military benefits.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_research_technology}}
Our enemies gather to strike against us! Attack first, and deny them the opportunity to reach full strength.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

Ungrateful miscreants in this [[sl:campaign_provinces]]settlement[[/sl]] seek to rebel against your rule. Crush this uprising, before it threatens your hold over the [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]]!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_revolts_learn_more}}
{{tr:hp_campaign_diplomacy_add_01}}\\n\\nBe on the lookout for opportunities to make diplomatic contacts as you expand your influence across the world.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_diplomacy_learn_more}}

Unwanted magic items in the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_global_item_pool]]Global Item pool[[/sl_tooltip]] may be magically fused to potentially form more powerful items.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_magic_items_add_02}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_magic_items_learn_more}}

Each [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] maintains a central {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury. The current {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl_tooltip:campaign_treasury]]treasury value[[/sl_tooltip]] and overall {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income[[/sl]] per [[sl:campaign_turns]]turn[[/sl]] are shown at the top of the screen.\\n\\nAdditional income can be gained from [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_trade]]trade[[/sl]] and other sources.\\n\\nLearn more about {{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}} [[url:script_link_campaign_money]]here[[/url]].

Great wealth leads to great power. Leverage the tools at your disposal to gain a substantial income from [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_trade]]trade[[/sl]] and other sources. Success against your adversaries depends on being able to afford to keep [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] in the field.\\n\\nLearn more about {{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}} [[url:script_link_campaign_money]]here[[/url]].

The stationing of an [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] in a province has a positive effect on {{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} there. Sending an army to garrison a [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] has a greater effect still.\\n\\nGarrison an army in a [[sl:campaign_province]]province[[/sl]] where {{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} is low to quickly restore order.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_learn_more}}

A high level of {{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} brings benefits above and beyond just staving off [[sl:campaign_revolts]]revolt[[/sl]]. Inspect the tooltips of the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_public_order_bar]] to see what effects the various thresholds of {{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} provide.\\n\\nStrive to maintain high levels of {{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} in all [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]] you have a stake in.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_learn_more}}
{{tr:hp_campaign_description_magic_items}}\\n\\nMagic items of uncommon rarity provide more powerful bonuses than more ordinary trinkets.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_magic_items_learn_more}}

You are defenceless before your enemies, your [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] defeated or disbanded. Raise a new military force, and quickly, lest your enemies overrun you!\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_raising_forces_learn_more}}

Your attention is split on many fronts: the time is surely nigh to raise a second [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]]. Seek to raise an additional force as soon as you can afford it.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_raising_forces_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_description_heroes}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_add_01}}\\n\\nRecruit a [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero to expand the range of tools at your disposal. {{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_add_03}}

Wars rage the length and breadth of this land. In such times, only the strong can hope to survive. Build your forces in order to meet the threats that face you.\\n\\n[[sl:campaign_units]]Units[[/sl]] cost money to [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit[[/sl]] and also to maintain through unit upkeep. Be sure to keep watch on your finances as you grow your forces.\\n\\nLearn more about unit recruitment [[url:script_link_campaign_unit_recruitment]]here[[/url]].

Recruited units cost [[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]] to maintain each [[sl:campaign_turns]]turn[[/sl]]. This upkeep can be ruinous if too many units are recruited. Units may be [[sl:campaign_unit_merging_and_disbanding]]merged or disbanded[[/sl]] to reduce upkeep costs.\\n\\nThe upkeep of each [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] is shown on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]army panel[[/sl]] when that army is selected.\\n\\nLearn more about unit upkeep [[url:script_link_campaign_income]]here[[/url]].

Each [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] maintains a central {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury. The current {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl_tooltip:campaign_treasury]]treasury value[[/sl_tooltip]] and overall {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income[[/sl]] per [[sl:campaign_turns]]turn[[/sl]] are shown at the top of the screen on the campaign interface.\\n\\nAdditional income can be gained from certain buildings, [[sl:campaign_raiding]]raiding[[/sl]], sacking enemy [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] and other methods.\\n\\nLearn more about {{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}} [[url:script_link_campaign_money]]here[[/url]].

Improvements to your [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction's[[/sl]] knowledge and practices are key to gaining dominance over your rivals. Technological research can unlock access to new [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_stances]]stances[[/sl]] and more, or provide improvements to existing assets.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_technology_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_character_skills_add_02}}\\n\\nLook to gain mounts for your [[sl:campaign_characters]]characters[[/sl]] to provide them with added reach on the battlefield.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_character_skills_learn_more}}

Through acts of great courage are legends and conquerors forged. Look to develop your [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] into great war leaders by performing acts of bravery in campaign and battle.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_character_skills_learn_more}}

Continue to develop your cities and fortresses at home, for they empower conquest abroad.\\n\\nProvince capitals can be developed to a higher degree than minor settlements. It pays to plan your building development accordingly, as some chains of buildings cannot be fully developed in a minor settlement.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_buildings_add_01}}

Your mightiest fortresses may become great engines of war, the home bases of conquering armies that roam far and wide. Continue to develop your facilities at home.\\n\\nOnly the most important province capital settlements may be developed to the highest level.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_buildings_add_01}}

A [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Hero[[/sl]] embedded within an [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] will fight with that army in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]], gaining [[sl:campaign_unit_experience]]experience[[/sl]] and abilities as they do so. With sufficient victories under their belt, any [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero has the potential to become a truly formidable warrior.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_heroes_add_03}}

A [[sl:campaign_chaos_cults]]Chaos Cult[[/sl]] has been established to evangelise the worship of [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]]! Already, hedonistic tendencies begin to spread amongst the local population.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_construct_chaos_cult_building}}

Devotion affords the servants of [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] many powers unavailable to inferior [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]]. Great [[sl:campaign_disciple_armies]]Disciple Armies[[/sl]] may be raised from amongst the willing, [[sl:campaign_chaos_cults]]Chaos Cults[[/sl]] may be spread across the world, and the weak and venal races of men and Elves may be [[sl:campaign_seductive_influence]]subjugated[[/sl]] through Devotees.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_devotees_learn_more}}

Gifts of Slaanesh facilitate the flow of great wisdom between the followers of Slaanesh and lesser [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]]. Those gifted with such a mark involuntarily spread the message of the Prince of Pleasure, ensuring a steady flow of [[sl:campaign_devotees]]Devotees[[/sl]] to your cause. In return, well, you get to see what the branded fools are up to...\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_2_gifts_of_slaanesh}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_gifts_of_slaanesh_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_devotees}}\\n\\nPut some [[sl:campaign_devotees]]Devotees[[/sl]] to good use by spreading the worship of [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] beyond your borders.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_chaos_cults_learn_more}}

{{tr:hp_campaign_description_seductive_influence}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_8_seductive_influence}}\\n\\nSeductive Influence with a faction may be increased by engaging it in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_diplomacy]]diplomacy[[/sl]], through [[sl:campaign_gifts_of_slaanesh]]Gifts of Slaanesh[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_chaos_cults]]Chaos Cults[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_chaos_corruption]]Chaos corruption[[/sl]].\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_seductive_influence_learn_more}}

The armies of the east encroach on the territory of our grand Holds, and Dawi blood has been spilled in defending them. This cannot be allowed to stand! A grudge has been recorded – now we must see it wiped out.

Many throngs of Dawi have been lost to the Daemonic scourge, before the eyes of our vengeful Ancestor Gods. For every terror they have inflicted, we will inflict one twice as great in return. Hunt their army down and crush them, and settle this grudge once and for all.
Before the downcast eyes of Grimnir, our warriors have fallen to an army of Kislev, and a grudge has been recorded in their names. Avenge their deaths, and erase this shame from the Dammaz Kron!

Grungni surely strikes his anvil in anger, to see the savage armies of the Ogres defile the bodies our brothers to fill their stomachs. Such vile insult cannot go unpunished. Their grotesque misdeeds against the Dawi have been recorded in the Dammaz Kron, and it is long past time we exacted retribution!
The Ancestors must rage to see these umgi of the east raiding our Holds. Halt them in their tracks and erase this grudge as an offering to Grimnir, through the strength and steel of the Dawi!

Grungni rages as the loathsome hordes of Chaos raid our lands, defiling our territory with their foul presence. Strike this grudge from the Dammaz Kron, for their deaths will surely please the Ancestors!
The foul manlings of Kislev dare to raid our lands, in the sight of our Ancestor Gods! We cannot tolerate such blatant disrespect. Track them down and wipe them out, our vengeance cannot wait!
Our ancestors watch with a furious glare as the Ogri scum raid our territory. Mark this grudge in the Dammaz Kron at once; this score will only be settled once their savage army is destroyed!

The Goddess of Home and Hearth surely weeps to see our glorious Holds desecrated by the umgi of Cathay. This insult has been added to the Dammaz Kron. Find the manlings responsible, and ensure they pay for their crimes with blood!

Under Valaya's sorrowful gaze, the scum of Chaos have sacked one of our great Holds. Their filth and perversion must be answered for with blood! Find their army in the name of the Ancestor Gods – every one of these Daemons must be punished!

The northern manlings dare to sack one of our Holds! Every stout-hearted Dawi who fell in its defence must be avenged. With Grimnir as witness, this grudge must be resolved – crush their army and make those cravens pay!

Valaya watches on in sorrow as the wicked ogri army lay waste to one of our Holds. We must show them that the Dawi do not forget, nor do we forgive. Our people lost enough to these kruti scum at Karak Azorn. We must show that history will not be repeated and destroy this detestable army at once!

The most devastating betrayals transcend even death, lurking forever in the memory as the hurt it left behind is passed from generation to generation. Such was the treachery of the Lord Malekith, whose sworn oath of friendship to the Dawi king Snorri Whitebeard was broken a hundred times over! The White Dwarf Grombrindal has sworn to right this wrong. The treacherous Dark Elves must pay for their deceit, for only then will the most grievous of betrayals finally be avenged!

These Cathayan umgi have taken our territory, right under the eyes of the Ancestors! This cannot be allowed to stand. Record this trespass in the book of grudges and bring that land back into Dawi hands!

Ruinous filth reside in our Dwarfhold, defiling our great halls and desecrating our homes. Their vile stench cannot be allowed to taint our lands a moment longer! Take back our Hold and visit our revenge upon these abominable scum-suckers!

By the eyes of the Ancestors, our Hold has fallen to the manlings of Kislev, who now reside in our rightful place! Our brave Dawi warriors must rectify this at once. Take back our home, and strike this grudge from the Dammaz Kron!

An army of vile Ogri have snatched a Dwarfhold out from under us, slaying its Dawi defenders and making a boiling broth from their bones! This is as vile a transgression as ever recorded in the Dammaz Kron. Our vengeance must be absolute; return this hold to our people, and reap bloody retribution in the name of our fallen brothers!

This keepsake once belonged to a mighty warrior who sought to eradicate defilers of the dead in the name of the Lord of Underearth, Gazul himself. Its loss has been a subject of great shame said to be felt even by the Ancestors, whose souls will not be appeased until it is back in Dawi hands.

By Morgrim's teachings, the craftsmanship displayed with these sacred gears, legendary paradigms of Dwarfen engineering, are of the highest echelons. The knowledge set by their standard is sacred, so the revered instruments must be recovered and preserved for future generations of Dawi.

In his time, Raton proposed dangerous and radical ideas to gain control over primitive beasts. With the help of the Engineers' Guild, he developed a prototype collar that apparently worked, but was slain while binding it to a beast subject. Now long lost, this item’s efficacy could further prove Dwarf engineering’s supremacy over magic.

It is no doubt that Smednir’s smelting techniques made us the most renowned metalworkers in the world. Many of his most important formulae were lost during the many upheavals of the Dwarfen dynasties, likely stolen by those without understanding of what they took. Without Smednir’s lost secrets, the Dawi can never be as great as they are destined to be!

Thungni’s Tongs were utilised by some of the first Runesmiths under his tutelage, serving them well in crafting the most potent rune-weapons ever made. These powerful armaments were crucial in many of the great victories of our kin – such weapons could be forged again, but not without the tongs that gave them their power, long lost in the mists of time.

After a considerable amount of searching high and low right across Lustria, Lord Kroak’s Skink scouts finally locate the overgrown temple-tomb in which the ancient Relic Priest is meditating, as ever, upon the fine details of the Great Plan. However, in their haste it would appear that the scouts were somewhat careless, as they have been followed to Kroak’s location by a force of those insidious ratmen, the Skaven! They plan to destroy him, once and for all, by incinerating his physical remains that anchor him to the world. This must not come to pass – defend Kroak from harm whilst his priests awaken him!
