There must be good a reason for them to have left the safety of their holds just to hunt down some belligerent beasts. They were last seen marching for Kislev, so some further reconnaissance there is needed.

Soaring above the eldritch plains of Sylvania there exists a rare species of gargantuan bat-like monster that is as giant and powerful as the largest of Dragons. They are known as Terrorgheists, flying nocturnal beasts of rotten flesh and withered organs exposed to the night air. Although most are guided by the will of their evil masters, some Terrorgheists are more self-serving, drawing their power and evil intent from the very soil of their Undead homeland. It is said that to bring down such a beast takes the greatest of hunters. This sounds like just the kind of sacrifice that would be seen very favourably by the Gods!\\n\\nThere is one ancient Terrorgheist known to be more terrifying than all others, with a scream that is said to break the will of any man, and eyes like black holes that suck in all manner of magical energies and light. It is known as the Abyssal Shrieker, an abominable Terrorgheist spoken about only in nightmarish tales shrouded in myth, the fragments of truth of which are unknown to most.\\n\\nIt would certainly be foolish to enter into this hunt with no knowledge of the bounty, so before setting off to find the monster, you call upon one most likely to have knowledge of the Old World’s ancient beasts – a Shaman-Sorcerer.

Delving into his vast collection of tomes and scrolls, the Shaman reveals that any records which might have mentioned the Abyssal Shrieker were so ancient that they are lost in the streams of time. With no hint as to where the monster’s lair could be, its very existence is in question. At the very least the Shaman is able to tell you that he knows Terrorgheists to be deeply bound to necromancy in the Sylvanian lands, and one particular Sylvanian family is known to be frequently mentioned in some records as having hunted the terrible beasts in the past. It’s not much to go on, but it’s a start. You must search out any remnants of this family in the lands of Sylvania.

After a short stint of raiding around Sylvanian lands, you come across an old manor known to be the former home of the Sylvanian family you seek. The house is lifeless – the line of nobility that used to live there had long ended, leaving only howling ghosts of the past that scatter into the shadows as you arrive. Searching every room, you come across a study with an old skeleton sat at a desk, a quill still in its hand. On the table is a leather-bound notebook containing a written history of the family who once lived there.\\n\\nAccording to the notebook, the former inhabitants of the house were once nobles of nearby Stirland, which was frequently haunted by The Abyssal Shrieker. The skeleton sat at the table was, in fact, a former Stirlander Lord, a renowned hunter who had once attempted to kill the exceptionally dangerous centuries-old monster himself. After a vicious battle, the great Lord failed to slay the beast and narrowly escaped with his life. Although he survived the encounter, he paid a terrible price for his defeat. The Terrorgheist absorbed almost all of his life-force and strength to make itself even more powerful, leaving the once-great hunter a sickly, weak individual, an affliction that infected his entire family and bloodline. Withered and disgraced, the noble and his kin exiled themselves to Sylvania where they eventually perished in shame.\\n\\nClearly, this pathetic Stirlander was nowhere near as great a hunter as you! He at least managed to record the location of his defeat, which you assume to be in the vicinity of the Abyssal Shrieker’s lair. All that remains to do is travel to Wurtbad to find it.

Soaring above the eldritch plains of Sylvania there exists flying nocturnal beasts of rotten flesh and withered organs exposed to the night air – the gargantuan bat-like monsters known as Terrorgheists. One such beast known as the Abyssal Shrieker is more terrifying than all others,with a scream that is said to break the will of any man, and eyes like black holes that suck in all magical energies and light. It is an abominable creature spoken about only in nightmarish tales shrouded in myth, the fragments of truth of which are unknown to most.\\n\\nIn your hunt for the Abyssal Shrieker you obtained a leather-bound notebook containing a written history of the last individual who had attempted to kill it. This long-dead hunter was once a noble of Stirland, which for a time was frequently haunted by the mysterious centuries-old monster, so he set out to kill it himself. According to the notebook, the great Lord failed to slay the beast after a vicious battle, from which he only narrowly escaped with his life. Although he survived the encounter, he paid a terrible price for his defeat. The Terrorgheist absorbed almost all of his lifeforce and strength to make itself even more powerful, leaving the once-great hunter a sickly, weak individual, an affliction suffered by his entire family and bloodline. Withered and disgraced, the noble and his kin exiled themselves to Sylvania where they all eventually perished in shame.\\n\\nClearly, this pathetic Stirlander was nowhere near as great a hunter as you! He at least managed to record the location of his defeat, which you assume to be in the vicinity of the Abyssal Shrieker’s lair. All that remains to do is travel to Wurtbad to find it.

The Hound God sits brooding upon a vast and ornately carved brass throne atop a great mountain of blood-stained bones, observing your progress with disdain. Although impressed by the slaughter – especially your dispatching of the other petty Gods’ champions – it is insulted that the killing was not done in its name, so sends its own challenger to defeat you…

The ancient Crow God is very established amongst the Norscan tribes, personified as a gigantic and massively bloated creature surrounded by dark clouds of tiny Daemonic insects. It is thought to be a ‘generous’ spirit, always interested in the plight of its mortal followers. Now, however, even the Crow’s generosity has worn thin. Observing your defeat of the other petty Gods’ champions, it is angry that the killing was not done in its name, so is sending a repulsive challenger to deliver punishment...

Those who worship the Serpent God do so for pleasure and personal gain, knowing that it is within its power to imbue followers with a portion of its radiant glory. The allure of the Serpent is highly addictive to most, but you have infuriated it by resisting the lure of its pride, arrogance, and excess. Having observed you obliterate the other petty Gods’ champions with interest, the Serpent God simultaneously writhes in disgust at your shunning. Now it sends a challenger, as charismatic as all its champions…

The inconstant Eagle God knows each trivial seed of hate in man’s heart, just as it knows the ultimate fate of every star in the cosmos. Its plans are convoluted and vast, spanning untold aeons, inexplicable and contradictory to mortal minds. Having observed you obliterate the other petty Gods’ champions with interest, it simultaneously writhes in disgust that you have shunned it, and so has set another one of its plans into motion. The final challenger, the champion of the Eagle God, awaits you in battle!

Your scouts tell you that a dragon-like shadow has been spotted up ahead, moving directly into the heart of the blizzard where the weather is at its worst. This can be none other than the Scion of the Cold-Void itself! There is only one way to see this hunt through to its conclusion, and that is to follow the monster right into the eye of the storm. It is time to claim the legendary beast for the Gods!

Do not take these behemoths lightly, for they are no ordinary Cygors. They hurl clusters of boulders with frightening speed, and will do so with reckless abandon.\\nThey are Soul-Eaters, so it may be difficult to wield magic against them. Difficult, but not impossible.

Following your lead, your army strides into the wastelands of the far north. The slave was speaking the truth – your scouts report back that the monstrous Traygard has been spotted not far from your location, and if you move immediately you can cut him off at the Cliff of Beasts. At last! Your search may soon be at an end, and the great hunt will finally begin in earnest.

There are multiple giant spider tracks leading into a subterranean passageway, making it easy to identify as the one you seek. Being cautious, you send scouts ahead to descend into the tunnel first, who return to tell you that the tunnel leads into an even bigger network of tunnels beneath. The spider tracks are as clear as day and the herd will be found, if only you follow them. All that remains is for you to lead your army down there…
Your scouts report seeing a great Forest Dragon lurking in front of the great tree. For once, it is neither a glamour nor a trick of the eye, but the Serpent of the World Roots itself!

Your scouts inform you that a band of addled Dwarfs are in fact hunting the herd to settle an old Grudge – revenge for the Mawherd's trampling of one of their past throng leaders. Stranger still, while you have been on the trail of this mighty Mammoth herd, you have not seen any actual traces of their presence anywhere, and that of the Mawherd has belied their supposed size and stampeding prowess. It is time, at last, to go and witness The Great Mawherd of Bloodfjord for yourself, if indeed it is actually there!
Following a trail of bones, you find the Terrorgheist’s lair in a nearby haunted forest – an obvious location for the dwelling of such an evil creature.\\n{{tr:advice_levels_onscreen_text_174323567}}
As witnessed by Grimnir's disappointed glare, this army of Bretonnian curs stole victory from our throng. Such a grudge should be avenged!
Seen by Grungni's indignant eyes, the Chaos horde has cheated its way to victory against our brave Dawi throng - a grave grudge indeed! Right this wrong, and hunt down the Chaos filth.
Under Valaya's stern gaze, the rival wattocks of a failing Hold have claimed victory against us! Foolish Dawi - it is a grudge that must be settled!
Spied by a raging Grimnir, the umgi - who once claimed kith and kinship with the Dawi - dare to entrap and slay our throng. Hunt down this army and wipe the grudge from the Dammaz Kron!

Witnessed by Grimnir's vengeful sight, the Greenskin mob attacks our own throng and fell urk treachery has forced a dishonourable retreat! We cannot - will not - let such a stain on Dawi courage past. A grudge is recorded, ensure it is settled!

Observed by the judgemental glare of Valaya, the filthy blood drinkers have claimed victory against honest, breathing, beard-growing Dawi. They are an affront to the Mother Goddess, hunt down this host and send them back to the dark!
Seen through Grungni's resentful gaze, the manling Knights in their shoddy, umgak armour have raided this Dawi-claimed region. Defeat these cretins to restore honour.

Under Grimnir's raging sight, the Chaos corrupted umgi have raided our lands - a fell grudge indeed! Find these urks and defeat them, only then will Grimnir let such an atrocity against the Dawi relent.
Via Valaya's despairing glare, our territory has been raided - not by urk filth but by our own kin! A vile betrayal, a terrible grudge, and one that must be paid in Clan blood!
In Gazul's vengeful sight, the manlings of the Empire have raided Dwarfen lands and taken Dwarfen treasure! This must be paid for in blood!
Under the outraged sight of Grimnir, the grobi scum raid our mountains as they always have. Another grudge for the great book, another wrong to be righted, more Greenskins to hunt and kill!
Witnessed by Thungni, an Undead host has raided our lands. Hunt down this horde of filthy bloodsuckers and visit vengeance upon them!
Witnessed by Smednir's furious, fuming gaze, their crone of a goddess has sent her Knights sacking Dawi lands. Find these trespassers and hold them to account!
Seen by Valaya's agonised eyes, the northern manlings have despoiled our home, stolen artefacts and tainted sacred vaults. A grudge is in place, vengeance will be ours!
In Grungni's deplored sight, our kin have defiled a rival Hold. Such desecration of our own Karaks by treacherous Dawi cannot be tolerated! Find the enemy throng and punish them!

Under Grimnir's vengeful stare, the Empire has betrayed and defiled our Holds, stealing our secrets and ruining proud Dwarfen works - as is typical of their kind. Find this army and claim retribution.
Beheld by a wrathful Grimnir, the old enemy, a Greenskin mob has sacked a Dwarfhold. The rage is deep, this is a grudge like no other! Find the grobi scum responsible and wipe them out!
Regarded by Valaya's resentful eyes, Uzkular have invaded and sacked our proud Dwarfhold. Revenge must be enacted; the grudge put right. Find this grave-scum host and destroy them!
Under Valaya's disappointed glare, infighting amongst the Dawi has led to an insurgency here. The grudge has been listed - end this despicable influx!
In Valaya's very own sight did the Bretonnian chufs dare take our homes and mines. Bring it back into Dwarf hands and curse every umgi for this treacherous act!

Before the eyes of Valaya, Goddess of Home and Hearth, the Chaos-sworn umgi of the north seize our land to honour their foul Gods. These wazzocks think they will be protected by their Ruinous benefactors. It is time we proved them wrong and took back what is rightfully ours!
Under the wrathful sight of Grimnir did Dwarfs of a rival Clan take this settlement by force. We cannot abide such wilful trespass. Remove them and restore the Dwarfhold to its rightful owners.
Viewed by a weeping Valaya, rival Dwarfs have taken a Hold in lieu of a debt allegedly owed by the original inhabitants' ancestors. Lies! Restore the true owners.
By Grimnir's stare, the Sigmar-loving umgi dare to take our homes and mountains. Record it in the book and ensure the settlement is returned to the Dawi.
Witnessed by Grungni, the urk and grobi bastards have taken our Dwarfhold. Is there a fouler grudge ever recorded? Get it back!

Seen by the Mother of Home and Hearth, the Greenskins have taken a Dwarfhold. A vile sin, this grudge has been entered into the book and must now be wiped clean. Take the Hold back and kill any grobi in our way!

As witnessed by a weeping Valaya, the enemy did come to our ancient home and ruin it. The Halls of the Ancestors lie discarded, the vaults raided! This is a black grudge, return the Hold and slay any who get in our way!
Seen by Grimnir, the Undead dare to ransack and occupy our settlement. A grudge has been recorded, ensure it is settled.

As seen by Thungni's raging glare, innocent Dawi travelling through Stirland have been taken by the von Carstein Zangunaz and slain. Their bodies have been risen and made to perform a dread revel - a puppet re-enactment of Jaeger's travesty of a play, "Stoutheart Beardcomber and the Ostlander's Wife". This is a terrible grudge - for it is a terrible play - and one that must be paid with von Carstein heads!

Under Smednir's annoyed gaze, did the Dwarfs from Kraka Drak send their emissaries to Everpeak covered in Chaos-tainted beard ticks! Many Dawi set their beards alight to rid themselves of the parasitic embuggerence or covered their beards in acrid powder, which had the unfortunate side effect of bleaching said facial hair a drastic blonde colour! A grudge is recorded against the Norse Dwarfs - one that should be settled by ignoring these lice-carriers for a long time.

Via Morgrim's discriminating glare, the manlings of Kislev are befouling sacred Dwarfen ale by mixing it with their distilled potato juice! Such contempt for honest Dwarfs ales tainted by this 'vodka' - they have even dared name it a 'boilermaker' - cannot be tolerated! This is a grudge of the highest order, let us show these manlings how Dawi feel about this... violation!

Seen by Valaya's angry eyes, the Bretonnians have slain many thaggoraki in their fell nest to save a clutch of maidens, both umgi and Dawi. But it turns out that the kruti Knights, while gladly escorting the damsels back to safety, left the fair Dwarf maids to fend for themselves with sorry excuses about there not being enough room on the backs of their nags. An outrage and one that must be paid for with these Knights' blood.

Beheld in Grimnir's seething sight, Bugman's Brewery was once the greatest of all brewhouses, where the fabled Bugman's XXXXXX was created – a few casks of which still exist. But it all ended when the grobi fell upon the fortified brewery, enslaving and killing the Bugman Clan, and – worst of all – drinking the ale! Such an atrocity is a grudge that can never be truly settled. Go and slay Greenskins to salve this open wound!

As witnessed by a vengeful Grimnir, the Orcs have taken great delight in reminding us of their 'claim' on the Dragonback Mountains, of how they have defiled Ekrund and stolen its wealth. Enough! Even if we lack the stout hearts to take it back, we can spike their grog. Let us give them a taste of Dwarf medicine!

Under Morgrim's disappointed glare, did the Dwarfs of Karak Ziflin steal away a cook bound for the kitchens of Karaz-a-Karak! The secret of his nutty fig pudding recipe was the reason - a spiteful move to deprive the High King of one of his favourites in petty retribution for a difficult Reckoner's inspection. A grudge has been recorded and there will be no negotiations with Ziflin until they give up the Halfling!

Witnessed by a concerned Valaya, the Karaz Ankor's ambassador to Nuln has returned with his beard shaved off! Apparently, the Countess Emmanuelle didn't take kindly to the Dawi's chance remark about the accuracy of the pupils at the Imperial Gunnery school! This is an affront to all Dwarfs - Nuln must pay!

By Grungni's indignant glare, the Imperial School of Engineers in the umgi city of Altdorf has claimed technical superiority over our kin! Such an offensive boast cannot go unchallenged, Dwarfen supremacy must be retained at all costs! Show the foolish manlings and their umgak machinery Dwarfen supremacy!

In the stern eyes of Valaya did the Elector Count of Ostermark commission skilled Dwarf Engineers to raise a mighty fortress and then short-change the Dawi by two pennies. An outrage! Ransack Ostermark to recover the cost!
Khorne cares not from whence the blood flows - kill him!
This bearded mortal is a threat to our plans. Send the oath-shackled fool to an early grave and take his soul for good measure!
One of Sigmar's little thralls challenges us. Ensure his death.
The Chaos Gods have deemed this foe our enemy, he should be devoured by you and you alone!
The Chaos Gods have deemed this foe our enemy, she should be devoured by you and your alone!
The Greenskins are nothing more than noisome beasts, and now one of their number acts against us. Kill it.
The feeble-minded creatures - enslaved to the weak-magic of Nagash - seek to steal our power in a vain attempt to become the fifth throne of Chaos. Destroy him.
The feeble-minded creatures - enslaved to the weak-magic of Nagash - seek to steal our power in a vain attempt to become the fifth throne of Chaos. Destroy her.
You are the one the Dark Gods favour as the Champion of Champions. Archaon's host is close, hunt down and kill the pretender!
The High King's throng is close - if you take Grudgebearer's head the whole Dwarf Race will bear an eternal grudge - a glorious act indeed!
The weakling southerners see Karl Franz as their saviour, let us disabuse them of that notion by killing this Emperor and taking his head for the glory of Chaos!
The enemy of Chaos is near! Hunt down his army and take his head before his troops. Their sorrow will be drank by Slaanesh!
The Orc known as Grimgor Ironhide, although an agent of destruction, plays no part in our masters' plans. His army is close, go and slay the beast.
That foolish grave-scum, Mannfred, like Nagash and Vlad before him, thinks he is better than the Gods of Chaos. He marches nearby - destroy him and watch his host crumble.
Our rival of the Gods' favour leads his followers through nearby lands. Pursue this pretender and destroy him - let the Ruinous Powers know there is only one true champion!
The Dwarfs march from their mountain holes close to us. They are led by their insufferable Lord. His soul would make a fine trophy for the Chaos Gods, go and claim it!
The crippled nation of the Emperor sends out his subjects to play war nearby. Let us show them this is no game - take their general's head as a prize!
The enemy is close by, we cannot dishonour Khorne by ignoring battle. Hunt down the foe and slay the enemy leader in the Blood God's name!
The Greenskin mobs are close, it would be a trifling matter to hunt down this filthy tribe and take their Boss' head for the Dark Powers.
An Undead host arises close to us, led by a Vampire. They think anchoring their souls to immortal remains keeps them from our masters' grasp. Prove that notion wrong - slay the corpse-lord!
This enemy army of Chaos shall fall before the might of our warriors. Smash them!
A Dwarf Throng comes. Slaughter them all!
So from the south of milk and honey come the weaklings of the Empire. Ravage them.
An army approaches, eager for battle. BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD!
The Orcs come blundering forward desperate for battle, it is Khorne's wish we give it to them!
The meek-willed champion of a rival aspirant tramples across our lands making sacrifices to the Gods in a vain attempt to mock our legions. Avenge us!
The short flesh-bags of prideful hot air - the Dwarfs - dare to trespass on lands claimed by the Ruinous Powers. Destroy them!
Franz dares to send his forces north. He thinks his crippled god as powerful as our Dark Masters. Prove yourself to Chaos, find these so-called invaders and obliterate them!
Our enemies invade! They dare to fetter lands claimed by the Dark Gods, they must be punished!
An Orc rabble has invaded. Show these filth who should be invading who!
The Undead trespass on our lands. They think to spread the taint of Nagash against the northlands - show them the wrath of the true gods!
The Undead seek battle. In the Dark Gods names, tread them into dust!
The Dwarfen mountain realms are ready for ravaging - begin the harvest!
The lands of Sigmar are ripe for pillage and plunder. Time to raid!
Mortal concerns hold little interest for the Chaos Gods, yet the tribes put great stock in raiding, so we must reward them. Raid this enemy, make them pay!
The Greenskin lands generally offer little of value to the Chaos Gods, yet this region may hold some riches for our Dark Masters.
The Vampires, squirrel away their arcane treasures for their own selfish ends. They do not realise the power the hoard - get it back for the Ruinous Powers!
It is time to gather the tribes. We invade the soft, sweet mortal lands - their souls are ours to take! Raise an army for Chaos!
This Dwarfen settlement is condemned by the Dark Gods. Reap what you can from it; if you see fit, put it to the torch as well!
A mortal settlement ripe for raiding. Take its value and then send it to the many hells with fire!
This settlement offends our masters. Steal what you can and then bring fire to all.
These hovels belong to the Greenskins, see them destroyed in our masters' honour but only after we have taken anything of worth!
The Spawn of Nagash continue to eek out an existence in these broken castles, contrary to our Gods' demands. Take everything and leave the grave scum with nothing!
Champions of Chaos that swear fealty are useful servants - powerful and domineering… and should things go awry, we can blame them in lieu of the Chaos Gods' wrath!
Chaos is magic. Magic is Chaos. None can wield its incarnadine power like the Sorcerers of Chaos. We will be stronger with one in our service.
The Hellcannon is a Daemon-forged monstrosity. Part artillery, part Daemon - it should be brought to battle for the glory of Chaos!
The cavalry of Chaos makes the Grail-drivelling fools of Bretonnia look like children on ponies! Bring the Horsemen and the Knights of Chaos - make the ground quake as they charge!
Reap their souls, and cover thyself in gore. Khorne will reward those who fight up close, where the blood flows strongest!
While such methods are shunned by the Skull Throne, there is use in some limited missile attacks.
The creatures of the Chaos Wastes are blessings from the Dark Gods, we should use their mortal children and bring ruin to the enemy!
Our hordes lack significant numbers of chariots. We should forge these Daemon-machines and unleash them on the enemy as quickly as possible.
A vile champion of the Ruinous Powers challenges us directly. He is a threat to our nation and must be vanquished before his lies and taint spread further. By Sigmar, smite him!

A Dwarf agitator causes us trouble - we must silence him! It is a task that risks offending the High King, but we cannot be paralysed by fear of offending the Dwarfs, for they take on grudges far too easily.
The Electors send their men abroad to rabble-rouse and damage our cause. Find this so-called 'hero' and slay him. Let the rivals of the Emperor know that Franz can play this secret war too.
This enemy malefactor is a threat. By the comet, slay him!
This enemy malefactor is a threat. By the comet, slay her!
The Orcs send out their malefactors to disrupt our plans. Find the sorry Greenskin and slay him in Sigmar's name!
An Undead minion is abroad defiling Sigmar's lands with his foul stench and fouler actions. Send this creature back to the grave!
An Undead minion is abroad defiling Sigmar's lands with her foul stench and fouler actions. Send this creature back to the grave!
If the Elector Counts refuse to parley then we must take the lands in the Emperor's name through force of arms!
To ensure the security and prosperity of Sigmar's realm we must expand its borders. Begin the conquest!
The Vampire Counts have always arrogantly believed the lands they hold dominion over are theirs, but they are and have always been within the Emperor's borders.
Our ancient allies have failed us. Let the Dwarfs know that their time has come, now is the Age of Karl Franz - the reckoning will ours! Declare war!
Mine Emperor has tried Shallya's dove but now is the time of Ulric's Wolf! It is war within the Empire!
Too long have we suffered these Greenskins to live. The time has come to march to war!
Too long have we suffered the Vampire menace to fester in Sylvania! We must purge the land of the Undead and return it to Sigmar's care. Declare war on these abominations!
We have been asked a boon by our potential allies - to wreak havoc upon their enemy by assassinating one of their men. If we do this, we increase our chances of ruling all our fellow men!

Our countrymen have requested that we weaken their enemy's position by seizing one of their regions. The men will bow to the Emperor if we succeed. Do this and increase our chances of bringing them entirely under our rule.
Our countrymen are in peril - they have requested that we defeat their enemy in battle. If we are victorious they will have no choice but to bow before the throne!
If we strike a blow against the enemy of our potential allies in battle, they will be more open to our requests. Do this - break the allies' foe and they will see the Emperor as a force for good!

We have been asked by potential allies to sabotage their enemy's war efforts by raiding their supplies. A grim task but if completed it will increase our chances of bringing them entirely under our rule.
Our fellow men have requested that we wreak havoc upon their enemy by ransacking the foe's lands. They may abide by the Emperor if we enact this dark mission.
Archaon leads his Swords of Chaos, corrupting the lands nearby - now is the time to answer the challenge and depose of the Dark Gods' champion once and for all!
The Ancient Alliance must die with the Dwarf High King. Grudgebearer is close - take his head, it is a heavy price but the Dwarf debt of blood is now too great.
To destroy this rebellion against the throne decisive action is needed. Kill this Faction Leader in battle and the men should turn back to their rightful ruler.
The foe is close, leading his dogs across lands. Bring him to battle and strike him down. Take the serpent's head and watch the body writhe!
Grimgor Ironhide is close! If we kill that mongrel dog in battle then his so-called Waaagh! will collapse as fast as his corpse. Break the beast and watch his support wither!

There are few ways to slay a Vampire, but decapitation works even on an Undead Lord as powerful as Mannfred. The Count is close, seek him out in battle - destroy him and witness his hordes literally crumble.
The Chaos Gods send powerful servants against us. Some will tell you glory awaits in slaying such a Chaos Lord, but that is false. There is no glory in this act, just survival…
This Dwarf Lord comes down from his mountains and dares to challenge us. Kill the little oaf and take his beard as a trophy!
A Noble of the Empire of some considerable rank and support, has decried the rule of Franz. He is a traitor and cannot be allowed to live or others will sense weakness.
This enemy Lord is powerful indeed. Think of the glory to be gained in killing him in battle!
A Greenskin Warboss, one chosen by his foul gods is a threat to our people. We must slay the brute before his power grows even stronger.
A Vampire Count has arisen, one that could challenge even Mannfred - but for now the creature is a threat to the Empire. It must be slain in Sigmar's holy name.
The forces of Chaos come to destroy us. Engage the dread army - For Franz, for Sigmar!
A Dwarf throng readies itself to battle us. We should not disappoint the bearded fools. Show the stunted folk what men of Sigmar can do - engage!
It is to be battle, such a waste in a world with so many other enemies. Yet Sigmar has ever-been the Warrior-God, so we must not disappoint him now - to arms!
There is only war. Engage the enemy army; bring them to battle!
An Orc mob gathers. We must stop it before they ravage the land. Bring the green filth to battle!
A Chaos horde raids across our lands. It must be stopped.
The Dwarfs stomp around our lands without our leave. Such defilement cannot be ignored!
An army of a rival Elector blatantly marches through our lands unsettling the smallfolk; it is time to put a stop to this.
This enemy force is stomping around our lands. Let us show them that Sigmar's justice is swift!
Orcs and Goblins raid the provinces, despoiling and befouling as they go. By the Jade Griffon, we cannot tolerate this!
An Undead host shambles around our lands. Hunt down and destroy the Corpse-spawn!
The puppet-master of an Undead horde seeks battle. By Morr's will we must oblige them. Send this grave filth back to the crypts!
The race of men know many enemies. By allying with our kin, we may stand a better chance at survival against dark forces of destruction.

The greed of the Dwarfs is legendary, taking valuables and jealously hoarding them under the ground. This region is said to contain some lost Dwarfen vaults, send forth dungeoneers to search for them!
This region of the Empire has been forsaken by Sigmar, so says Volkmar the Grim. It is ripe for plunder.
This region is ripe for plunder. Send forth forces to reap their lands!
This region, held by the Orcs, may turn up valuables and plunder missed by the Greenskins whose interests lie in violence rather than riches.
This Undead realm hides many great secrets and relics of value - items of gold and other baubles that no longer interest immortals. Send forth forces to scour the lands.
As the Empire grows, so too does the need to raise additional forces to protect our borders and expand further. We should raise an army.
This Dwarfen settlement is an affront to Sigmar! Reap what you can from it; if you see fit, put it to the torch as well!
This settlement is home to the enemies of the Emperor. Take anything of value and then put it to the torch!
This settlement is a blight on the world. Cleanse it in holy fire after you have taken anything of value.
These vile Orc hovels are an affront to Sigmar! See if there is anything worth taking and then purge it in flame, should you so wish.
This Vampire nest is an unholy blight on the world. Send in the Witch Hunters so they may confiscate the abominable relics and then put the foul place to the torch!
A Captain of the Empire - a warrior from the noble classes - will be able to bring discipline and martial prowess to our forces. We should recruit one at the first opportunity!
A Warrior Priest is needed in our force to embolden the men and bring his righteous might to the many battles we will have to fight.
An agent of the Order of the Silver Hammer - more commonly known as Witch Hunter - is needed. His unique skills will give us a clear advantage in the battles to come.
Not since before Magnus as the Empire been without enchanters to protect and serve our nation's interests. We should recruit an adept - a Battle Wizard - from the Colleges of Magic.
The Dwarfs can try, but no one under Sigmar's sun can match the range and accuracy of the Imperial Gunners. Bring the artillery to bear; let it speak for itself!
We care not what the Bretonnians claim, it is the Empire that is blessed with the best cavalry in the Old World! We should recruit such regiments now.

The highly-trained State Troops cannot be beaten by savages or even the axe-obsessed Dwarfs. Individually, they may not the greatest of fighters, but as regiments, the Empire has the best troops. Start recruiting!
The missile troops of the Empire are like no other, armed with black powder or more traditional crossbow weapons. We should bring some into our armies.
The menageries of the Empire contain many fantastical beasts that brave - or foolish - riders can guide into battle. Now is the time to see such magnificent creatures!
Empire war machines have long since surpassed those of the Dwarfs that are moribund in pointless traditionalism. The Empire innovates! Bring these machines of war to the battlefield.
A servant of the Dark Powers could be a threat to your growing power, grab your choppa and bring this metal-clad fool down.
If the Dwarfs love their dead ancestors so much, send them to meet their rotting kin! There is one of the bearded-gits mocking you - make him the first to die!
One of the Empire's agents could be a thorn in our side. Stomp on him good.
We need to kill this foe, or he'll become a threat to your dominance.
We need to kill this foe, or she'll become a threat to your dominance.
Another Greenskin dares to challenge us! End him.
An agent of the Undead stalks you. Best to seek him out and rip off the wretch's head - let us see if he can rise back up then!
An agent of the Undead stalks you. Best to seek her out and rip off the wretch's head - let us see if she can rise back up then!
It is time to expand your realms, Mork demands it! Take another region off the stunties, make them scrawl another wrong in their petty little book!
This stronghold is dominated by a rival Warboss, take it from him! Let the other wretches know the power of the boyz!
Your ancient enemies think to bring back their petty empire. Declare war! Show them their age is done - now is the time of the Orc!
The time of men is over, begin the Waaagh! Ravage the lands, Mork demands that the green tide rises - declare war!
Not all the boyz want to be dominated. The fools! Teach them the error of their ways, make them pay for defying us! Declare war!
Time for the Vampires and their shambling hordes to feel the might of the Greenskins. Declare war!
Boyz from another tribe have asked for a 'favour'. If you slay the git bothering them, then they may well swear allegiance.
The Greenskins of another tribe have begged us to take their enemy's territory, swearing fealty if we succeed.
Our potential allies have a task for us, if we can bring down their enemy's champion in battle then they may be inclined to Waaagh! with us. It's a good deal!
Some boyz want us to fight their enemy. Do this and we will increase our chances of bringing them entirely under our rule.

A rival tribe and potential ally have asked your boyz to go raiding on enemy lands. The spoils will be ours, of course, and it will be seen favourably by these boyz - allowing us to dominate them soon!
Your Greenskin mates have requested that we wreak havoc upon their enemy by ransacking their lands. Do this and we will increase our chances of bringing these boyz entirely under our domination!
This Archaon proclaims himself the ultimate destroyer, that is our savage Lord's role! Hunt down this spiky-clad pretender and his pitiful army - destroy them all!
The Dwarf Boss - king of the stunties - is close. Go and find his mates, kill them and take the Dwarf's crown. That will be something to write in their precious book alright!
The Emperor is close. He leads his personal army out - a foolish move that our Boss should take advantage of. Kill Karl Franz in battle and watch the humie scum quail!
The enemy is leading his army through nearby lands. Kill him - take his head for the boss pole and we will strike a terrible blow against our foes!
Grimgor challenges us, and he is close. Bring this pretender to his knees and then knock out his teef, and take his boyz!
The Blood Sucking corpse known as Mannfred is near. He leads an army of bones within brawling distance. Bring the cadaver to battle and kill him - again!
The Dark Gods send their champion forth and he is powerful indeed. His head on your boss pole would bring more boyz to our banner. Go and slay the Chaos Lord - take his glory for your own!
One of the Stunty gits has gotten too big for his beard. Find this 'Lord' and bring him down. Make the git even shorter by a head than he is now…
An Empire noble is on the rise, some even call him 'Orc-Slayer'. Best to find this git and show him what a 'humie slayer' can do.
An enemy Lord grows in power. A choppa to the face will cut him down to size!
A rival Warboss has been causing trouble amongst the tribes. See that he doesn't cause anymore!
The Undead stalk the lands and a Vampire Lord rises in power; that could threaten us. Seek out the corpse-creature and take a choppa to its neck!
The Chaos army shall fall before the might of our boyz. Smash the spiky metal gits!
The Dwarfs send a throng against us. Seek them out and fight!
The Empire seeks out our mobs and readies for battle, it would be un-Orcy to shun such a scrap!
The foe comes - an army calling us out. For Mork's sake, engage the army - bring these gits to battle!
Orcs come! These Greenskins are our enemies - it is time to fight!
The Chaos filth roam across lands proclaimed by Gork and Mork, kick them out!
The Dwarfs invade tribal lands. How dare they! Get rid of the stunties!
Karl Franz sends his men to take Greenskin lands from our tribes. It's time to fight!
The enemy raid our lands. They raid OUR lands! Find these gits and get them good!
A rival tribe roves through our region, raiding and plundering. Find the invaders and make them pay.
An Undead army shambles through our lands, taking stuff - get them!
This Undead host stands ready for battle. Be it Blood Sucka or Necromancer, we must teach these corpses a lesson - not to mess with living, breathing Orcs!
There are many gits to crush. Make an alliance with fellow Greenskins and you can destroy the other races together.
Stealing from the Dwarfs really winds them up! Let's loot their lands and really get their beards in a twist.
This Imperial region is ripe for plunder. Send in the scavengers and pick it clean!
This region is ripe for plunder. Send forth forces to reap their lands - Gork demands it!
This land is yet to become green - loot it and take anything shiny!
Raid the Vampire lands, knock over a few graves and steal from the tombs. That is the Greenskin way.
As the Waaagh! grows additional boyz can be summoned. Send out the call, bring fresh mobs to our totem.
This stunty barrow needs smashing! Take any shiny stuff and then burn it!
This settlement of man must be destroyed - Mork commands it! Reap what you can and then bring fire!
This settlement must be broken as if by Gork's Fists. Put it to the torch but only after you have taken all its valuables for the Boss' shiny pile.
This Greenskin encampment should be ransacked and burnt in Gork's (or Mork's) name. Do it!
The Vampires have their filthy nests everywhere. This one should be raided; steal all the shiny stuff and then - if you want, and you probably do - burn it to the ground!
You need a Goblin to talk to other Goblins. Well, whether that true or not, recruiting a Goblin Big Boss is a good idea!
A Shaman is needed to give your mobs a bit of arcane poke. Recruit one - Goblin or Orc it doesn't matter… yet.
A Greenskin barrage is about throwing lots of big rocks at the same time. Crude but effective. Let's organise it.
Greenskin cavalry can be fast and brutal. We should get some mobs of cavalry in, they will make your armies more powerful.
More boyz means more choppas. That’s a good thing… Get some more!
It doesn't always have to be about getting up close with your choppas. Hitting the gits from afar can work well too. We should recruit some missile mobs.
The monstrous pets of the Greenskins will terrify and munch through any army, Get some!
Greenskin war machines are the best - maybe - I recommend starting construction!
This mortal vessel reveres the Dark Gods, he is a pawn of our enemies and a risk to our own plans. Kill him.
One of Grudgebearer's peons is a threat. Send him to an early grave so the stunted fool may be risen to serve us.
A dog of Franz comes lolloping into our sights. It is loyal to its master and believes it can do you harm. Put the mongrel out of its misery!
This agent of the foe is hostile to our goals. Sever his head from his shoulders, and the threat will go away.
This agent of the foe is hostile to our goals. Sever her head from her shoulders, and the threat will go away.
The Greenskins send their brutes to frustrate and annoy our plans. Obliterate it, like you would any pest!
Another practitioner of Dark Magic seeks to unseat us. Send this amateur's pet back in a coffin!
Another practitioner of Dark Magic seeks to unseat us. Send this amateur's pet back in a coffin!
This settlement of mortals should belong to us. We care not for Morr's tenets - conquer it at the first opportunity!
The Undead require this settlement. Send forth our legions to take it.
These lands are ours by rights older than Sigmar himself! Claim them in the von Carstein name.
It is Hel Fenn all over again! This time the Vampire Counts will be victorious - declare war on the Dwarfs!
We have warred with the mortal usurpers of the Empire many times before; now we will teach them a final lesson!
Too long have we suffered these Greenskins to live. The time has come to march to war, wipe these base creatures off the map!
For too long have we suffered these thralls to parasitically exist on our triumphs. No longer! Destroy these pretenders, there is only one von Carstein!

Our brethren have requested that we dispose of their enemy's greatest warrior, and will swear fealty if we succeed. Do this and we will increase our chances of bringing all Vampire Counts entirely under our will.
Another of our bloodline has requested that we weaken a mortal's position by seizing the enemy region. Should we do this, our sibling will swear fealty, or so they say.
Our kin request that we strike a blow to their enemy by slaying their greatest mortal fighter in battle. Do this and they will be more susceptible to our dominion!
Another count has approached us; we must engage an enemy force to plague them. If we do this, then we can manipulate them into our service.
Another Count has approached us; we must engage an enemy force that plagues them. If we do this, then we can manipulate them into our fealty.
Your brothers in death have requested that we sabotage their enemy's war efforts by raiding their supplies. Should we do this, they will owe us!

Our Undead brethren ask that we wreak havoc upon their foe by ransacking their lands. Bring the blight to this mortal enemy and our brothers may side with us, allowing the Midnight Aristocracy to ascend!
Does the Ruinous Power's chosen pet, think to threaten us? What does he know of immortality? He and his armies are close, find and kill this pretender.
The Dwarfs have always been threat. Now their High King marches close with his stunted throng. Hunt down their sovereign and slay him.
The false Emperor is close! Karl Franz is near, accompanied by his cattle. Let us find him and slay the fool, leaving the throne for us!
An enemy is so close, you can taste it! Hunt down this fool and his entourage - show him the power of the Undead!
The beast, Ironhide, is close. Hunt down this Orc's army, meet the creature in battle and bring its end.
He challenges us. But there is only one, count… one Lord of the Night… and that is you! Find this pretender for he is close and skulking within his host. End him!
This Chaos Lord holds great power. Nagash would see such a foe and end them - so should we.
A Dwarf Lord challenges us. There is much glory in silencing such challengers.
This Empire Lord grows in power. To kill and rise him up as a zombie servant would be very satisfying indeed.
This enemy Lord is powerful indeed. Think of the glory to be gained in killing him in battle!
A Greenskin Warboss rises in power and could one day even challenge the Midnight Aristocracy! Take the beast's head as a trophy!
Another of Vlad's progeny emerges and thinks to challenge our dominion. Take it's head and show the world who is the one true von Carstein.
Chaos think to take this world - but it's ours to reap! Engage this Chaos army in battle!
A Dwarf army has been lured into our trap. Now finish the job and bring the bearded-scum to battle!
An Empire army comes, engage the mortal fools in combat and think of the corpses that shall refresh our ranks in battle's wake.
This enemy army shall fall before the might of our Undead warriors. Make them dead.
The Greenskin may love war but they are no match for our Undead minions. Bring the Orc-filth to battle and teach them what immortality is!
The Ruinous Powers dare to set foot in lands claimed by von Carstein. Get the invaders, show them a new god - show them death!
The Dwarfs send their stunted kin to our lands in some foolish notion to steal our territory. They are not welcome here - eject the living from our lands!
The Empire claim these lands as their own… They are trespassers! Invaders! See them destroyed!
This enemy force is stomping around our lands. Show them the darkness of the grave!
The Orcs invade our lands. Find them, steal their breath and make them dead!
A rival stalks our lands at the head of an Undead host. We must show him who the true ruler of the night is!
This enemy Vampire army shall fall before the might of our unholy host. Tread them into dust!
This Dwarfen region is ripe for harvesting. Send forth our legions to reap their lands!
This region of the Empire sits stagnant and rotting like an ageing corpse. Sack it and dispose of the remains.
Like a rotting corpse, this region is ripe for plunder. Send forth forces to reap their lands!
This region claimed by the Greenskins is ripe for harvest. Send our legions forth to do this.
This Undead region should be searched, and anything of value brought to us. Send out your forces.
As our eternal empire grows, so too, does the need to raise additional forces to protect our borders and expand further. We should raise an Undead host.
This Dwarfen settlement is a canker on our plans. Destroy it. Steal its secrets and then bathe it in fire and blood.
The mortal settlement of the false Emperor should be no more. Reap what you can from it and then bring fire!
This settlement offends our Undead majesty. Steal anything of value and then burn it to the ground, if you so wish.
The accursed Greenskin blight of a settlement must be purged. Take anything of value and put the rest to fire!
No Vampire has the right to exist - except our Lord - reap this lair. And then destroy it with fire.
Summon a Wight King - this ancient warrior's martial skills will help our damned cause.
A Vampire Count under our dominion is a powerful ally. Just remember, they are as ambitious in their quest for power as us.
The sorrowful wails of a Tomb Banshee are needed, their shrill screams should send enemies fleeing for their pitiful lives. Summon such a harridan.
We need a Necromancer in our legions. A wretched magic-user whose abilities will aid our unbreathing legions. Consider recruiting one soon.
The Cavalry of the Undead is a fearsome spectacle, adding speed to our shambling forces. Add their might to our roster.
Our melee hordes can overwhelm any foe and will never succumb to mortal concerns such as fear. Raise them!
The pets of the Vampire Counts are fearsome Unliving creatures whose only desire is to serve. Read the books and summon them to our cause!
Nagash never took much stock in war machines but he was wrong. Recruit engines of death - make their deadly mechanisms work in service to us!

Beheld by the enraged gaze of Grimnir, the Bloody Spearz have trespassed with impunity all over the sacred mountains. Their forces gather to the east, and must be defeated in battle before their strength is regained.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}
Our enemies gather to strike against us once more. Attack first, and deny them the opportunity to reach full strength.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}
We must defeat the Red Fang in battle before they are able to regain their strength. See that it is done.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}

The Templehof brood must be crushed in battle before they are able to regain their strength. Another victory against Van Kruger's armies will leave his lands ripe for the taking.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_attack_enemy}}
Van Kruger has left Eschen wide open to attack. Strike now, and punish his error.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}
The breakaway city of Grunburg lies relatively undefended. Reclaim it to send a powerful message to all those who doubt your authority.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}
Gorfang refuses to come out from his keep at Iron Rock. Take the fight to him and drive him from his fortress.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}

Observed with disdain by Grungni and all his kin, the Bloody Spearz maintain an encampment at the Pillars from which they raid the surrounding valleys. These vermin have long outstayed their welcome in these sacred mountains. March against them, and drive them from these lands that are rightfully Dwarfen.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_capture_settlement}}
Your realm abounds with patriotic men of learning. Provide the facilities, and their studies may be turned to matters of war.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_research_technology}}
Construct a Tinkerer Bench, so that the crafty Goblins that serve your cause may come up with new inventions to aid your war effort.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_main_narrative_addendum_research_technology}}

The finest minds in Altdorf stand ready to improve your methods of war. Task them with a direction of development and reap the benefits of their research.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_technology_learn_more}}
Your Goblins can be put to work improving your weapons and practises. Set them on a path of development that will advance your methods of war.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_technology_learn_more}}

The king must make his way through the Underway, an area under the dominion of urks and grobi. Be wary of the side passages, for it stinks of an ambush, even if the Everpeak Aircorps is en route to offer support.
So it is, the Empire must fight against its own kind for survival within the bounds of the Empire itself. We must be wary for there are more than traitors lurking in Bloodpine Woods.

Dwarfs travelling along this lost dark road are ripe for an ambush. Don't let the beardy gits form a defensive perimeter. Get 'em in the flanks nice an' early and den smack 'em from behind with da big stuff!

Hel Fenn, a place Mannfred is not fond of for historical reasons. But these mortals pose no such threat! They are few in number and while they have a strong position between two rocks, they can be flanked easily enough. It will not take long for these fools to join our Unliving ranks!
A final challenge to your supremacy has arisen. Overcome this hurdle and your dominance over the world shall be assured!

Dread is the currency used to invoke the Dark Gods to strengthen your tribe via the Rewards of Dread panel. It is acquired by completing missions, razing settlements and winning battles, with more Dread received the more enemy casualties inflicted. Dread can be spent on expanding unit and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero capacities, recruiting [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Legendary Lords, and other upgrades.

Herdstone Shards are the raw materials required to raise Herdstones. Additional Shards are attained when reaching certain [[img:icon_marks_of_ruination]][[/img]]Ruination Levels as you progress through the campaign and can never be lost, only reused. Shards are regained after casting a Ritual of Ruin or if a Herdstone gets destroyed before the ritual is performed.

Momentum dictates how long a Rampage is sustained. As long as Momentum stays above zero, battle victories will continue to accumulate [[img:icon_rampage]][[/img]]Rampage Marks, but if all Momentum is lost a Rampage must restart. Momentum decreases every turn but also when Taurox loses battles, retreats, or when using his [[img:icon_effect_campaign_movement]][[/img]]movement range replenishment ability. Once reaching zero, Momentum can be regained simply by winning a battle.

Rampage Marks are collected as Taurox wins successive battles, repeatedly filling the Rampage bar to periodically offer various rewards. The rate at which the Rampage bar fills depends on the strength of opponents and the number of battles fought in a single turn. To sustain a Rampage, [[img:icon_momentum]][[/img]]Momentum must be kept above zero – once all Momentum is lost due to inactivity or other factors, all Rampage Marks are lost.

Ruination Level is a measure of the warherd’s progress, increasing as Marks of Ruination are collected. Once a Herdstone has been erected, razing settlements in the surrounding Blood-grounds will earn Devastation which in turn can be converted to Marks of Ruination by way of a Ritual of Ruin. The higher the level of razed settlements, the more Marks of Ruination earned for performing the ritual.

[[img:icon_malus_possession]][[/img]]Possession indicates the strength of Tz’arkan’s constantly increasing influence over Malus. It intensifies if Malus transforms into Tz’arkan in battle or if he follows [[img:def_malus_tzarkan_whispers]][[/img]]Tz’arkan’s Whispers, but decreases while he is in a settlement or if he uses the [[img:def_malus_possession_potion]][[/img]]Elixir.

Those unfortunate enough to be taken captive by the Dark Elves know their fate is to be worked to death fulfilling many exhausting and degrading tasks across the Druchii empire!\\n\\n[[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Slaves are gained through fighting battles, capturing and upgrading ports, and by recruiting Black Arks or Assassin heroes.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[img:icon_slaves]] [[/img]][[col:yellow]]They are used to boost the income, control and growth effects of Infrastructure buildings. They can also be spent on instant building construction or to gain bonuses from provincial Diktats and rites.[[/col]]

A rare form of gold ore mined from the deepest caverns yields a material of strange properties coveted by the Runesmiths; a scarce and valuable means to fuel their forgecraft.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_oathgold]][[/img]]Oathgold enables the use of the Forge, where it is spent with other resources to create magic items.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_oathgold]][[/img]]Oathgold is primarily obtained from certain buildings, recycling magic items in the Forge, and missions. Its rate of gain can be increased via skills.[[/col]]

Reconquest of the Deeps beneath the ancient Dwarf Karaks is always a long and costly endeavour and, as such, the High King must approve any efforts to reclaim the deepest areas of these Holds.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_underdeep]][[/img]]High King Decrees enables access to the Deeps via construction of the Great Gate building within settlements.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_underdeep]][[/img]]High King Decrees are primarily obtained from upgrading existing Deeps locations, but can in some cases be gained via technology or Thorgrim's skills.[[/col]]

[[img:emp_imperial_authority]][[/img]]Imperial Authority is a measure of how the other [[img:emp_elector_counts]][[/img]]Elector Counts within the Empire view your faction. Low [[img:emp_imperial_authority]][[/img]]Imperial Authority will not only cause you to lose the confidence of your subjects, but may eventually lead to the other [[img:emp_elector_counts]][[/img]]Elector Counts deciding to oust you.

The greater the number of Imperial lands in Imperial hands, the greater your authority over your faction.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_imperial_authority]][[/img]] Imperial Authority is the measure of how many regions within the Empire are owned by your culture.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_imperial_authority]][[/img]] To benefit from Imperial Authority, secure the borders of the Empire’s home provinces and repel foreign invaders where possible.

An Elector Count’s loyalty to their kith and kin is never as important as their belief in your plans for the greater good of the Empire.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_fealty]][[/img]] Fealty is a measure of how strongly an Elector Count believes in your cause, rising and falling based on your political interactions with them and your actions towards their faction.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_fealty]][[/img]] An Elector Count whose Fealty reaches 10 may be confederated via an Emperor’s Decree, while those whose Fealty reaches 0 will attempt secession.[[/col]]

Political will is of little consequence without the gravitas to exert it.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_prestige]][[/img]] Prestige is the measure of how influential your faction leader is within the political landscape of the Empire. It is used to respond to political events to dictate their outcomes.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:emp_prestige]][[/img]] Prestige can be gained from battles, special events, and from the Elector Counts, whose per-turn Prestige contributions increase with higher Fealty Levels.[[/col]]

[[img:bullet_emp_mandate]][[/img]]Acclaim is a measure of how much progress the expedition makes towards fulfilling the Emperor’s Mandate. Expansion, building or upgrading ports, or unlocking special [[img:bullet_emp_hunters]][[/img]]characters will increase [[img:bullet_emp_mandate]][[/img]]Acclaim and lead to better-quality reinforcements dispatched from home via the [[img:emp_imperial_supply]][[/img]]Imperial Supplies system.

[[img:emp_hostility]][[/img]]Hostility reflects the current level of enemy aggression due to the expedition’s military activities. [[img:emp_imperial_supply]][[/img]]Imperial Supplies are the care packages sent from the Empire to provide various reinforcement types. The higher the [[img:emp_hostility]][[/img]]Hostility level, the more frequently [[img:emp_imperial_supply]][[/img]]Imperial Supplies are dispatched from home.

Necromantic Energy swells within the Land of the Dead. As the life of the land and its people fades, Nagash's power grows.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_necromantic_energy]][[/img]]Necromantic Energy is only usable within the Land of the Dead.\\n\\n[[img:icon_necromantic_energy]][[/img]]Necromantic Energy is primarily gained from fighting battles within the Land of the Dead. Minor settlements and special landmarks will also generate small amounts of passive [[img:icon_necromantic_energy]][[/img]]Necromantic Energy.\\n\\n[[img:icon_necromantic_energy]][[/img]]Necromantic Energy can be spent in many places, primarily: increasing unit capacities, constructing Necropolis settlement buildings, and recruiting units via the Grave Call.[[/col]

Unbeknownst to a province's inhabitants, the sisters of Neferata’s Covens exist and operate in plain sight, advancing the Queen’s ambitions for as long as their infiltration can stay unnoticed.\\n\\n[[img:icon_concealment]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Concealment is a measure of how well a Coven maintains its cover in a province. It is primarily increased by certain Coven buildings, and at higher values will enable a Coven to function more efficiently and provide greater benefits.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[img:icon_concealment]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Concealment can decrease due to certain Coven buildings and with the presence of foreign armies and Heroes in the locality.[[/col]]

The presence of Lahmians is seldom noticed. Yet as they silently operate towards their aims and strengthen their queen’s web, their hand is certainly felt.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_manipulation]][[/img]]Manipulation is a measure of the Lahmian Sisterhood’s capability in manipulating armies, settlements and factions on the campaign map via Web of Power actions.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_manipulation]][[/img]]Manipulation is primarily gained via upgraded Vampire Covens, which can also increase its total capacity.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_manipulation]][[/img]]Manipulation is the primary cost for Web of Power actions, while its capacity dictates the level of actions available, i.e. increasing capacity allows the use of more powerful actions.[[/col]]

Emerald-green pieces of solidified Chaos energy – which all Skaven use for technology, weapons and creature growth. Thanquol has a particular fondness for this powerful and dangerous crystal.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_warpstone]][[/img]]Warpstone is gained by completing Steal-Take Masterplans, missions and certain buildings.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_warpstone]][[/img]] Warsptone is required for performing Masterplans and upgrading your Masterplan Schemes.[[/col]]

For many, death will not be the end, their remains "taken" for one macabre use or another, ultimately fuelling the hordes helmed by the Vampires and Necromancers that terrorise the world.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_vmp_corpses]][[/img]]Corpses are generated for each province’s pool based on the number and quality of units killed in battles fought within the province.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_vmp_corpses]][[/img]]Corpses are used to recruit all lower tier units via the Raise Dead recruitment system, but are also critical in the creation of [[img:icon_vmp_shyish]][[/img]]Blood through converting them in various settlement buildings.[[/col]]

Blood is the aetheric embodiment of death itself, wielded by the Vampire Counts as a source of power to shape the world as they see fit.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_vmp_shyish]][[/img]]Blood is created by converting Corpses within provinces via various buildings within settlements.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_vmp_shyish]][[/img]]Blood is used to recruit all high tier units via the Raise Dead recruitment system, but is used in many other places including Vampire Lairs, technology, buildings and more.[[/col]]
Maximum number of {{tr:ui_text_replacements_localised_text_wh3_dlc29_blessings_of_nurgle_marks_of_nurgle_title}} you can assign simultaneously
Harmony is the balance of [[img:icon_yin]][[/img]]Yin and [[img:icon_yang]][[/img]]Yang across your faction. Characters, buildings and technologies will all affect the balance.
Khorne, the Blood God, rages upon his brass throne, resting atop a mountain of skulls.
Nurgle, also known as the Plague Lord, is the Chaos God of disease, decay, death and degradation.
Slaanesh is dedicated to the pursuit of excess, gratification, hedonism, pain and amoral pleasure at the expense of any other soul.
Tzeentch – the Changer of the Ways – is the Chaos God of magic, evolution, manipulation and trickery.
When the Dark Gods join as one, then all must suffer for the manifest glory of Chaos Undivided.

Khorne cares not from where the Skulls are reaped – as long as it is done in His name!\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_skulls]][[/img]] Skulls can be collected by killing enemy units in battle or from Skull Piles dropped by other factions in corrupted provinces, amongst other sources.[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_skulls]][[/img]] Skulls are consumed by actions such as occupying settlements, technology research, offerings to the Skull Throne and summoning Blood Hosts.

Defending Kislev against the forces of Chaos will produce [[img:icon_devotion]][[/img]]devotion, along with pious buildings. Consume your [[img:icon_devotion]][[/img]]devotion by invoking the Motherland, which will bolster your territory and allow the gain of [[img:icon_supporters]][[/img]]supporters.
Using Invocations of the Motherland allows Kislev to sway its population into becoming supporters of its cause.

{{tr:wh3_main_ksl_court_pooled_resource_description}}\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Boons are the means to acquire powerful rewards from the Ice Court.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Acquire Ice Court Boons by raising your Support with the Ice Court.

{{tr:wh3_main_ksl_orthodoxy_pooled_resource_description}}\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Boons are the means to acquire powerful rewards from the Great Orthodoxy.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Acquire Orthodoxy Boons by raising your Support with the Great Orthodoxy.

[[img:ksl_support_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Garner Support from the Ice Court to fill the bar and increase your Tier with them, granting their Boons and potential rewards.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Should the Ice Court’s Tier exceed the Orthodoxy’s by more than the permitted amount, penalties will be suffered.

[[img:ksl_support_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Garner Support from the Great Orthodoxy to fill the bar and increase your Tier with them, granting their Boons and potential rewards.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Should the Great Orthodoxy’s Tier exceed the Ice Court’s by more than the permitted amount, penalties will be suffered.

{{tr:wh3_main_ksl_court_pooled_resource_description}}\\n\\n[[img:ksl_support_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Ice Court Support represents your growing political capital, favours and resources tied to the Ice Court.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_support_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Ice Court Support is raised by constructing their aligned buildings, fielding their associated characters and dedicating your Atamans, which will increase your Tier with them.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_ice_court]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Ice Court Boons are gained every time you increase Tier with the Ice Court and are used to claim their powerful rewards.

{{tr:wh3_main_ksl_orthodoxy_pooled_resource_description}}\\n\\n[[img:ksl_support_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Orthodoxy Support represents your growing political capital, favours and resources tied to the Great Orthodoxy.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_support_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Orthodoxy Support is raised by constructing their aligned buildings, fielding their associated characters and dedicating your Atamans, which will increase your Tier with them.\\n\\n[[img:ksl_boons_orthodoxy]][[/img]] [[col:yellow]]Orthodoxy Boons are gained every time you increase Tier with the Great Orthodoxy and are used to claim their powerful rewards.

Interpretation of the Sacred Plaques allows the Lizardmen to prophesise the coming of their Sacred Spawnings, ensuring they are plenty prepared to receive their new charges with ceremony before they go off to fulfil their intended purpose. \\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Spawning Sequences are gained primarily through the completion of missions and can be used to recruit special ’blessed’ variants of existing units that are empowered with unique benefits[[/col]].

Hoarding and consuming Meat is not just a religious matter for Ogres – for to eat a thing is to show your superiority over it – but also a means to expand tribal power.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_ogr_meat]][[/img]] Meat is gathered from winning battles, sacking, razing and raiding, as well as other sources.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_ogr_meat]][[/img]] Each army’s Meat supply is consumed every turn as upkeep and can be used as Offers to the Maw, as well as being crucial to Camp construction.

Amass your [[img:icon_devotees]][[/img]]devotees by raiding, looting and sacking settlements. The higher the [[img:icon_public_order]][[/img]]control and {{tr:icon_income}}income, the more [[img:icon_devotees]][[/img]]devotees will join your cause. Consume them by establishing [[img:icon_cult]][[/img]]cults, forcefully [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassalising other factions, and summoning [[img:icon_disciple_army]][[/img]]disciple armies.

A faction's [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]seductive influence increases when contact is made with a Slaaneshi faction via diplomacy or battle, or via [[img:icon_cult]][[/img]]cults, the [[img:icon_gift_of_slaanesh]][[/img]]Gift of Slaanesh and high [[img:icon_corruption_sla]][[/img]]Slaanesh corruption. Factions with high [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]seductive influence are more manipulatable, and can eventually be forced into [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassalage.\\n\\nOnly Human, Elven and Beastmen factions are vulnerable to [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]seductive influence.

With every sliver of Tzeentch’s power revealed, the entire world becomes yours to manipulate.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_grimoires]][[/img]] Grimoires are primarily generated from buildings and fighting battles.[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_grimoires]][[/img]] Grimoires are used for Changing of the Ways actions and technologies.[[/col]]

Use the Winds of Magic to cast spells in battle. Increase the power reserve by moving through provinces with high winds, or via certain stances.\\n\\nThe Winds of Magic Reserve can never go below a certain amount.\\n\\nDaemon factions suffer penalties when at low Winds of Magic, and receive bonuses when it is high.

Yvresse’s Defence Level dictates the reach of the [[img:mist_of_yvresse]][[/img]]Mists of Yvresse which cause [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]]attrition to invaders and bolsters your forces. Each level can be reached by accumulating [[img:yvresse_defence_level_increase]][[/img]]Ladrielle’s Blessings from Athel Tamarha upgrades and expanding Tor Yvresse, in turn spreading the Mists further across Ulthuan.
Skulls sent to the Skull Throne
Shooting many smaller projectiles instead of one large one is more effective when fighting multiple small targets, such as infantry units.
Shooting a single, large projectile instead of many smaller ones is more effective when fighting larger single targets, such as monsters.
The Deathshrieker Rocket is made up of multiple packed warheads, which detonate in the air above the battlefield in a storm of fire and plunge multiple tendrils of flame downwards from the blast.
Demolition Rockets use densely packed explosive warheads with delayed fuses in a strengthened iron tube to channel the blast against a single point.
A single, large piece of ordnance, designed to maim and kill, en masse, on contact.
Due to this projectile's fiendish design, whichever direction you choose to run is the wrong one!
Made using secret techniques, these shells strike with a crack and rumble that mirrors Tor's mighty lightning, shattering clustered foes.
Bolts of blessed light melt through armour to sear the flesh beneath.
Once loosed, these arrows splinter into scores of poisonous thorns that seek the flesh of Athel Loren’s enemies.
Engineers have refined both rifle and shot to guarantee the highest possible propulsion and penetration.
The gunpowder used in these shots is so volatile that it often explodes before reaching the target. Get as close as you can before firing, but not *too* close!
Surrounded by stained workbenches scattered with crude components, electronics, and bits of salvage, the Warlock Engineers of Skryre design and manufacture death.
The improved tools found here facilitate more complex crafting, easing the process of constructing weaponry to satisfy destructive tendencies.
A redesign of the entire laboratory layout has resulted in a facility where the boundless potential of Warpstone can be realised to its fullest extent.
This is where the greatest brains of all Skavendom devise the world's most heinous contraptions, making them into horrific realities on the grandest scale.

Against the tide of non-believers, Sotek’s red-crested faithful shall emerge as his champions to go forth and make disciples of all the Old Ones’ children, beseeching them in the name of the Serpent-God.
At the time of the three hundredth cycle of this world, the two moons shall unite and summon forth the Rodent-God and his evil spawn to deliver plague and pestilence upon the land named Lustria.
Behold Sotek, a serpent of such unimaginable size and appetite that he shall swallow the Rat-God himself and spend a thousand years digesting him, crushing him within his coils!
