With a [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero selected, right-click a controlled [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] to embed it. Outside of fighting battles, [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes will perform some useful function such as scouting or training the troops when they join an [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]].
Candidates may be sent to the Ice Court for training on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_ice_court_panel]]Ice Court panel[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing as a Kislevite [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
Learn more about the Ice Court [[url:script_link_campaign_ice_court]]here[[/url]].
Learn more about the Imperial Gunnery School [[url:script_link_campaign_imperial_gunnery_school]]here[[/url]].
Learn more about the Ivory Road [[url:script_link_campaign_ivory_road]]here[[/url]].
As a Troll King, Throgg can grow a Troll Kingdom and summon Troll, Monster and Beast units to temporarily support him in battle.
Enchanted weapons, armour, and talismans can be collected through the course of a [[sl:campaign_campaign_game]]campaign[[/sl]].
Items may be viewed, equipped and fused on the [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]].

Each [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] maintains a central {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury. The current {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl_tooltip:campaign_treasury]]treasury value[[/sl_tooltip]] and overall {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income[[/sl]] per [[sl:campaign_turns]]turn[[/sl]] are shown at the top of the screen on the campaign interface.

[[sl:campaign_chaos]]Chaos[[/sl]] [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] use {{tr:icon_money}}Favour as currency. The available {{tr:icon_treasury}}Favour and overall {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income per-turn[[/sl]] are shown at the top of the screen on the campaign interface.

[[sl:campaign_vampires]]Vampire[[/sl]] [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] use {{tr:icon_money}}Dark Magic as currency. The available {{tr:icon_treasury}}Dark Magic and overall {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income per-turn[[/sl]] are shown at the top of the screen on the campaign interface.
Invocations, while active, grant each Kislev faction the opportunity to gain [[img:icon_supporters]][[/img]][[sl_tooltip:campaign_supporters_track]]Supporters[[/sl_tooltip]].
Learn more about Invocations of the Motherland [[url:script_link_campaign_motherland]]here[[/url]].
Nehekharan Decrees can be issued in a province in exchange for[[img:icon_jars]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_canopic_jars]]Canopic Jars[[/sl]] to empower, defend or enrich the faction.

You start with one active Manipulation in each category and unlock higher tier manipulations via “Dark Ritual” progression.\\n\\nYour Manipulations will increase your “Attention of the Gods”, which will trigger different undesirable events.

Insert even longer desc about = Marauding actions are performed as an initiative over a province. They can cost control or spoils to be performed and grant the province and/or the faction effects for a duration. They represent how the settled part of the norsca culture can develop with the spoils it accumulated from war.

You can increase your Troll King’s Dominion level by constructing specific Troll Kingdom buildings in your settlements.\\n\\nEach level of the Troll King’s Dominion provides increasingly more powerful benefits and allows you to use the “Call the Monstrous Horde!” ability.\\n\\n”Call the Monstrous Horde!” allows you to reinforce a targeted lord with a temporary support army, consisting of Trolls, Monsters and Beasts. The strength, numbers, cost and cooldown of this ability all increase as your Troll King’s Dominion level rises. At it’s last level you will be able to temporarily reinforce all your lords.\\n\\nConstructing Troll Kingdom buildings and activating the “Call the Monstrous Horde!” ability costs “Trollkind” – a resource that you can mainly gather by fielding trolls and specific monster units in your armies, as well as from certain buildings and completing Monster Hunts.\\n\\nOn specific locations, the Troll Kingdom buildings also allow you to recruit a limited amount of Bile, Stone, River and Chaos Trolls, depending on the location.
Ogre Camps are the only opportunity for Ogres to construct top-tier [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], as they are unavailable in Ogre [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]].

From time to time Oxyotl receives visions of future atrocities committed by the thralls of Chaos believed to be sent to him by the Old Ones themselves. This powerful gift of foresight allows him to instantly traverse the world and launch timely interventions to thwart the Chaos Gods’ machinations.
Visions of the Old Ones appear as timed missions that can be viewed in the panel accessed via the button in the bottom right corner of the main campaign interface.

Using the Visions of the Old Ones map, Oxyotl can instantly travel to mission locations to prevent events occurring ahead of time, but can only traverse the map in this way once per turn when in territory owned by factions he is not at war with.
Any Ghosts of Pahuax force can complete Chaos-thwarting missions, but only Oxyotl’s army can use the Visions of the Old Ones map to traverse the world.

Successfully completing a Visions of the Old Ones mission grants various bonuses including [[img:sanctum_gem]][[/img]]Sanctum Gems (used to unlock [[sl:campaign_silent_sanctums]]Silent Sanctums[[/sl]]), [[sl:campaign_blessed_spawnings]]Blessed Spawnings[[/sl]] and Diplomatic Relations with Lizardmen.
Failure to complete Visions of the Old Ones missions in time will come with consequences, generally hastening or strengthening Chaos’ presence in the world.
Learn more about Path to Glory [[url:script_link_campaign_path_to_glory]]here[[/url]].
Nurglish factions can create plagues on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_plague_cauldron_panel]]Plagues panel[[/sl_tooltip]].
Learn more about Plagues of Nurgle [[url:script_link_campaign_plagues_of_nurgle]]here[[/url]].
The Garden Plagues' [[sl_tooltip:campaign_symptoms]]Symptoms[[/sl_tooltip]] can be improved in number and strength by building the Plague building chain.

Reach the next [[img:wh3_dlc29_total_accumulated_souls]][[/img]] Tallied Souls thresholds to unlock new [[sl_tooltip:campaign_rituals_of_decay]]Rituals of Decay[[/sl_tooltip]], increase the number of bestowed [[sl_tooltip:campaign_grandfather_gifts]]{{tr:ui_text_replacements_localised_text_wh3_dlc29_blessings_of_nurgle_marks_of_nurgle_title}}[[/sl_tooltip]] and the maximum amount of constructed [[img:icon_garden_of_corruption]][[/img]][[sl_tooltip:campaign_gardens_of_corruption]]{{tr:ui_text_replacements_localised_text_wh3_dlc29_gardens_of_nurgle_title}}[[/sl_tooltip]]. Use [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls to obtain or benefit from the Gifts of Nurgle.

Once bestowed, a Blessing will improve based on actions taken by its bearer and relevant to the Blessing's powers such as spreading a plague, gaining ranks, or completing a building’s construction.  Each completed action will reward the one bestowed with [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nur_mark_progression]][[/img]]Progression Points for this Grandfather's Blessing. Accumulate enough [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nur_mark_progression]][[/img]]Progression Points to reach the next threshold and automatically unlock more benefits.

A Garden's [[url:script_link_campaign_cyclical_buildings]][[tooltip:{{tt:tooltip_campaign_cyclical_buildings}}]]Cyclical Buildings[[/tooltip]][[/url]] require an initial fee in [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]] Souls to get started. Every cycle then demands upkeep in [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]] Souls to add Daemonic units to the faction pool.\\nAmass enough [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]] Souls to feed the buildings and maintain their function.

Perform the Ritual of the Foul Tempest and all your characters bestowed with a [[url:script_link_campaign_gifts_of_nurgle]][[tooltip:{{tt:tooltip_campaign_grandfather_blessings}}]]Grandfather's Blessing[[/tooltip]][[/url]] will start a rotting, flesh devouring, disease spreading [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nurgle_rains]][[/img]]Nurgle Rain.
After performing a ritual once, you can use [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls to improve it further, and reduce its cooldown.
High Nurgle Corruption in the province also reduces the time between Plagues.
Note that only one Grandfather's Blessing can be bestowed per target, and removing it comes at the cost of a few turns’ wait.

Every so often, the Gardens will spawn [[sl_tooltip:campaign_garden_plagues]]Garden Plagues[[/sl_tooltip]], which can spread to nearby armies and adjacent regions. Build up the Plague building chain to add more Symptoms to the plagues in exchange for longer buildup time.

Improve the Ritual of the Foul Tempest to obtain the [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nurgle_rains_t2]][[/img]]Greater Nurgle Rain, inflicting attrition upon the armies in the region while healing your own troops.

The more Gardens you erect, the greater their collective benefits, with many buildings providing factionwide bonuses that can very quickly compound. Such buildings usually require the sacrifice of [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls in exchange for their powerful boons.

[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nurgle_rains]][[/img]]Nurgle Rains only benefit Nurgle favoured factions. Humans, even your Vassals, might suffer from negative effects when in the same province as a [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_nurgle_rains]][[/img]]Nurgle Rain.

The Ice Court and the Great Orthodoxy [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] vie with one another to gain [[img:icon_supporters]][[/img]][[sl_tooltip:campaign_supporters_track]]Supporters[[/sl_tooltip]] amongst the political classes of [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]].

The forces of Slaanesh have the [[sl:campaign_post_battle_options]]post-battle option[[/sl]] of subjugating human or Elvish factions into [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_vassalage]]vassalage[[/sl]] instead of destroying when they capture their last [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]].

When fully completing a progression bar in any of the research tabs, a unique [[sl:campaign_regiments_of_renown]]Regiment of Renown[[/sl]] will be unlocked and become available for recruitment from the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_regiments_of_renown_panel]]Regiments of Renown panel[[/sl_tooltip]].
[[sl:campaign_greenskins]]Greenskins[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_dwarfs]]Dwarfs[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_skaven]]Skaven[[/sl]] may use [[sl:campaign_underway]]the Underway[[/sl]] to the same effect.

[[img:icon_supporters]][[/img]]Supporters gained by the Great Orthodoxy or the Ice Court advances them along the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_supporters_track]]Supporters track[[/sl_tooltip]]. Rewards on the Supporters track are claimed by the first of the two competing [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] to reach them. They cannot be later claimed by the opponent.

Slaaneshi factions may also be able to liberate destroyed human and Elvish factions when they capture [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] that destroyed faction once owned. The liberated faction is resurrected and re-established as a [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassal that owns the captured settlement.

Many races have access to [[img:icon_encamp_stance]][[/img]]Encamp stance, which amongst other effects grants the army the ability to [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit[[/sl]] from the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_global_recruitment_pool]]global recruitment pool[[/sl_tooltip]] when in foreign territory.

Should the player, playing one of the two competing factions, gain the full support of the people first, they will have the opportunity to [[sl:campaign_confederation]]confederate[[/sl]] their opponent.

When [[img:icon_seductive_influence]][[/img]]Seductive Influence is sufficiently increased over an enemy non-Legendary [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]], N’kari may target them with his [[i]]Lord Seduction[[/i]] action via the button above his [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]], causing them to defect and join his faction as a Chaos Lord.
[[sl:campaign_hordes]]Horde[[/sl]] armies may only construct new [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] when in [[img:icon_encamp_stance]][[/img]]Encamp stance.
Should a non-player opponent gain the full support of the people first, the opportunity to confederate will be lost.

Races that make heavy use of [[sl:campaign_winds_of_magic]]magic[[/sl]] commonly have access to Channelling stance, which allows the army to increase its magic reserves at the cost of some manoeuvrability.
[[sl:campaign_devotion]]Devotion[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_money]]money[[/sl]] can be spent on the Motherland panel to sabotage the opponent, setting them back on the Supporters track.
The advisor can be dismissed or recalled at any time by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_advisor_button]]advisor button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface.

Dwarf campaigns are marked by the Age of Reckoning – a recurring [[img:icon_turns]][[/img]]15-turn period when Dwarfs can work towards powerful factionwide benefits, by defeating [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] with [[img:icon_grudges]][[/img]]Grudges incurred against them.

Allegiance points are shown on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_war_coordination_panel]]War Coordination panel[[/sl_tooltip]], which may be accessed on the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]] when any ally or [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_vassalage]]vassal[[/sl]] is selected.
[[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]]Alliance proposals are sent and received on the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]].

Amanar will attack coastal regions and sea regions indiscriminately without warning, leaving [[img:icon_port]][[/img]]port settlements devastated and causing [[img:icon_transport_fleet]][[/img]]fleets to suffer [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_attrition]]attritional[[/sl]] casualties wherever it ascends.

If an [[img:icon_ambush_stance]][[/img]]ambush is successfully sprung then an ambush [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] will be fought, in which the attacker will be at a great positional advantage.
An army may be selected by left-clicking. A selected army can be instructed to move or attack by right-clicking the destination or target.
An army on land may be [[sl:campaign_army_movement]]moved[[/sl]] onto the sea by selecting it and right-clicking the destination.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_armies_of_shang_yang_link]]Armies of Shang-Yang panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows the use of [[img:icon_iron_favour]][[//img]]Iron Favour as a means to strengthen Bhashiva's [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] and military [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]]. It also offers greater rewards from the completion of Zhao Ming's Goals and other objectives for Shang-Yang.

The distance a [[sl:campaign_characters]]character[[/sl]] can move in a turn is displayed on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] when selected. It can be affected by [[sl:campaign_terrain_types]]terrain type[[/sl]] and by army [[sl:campaign_stances]]stance[[/sl]].

Each [[sl:campaign_units]]unit[[/sl]] in a selected army is represented on the Army panel by a unit card. Units in the process of being [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruited[[/sl]] are also shown.
Unlike [[sl:campaign_elven_halls]]Elven Halls[[/sl]], Asrai Lookouts provide only one [[sl:campaign_building_slots]]building slot[[/sl]].

A selected Lizardmen army may be switched into [[img:icon_astromancy_stance]][[/img]]Astromancy stance using the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_stances_rollout]]Stances rollout[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]].

Aislinn’s faction can gift conquered settlements to fellow High Elves, which establishes [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]][[/img]]Sea Patrol Outposts. Outposts grant visibility over Asur lands, but more importantly generate [[img:icon_dedication]][[/img]]Dedication, used to purchase [[img:icon_asur_domination]][[/img]]Asur Domination upgrades.

Atamans may be assigned on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_atamans_panel]]Atamans panel[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing as a Kislevite faction. Only one Ataman can be assigned for every two [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]] owned.
Any [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]]attritional effects present in an area on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] can be seen on the tooltip shown when the cursor is held there.

A battle may be auto-resolved by selecting the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_autoresolve_button]]auto-resolve option[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_pre_battle_panel]]Pre-Battle panel[[/sl]]. An indication of the likely outcome is shown on the panel.

A faction with an empty {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury and a negative {{tr:icon_income}}income is considered bankrupt. The {{tr:icon_treasury}}treasury value and {{tr:icon_income}}[[sl:campaign_income]]income per-turn[[/sl]] are shown on the campaign interface.
Any banners that randomly drop after victory in battle are shown on the [[sl:campaign_post_battle_panel]]Post-Battle panel[[/sl]].
An army under attack may be able to decline and withdraw if there is room to retreat. Each army may only withdraw once during the [[sl:campaign_turns]]end-turn sequence[[/sl]].
A Beastmen [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] can move through beast-paths by activating the [[img:icon_use_beastpaths_stance]][[/img]]Use Beast-Paths [[sl:campaign_stances]]stance[[/sl]].

Beastmen [[sl:campaign_hordes]]hordes[[/sl]] cannot inhabit conquered [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]]. Instead, they erect Herdstones in the ruins to establish [[sl:campaign_bloodgrounds]]Blood-grounds[[/sl]].

[[img:icon_bestial_rage]][[/img]]Bestial Rage is the primary means for Beastmen hordes to increase their growth. It is boosted by fighting battles and using the [[img:icon_raiding_stance]][[/img]]Raiding [[sl:campaign_stances]]stance[[/sl]].

Ogre [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] each have a list of attainable [[sl_tooltip:campaign_big_names_link]]Big Names[[/sl_tooltip]] with specified conditions to fulfil to gain their bonuses.

A Black Ark can be made available for recruitment by performing the Sacrifice to Mathlann [[sl:campaign_rites]]rite[[/sl]] or occupying a major [[img:icon_port]][[/img]]port when playing as Lokhir Fellheart.
A special mission is issued when a blessing spawning event occurs. {{tr:hp_campaign_point_2_blessed_spawnings}}
The Blessings of the Lady grant a damage resistance bonus to the [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] upon which the blessing is bestowed.

These armies have no upkeep but cannot recruit additional units and will suffer [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_attrition]]attrition[[/sl]] over time. They must fight [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]] to sustain themselves as the units will not [[img:icon_replenishment]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_unit_replenishment]]replenish[[/sl]].

The Har Ganeth [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] will be rewarded with {{tr:icon_money}}[[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_slaves]]slaves[[/sl]] proportional to the carnage inflicted by the Blood Voyage [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]].
A Blood-ground is created whenever the Beastmen raise a Herdstone in a defeated settlement, offering them limited but powerful building options.
The Bloodletting level of a selected [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] is shown on the [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]] when playing a Khornate faction.

[[img:icon_vmp_shyish]][[/img]]Blood is shown at the top of the campaign interface when playing a [[sl:campaign_vampires]]Vampire Counts[[/sl]] faction. It is mainly obtained through conversion of [[img:icon_vmp_corpses]][[/img]]Corpses via certain settlement buildings.
Collected Books of Nagash may be viewed in the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_books_of_nagash_link]]Books of Nagash panel[[/sl_tooltip]] located at the top of the main campaign interface.

[[img:icon_chivalry]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_chivalry]]Chivalry levels[[/sl]] for Bretonnian [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] are increased by victories in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]], and are affected by honourable and dishonourable acts. Greater levels of [[img:icon_chivalry]][[/img]]Chivalry lead to greater faction-wide bonuses.

Bretonnian armies far from home are susceptible to desert [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_attrition]]attrition[[/sl]] which depletes their [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] when moving through such [[sl:campaign_terrain_types]]terrain[[/sl]].

Bretonnian [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and Paladin [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] can gain three Knightly Vows by choosing a pledge and completing the task it sets. Prophetess [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes can gain three Troths of the Lady through similar pledges.

The Building panel can be viewed by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_building_panel_tab]]Building panel tab[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]] when a horde [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] is selected.

[[img:icon_growth]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_growth]]Growth[[/sl]] causes [[img:icon_pop_surplus]][[/img]]population surplus to accumulate in a [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]]. [[img:icon_growth]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_growth]]Growth[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_pop_surplus]][[/img]]population surplus values are shown on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]] when a controlled settlement in the province is selected.

Buildings cost [[sl:campaign_turns]]time[[/sl]] and {{tr:icon_money}}[[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]] to build, but grant a variety of benefits when completed which are shown on their icon tooltips.
Move the camera with the W, A, S and D keys, or by holding the middle mouse button and dragging.
Basic controls for the player are listed [[sl:campaign_campaign_controls]]here[[/sl]].

Territory on the map is divided into [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]], each containing several [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]]. Control of the settlements grants control of the portion of the province that surrounds it.

[[img:icon_jars]][[/img]]Canopic Jars may sometimes be obtained from [[sl:campaign_missions]]missions[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_quests]]quests[[/sl]], and also produced by certain [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]].
Cathayan rulers must maintain [[sl:campaign_harmony]]Harmony[[/sl]] by balancing levels of Yin and Yang across their [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].

{{tr:hp_campaign_changing_of_the_ways_add_01}} Actions can be targeted at rival factions to gain information, change [[sl:campaign_diplomacy]]diplomatic relationships[[/sl]], or influence them in other ways.

The primary followers of the Chaos gods [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentch[[/sl]] wage war on the mortal races from their domains deep within the [[sl:campaign_realm_of_chaos]]Realms of Chaos[[/sl]].
Artefacts, such as Chaos Rifts or Herdstones, may be destroyed by other [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]] if they recolonise the [[sl:campaign_ruins]]ruined settlement[[/sl]].

The dedicated followers of the four gods of Chaos – [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentch[[/sl]] – spread variants of corruption specific to their chosen deity. The spreading of each variant benefits the related God in [[sl:campaign_the_great_game]]the Great Game[[/sl]].

Chaos Cults have a chance to automatically appear in any foreign province with high levels of [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentch[[/sl]] Corruption.

Chaos Dwarf factions have access to unique resources that drive their [[sl:campaign_chd_economy]]Industrial Economy[[/sl]] and military might.\\n\\n[[img:icon_labour]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_labour]]Labour[[/sl]] is required in provinces to mine Raw Materials and can be spent on quickly constructing buildings or to gain bonuses via provincial Labour Actions.\\n\\n[[img:icon_raw_materials]][[/img]]Raw Materials are spent on constructing buildings and manufacturing Armaments in Factory settlements.\\n\\n[[img:icon_armaments]][[/img]]Armaments are spent on constructing Advanced Military buildings and enhancing armies via the [[sl:campaign_hellforge]]Hell-Forge[[/sl]].

[[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_souls_resource]]Souls[[/sl]] can be sacrificed by Warriors of Chaos [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] for rewards such as factionwide boons and Daemonic [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] in the [[img:icon_chaos_gifts]][[/img]]Gifts of Chaos panel, accessed from the main campaign interface.
Ursun, the [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislevite[[/sl]] God-Bear is trapped and wounded in the Forge of Souls. Grieviously injured, he [[sl:campaign_turns]]periodically[[/sl]] howls with pain.

The details of a selected character may be viewed on the [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]], which may be opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_character_details_button]]Character Details button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]].

[[sl_tooltip:campaign_character_details_panel_character_stats]]Character Stats[[/sl_tooltip]] which indicate the selected [[sl:campaign_characters]]character's[[/sl]] essential performance in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] are listed on the Character Details panel. Inspect the tooltip of each stat to find out more about it.
Click the Character Details button on the Character Info panel to open the [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]].

{{tr:hp_campaign_character_skills_add_01}} The character's current rank, and an indication of whether any skill points are unspent, is shown on the Skills button on the [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]].
The [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]] shows [[sl:campaign_character_details]]detailed information[[/sl]] about a specific character.

[[img:icon_labour]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_labour]]Labour[[/sl]] is required to mine [[img:icon_raw_materials]][[/img]]Raw Materials and can be spent on instantly constructing buildings. It is primarily gained from battles and is distributed to all provinces opted in to accepting new Labour on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]] where it is tracked with other Industrial Economy factors.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_chieftains_link]]Tamurkhan’s Chieftains panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows recruitment of unique [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]], each granting access to unique Chieftain Abilities and units that would otherwise be unavailable, such as those of other races.

The current level of [[img:icon_chivalry]][[/img]]Chivalry is [[sl_tooltip:campaign_chivalry_link]]shown on the campaign interface[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing a Bretonnian [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_cloak_of_skulls_link]]Cloak of Skulls panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows Skulltaker to increase his power through ten unique skulls, each of which can be empowered to provide different effects and bonuses.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_colleges_of_magic_link]]Colleges of Magic panel[[/sl_tooltip]] grants access to Wizards and unique actions of their Orders in return for [[img:icon_arcane_essays]][[/img]]Arcane Essays, as well as various magic [[sl:campaign_magic_items]]items[[/sl]] and bonuses.

Commandments are issued on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_commandments_rollout]]commandments rollout[[/sl_tooltip]], which is shown when a controlled [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] is selected. The tooltips on the various commandment buttons show the bonuses that they apply.
When playing as a Cathayan [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]], the Compass can be viewed and its direction changed on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_compass_panel]]Compass panel[[/sl_tooltip]].

[[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]]Confederation combines two factions by absorbing all the confederated faction's armies and holdings into the confederating faction's ownership, and cannot be reversed.

Every few [[sl:campaign_turns]]turns[[/sl]] when playing as an Ogre [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] a number of Bounties are issued. These may be browsed on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_contracts_panel]]Bounties panel[[/sl_tooltip]].
If the proportion of any one type of corruption exceeds 50% in a province then the effects of that corruption will begin to apply.

Cyclical [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruitment[[/sl]] buildings can continually upgrade themselves if conditions are right, continuously increasing the number of summonable [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] they provide.

Each [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]] in Gorbad's [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] has access to Da Plan via their [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]], allowing their army to equip various Tactics when they have the correct [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] to carry them out.

A Daemon Prince may gain glory with an individual God of Chaos by dedicating victories in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] to them, by constructing certain [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], and through [[sl:campaign_missions]]mission[[/sl]] rewards.

An army's Dark Authority levels and effects are viewed above the [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]] and can be affected by the [[sl:campaign_character_skills]]skills[[/sl]], [[sl_tooltip:campaign_character_traits]]traits[[/sl_tooltip]], and ancillaries of its [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]].

The [[img:icon_loyalty]][[/img]]loyalty of a [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord can be increased by [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruiting units[[/sl]] to their [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]], by gifting them items and by completing [[sl:campaign_missions]]missions[[/sl]].
Dark Elves capture [[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_slaves]]Slaves[[/sl]] in battle, who are put to work fulfilling many degrading and exhausting duties across the Druchii empire.
[[img:icon_dark_fortress]][[/img]]Dark Fortresses are special major [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] constructed in specific regions in Norsca, the Chaos Wastes, and other key locations.

Sayl's [[img:icon_sayl_dark_ritual]][[/img]]Dark Ritual is the ultimate objective for the Dolgan [[img:icon_victory_condition]][[/img]]campaign victory, requiring the construction of [[img:icon_nor_undivided]][[/img]]Undivided Chaos Altars.
The number of units of each type that may be fielded is shown on its card on the [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment_panel]]Recruitment panel[[/sl]].

A Death Night can be initiated by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_death_night_button]]Death Night button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface. This becomes active when a sufficient number of sacrificial [[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_slaves]]slaves[[/sl]] have been acquired.

A Dedication can be made on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_daemonic_glory_panel]]Daemonic Glory panel[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing as a Daemon Prince [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] when sufficient Daemonic Glory is attained.
Ulthuan, the island home of the [[sl:campaign_high_elves]]High Elves[[/sl]], is divided by a ring of mountains between outer and inner [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]].
Only Slaaneshi factions collect Devotees, who can be tracked via the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_devotees_counter]]counter[[/sl_tooltip]] and tooltip at the top of the main campaign interface.

When playing as a Kislev faction, [[img:icon_devotion]][[/img]]Devotion is tracked on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]] in the same way that Control is for most other [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]].
{{tr:hp_campaign_diplomacy_add_01}} Diplomatic actions are received or can be proposed on the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]].
Information about the player’s [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] is shown on the left panel on the Diplomacy screen.

A Disciple Army is summoned from an existing Slaaneshi military force, at a cost in [[sl:campaign_devotees]]Devotees[[/sl]]. When playing as Slaanesh, select an army and click the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_summon_disciple_army_button]]Summon Disciple Army button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]] to perform a summon.

Sea Lord Aislinn starts the campaign with a [[img:hef_dragonship]][[/img]]Dragonship – a powerful [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] type that offers shipbuilding upgrades via the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_ship_building_link]]building panel[[/sl_tooltip]] to unlock [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]unit recruitment[[/sl]], army abilities, and other bonuses.

The chance of a Khornate faction automatically gaining control of a ruined [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] in their province is increased if they own more than one settlement in the province. The chance is lower for a [[sl:campaign_fortifications]]fortified[[/sl]] province capital than for an unfortified minor settlement.
[[img:icon_dread]][[/img]]Dread is spent in the Rewards of Dread panel accessed via the button in the bottom right corner of the main campaign interface when playing a Beastmen faction.
The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_events_list]]Events list[[/sl_tooltip]] shows important notifications about your [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] or the wider world.
Dwarf [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] maintain a record of grievances in their Book of [[sl:campaign_grudges]]Grudges[[/sl]].

Each Tomb King dynasty researched will increase the number of [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords the faction may [[sl:campaign_raising_forces]]recruit[[/sl]], and the number of [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] it may field, by one.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_electoral_machinations_link]]Electoral Machinations panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows you to spend [[img:icon_prestige]][[/img]]Prestige to perform unique actions across the campaign via two tabs: Emperor’s Decrees and Diplomatic Talks.
Positions of Office may be assigned on the Offices panel, which is opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_offices_button]]Offices button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the user interface.
An Elven Hall is invariably the only settlement found within the [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]] that contains it.
The Empire is fractured into multiple [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] at the start of the [[sl:campaign_campaign_game]]campaign game[[/sl]].
As the Huntsmarshal's Expedition makes progress, increasingly better reinforcements are sent to aid them from the homeland.
The [[img:emp_hostility]][[/img]]Hostility bar can be viewed at the top of the campaign interface when playing as the Huntsmarshal's Expedition [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
[[img:emp_imperial_authority]][[/img]] Imperial Authority is a measure of how many of the Empire’s home [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]] are occupied by factions belonging to it.

The [[img:emp_elector_counts]][[/img]]Elector Counts are the leaders of the Empire’s states, whose changing individual [[img:emp_fealty]][[/img]]Fealty can unite or divide the nation. High [[img:emp_fealty]][[/img]]Fealty may lead to confederation, while low [[img:emp_fealty]][[/img]]Fealty may lead to war.

The [[img:bullet_emp_hunters]][[/img]]Wulfhart's Hunters panel can be accessed from the lower-right section of the campaign interface when playing the Huntsmarshal's Expedition [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
Only the Jade Court faction have access to the four dormant directions of the Wu Xing Compass, which can be unlocked in any order as part of their campaign victory conditions.
Encounters at sea appear as wrecked ships or magical islands in ocean areas.

The additional Influence that High Elves gain from their outposts affords them a greater capacity to manipulate other factions’ [[sl:campaign_diplomacy]]diplomatic relations[[/sl]] through the [[sl:campaign_intrigue_at_the_court]]Court[[/sl]].

Herald Lords and Exalted Greater Daemons are only available to [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khornate[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurglish[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaaneshi[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentchian[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_daemons_of_chaos]]Daemons of Chaos[[/sl]] factions.

Buttons to open the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_technology_panel]]Technology panel[[/sl_tooltip]], {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl:campaign_treasury_panel]]Treasury panel[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_missions]]Objectives panel[[/sl]] and more are shown next to the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_end_turn_button]]End Turn button[[/sl_tooltip]].

The {{tr:icon_treasury}}[[sl:campaign_treasury_panel]]Treasury panel[[/sl]] shows information about [[sl:campaign_tax]]{{tr:hp_campaign_tax_term}}[[/sl]], [[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_trade]]trade[[/sl]], and {{tr:icon_money}}[[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]] for the player's faction.
The Faction Summary screen can be displayed by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_faction_summary_button]]Faction Summary button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface.

A faction is served by [[sl:campaign_characters]]characters[[/sl]] such as [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]].
Fleet Offices may be awarded on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_fleet_office_panel]]Offices panel[[/sl_tooltip]].

The fog of war is lifted over an area of land when its central [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] is captured, or if controlled by a [[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_alliances]]military ally[[/sl]].
Current [[img:icon_skaven_food]][[/img]]food levels are shown on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_food_bar]]Food bar[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing as a Skaven [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
{{tr:hp_campaign_forge_of_souls_add_01}} This journey is difficult, however, for mortal souls are required to illuminate the path to the Forge.
Items can be made on the Forge panel, which can be opened by clicking the Forge button on the campaign interface.
Province capitals feature fortification [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] that may be upgraded to improve the settlement defences.

Kairos’ Fragments of Sorcery gives him access to different lores of magic via his [[sl:campaign_character_details]]Character Details panel[[/sl]] from which he can preselect spells between [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]].

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_gardens_of_morr_link]]Gardens of Morr panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows the construction of Black Tower buildings, in any visible friendly or neutral Empire settlement, for powerful benefits.

The garrison army a settlement provides can be seen on the [[sl:campaign_province_overview_panel]]Province Overview panel[[/sl]], by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_garrison_details_button]]Garrison Details button[[/sl_tooltip]].
The Gathering of the Ancients may be browsed on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_gathering_of_the_ancients_panel]]Offices screen[[/sl_tooltip]].

The Geomantic Web may be viewed by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_geomantic_web_button]]Geomantic Web button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface when playing as a Lizardmen faction. In this view, the colour of each Geomantic Web link and node indicates its operating power.

A Gift of Slaanesh can be received by any [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]] who loses a [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] against a Slaaneshi [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]], or any victim of a successful Slaaneshi [[sl:campaign_hero_actions]]Hero action[[/sl]].

[[sl:campaign_norsca]]Norscan[[/sl]] Legendary Lords can gain bonuses and gifts by raising Altars over conquered [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] in one of the [[sl:campaign_gods]]Dark Gods[[/sl]]' names – the [[img:icon_nor_hound]][[/img]]Hound, the [[img:icon_nor_eagle]][[/img]]Eagle, the [[img:icon_nor_serpent]][[/img]]Snake and the [[img:icon_nor_crow]][[/img]]Crow.

Gotrek and Felix can be recruited by completing their [[sl:campaign_quests]]quest[[/sl]] battle during campaigns played as the [[sl:campaign_empire]]Empire[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_bretonnia]]Bretonnia[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_dwarfs]]Dwarfs[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislev[[/sl]] or [[sl:campaign_cathay]]Cathay[[/sl]].

Cathayan [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] must maintain and defend the Snake Gate, the Dragon Gate, and Turtle Gate [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] to prevent Chaos from entering their lands.

The Great Temple of Ulric panel allows construction of six Sanctuaries to grant powerful factionwide benefits – including Winter Rites and Chosen of Ulric recruitment – at the cost of [[img:icon_fervour]][[/img]]Fervour.

The [[img:icon_green_knight]][[/img]]Green Knight may be summoned by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_green_knight_link]]Legendary Knight button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface when playing as a Bretonnian [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].

Greenskin tribes earn [[img:icon_waaagh]][[/img]]Reputation from fighting [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_razing]]razing[[/sl]] settlements which can eventually lead to a [[sl:campaign_waaagh]]Waaagh![[/sl]].
Grom’s Cauldron can be accessed from the main campaign interface when playing as the Broken Axe [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
[[img:icon_scrap]][[/img]]Scrap is automatically picked up after battles and when razing settlements when playing as any Greenskin faction.
Grimoires can be tracked via the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_grimoires_counter]]counter[[/sl_tooltip]] and tooltip at the top of the main campaign interface when playing a Tzeentchian faction.
[[img:icon_growth]][[/img]]Growth and [[img:icon_pop_surplus]][[/img]]population surplus can be seen on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]].

Playing as the Dwarfs, the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_grudges_button]]Great Book of Grudges panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows you to browse your most important Grudge objectives and the unique rewards of your Grudge-settling.
Cathayan [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] receive campaign bonuses depending on the balance between the levels of Yin and Yang in their [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]].

The Hell-Forge is accessed via the dedicated button on the main campaign interface. It is split into the Armoury tab, which allows the increase of unit capacities, and the Manufactory tab, which can be used to enhance entire categories of units.
With a [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero selected, right-click the desired target to move the [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero there and show a range of options.

[[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes can move independently of armies, and can freely move into enemy territory. [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes cannot be attacked by enemy armies, only by enemy [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes.

Hexes are powerful magical actions that Mother Ostankya can perform to target [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] and regions with different effects to benefit her campaign.

High Elf Legendary Lords all nominally serve the Phoenix King, the ruler of all Asur, wielding [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_influence]]Influence[[/sl]] and garnering his [[img:icon_hef_favour]][[/img]]Favour to increase their strength and consolidate High Elf power.
Athel Tamarha can be accessed from the main campaign interface when playing as Yvresse.
Dragon encounters occur from time to time throughout the campaign in the form of a Dragon Marker that appears on the map when playing as the Knights of Caledor.
Horde growth and [[img:icon_pop_surplus]][[/img]]population surplus can be seen on the [[sl:campaign_building_panel]]Building panel[[/sl]].

Horde [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] reside with their armies. Available building options for a selected Horde army may be seen on the [[sl:campaign_building_panel]]Building panel[[/sl]], viewable by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_building_panel_tab]]Building tab[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]].
{{tr:hp_campaign_ice_court_add_01}} The initiation of training carries a [[sl:campaign_money]]financial cost[[/sl]].

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_imperial_gunnery_school_link]]Imperial Gunnery School panel[[/sl_tooltip]] offers special upgrades for gunnery and artillery units in return for [[img:icon_schematics]][[/img]]Schematics earned from the damage such units inflict in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]].
The {{tr:icon_treasury}}Treasury panel also shows expenditure from sources such as [[sl:campaign_units]]unit[[/sl]] upkeep and [[sl:campaign_buildings]]building[[/sl]] construction.

Pirates of the Vampire Coast gain [[img:icon_infamy]][[/img]]Infamy by winning battles, claiming settlements, and establishing [[img:icon_cove]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_pirate_coves]]Pirate Coves[[/sl]].

[[sl:campaign_high_elves]]High Elf[[/sl]] factions earn [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]]Influence from events, [[sl:campaign_outposts]]outposts[[/sl]], and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_hero_actions]]Hero actions[[/sl]] of their Nobles. The current amount is shown at the top of the main campaign interface.

Intervention armies may be hired by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_interventions_button]]Interventions button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the [[sl:campaign_rituals_bar]]Rituals bar[[/sl]] while a rival [[sl:campaign_races]]race[[/sl]] is conducting a [[sl:campaign_rituals]]ritual[[/sl]].

Because of their hardy and survivalist nature, Kislevite [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] tend to be versatile and fulfil multiple roles in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]].

The [[sl:campaign_lizardmen]]Lizardmen[[/sl]] maintain the [[sl:campaign_geomantic_web]]Geomantic Web[[/sl]], an unseen network of magical energy that spans the world.

When a temple is built, [[img:icon_lzd_nakai_favour]][[/img]]Favour and alignment to an [[img:icon_lzd_nakai_temple_green]][[/img]][[img:icon_lzd_nakai_temple_blue]][[/img]][[img:icon_lzd_nakai_temple_red]][[/img]]Old One will be granted to unlock rewards, powerful [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_technology]]technologies[[/sl]], increasing the strength of the Spirit of the Jungle.

Lord Kroak will be automatically summoned after completing his unique [[sl:campaign_quests]]quest chain[[/sl]], which will become available during the course of the campaign for each playable Lizardman [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Legendary Lord[[/sl]].

The warm-blooded invaders can be viewed at the top of the campaign interface when playing as Nakai.

A new army may be [[sl:campaign_raising_forces]]raised[[/sl]], and a [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord appointed to lead it, on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_raise_forces_panel]]Recruit Lord panel[[/sl_tooltip]].

[[sl:campaign_dark_elf_loyalty]]Dark Elf loyalty[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_skaven_loyalty]]Skaven loyalty[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_vampiric_loyalty]]Vampire loyalty[[/sl]] are all influenced by different factors.

Magic items may be received after victory in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] or as a [[sl:campaign_quests]]quest[[/sl]] reward. Malakai’s Adventures are a series of dangerous missions that permanently modify his Artillery and War Machine units, culminating in unique Legendary Battles and other rewards.
At the start of the campaign, a set of three neutral or enemy [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords are selected as targets when playing as Nagarythe.

The total number of [[img:icon_marks_of_ruination]][[/img]]Marks of Ruination collected and the resulting Ruination Level can be viewed via the tooltips on the bar at the top of the main campaign interface when playing a Beastmen [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].

Matters of State actions are performed by using the energies of [[img:icon_mos_steel]][[/img]]Steel and [[img:icon_mos_stone]][[/img]]Stone which are never lost, only transferred between one another in the form of tokens.

Ogre armies gather and carry a [[img:icon_ogr_meat]][[/img]][[sl_tooltip:campaign_meat_link]]Meat[[/sl_tooltip]] supply from which they can directly benefit or spend surpluses for [[sl:campaign_ogre_camps]]Ogre Camp[[/sl]] construction and other uses.

The [[sl:campaign_mercenary_contracts_link]]Mercenary Contracts panel[[/sl]] provides a list of potential client [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] Golgfag can accept Contracts from to fight in their wars, in return for culture-specific rewards.
Military Convoys can be dispatched by selecting or recruiting a Convoy Master in the Military Convoys panel, accessed via the button in the bottom right of the main campaign interface.

A list of active missions and [[sl:campaign_victory_conditions]]campaign victory conditions[[/sl]] may be seen on the Objectives panel, which can be opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_objectives_button]]Objectives button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface.

The Sea Patrol's armies can use the Mist Landing [[sl:campaign_stances]]stance[[/sl]] to instantly traverse the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] from [[sl:campaign_sea]]sea[[/sl]] to dry land within range (but not vice versa), regardless of impassable coastlines.

A faction can earn {{tr:icon_money}}{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}} through [[sl:campaign_tax]]{{tr:hp_campaign_tax_term}}[[/sl]], [[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_trade]]trade[[/sl]], and certain military activities such as [[img:icon_raiding_stance]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_raiding]]raiding[[/sl]] and looting.

[[sl:campaign_units]]Units[[/sl]] captured for the [[img:icon_monster_pens]][[/img]]Monster Pens can be instantly recruited into any [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] via the dedicated button on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]]. The number of monsters available at any one time is limited.

The [[sl:campaign_monsters]]Monstrous Arcanum[[/sl]] is available when playing as any Norscan faction, allowing participation in different types of hunts comprising of [[sl:campaign_missions]]missions[[/sl]], dilemmas and [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]] to attain various powerful unique rewards and monster units.

As [[img:icon_corruption_chs]][[/img]]Chaos corruption increases, Alarielle will suffer from reduced [[sl:campaign_winds_of_magic]]Winds of Magic[[/sl]] and her faction will suffer penalties to [[img:icon_public_order]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_public_order]]{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}}[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_growth]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_growth]]growth[[/sl]].
The Mortarchs panel offers Nagash powerful characters who he can Subjugate into his Undead Legions to lead and fight in his armies, and even grant him a special ability.

Items may be crafted on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_mortuary_cult_panel]]Mortuary Cult panel[[/sl_tooltip]], which can be opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_mortuary_cult_button]]Mortuary Cult button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_motherland_link]]Court & Orthodoxy panel[[/sl_tooltip]] tracks the level of [[img:ksl_support_ice_court]][[/img]]Ice Court Support and [[img:ksl_support_orthodoxy]][[/img]]Great Orthodoxy Support attained during a Kislev campaign and offers various permanent powers from both sides.
The Necromancy screen allows you to review the wide array of Undead unit types available to Nagash to increase their initially limited capacity.

The [[img:icon_nemesis_crown]][[/img]]Nemesis Crown is a powerful artefact that can be discovered by any [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] and increased in level to grant their leader and forces great strength, but at the cost of debilitating effects.
[[img:icon_non-aggression_pact]][[/img]]Non-aggression pacts can be proposed and agreed on the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]].
Killing Norscan faction leaders in battle will force their [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] to [[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_confederation]]confederate[[/sl]].

Norscan Homelands are indicated by the associated tribe’s faction icon on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_settlement_bars]]Settlement bars[[/sl_tooltip]], with Homeland Capitals denoted by the icon’s tooltip.
The full rejuvenation of the Oak is one of the [[sl:campaign_victory_conditions]]victory conditions[[/sl]] for Wood Elf [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]].

[[img:icon_oathgold]][[/img]] Oathgold enables the use of the [[sl:campaign_forging_magic_items]]Forge[[/sl]], where it is spent with other resources to create magic [[sl:campaign_character_details]]items[[/sl]].
Offices may be awarded on the Offices panel, which is opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_offices_button]]Offices button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the user interface.
The total number of Ogre Camps that can be deployed at once can be increased by researching further [[sl:campaign_technology]]technologies[[/sl]].

Ogre [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] consume and carry a supply of [[sl:campaign_meat]]Meat[[/sl]], which they must maintain to avoid suffering [[sl:campaign_attrition]]attrition[[/sl]] from cannibalism.

Outposts are constructed on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_war_coordination_outpost_tab]]Outpost tab[[/sl_tooltip]] of the [[sl:campaign_war_coordination]]War Co-ordination panel[[/sl]], which is opened from the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]]. Outposts take [[sl:campaign_turns]]time[[/sl]] and cost [[sl:campaign_money]]money[[/sl]] to build. They may be moved or demolished once constructed.

The Path of the Butcher grants powerful bonuses to Skrag the Slaughterer and his [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]], based on the total number of active Offers to the Great Maw across all of his [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] at any one time.

[[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_heroes]]Heroes[[/sl]] can become more powerful beings by being granted Marks of Chaos via the Path to Glory tab of their [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]].

The number of [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruited[[/sl]] peasant [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] is [[sl_tooltip:campaign_peasants_link]]shown on the campaign interface[[/sl_tooltip]] when playing as a Bretonnian [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].
Each Piece of Eight is connected to a unique [[sl:campaign_regiments_of_renown]]Regiment of Renown[[/sl]].

A [[img:icon_cove]][[/img]]Pirate Cove can be established in any foreign [[img:icon_port]][[/img]]port after winning a battle there or via [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_hero_actions]]Hero actions[[/sl]].
[[img:icon_plague]][[/img]]Plagues are generated by a Skaven faction performing the [[sl:campaign_rites]]rite[[/sl]] of the Pestilent Scheme.

Plagues can cause positive effects for Nurgle factions, or negative effects for non-Nurgle factions.

Coastal settlements contain special [[img:icon_port]][[/img]]port [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] that provide facilities for sea [[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]]trade.
Possession increases naturally over time but is slowed whenever Malus is garrisoned within a [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]].
More options are available if the winners and losers are of the same [[sl:campaign_races]]race[[/sl]].
If the battle was won then the tooltip on each choice button gives information about the choice and its consequences.

Examine the tooltip on each engagement button to view more information about that option.

Information about [[sl:campaign_growth]]growth[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_tax]]{{tr:hp_campaign_tax_term}}[[/sl]] or [[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_slaves]]slaves[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_public_order]]{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}}[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_corruption]]corruption[[/sl]] are displayed on the Province Info panel.

Factions of a particular race receive a bonus to [[sl:campaign_diplomacy]]diplomatic[[/sl]] relations and therefore tend to stick together.

Raise the dead into a selected army by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_raise_dead_button]]Raise Dead button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface. Click the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_raise_forces_button]]Recruit Lord button[[/sl_tooltip]] with a controlled [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlement[[/sl]] selected to open the Recruit Lord panel.
The progress of a Rampage is tracked on the Rampage bar, accessed via the button at the top of the main campaign interface when playing as the Slaughterhorn Tribe.
No faction will own a settlement after it’s been razed.

[[sl:campaign_ursun]]Ursun[[/sl]], the injured [[sl:campaign_kislev]]Kislevite[[/sl]] God-Bear is being held within the [[sl:campaign_forge_of_souls]]Forge of Souls[[/sl]]. Regiments of Renown can be recruited into a selected [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] from the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_regiments_of_renown_panel]]Regiments of Renown panel[[/sl_tooltip]].
Settlements may be offered or requested by selecting the Trade Settlement option when constructing a deal on the [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]Diplomacy screen[[/sl]].
Hover the mouse cursor over an army on the campaign map to see which nearby forces it supports. An arrow is drawn where reinforcement would occur.
The presence of a resource in a settlement is indicated by an icon on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_settlement_bars]]Settlement bar[[/sl_tooltip]].
A rebellion occurs if the [[img:icon_public_order]][[/img]]{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} in a province drops to -100.
An incursion occurs if [[img:icon_public_order]][[/img]]{{tr:hp_campaign_public_order_term}} in a province drops to -100.

Rites may be browsed and initiated from the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_rites_panel]]Rites panel[[/sl_tooltip]], which is opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_rites_button]]Rites button[[/sl_tooltip]] on the campaign interface.

Ritual resource sites are indicated by a glowing icon on the settlement's [[sl_tooltip:campaign_settlement_bars]]Settlement bar[[/sl_tooltip]].

A ritual may be initiated by clicking the corresponding button on the [[sl:campaign_rituals_bar]]Rituals bar[[/sl]]. Once initiated, a ritual takes several [[sl:campaign_turns]]turns[[/sl]] to complete.
The mouse cursor tooltip on the Rituals bar shows the amount of ritual currency accrued, as well as details concerning sources of ritual currency income.
Rogue armies typically appear in sparsely-populated terrain.
Rogue Pirate fleets often employ troops from many different [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]], making them a challenge to defeat in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]].
Settlements become ruins when [[sl:campaign_razing]]razed[[/sl]] by an attacking force after a [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]].
Previously-saved games can be loaded from the game options, either on the main menu or from within a campaign.
The [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] is divided into several Theatres of War within the panel, with each one containing one Grand Scheme and multiple minor ones.

Sea Lanes take two [[sl:campaign_turns]]turns[[/sl]] to navigate for most, but the skilled navigators of certain seafaring [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]] only require a single turn to traverse a Sea Lane.

The Lost Sea Shanty is separated into three [[img:icon_shanty]][[/img]]verses, each carried by a different pirate [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lord[[/sl]]. [[sl:campaign_buildings]]Buildings[[/sl]] may be constructed within a settlement to boost its production or defences.

Shipbuilding is only available to [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Legendary Lords[[/sl]] of the Vampire Coast and Legendary Pirates found in the [[sl:campaign_technology]]Technology tree[[/sl]].
Small settlements without fortifications may be directly attacked or encircled in an attempt to starve the enemy out.
The defenders of a settlement under siege will eventually starve and surrender unless they sally or are relieved by a [[sl:campaign_reinforcements]]reinforcing army[[/sl]].
Different siege weapons are used to attack different parts of the settlement defences during [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]].

Skaven [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] [[img:icon_stalking_stance]][[/img]]stalk their enemies by default, giving them a chance to [[img:icon_ambush_stance]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_ambushes]]ambush[[/sl]] even when attacking normally.
Corruption in a province is shown on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]].

The Flesh Laboratory is accessed via the button in the bottom right of the main campaign interface. [[sl:campaign_unit_cards]]Unit cards[[/sl]] can be selected directly from Throt’s [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] to upgrade infantry and monsters with various Augments via the respective tabs.
The Forbidden Workshop can be accessed from the main campaign interface when playing as the Clan Skryre [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]].

Standard Skaven settlements are not ordinarily visible to other [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]], appearing instead as uninhabited [[sl:campaign_ruins]]ruins[[/sl]]. Skaven factions can always see each other’s settlements, but [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] of other races will not discover the Skaven threat within a ruin until they attempt to colonise there.

Accessible via the bottom right corner of the campaign interface, the Skull Throne panel allows you to spend [[img:icon_skulls]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_skulls]]Skulls[[/sl]] to gain powerful bonuses via special rituals.

[[img:icon_skulls]][[/img]]Skulls can be tracked via the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_skulls_counter]]counter[[/sl_tooltip]] and tooltip at the top of the main campaign interface when playing a Khornate faction.
The servants of Slaanesh may use their [[sl:campaign_seductive_influence]]Seductive Influence[[/sl]] to gain [[sl:campaign_diplomacy]]diplomatic[[/sl]] leverage over humans and elves that they meet.
The total number of [[img:icon_slaves]][[/img]]slaves, population changes and a breakdown of sources are shown via the figures and tooltip at the top of the main campaign interface.

[[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls are acquired by winning battles and razing settlements against all factions except [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentch[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]], or [[sl:campaign_daemons_of_chaos]]Daemons of Chaos[[/sl]], whose [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls have already been claimed.
The Spirit of Grungni is a unique Airship only available to Malakai Makaisson's army, which grants access to unique Airship buildings.

Norscan [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] require [[img:icon_nor_spoils]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_marauding]]Spoils[[/sl]] to occupy [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] outside of their homelands, which they earn by using their unique [[sl:campaign_post_battle_panel]]post-battle[[/sl]] option – [[i]]Pillage & Raze[[/i]].
Many stances are only available to armies of certain [[sl:campaign_races]]races[[/sl]].
The Strategic Overview shows a wider world-view, and may be used to assist with [[sl:campaign_faction_management]]faction management[[/sl]].

Only [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords of the [[sl:campaign_high_elves]]High Elves[[/sl]], the [[sl:campaign_dark_elves]]Dark Elves[[/sl]], or the [[sl:campaign_wood_elves]]Wood Elves[[/sl]] may construct the Shrine of the Widowmaker building at the Shrine of Khaine, from which the Sword of Khaine is acquired.

Taxed {{tr:icon_income}}income is mainly generated by economic [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_port]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_ports]]ports[[/sl]]. {{tr:icon_income}}Income to extort is mainly generated by economic [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_port]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_ports]]ports[[/sl]]. Left-click a technology on the panel to begin research towards it. Only one technology may be researched at a time.

Chaos [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] may advance the cause of their chosen God by spreading [[sl:campaign_chaos_corruption]]Chaos corruption[[/sl]] across the mortal world.

Additional uses of the ability can also be purchased on the [[sl:campaign_pre_battle_panel]]pre-battle panel[[/sl]] for most battles by expending [[img:icon_skaven_food]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_food]]food[[/sl]].
The Artefact Vault is part of the [[sl:campaign_forging_magic_items]]Forge[[/sl]] and can only be accessed when playing as Ironbrow’s Expedition.

[[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls are Dechala’s servants taken during her campaign which she uses to boost her [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]], and vital to the construction of her most powerful type of major settlement – [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces.

Throgg's Wintertooth [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]] can construct Troll Kingdom [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] to gradually increase the [[img:icon_troll_expansion]][[/img]]Troll King's Dominion, granting powerful army bonuses for Troll [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] and boosting Throgg's [[i]]Call the Monstrous Horde![[/i]] campaign action.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_tiger_court_link]]Tiger Court[[/sl_tooltip]] allows the Tiger Warriors to enhance their [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]], and other aspects of their campaign.

The [[sl:campaign_mortuary_cult]]Mortuary Cult[[/sl]] may be used by the Tomb Kings to craft magic [[sl:campaign_character_details]]items[[/sl]] and unlock [[sl:campaign_regiments_of_renown]]Regiments of Renown[[/sl]].
Tormentor’s Tributes are unique rewards available to Dechala's faction, viewed and purchased in the panel accessed via the bottom right of the main campaign interface.

The Seats of the Tower of Zharr can be viewed via the button on the main campaign interface. Claiming Seats requires [[img:icon_conclave_influence]][[/img]]Conclave Influence, which is gained through expanding territory and raising towers and temples.

[[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]]Trade agreements are generally only signed between factions where relations are good. [[img:icon_non-aggression_pact]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_non_aggression_pacts]]Non-aggression pacts[[/sl]] may be agreed or diplomatic gifts may be given to improve relations to a level where trade is feasible.
Treasure Maps may be gained from victory in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] or from [[sl:campaign_encounters_at_sea]]Encounters at Sea[[/sl]].
The {{tr:hp_campaign_treasury_panel_term}} is opened by clicking the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_treasury_button]]{{tr:hp_campaign_description_treasury_button_term}}[[/sl_tooltip]] on the user interface.

As the leader of a [[sl:campaign_factions]]faction[[/sl]], killing other faction leaders of the same race in battle will force their [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] to [[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_confederation]]confederate[[/sl]].

[[img:icon_trickster_cult]][[/img]]Trickster Cults co-exist with their host settlements via Trickster Cult buildings, which the Deceivers can establish [[sl:campaign_post_battle_options]]post-battle[[/sl]] or via [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_hero_actions]]Hero actions[[/sl]].

Once the turn is ended, other [[sl:campaign_factions]]factions[[/sl]] will then get the ability to move their [[sl:campaign_armies]]armies[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit units[[/sl]] and perform other actions.
The Tyrant's Demands panel allows Greasus Goldtooth to use [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_money]]money[[/sl]] to carry out eight unique campaign actions.
Only [[sl:campaign_dwarfs]]Dwarfs[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_greenskins]]Greenskins[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_skaven]]Skaven[[/sl]] can move using the Underway.

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_unholy_manifestations_panel]]Unholy Manifestations panel[[/sl_tooltip]] allows [[sl:campaign_khorne]]Khorne[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_nurgle]]Nurgle[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaanesh[[/sl]] and [[sl:campaign_tzeentch]]Tzeentch[[/sl]] factions to empower their forces via special rituals.
Select an army to show the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]], on which Unit Cards are displayed.
The selected army will move to the target if the two are not close enough to exchange units.
The experience level of a unit is shown in chevrons on its [[sl:campaign_unit_cards]]Unit Card[[/sl]].
Left-click on a Unit Card on the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]] to pin the unit's information on the Unit Info panel.
Similar units that have suffered casualties in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]] may be merged together by selecting both Unit Cards and clicking the merge option.
Unit Recruitment is performed from the [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment_panel]]Recruitment panel[[/sl]], which is opened from the [[sl:campaign_army_panel]]Army panel[[/sl]].

The [[sl_tooltip:campaign_local_recruitment_pool]]local[[/sl_tooltip]] and [[sl_tooltip:campaign_global_recruitment_pool]]global[[/sl_tooltip]] recruitment options display [[sl:campaign_unit_cards]]Unit Cards[[/sl]] representing [[sl:campaign_unit_types]]unit types[[/sl]] that may recruited by the selected army.
Active [[img:icon_replenishment]][[/img]]replenishment effects are indicated on the [[sl:campaign_unit_cards]]Unit cards[[/sl]] of a selected [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]].
Infantry units are tightly-packed bodies of soldiers that fight hand-to-hand.

Units cost [[sl:campaign_money]]{{tr:hp_campaign_money_term}}[[/sl]] to [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit[[/sl]], and also require a further payment [[sl:campaign_turns]]per-turn[[/sl]] for upkeep.
As Ursun lays dying within the Forge of Souls, his roars of pain cause [[sl:campaign_chaos_rifts]]rifts[[/sl]] to open between the corporeal world and the Realm of Chaos.

The Champion of Ulthuan panel is accessed via the button in the bottom right of the main campaign interface when playing as Tyrion, allowing the spending of [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_influence]]Influence[[/sl]] to perform unique actions beneficial to military operations on his campaign.
The most infamous pirates may seize [[img:icon_shanty]][[/img]]verses of the [[sl:campaign_sea_shanties]]Lost Sea Shanty[[/sl]].
The [[img:icon_vampiric_confederation]][[/img]]Confederation panel allows you to confederate the other Vampire leaders after meeting the requirements and paying the resource costs.

Vampires spread [[img:icon_corruption_vmp]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_vampiric_corruption]]Vampiric corruption[[/sl]] wherever they settle. Vampires will suffer [[img:icon_attrition]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_attrition]]attritional casualties[[/sl]] when moving through land areas not afflicted by Vampiric corruption.
Corruption in a [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]] is shown on the [[sl:campaign_province_info_panel]]Province Info panel[[/sl]].

The primary trait of a [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord of the Vampire Coast can be seen on the Details tab of the [[sl:campaign_character_details_panel]]Character Details panel[[/sl]]. The tooltip on the trait indicates actions that will increase that [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lord’s [[img:icon_loyalty]][[/img]]loyalty.

[[sl:campaign_vampires]]Vampiric[[/sl]] factions and [[sl:campaign_warriors_of_chaos]]the Warriors of Chaos[[/sl]] may take [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassals. [[sl:campaign_slaanesh]]Slaaneshi[[/sl]] factions may also vassalise human or Elvish factions that they have enticed through [[sl:campaign_seductive_influence]]Seductive Influence[[/sl]].
There are a number of different victory types which are shown on the Objectives panel.

Vampire Counts factions can detect hidden [[img:icon_vmp_lair]][[/img]]Vampire Lairs – which are unknown to their settlement owners – as the campaign map is revealed.\\n\\nOnce a Lair is discovered, they can gain control over it either by occupying the settlement or using the "Occupy Vampire Lair" [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero action (unlocked via [[img:icon_tech]][[/img]]technology).

A Call to Waaagh! can be made in any Greenskin campaign once enough [[img:icon_waaagh]][[/img]]Reputation is gained from fighting [[sl:campaign_battles]]battles[[/sl]] and razing [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]].
A declaration of war on a faction may also result in war with that faction’s [[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]]allies.

War co-ordination requests cost [[img:icon_allegiance]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_allegiance]]allegiance[[/sl]] when made between allies. [[sl:campaign_factions]]Factions[[/sl]] with [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]vassal states may assign war co-ordination requests to those states for free.

Warband Recruitment in each [[sl:campaign_provinces]]province[[/sl]] is affected by [[sl:campaign_settlement_climates]]climate[[/sl]], [[sl:campaign_corruption]]corruption[[/sl]], and [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]]. Unit availability is previewed via the tooltip on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_settlement_bars]]Settlement bar[[/sl_tooltip]] icon.

The [[img:icon_vmp_web_of_power]][[/img]]Web of Power panel allows Neferata and her Lahmian Vampires to execute manipulative actions that can affect friendly, allied, neutral and enemy armies, settlements and characters at the cost of [[img:icon_manipulation]][[/img]] [[sl:campaign_nef_manipulations_link]]Manipulation[[/sl]] in increasing amounts.
The Winds of Magic blow at varying strengths across different provinces, increasing or depleting the power reserves of armies stationed there.

The Winds of Magic may be altered on the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_winds_of_magic_manipulation_panel]]Winds of Magic Manipulation panel[[/sl_tooltip]]. Only the strength of the Winds of Magic in controlled [[sl:campaign_provinces]]provinces[[/sl]] may be manipulated.

Incantations are created within the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_witchs_hut_panel]]Witch's Hut panel[[/sl_tooltip]] to prepare Blessings and Curses for units in battles, benefitting the Daughters’ armies and weakening their enemies respectively.
Wood Elves may expand anywhere on the campaign map by capturing enemy [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] and constructing [[sl:campaign_asrai_lookouts]]Asrai Lookouts[[/sl]].
Ariel appears to aid all Wood Elf campaigns, except when playing as Drycha’s Wargrove of Woe.

Glamoured Elves are [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruited[[/sl]] normally from the appropriate recruitment [[sl:campaign_buildings]]buildings[[/sl]] with reduced combat stats but increased leadership.
Drycha players may summon spirits or beasts into a selected army by clicking the Wild Spirits & Beasts button at the bottom of the campaign interface.

Each time the Sisters win a [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]], Lord Daith grants them one Favour which can be used to receive gifts chosen from the [[img:icon_forge_of_daith]][[/img]]Forge of Daith panel.
The location and [[img:forest_health]][[/img]]health of the world’s Magical Forests can be viewed via the Worldroots button located in the bottom right corner of the main campaign interface.
A Wood Elf [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] can move through Worldroots by activating the Use Worldroots [[sl:campaign_stances]]stance[[/sl]].
The Challenges of Khorne appear within the map accessed via the button in the bottom right corner of the campaign interface.

When Wulfrik's [[sl:campaign_armies]]army[[/sl]] is at [[img:icon_transport_fleet]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_sea]]sea[[/sl]] near a  [[img:icon_port]][[/img]]port settlement, he can instantly travel to other visible port settlements using the [[i]]Seafang Travel[[/i]] button above his [[sl:campaign_character_info_panel]]Character Info panel[[/sl]].
Zones of control can be seen by placing the mouse cursor over an army or settlement.
Advice history can be navigated using the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_advice_history_buttons]]back and forwards buttons[[/sl_tooltip]] on the Advisor panel.

[[img:icon_grudges]][[/img]]Grudges are incurred by any non-Dwarfs who commit acts against any Dwarfs such as attacking, trespassing or treacherous [[sl:campaign_diplomacy_screen]]diplomacy[[/sl]]. Armies and settlements will display their incurred Grudges as numbers above them on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]], which can be settled by Dwarf factions who defeat them.

[[img:icon_allegiance]][[/img]]Allegiance is earned slowly over [[sl:campaign_turns]]time[[/sl]] while an [[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]]alliance is maintained. It may also be earned by completing certain [[sl:campaign_missions]]missions[[/sl]] that are issued when both factions have a mutual [[sl:campaign_war]]enemy[[/sl]].

Significant [[sl_tooltip:campaign_diplomacy_attitude_icons]]diplomatic standing[[/sl_tooltip]] must be built up between two factions before an [[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]]alliance proposal is likely to succeed. Such standing may be improved by agreeing and sticking to [[img:icon_non-aggression_pact]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_non_aggression_pacts]]non-aggression pacts[[/sl]] and [[img:icon_trade_agreement]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_trade]]trade[[/sl]] agreements, and via diplomatic gifts.

The Undead [[img:icon_general]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_lords]]Lords[[/sl]] of the [[sl:campaign_vampire_coast]]Vampire Coast[[/sl]] are hell-bent on controlling the creature. They compete with one another to secure the Star-metal Harpoon, the only weapon that can kill the monster.
The amount of [[img:icon_amber]][[/img]]Amber currently held is shown at the top of the screen on the campaign interface when playing as Wood Elves.
An army in [[img:icon_ambush_stance]][[/img]]ambush stance cannot move or [[sl:campaign_unit_recruitment]]recruit troops[[/sl]] without leaving the stance.

Armies that fight one another on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]] will meet in [[sl:campaign_battles]]battle[[/sl]]. The strength of an army is indicated on its banner shown in campaign.
An army switching between land and sea will not be able to move further on that [[sl:campaign_turns]]turn[[/sl]], unless they move through a [[img:icon_port]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_ports]]port[[/sl]].

[[img:icon_iron_favour]][[//img]]Iron Favour is awarded by the Iron Dragon for the completion of Ivory Road journeys, but also for conquering [[sl:campaign_settlements]]settlements[[/sl]] and defeating armies that are notable to him. Targets of interest are denoted by an Iron Favour amount displayed above them on the [[sl:campaign_campaign_map]]campaign map[[/sl]].

Certain actions, such as changing stance or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]][[sl:campaign_hero_actions]]Hero actions[[/sl]], consume or require a portion of the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_movement_range]]movement range[[/sl_tooltip]] of the selected army or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Hero.
