No sooner has Malekith issued his commandment to Felicion than word reaches him that Naggarond is under attack. A treacherous band of Skaven and their Marauder allies have taken advantage of the discord wrought by the comet's appearance to strike at the Dark Elf heartland.\\nCursing the perfidious ratmen, Malekith gathers his retinue and hurries back to the shore to mete out their punishment in person.

Lord Mazdamundi is now fully roused and ready to enact his interpretation of the Great Plan. The spawnings are gathering at City of the Sun, for he senses a disturbance in the Geomantic Web surrounding Hexoatl, his capital. Communing telepathically with his fellow Slann, Mazdamundi learns of the invasion of his jungles by an army of tribal warmbloods.\\nThe warmbloods in question are worshippers of the Ancient Enemy from the colony of Skeggi, notorious savages that dwell on the shores of the Lustria. Incited by the appearance of the comet, the Norse have launched an invasion of the Lustrian interior.

Queek Headtaker, the scion of Clan Mors, emerges from under the City of Pillars. Dispatched by Grey Seer Vulscreek at the behest of the Council of Thirteen, Warlord Queek and his forces are sent to a nest-lair under the ruined city of Yuatek, deep in the Southlands.\\n\\nQueek's task is to garner as much precious Warpstone as possible and repel a nascent invasion of hated Elf-things. The High Elf incursion is surely linked with the comet's appearance. In any case, Queek is thirsty for blood, and Elven blood flows the richest of all!

Ever-watchful for a chance to strike at their mortal enemies, the hateful Dark Elves have taken advantage of the discord wrought by the comet's appearance to launch an invasion of Ulthuan, the divine home of the High Elves. Lothern, the High Elf capital city and seat of the Phoenix King, is gravely threatened.\\nCursing his brother's absence, and with the few forces at his disposal, Tyrion marches south to lead the counterattack.

Victory! In a world of Chaos, a time of heroes - an age of war - you have overcome every challenge laid before you and faced down every foe bent upon your destruction. This strange and dangerous realm, riven with battle, bloodshed and slaughter, twisted beyond sanity by the warping power of Chaos, has seen the foundering of many a mighty empire, yet yours remains triumphant and unconquered, victorious in defiance of all!

In cities under your control across the world, citizens throng the streets to greet the dawning of a new age. Burghers, merchants, veterans, masters and apprentices, all raise their voices as one in a joyful shout of acclamation "For the Emperor! For Sigmar! For the Heldenhammer!"

Ptra is pleased, for the desert gods have returned and are a force in the world once again. Nehekhara is resurgent – the greatest of all civilisations returns to prominence and domination. The mightiest kings and queens sit upon thrones of bone and look down upon the living with jealous contempt. Now, the Realm of Souls splits asunder and the Day of Awakening is at hand!
Yet your empire is not bound by borders - yours spans the seas of the world. You top a hierarchy of infamy and power - your strength makes all those who traverse your waves tremble in fear.

For thousands of years, the Dark Elves have plundered the riches of the world, using the blood and treasure of distant lands to fuel their war against the High Elves and others. Millions groan under the yoke of their slavery, or choke out their last on the altars of the Bloody-handed God. Under your dominion, the empire of malice reigns supreme!

The High Elves have stood guard over this world for millennia, defending it from the worshippers of unholy gods and the unthinking meddling of lesser races. Now, under your stewardship, the Glittering Hosts have beaten these foes into retreat or oblivion. An age of peace dawns, founded on the glory of the Elves!

Long before the rise of the younger races, the Lizardmen ruled supreme. After countless disasters and aeons of decline you have led them to the brink of success, finally enacting the unfinished plans of their long-lost cosmic masters!

The warped history of the corrupted Skaven race lists their many attempts to overthrow and enslave the other civilisations under the iron claw of Skaven rule. Now, under your control, the verminous hordes seethe openly across the face of the world, chittering their triumph in praise of the Great Horned Rat!

Yet what is talk of empires to the destroyer of all civilisations? Let the shattered cities smoulder to ash, let briar and thorn reclaim their tumbled stones and bleached bones. Your warherds roam lands returned to their primal roots, braying a triumphant challenge to storm-wracked skies!

Yet your empire is not built from stones piled one upon another, on trade rooted in the sack of the land. Rather, it is the oldest empire of all; that of root and branch, leaf and bough. Its mighty hosts stretch unbroken from shore to shore once more, their deep roots anchoring the land, their song of triumph the whisper of leaves stirring in the breeze.

The men and monsters of the north have long sought to overthrow the civilisations of the south, but have always been thrown back to their frozen wastelands. But no more! Now, under your control, the Norscan hordes have been unleashed upon the Old World. The Chaos Gods gaze admiringly falls upon the leader of this cataclysmic event: you!

That which is sacrosanct has been preserved. That which is sublime has been protected. That which threatened has been destroyed. Your name and deeds of heroism will be remembered always. For Bretonnia, and for the Lady!

Yet your empire is not one of petty territory, rather it is an empire of blood and Chaos, where mighty champions rise and fall, striving ceaselessly against each other for the favour of the Dark Gods. And at their pinnacle you stand, mighty and unvanquished, Lord of All, and most favoured by the Gods of Chaos!

In Karaks reclaimed according to the oaths laid down in the Great Book of Grudges, and in countless other mining colonies, trading posts, villages and great cities across the world, your people throng the halls in celebration, and many a horn of ale is raised on high to join the drinking songs and the fierce voices crying "Vengeance is ours!"

Whilst other races have shown nothing but weakness, wasting their time on nonsense such as honour and duty, the Greenskins have followed their nature, given to them by Gork (and Mork), striving against each other until none but the mightiest remain to engulf the world in an endless Waaagh!

Under your command, legions of the living have been relieved of the burden of life's struggle, and raised again into your eternal service. Those still permitted to cling to the misery of life are now as cattle, prey to the depraved hunger of your numberless dark servants, whose triumphant shrieks pierce the eternal night!

The High Elves have enacted their final ritual. Their feeble Phoenix King will once again own the Vortex, and their kingdoms shall be shielded by that traitor, Caledor Dragontamer! If you are to bring about the absolute destruction of the Asur and their homeland, then the invasion of the Isle of the Dead must begin! You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your enemies, and stop the High Elves from claiming victory!

The Lizardmen have enacted their final ritual. Their cold-blooded armies arrive on the Isle of the Dead to claim the Great Vortex - the prize that is rightfully yours. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Lizardmen from claiming victory!

The Skaven have enacted their final ritual. The hordes of Queek Headtaker swarm onto the Isle of the Dead where they will attempt to take control of the Great Vortex. The vermin think to rob us of our vengeance and to claim the Vortex before you. They must be purged from hated Ulthuan. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Skaven from claiming victory!

The goblet brims with the lifeforce of victims claimed by your sorcerous vassal and her assassin. Now is the time to move on hated Ulthuan and claim the power of the Vortex! The other races sense the peril and converge to stop you! Yet the vermin have been enacting their own devious, world-shattering plot. Under the shackles of the Council of Thirteen, the Grey Seer Clan fight for dominance of the Vortex. Using power stolen from all the rituals enacted thus far, they plan to transform the Vortex into a portal and summon forth their Horned God from the Realm of Decay. The Vortex is your tool for ultimate vengeance; the Skaven must be stopped - prepare for the ultimate battle!

The greatest of all fears has come true, the Druchii have enacted their final ritual. The legions of the Witch King defile Ulthuan’s heart. Malekith intends to step into the Vortex and claim its power, which will surely mean the end of the Asur! You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Dark Elves from claiming victory!

The Lizardmen have enacted their final ritual. The cohorts of Lord Mazdamundi have invaded Ulthuan – they wish to control the Vortex, a creation of the Asur! Their goals are not the same as ours; the ancient Mage-Priest could easily decide to sink Ulthuan beneath the sea in order to permanently safeguard the Vortex. It has to be returned into the care of the High Elves. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Lizardmen from claiming victory!

The Skaven have enacted their final ritual. The hordes of Queek Headtaker swarm onto the Isle of the Dead where they will attempt to take control of the Great Vortex. That they befoul the heart of Ulthuan is crime enough, but should the vermin take control of the Vortex, it will surely mean doom for the world. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Skaven from claiming victory!

At the very heart of Ulthuan, upon the Isle of the Dead, the greatest of all battles must be fought. Enemies from many realms gather, ready for war. Under the shackles of the Council of Thirteen, the Grey Seer Clan fight for dominance of the Vortex. Using power stolen from all the rituals enacted thus far, they plan to transform the Vortex into a portal and summon forth their Horned God from the Realm of Decay. The Star Crown is now re-forged and so the Vortex can be saved, but first the Skaven must be stopped - prepare for the ultimate battle!

The Dark Elves have enacted their final ritual. These lost servants have long since forgotten their original purpose and consort with Daemon-spawn. Their first generation marches on the Vortex, and will consume its power. This has been foreseen in the lost plaques of Tlanxla and it cannot be allowed. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Dark Elves from claiming victory!

The High Elves have enacted their final ritual. They have proven inadequate caretakers of the Great Vortex. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the High Elves from claiming victory!

The Skaven have enacted their final ritual. The hordes of Queek Headtaker swarm onto the Isle of the Dead where they will attempt to take control of the Great Vortex. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your enemies, and stop the Skaven from claiming victory!

The Great Warding is bolstered and the Geomantic energies flow once more. The Lords of Decay will blame you! You have to thwart the Reptile-things before it is too late… or at least until another candidate can be found to blame. You must immediately muster on the cursed shores of the island that anchors the Vortex, make temporary alliances with your most bitter of enemies, and stop the Lizard-things from claiming victory!

The Machine of Doom and Curses is ready! The Grey Seer Clan and their masters on the Council of Thirteen tried to betray you… but now, thanks to the scribe’s wrath, it is the Grey Seer’s blood imprinted on the unholy bell’s Warpstone clapper! And so the Grey Seer Clan shall be sacrificed - consumed by the Horned Rat on His arrival. Upon the Isle of the Dead, in the heart of hated Ulthuan, the machine begins its work - turning the Vortex into a portal from which your god shall emerge. The other races sense the peril and converge to stop you. Above all, the Grey Seers send their minions - desperate to halt the Great Ascendancy. The unholy bell must toll thirteen times - prepare for the ultimate battle!
Those sacrificed to the Lady of Desire go willingly to their deaths. Such appeasement enthrals the masses.
The Mistress of Magic is very choosy about who is sacrificed to her - only those touched by sorcery may be offered. In return, she brings the Winds of Magic.
The victims of Khaine cannot go meekly to His halls; it must be bloody-handed murder. But once the blood is flowing from whence will it stop?
The slaves are brought to the altar of Mathlann, Lord of the Deeps; their sacrifice ensures the seas are for the Druchii alone.
The Creator, greatest upon the Mandala; his name alone can calm princes, tame courts and embolden all.
Lord of Wisdom, God of Learning and Sorcery. Those who invoke him gain precious insight and may divine the Winds of Magic.
The Mother Goddess, purity is her virtue. The tears she weeps for her children can cleanse the land of any taint.
The Maker, patron of Elven smiths. Items bearing his mark are the greatest of their kind.
Send an intervention force of low quality units to target the ritual sites.
Send an intervention force of medium quality units to target the ritual sites.
Send an intervention force of high quality units to target the ritual sites.
Awakening a Mage-Priest from his contemplation must not be done lightly, but those that are roused add their unfathomable power to the great purpose.
An ancient observance that invigorates those reptiles who oppose trespassers, intruders and servants of the Ancient Enemy.
The Slann summon the fauna of Lustria; the beasts of the jungle shall answer.
Invoking the Serpent-God makes the jungles themselves turn against the intruders and interlopers who dare invade His realm.
Provoke the brood-mothers, have them breed-breed! We will flood the over-world with our bodies! Yes-Yes!
Yes-yes, a scheme of great DOOOOM! Send an agent of Skryre to cause great calamity on the things!
Good-good! Further agenda of Arch Plaguelord Nurglitch, summon his agent-minion and let-let the choicest of plagues ravage the world.
The Lords of Decay have spoken! We-we invoke their scheme - the Thirteenth Plot - all Skavendom must unite against things!
Low-ranked Beastmasters are always keen to prove themselves to the Beastlord, doing his bidding in the hope that they may ascend their standing within his cadre.
You can choose to see Lords and Heroes from different camera angles and speed up their animations.

By default, you will see every Lord and Hero moving around the map. Use these settings to pick which factions, Lords and Heroes you want to focus on. This can hasten and optimise the end turn sequence.
You can decide how much cargo the Caravan should take west. The more cargo, the greater the reward you will receive if it reaches its destination.
After choosing your initial route, click the Dispatch button to send the Caravan and return to the campaign map. Remember to return and check on the progress of your Caravans.

This panel displays your Caravans. They can be sent along the [[sl_tooltip:campaign_ivory_road_panel]]Ivory Road[[/sl_tooltip]] from Cathay to the west. If a Caravan reaches its destination, you will receive a large reward.
Use these buttons to apply the settings to entire categories.

Access the Wu Xing Compass to view the Jade Court’s expanded array of options and their potential benefits for Cathay.

To activate a different set of compass effects, click on any unlocked compass direction.\\n\\nThe four directions native to Grand Cathay are already available from the start. Once unlocked, the Jade Court’s unique directions can be activated here in the same way.

As the Administrator of the Realm, Yuan Bo is able to harness the full potential of the Wu Xing Compass by unlocking four unique and powerful compass directions.\\n\\nTo unlock them, Astromantic Relay buildings must be constructed in specific settlements.\\n\\nLeft-clicking the icons at the top of the screen pans the camera to the required settlements' locations. The tooltips provide information about each direction’s effects.

An overview of the current energy reserves for all compass directions can be found here.\\n\\nAs with the standard Wu Xing Compass, channeling the Winds for a chosen direction increases its reserves and in turn its granted bonuses – but over time the reserve of other directions will decay.
During the end turn sequence, you can pause the game by pressing this button.
Alternatively, you can press this to make the end turn sequence as fast as possible. If you do this, no movement will be tracked.

A new form has been obtained by the Changeling!\\n\\nThe Formless Horror feature allows the Changeling to shapeshift into other Legendary Lords and Heroes in battle. Left-click on the Formless Horror button to learn more.

Obtained forms are listed here, viewable by race and sortable by unit statistic.\\n\\nHovering over or left-clicking any form displays its details such as unit statistics, abilities and spells. Left-click any form to learn more.
The Changeling can only assume one chosen form at a time for use in battle. After selecting the desired form from the list, confirm your choice here.

Now that a Blessing is available, you can drag and drop it onto one of your units here in the pre-battle screen to bestow its effects in battle.
Curses that can debilitate your enemies will appear here once created in the Witch's Hut. Drag and drop a Curse onto an enemy to afflict them during the battle.
The Caravans you can dispatch are displayed here. You can see its level and the number of [[sl:campaign_units]]units[[/sl]] that will protect it.
Hovering over any available Matters of State action reveals further details such as the type of target required and the action’s effects.
Once you perform the action, the resource requirement will be expended and added to the other in a pending state until it becomes usable again.

{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_matters_of_state}}\\n\\nWhen a [[img:icon_mos_steel]][[/img]]Steel or [[img:icon_mos_stone]][[/img]]Stone token is used for an action, it transfers to the other resource in an unusable pending state which lasts a number of turns. Winning battles reduces the number of turns tokens stay in a pending state.
Left-clicking an action then requires a target to be selected, if any, before confirmation.

Power among the Dawi-Zharr requires the respect of the Conclave of Evil; those who achieve status cannot hope to retain it without their backing. Having worked so hard to earn recognition, it would be a shame to have it ruined by a bitter rival's sabotage.\\n\\nEnsure the path to glory is unhindered; put the agents of your competitors to the blade, and end their interference once and for all.

A wretched agent of the Chaos Dwarfs has been spotted lurking around our lands, no doubt hoping to obtrude on the business of Cathay! Whatever schemes those damned fire worshippers have drawn up must be ended quickly. There's no telling the damage they could do should they interfere with the work of the Dragons!\\n\\nIt is time to do what must be done. Slay this Dwarfen pest, and end the threat before it even rears its head!

A pathetic spy of the Dark Lands seeks to meddle in our affairs! Whatever they're planning, it ends now. Hunt down this wretched Dwarfling threat, and parade their body before our kin. Only then will these interlopers know to fear the Daemonic tide!

The worshippers of Hashut continue to make a nuisance of themselves, as their agents threaten our bloody work in their fool lord's name. Khorne will not stand for this, and neither will we!\\n\\nIt's time we plucked an agent of those pathetic Chaos Dwarfs from hiding and tore them in two! That will send a clear message to any others seeking to interfere in our business.

The Chaos Dwarfs grow too bold! They take far too much interest in Kislev and our thriving empire of ice and snow. That can only mean trouble looms. Best to snuff it out, before the danger has chance to grow.\\n\\nSlay this foul agent of the Dark Dwarfs, so they may no longer lurk where they are unwanted.

The smoke-charred worshippers of Hashut have deluded themselves into believing they pose a threat to us. Though an amusing misapprehension, this foolishness could prompt them to action. You must punish them for their arrogance! Ensure their agent succumbs to disease, and make it clear they will all fall to our empire of filth!

If the agents of the Dark Lands truly believe they cannot be seduced from their path, they are more foolish than they look! This has not stopped them trying, however, by sending agents to ruin our sweet temptations wherever they are able.\\n\\nThis cannot go on. It's time to respond to one of their agents with the flair and finesse of Slaanesh. Let them succumb to debauchery once and for all!

If it's Change the Chaos Dwarfs fear, it's Change we'll give them! No longer will their prying agents obtrude on our weaving of fate, while trying so desperately to escape their own.\\n\\nSoon the Great Conspirator will teach these Hell-Dwarfs that our plots are far more intricate than their own. Flush out their agents wherever they hide and put an end to them. Permanently!

Though the Dark Dwarfs pledge themselves to Chaos, they and their Hell-forged forces remain blind to all but their Father of Darkness. Instead of offering their flesh and blood in sacrifice to the true rulers of Chaos, they interfere in the affairs of their children.\\n\\nOur tribes cannot let this stand! We must send our blades into the dark, to cut down the agents of Hashut for corruption's sake!

Our empire will only stagnate under the control of the brainless wazzocks that currently compete for power. Far better our ziggurats be guided by a more capable hand.\\n\\nThe best course of action seems clear: seize the land of your hapless rival. It is the only way to restore control over the region and erase the stain of incompetence the fool has left on our legacy.

The so-called 'Infernal Empire' of the Dark Lands has grown arrogant beyond belief. They think themselves untouchable, and it seems even our past skirmishes along the Ivory Road have done little to quell their conceit.\\n\\nIt is long past time they learned the true threat of Cathay. Bring the full might of the Dragons down upon them, and add their land to our ever-growing realm!

The Dark Lands are no stranger to Daemonic influence, for the Chaos Dwarfs have long made use of our strength. Bound to their every whim, they see us as no more than useful tools, to fuel their hellish machinery.\\n\\nWe must remind these creatures of their place. When we conquer their strongholds and take their land for ourselves, they will soon remember that our Daemonic hordes are the true heirs of Chaos!

Every bloodthirsty, conquering empire must have room to grow. Ours is no different, yet the Dark Dwarfs seek to bar our path. Bring the armies of Khorne down upon them and force these fools from their lands. The Lord of Skulls will have blood this day – we will squash these Dwarfen bugs and let Khorne feast amid the carnage of our victory!

The evil empire of the Chaos Dwarfs is a continuous threat to our kingdom of ice and snow. The Motherland demands their cruelties be ended, in the name of protecting our people. It is time to rally our armies, and seize their land at once. Go forth and let the cool winds of Kislev snuff out their hellish flame!

The followers of Hashut continue to pollute the land with their smoky stench. Such a waste. The Urfather demands that the reeking miasma of disease should pervade the air instead!\\n\\nConquer this Dwarfen scourge. Their land will be the foundation for a whole new plethora of sickness and plague!

The dark devotees of Hashut hold lands that should be ours, toiling in their industry where indulgence and luxury should rule. They have long overstayed their welcome!\\n\\nNow the Prince of Pleasure's command is clear; wipe their factories and forges from the map and claim the region for our revelry. It is time the Father of Darkness learned that Slaanesh is to be revered and worshipped.

The influence of Hashut is felt across the land, as the insufferable Fire-Dwarfs gain more territory to call their own. Every bit of land they capture is sure to feed their wretched god, whose flames will no doubt reduce the Conspirator's plans to cinders.\\n\\nDeprive the Father of Darkness of this power. Conquer the region and claim the land for the warriors of Change!

Not all among the our kin are worthy to bear the name of Uzkul-Dhrath-Zharr; their very existence is a blemish on our infernal empire's glory. In such cases, the best outcome for our people is to remove these parasites entirely.\\n\\nCall your armies to war. It's time to let every sorry excuse for a Dawi-Zharr know that their end is coming!

The Chaos Dwarfs continue to be a thorn in our side, one that must be plucked and discarded. Their 'Industrial Empire' is nothing next to the shining glory of Grand Cathay, nor is their precious Father of Darkness a match for the Celestial Dragon.\\n\\nDeclare war on those infernal miscreants; soon they will be crushed beneath a mighty draconian claw!

When the Hell-Workers use their sorcery to bind our kin to their will, they force us to serve only as slaves to their every whim. We must send our armies against those pathetic Fire-Dwarfs! Show them our cruelty far surpasses their own, and make it clear the Daemons of Chaos will never belong in bonds!

The Blood God craves the slaughter of war! Perhaps the corrupted Dwarfs of the Dark Lands will make worthy targets for our sport – their screams will surely satisfy our dark master.\\n\\nDeclare war and rain the fury of Khorne down on their empire. It's time to collect their skulls for the Skull Throne!

There is no doubt the Chaos Dwarfs pose a growing threat; if left unchecked their power could prove impossible to overcome. We must freeze their infernal factories, to stop the production of their gruesome war machines before they are turned in our direction.\\n\\nSummon your armies for battle – the kingdom of ice must overcome the empire of smoke and flame.

The toiling masses sworn to Hashut are an affront to the Plague Lord, for as their industry spreads, the power of their dark father only grows.\\n\\nWe have no choice but to let sickness stop their influence. Declare war on these grasping Fire-Dwarfs, and bless them all with the reeking, putrid poxes of Grandfather Nurgle!

The Chaos Dwarfs continue to resist our alluring seductions, remaining annoyingly adamant in their steadfast commitment to Hashut. If subtlety is lost on them, then war will have to suffice! We must bring our blades to bear upon these heathen hordes, and finally show them the beauty of Slaanesh in battle!

The nefarious schemes of the Great Conspirator continue to be scuppered by the blasted Hell-Dwarfs of the Dark Lands. The great Architect of Fate will not be pleased!\\n\\nWe must facilitate their downfall through any means necessary. Challenge them to face us in battle and rain the sorceries of Tzeentch down upon them!

The Chaos Dwarfs have power and riches hidden away in their smoke-filled kingdom. It's time we took it from them – by any means necessary.\\n\\nCall the disciples of Chaos to war. The hordes of the north will sweep over the Dark Lands in the name of conquest, and take whatever we please!

Establishing dominance as Hashut's greatest disciple requires the annihilation of those that would seek to claim the same. They are merely a hindrance to our empire's growth – the Dawi-Zharr will be better off without them!\\n\\nTake to the battlefield and decimate their armies, and above all, ensure that their feckless leader dies with them!

The Chaos Dwarfs continue to make nuisances of themselves. Hoping to pose a real threat, their generals advance, inspiring their forces with faith in Hashut's eventual triumph against the immortal Dragons.\\n\\nIf we are to crush the spirits of their armies, we must eliminate these leaders in battle, and expose their rousing words as the baseless lies they are!

An arrogant Chaos Dwarf general gathers the legions of the Dark Lands to their cause, hoping to lead their forces to victory against us! As laughable as the idea is, the mortals seem to believe triumph is inevitable. It's time we proved them wrong.\\n\\nRally the Daemonic brood to battle and slay this boastful general as proof of our hell-spawned superiority!

The armies of the Chaos Dwarfs believe themselves unstoppable when spilling blood for their Father of Darkness. The most dedicated and powerful of his forces has risen through the ranks, serving as a savage exemplar of the supposed power of their God.\\n\\nNothing would demoralise Zharr-Naggrund's armies more than taking to the battlefield, and making a bloody example of such a powerful figurehead.

Such a glorious empire as ours was always bound to earn itself some powerful enemies. The stunted fools of the Dark Lands are among them, no doubt plotting the fall of the Motherland as we speak!\\n\\nPut an end to their advances by slaying one of their leaders in battle. Destroying such a beacon of might will no doubt demoralise their hellish forces.

The unworthy masses of Zharr-Naggrund seek to spread their wretched industry throughout the land, creating an endless empire of fire and ash. Urged on by mighty generals, their armies have even dared to point their blades in the direction of Nurgle's children!\\n\\nThese self-righteous leaders must be made to answer for their audacity. Meet them in battle, and make their bodies rot beneath the onslaught of illness!

One of the Hashut's more dangerous devotees has set their sights on the Prince of Pleasure's lustful protégés. While such insolence is to be expected from the arrogant wretches of the Dark Lands, the insult must be answered with force all the same.\\n\\nCall the armies of indulgence to war and slaughter this arrogant enemy before the eyes of their followers. That will surely be enough to appease Slaanesh!

The glory of Tzeentch was always bound to be threatened by those envious of our schemes. Now that threat has finally reared its head; a dangerous general has arisen from among the worshippers of Hashut, and they have set their sights on the Changer of Ways.\\n\\nTake to the battlefield and put an end to this worthless foe – only then will our arcane secrets be safe.

The Dark Dwarfen hordes attack with unflinching audacity, led by a mighty general who leaves blood and carnage in their wake. We cannot allow the ourselves to be outdone in merciless savagery. Slay this fool in battle and prove the Warriors of Chaos remain unmatched, and that we will not be laid to waste so easily!

The path to power is never easy. Ambition was always bound to make enemies among our kin. Now such enemies rise against you, gathering in force in the hopes of halting your journey permanently. These ingrates must be dealt with!\\n\\nMeeting their army in open conflict is the surest way to end their threat; they'll cause no more trouble once their warriors have been trampled under foot!

The armies of Zharr-Naggrund grow bolder each day, driven by arrogance and envy. Their empire cannot hope to match the might of our own, yet the threat they pose to Cathay cannot go unaddressed.\\n\\nThe time for caution is over; let the Dragons take flight to meet this deadly scourge on the field of battle!

Zharr-Naggrund's Daemonsmiths hunger for more bodies to bind to their hellish machinery, and they aim to target the Daemonic hordes to do it.\\n\\nIt's nothing a little slaughter won't fix! Engage their forces in battle. Make it clear the Daemons of Chaos will massacre every Chaos Dwarf in the Dark Lands before we serve as fuel for their machines!

The forces of the Fire-Dwarfs grow larger with each passing day, gathering more warriors to their empire's industrious cause. They cannot be allowed to bolster their strength any further – not while the Blood God demands their deaths!\\n\\nThe forces of Khorne must march to war at once. Take to the battlefield and anoint your weapons in corrupted Dwarfen blood!

Hashut's dark fire is the antithesis of the Ice Magic of Kislev. Its very existence is an insult to the Motherland, one that must be snuffed out for good!\\n\\nThe battlefield beckons. Engage the forces of Zharr-Naggrund and ensure the Lore of Ice will forever douse the destruction of Hashut's malevolent flame!

Disease and sickness run rampant as our forces continue their march. Wherever we go, ailment and suffering follow, empowering the Lord of Pestilence.\\n\\nOne day, even the Tower of Fire and Desolation must fall to the Plague Lord's virulent maladies, yet the stubborn Chaos Dwarfs still stand in our way. Challenge their forces; it is long past time they succumbed to our plague.

Slaanesh represents indulgence and exhilaration – a direct contradiction to the laborious toil of those gloomy Chaos Dwarfs. Their way of life is built on the blood and sweat of endless diligence. It's time we freed them from their dreary work!\\n\\nDestroy these miserable Dark Dwarfs and prove excess will always overpower industry!

We agents of Tzeentch weave our conniving plots, manipulating fates and facilitating Change. Yet the Chaos Dwarfs seek to interfere in our plans, meddling with things they cannot hope to understand.\\n\\nTzeentch will be most displeased should we let these miscreants intervene. March our forces to battle and put an end to these tinkering Fire-Dwarfs once and for all.

The wretched Dark Dwarfs must be taught a lesson. These troublesome engineers pledge themselves to their Father of Darkness, yet dismiss the greatest dark forces of them all. The Chaos Gods demand retribution!\\n\\nSend out the war parties and ready your blades. It is time for bloodshed; these Chaos Dwarfs must pay for their insolence with their very souls!

One of your rivals brazenly marches against us, hoping to capture land that is rightfully ours! Now blood and fire must be answered with the same – the Father of Darkness demands it!\\n\\nSend your army against these traitorous Skruffs and make them pay. They have earned their deaths a hundred times over!

The malevolent Dwarfs of the Dark Lands have struck out at our territory, threatening the very heart of the Celestial Empire! Their forces march on our lands with haste, shedding the blood of everything in their path.\\n\\nThis outrage must be answered for! Halt their army in its tracks and slaughter them to the last Dwarf. Let them know they have awoken the wrath of the Dragons!

The Chaos Dwarfs have grown far too confident! They invade our corrupted lands with malicious glee, massacring all our kin in their way. Pride demands we tear them limb from limb, and use their broken bodies as decorations for our strongholds!\\n\\nFace their army before they can cause any more damage, and put a brutal stop to this poorly-planned invasion!

Khornate blood has been spilled in the name of Hashut, as an invading army of his conniving Chaos Dwarfs advances on our lands. We cannot allow ourselves to be beaten by these pathetic wretches!\\n\\nDestroy this invading force at once! Their mangled bodies will be a message to all: beware the fury of Khorne!

The Motherland is under attack! The Chaos Dwarfs descend on our homes, wielding their monstrous engines of war against our people. Such a brazen display of cruelty must be answered with cold and righteous fury!\\n\\nMarch against these malicious fools. Soon all that will be left of them is blood and regret!

The stubborn Chaos Dwarfs have dared to invade us, sweeping through our lands seeking to undo our putrid work. Their hardy constitutions help them fight off even the most abhorrent of sicknesses, leaving them bereft of Nurgle's unclean blessing. We must rectify this at once!\\n\\nMeet the Dark Dwarfen armies head on, to ensure their empire finally succumbs to malaise and malady.

It seems the forces of the Chaos Dwarfs could not resist encroaching on our territory, tempted by conquest like the slaves to indulgence they are, even as they try to deny it! They think their armies will overpower us. Instead the Prince of Pleasure will delight in their slaughter.\\n\\nCharge against these fools and halt them in their tracks – Slaanesh will ensure we are rewarded!

The armies of Zharr-Naggrund approach at speed, aiming to tear our strongholds to the ground. No doubt Hashut seeks to supplant the Changer of Ways in these lands – it cannot be allowed!\\n\\nStop this army before they can advance any further. Show them their dark god has only led them to their graves, for this ridiculous invasion is destined for failure!

The Chaos Dwarfs have dared to venture towards the Northern Wastes, threatening our lands with every advance. These blasted Fire-Dwarfs must be dealt with swiftly before they can take our rightly-raided goods!\\n\\nCrush the invading army – let these Chaos Dwarfs feel the brutality of our vengeance!

Those who bring shame to Hashut are no true Dawi-Zharr. All they are good for is entertainment, for our Dark Father will surely delight in their suffering!\\n\\nSend a raiding force among these worthless pretenders and strip them of everything they have. It will be of far more use in our hands anyway.

No empire can function without resources, even one built before the Dragon Emperor's awe-inspiring gaze. Should we turn our attentions to the west, we might find the goods we seek. The evil Chaos Dwarfs hoard a large bounty, ripe for redistribution.\\n\\nSend our raiding party into the Dark Lands, and return with a haul worthy of our empire!

Our Sorcerers always need more for their Dark Magic – blood, bodies, sacrifice and power – all is necessary in tapping into the arcane mysteries of Chaos. The Chaos Dwarfs are sure to have all that and more. All we need do is take it.\\n\\nLaunch a raid on the Dark Dwarfs' lands so our Daemonic conquest might continue in its expansion.

The Chaos Dwarfs have gathered an impressive stockpile of wealth and materials, either mined from the Dark Lands, or ripped from the helpless hands of their numerous victims. Such a cache would serve us well in expanding Khorne's armies. It's an opportunity we cannot miss!\\n\\nRaid the region when the Dark Dwarfs will least expect it and snatch their reserves out from under them!

Our spies have sent word from the Dark Lands, where the Chaos Dwarfs supposedly hoard a treasure trove of resources for their infernal industry. Since they would have no qualms in stealing from our stores, we would be fools not to return the favour and relieve them of their prize.\\n\\nRaid the Chaos Dwarfs' stockpile – whatever we find will be used for the Motherland!

The armies of Zharr-Naggrund have grown lax in the occupation of their lands, focusing more on their hellish industry than on defending their possessions. From their carelessness arises opportunity... We only need reach out and seize it!\\n\\nRaid the fools while their attentions are diverted and take all they have for the unholy glory of the Urfather!

The Chaos Dwarfs' dreadfully dull obsession with their industry might prove useful to us yet, as they amass a growing heap of treasures to build their war machines. How kind of them, to gather all their wealth together for us!\\n\\nA decisive raid on the region would prove very profitable indeed. The Fire-Dwarfs will not miss a few baubles, claim them for Slaanesh instead!

The forces of Tzeentch grow exhausted, as our resources begin to dwindle. A disastrous outcome indeed, for without supplies our Sorcerers cannot hope to influence the Winds of Change!\\n\\nWe must set out raiding for wealth and resources before such an event can come to pass. Perhaps the Chaos Dwarfs are hiding a worthwhile supply...

We Warriors of Chaos are no strangers to raiding; stealing away the rewards of another's toil has always been our way of life. Now, as our stocks begin to look sparse, we must look for new victims for our savagery.\\n\\nConduct a raid on the lands of the Chaos Dwarfs – their thriving industry can only mean they possess a wealth of treasures worth taking!

Our empire is being dragged down by an obvious weak link – a rival for power whose every action is an embarrassment to our kind. It's time they were shown what the true strength of the Dawi-Zharr should look like!\\n\\nAssault their walls and rain the fire of Hashut down upon them, until their home is little more than a ransacked ruin!

Our armies grow restless, no doubt yearning to visit righteous vengeance on our enemies. After all, we cannot allow our foes to think us weak!\\n\\nFor now, the Chaos Dwarfs work diligently in the Dark Lands, entirely unafraid of our power. It is time we reminded them of the Dragons' dominance. Ravage their monstrous ziggurats so they may never rest easy again!

A group of particularly brave and foolish Chaos Dwarfs venture out from their ziggurats, determined to make a nuisance of themselves in our lands. Their arrogance and pride will be their undoing, for our vengeance will be brutal and inescapable.\\n\\nSack their ziggurat to send a message. Or better yet, put it to the torch and let it be devoured by the malignant flames of Chaos!

There is little more satisfying than wreaking havoc among the Chaos Dwarfs. They believe they have a monopoly on cruelty and killing, yet Khorne spurs His followers to far greater acts of savagery!\\n\\nThe only message these Fire-Dwarfs will understand is one written in blood. Pillage one of their ziggurats – they'll soon remember their place!

The arcane fire of the Father of Darkness hungers to burn living flesh and melt away the ice of the Motherland. We must send a clear message that such a thing will never come to pass!\\n\\nEngulf their ziggurats in ice and snow, destroying everything in your path. Do not rest until their factories have been plundered and left to crumble!

Our mighty, reeking herd has clashed with the Chaos Dwarfs many times in the past, and with each encounter Hashut's worshippers have grown more confident. If they are left to fester in their arrogance, it will not be long before they are taking the challenge to the Plague Lord Himself!\\n\\nRemind these wretches of their place. Sack one of their settlements or raze it to the ground – either way, Nurgle will be pleased.

For too long the Chaos Dwarfs have languished in hiding, enjoying the spoils of their industry in the relative safety of their ziggurats. Their isolation must come to an end, for Slaanesh longs to hear them scream.\\n\\nBring the flames of Chaos down upon them, and finally put an end to the halcyon days spent hiding behind their walls!

Our Sorcerers study the darkest secrets of magic, twisting arcane energies into the malevolent tools of our will. Now Tzeentch demands we put such mastery to use in His name!\\n\\nThe Chaos Dwarfs would serve as worthy targets. They have served as the enemies of Change one too many times, and now they must pay the price. Assault their base of power, and leave only decimation in your wake!

The Chaos Dwarfs have established a strong and unwelcome presence, continuously churning out new engines of war that could soon be turned against us! A clear message must be sent before they can take us by surprise.\\n\\nRoot them out of their ziggurats at once, and leave only barren ruins behind!

[[i]]This most violent of dances depicts the final battle and Twilight of the Gods, Rhan'k'adanra. An advanced arrangement when only a climactic ending will do, these masterful movements are saved for the most difficult battles against larger and more powerful foes.[[/i]]

[[i]]Loec!... His crude aspect mocks our Prince's incomparable gifts at every step! Grace and gaiety, subtlety and shadow? He has no more of that than a foxling staggering through forest foliage. He crawls along the depthless void and steals those souls that should have fallen in Slaanesh's grasp.[[/i]]\\n\\n[[i]]But luck shall not avail him in the end. Careless steps will carry him into that same grasp where princely fingers will close on him like a cage, as befits a lowly animal.[[/i]]

[[i]]Oh, how the howling hound does gnash his teeth upon his charnel throne to always stem the flow of our delight! From the dimmest "then" in the depths of time, and ever on, he hated, hates, will hate our master. Yet it is The Prince, and us, that lead the dance of Chaos.\\n\\nLet Khorne, rage-bound, bring to bear any measure of might – for we will equally oppose it, as we were made to do. Hate is Chaos – we allow it! – yet Chaos is not merely Hate. We have prevailed against the Hound, and will again.[[/i]]

[[i]]Ah, to sup amidst the putrid disarray of the Fly Lord's garden, and sweeten its malodorous fumes with our incense! We will weed out Nurgle's rot-ridden "experiments" and plant a *true* garden to Slaanesh's darkling delight.[[/i]]\\n\\n[[i]]Fire will precede the fine fruits of our tending, which shall be ours to savour.[[/i]]

[[i]]This tableau of spasmodic movements tells the story of one of Slaanesh’s great victories over Khorne. Vicious and reckless movements make up attacks with increased damage at the cost of survivability, encouraging swift victories over slow and resistant foes.[[/i]]

[[i]]Our Final Dance will be fierce with the knowledge that then we dance no more. And so, we'll seek to spend ourselves all at once. A maddened squall will carry us, to burst the seas from their seams, and lift the earth into the sky, and make the air shimmer in the heat-haze of our passion. We'll spin, and spin, and spin – and cease.[[/i]]\\n\\n[[i]]The final curtain will drop upon all worlds and all time. And yet, our Prince will have the final word, a question – beyond all space, after all time, might there be more?[[/i]]

The quarry's absence hangs heavy, but clearly it was here – and there is a trail showing the way to where it may have moved on. Rankled by frustration, some of the hunters seem ready to press on immediately. Others have passed over into listless disappointment, and would rather set up camp.

A short and fierce clash could serve as a reminder that before the hunters undertook this venture, they were warriors. Who better to provide that example than their Lord? On the other hand, the encounter could be avoided – however, the hunters themselves, having announced their presence, may become the hunted, for a while.

It is a galling thing, to find yourself outpaced, and the burgeoning friction threatens to escalate into a full-blown conflict. Yet, have the rival hunters not missed their opportunity as well? Maybe next time, together, this will not be the case. One way or another, the competition must be dealt with.

The Dark Gods must be mocking you to have lead you here, to a place without even a sign of the trail you were following so confidently. Certainly it will pick up again but this dead end has dulled the hunters' appetite for pursuit and sharpened their tempers.

Not the end of your hunt, but an auspicious course, nevertheless. The hunting party could benefit from what they find here – or they can collect it for *your* benefit. Either way, the delay may be worth it.

In the end, you manage to catch up to a few of their stragglers – and learn they are former rivals of yours, who started their own hunt with plenty of steel and resources on hand, but were ultimately failed by their lack of inner steel and resourcefulness before the monster – and were reduced to mere brigands.

Is this the your quarry's doing – or was it drawn to this place so it may leave a trail you can follow? A hunt this may be, but may it also be a pilgrimage? Or should you treat this place as but a waypoint on your way to the final confrontation?

The hunters had expected to locate their quarry and wade into slaughter. Instead they step into a scene of recent carnage. In the middle of it, a single survivor leans on a staff, a white bird circling above him.\\n
\\n"I have come to... advise," the old man says. "I have a tale to tell of what went on here, and a tale to tell of where you must go next. The former is free. The latter is not. What say you?"

Pillage and raze this region while erecting an Altar to Chaos Undivided.\\n\\nSpread Undivided corruption across the land.\\n\\nChaos Altars provide [[img:icon_arcane_power]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Arcane Power[[/col]] – use it to fuel the ultimate execution of the Dark Ritual.\\n\\n{{tr:ui_text_replacements_localised_text_wh3_dlc27_nor_allegiance_altar_landmark_limitation}}

As Sayl steals magical powers from other spellcasters, the forces of Order are take notice.\\n\\nAt certain thresholds of [[img:icon_arcane_power]][[/img]]Arcane Power, armies of Empire, High Elves or Lizardmen will attempt to stop Sayl from empowering his Dark Ritual - defeat them to unlock more abilities!\\n\\nThe more he uses these new-found magical powers to impede his enemies, the more he raises the [[img:icon_attention]][[/img]]Аttention of the Chaos Gods, who are not happy with a mortal using their powers without praying for their blessing. If too much [[img:icon_attention]][[/img]]Аttention is accumulated, servants of the Chaos Gods will confront Sayl!

Treachery is his craft, and power his prize. Sayl can use Manipulations - actions to be performed on enemy factions, their regions, their forces or even Sayl's own armies.\\n\\nEach Manipulation either weakens enemies or grants power to Sayl, but they also draw the Attention of the Chaos Gods, who are not happy with a mortal using their powers without praying for their blessing.\\n\\nIf too much [[img:icon_attention]][[/img]]Attention is accumulated, servants of the Chaos Gods will confront Sayl!

Sayl does not owe Allegiance to the Norscan Gods - instead of dedicating Altars to them, he can construct [[img:icon_nor_undivided]][[/img]]Altars of Chaos Undivided, which fuel his Dark Ritual. As Sayl's power grows, the forces of Order take notice.\\n\\nAt certain thresholds of [[img:icon_arcane_power]][[/img]]Arcane Power, armies of Empire, High Elves or Lizardmen will attempt to stop Sayl from empowering his Dark Ritual - defeat them to unlock more Manipulations!
Increase the [[img:icon_troll_expansion]][[/img]]Troll King's Dominion by constructing Troll buildings in your settlements:

Each unit Troll type (Norscan Trolls, Norscan Ice Trolls, River Trolls, Stone Trolls, Bile Trolls, Chaos Trolls) in all armies contributes Trollkind points. The troll units in Throgg’s army are multiplying by double the Trollkind points.
Troll Trollkind points can be spent to build special structures in Minor and Major settlements, and to perform the Troll Call.
The following effects will be received by the Patron Lord:
The King of Storm and Sea, ruler of all those creatures who dwell below the waves, Mathlann has little love for any of dry land's creatures.
Pleasure Palace||Powerful settlements, used to recruit elite units and provide global bonuses
Thrall Camp||Used to improve your economy and gather [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls
Tormentor's Hold||Used to recruit units and build up a strong garrison that can Sally Out

[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces are powerful Settlements that provide access to characters, powerful global benefits and advanced military recruitment. Instead of using [[img:icon_growth]][[/img]]Growth or [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]]Favour, [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces are built with [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls.\\n\\nEach [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palace must have a {{tr:building_culture_variants_name_wh3_dlc27_sla_dec_palace_settlement_3wh3_dlc27_sla_the_tormentors}}, before you can construct a new one.[[/col]]

Settlements which deplete their [[img:icon_region_thralls]][[/img]]Regional Thrall Population operate at significantly reduced capacity, but can be converted to a [[img:icon_dechala_war_pit]][[/img]]Tormentor's Hold or simply abandoned.

[[col:yellow]][[img:icon_dechala_war_pit]][[/img]]Tormentors' Holds are military settlements that provide recruitment for basic units. They can also empower local armies, generate [[img:icon_corruption_sla]][[/img]]Slaanesh corruption and their garrison can Sally Out to attack nearby armies.[[/col]]

\\n\\n[[col:red]]If you convert a [[img:icon_region_thralls]][[/img]]Thrall Camp to a Tormentors' Hold[[img:icon_dechala_war_pit]][[/img]] all [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls remaining in the region's pool will be lost and the settlement tier will drop by one level (to a minimum of 1). A [[img:icon_dechala_war_pit]][[/img]]Tormentors' Hold cannot be converted back to a [[img:icon_region_thralls]][[/img]]Thrall Camp.[[/col]]

The Sea Patrol has access to unique benefits in the form of Asur Domination initiatives. You can spend [[img:icon_dedication]][[/img]]Dedication received from Sea Patrol Outposts on three categories of initiatives:\\n\\n[[b]]Colony Dedication[[/b]] improves the [[img:icon_hef_colonies]][[/img]]Elven Colony settlements under your faction's control.\\n\\n[[b]]Outpost Dedication[[/b]] allows you to have more developed [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]][[/img]]Sea Patrol Outposts.\\n\\n[[b]]Dragonship Dedication[[/b]] focuses on empowering your [[img:wh3_dlc27_hef_dragonships]][[/img]]Dragonships and their Admirals.

Initiatives activated within each Asur Domination category are tracked here.\\n\\nTooltips will display various additional effects applied after certain numbers of initiatives are complete – first at 2, then at 4, and finally at 6 completed initiatives.
The Active Effects tab shows a list of all effects being gained from initiatives in Asur Domination.

The Ulthuan's Leaders tab displays your fellow High Elf factions, tracking how many captured settlements you have gifted to them and thus how many [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]]Sea Patrol Outposts you have on their territory.\\n\\nThe more Outposts extablished in a leader's territory, the more benefits you can receive from them via the Consult Leaders button.
When you have enough Outposts on the territory of any one High Elf Legendary Lord, use the Consult Leaders button to convene with them and select a benefit to receive their aid.
Here you can either confirm your [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]][[/img]]Outpost's construction and gift this settlement, or click the faction banner above to change your selection.

You may now establish an [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]][[/img]]Outpost!\\n\\nBefore establishing an [[img:icon_sea_patrol_outposts]][[/img]]Outpost, you must choose a major High Elf faction to gift this settlement to.
[[img:icon_hef_colonies]][[/img]]Elven Colonies are expensive and limited to construct, but their availability can be increased via the use of [[img:icon_asur_domination]][[/img]]Asur Domination.

This is a list of factions of High Elf Legendary Lords who may receive the conquered settlement, based on their presence in the province and whether they are known to you in diplomacy.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_asur_domination}}

This map displays the Patrons of the Realms, allowing you to install your [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords into Patronage positions within Ulthuan’s provinces to bring benefits to your faction.\\n\\nIndicated on the map are the current Patronages and each province’s status of ownership.\\n\\nIf a province is [[col:red]]red[[/col]], it is under control of a non-High Elf faction and must be reconquered by the Asur before its Patronage can be claimed.

Select a position to view who currently holds a Patronage position (if any) and the effects granted by holding it.\\n\\nIf you have enough [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]]Influence, you may take this Patronage for yourself, but be careful – other factions will try to take it from you as well!

The effects of a selected Patronage can be viewed in this section. With a position selected, click an eligible [[img:icon_lord]][[/img]]Lord from the top, then use the Take Patronage button to spend the required [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]]Influence.\\n\\nYour Lord will take the Patronage of the selected province and further [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]]Influence can be spent to upgrade the effects provided.

Your level of [[img:icon_hef_favour]][[/img]]Favour with the Phoenix King is tracked here. It will increase naturally as you hold Patronages, eventually enabling [[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]]confederations with other High Elves via Court Unity.

The Court Unity tab allows you to view special conditions to confederate other High Elf factions.\\n\\nConfederations through the court are made possible by holding Patronage positions in certain provinces and having sufficient [[img:icon_hef_favour]][[/img]]Favour of the Phoenix King.\\n\\nEach shield represents an Asur faction with a tooltip displaying its conditions – once fulfilled for a selected faction, the Confederate button at the bottom may be used.

The Patrons of the Realms panel gives you an overview of the current Patronage status of Ulthuan provinces, as well as the effects granted by holding them via [[img:icon_influence]][[/img]]Influence.\\n\\nIt also allows you to track your [[img:icon_hef_favour]][[/img]]Favour of the Phoenix King progress, eventually allowing you to [[img:icon_confederation]][[/img]]confederate High Elf factions.
{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_gods}}\\n\\nAltars contribute to your Allegiance to the Gods, but have limited development options.
One of the four gods must be chosen before raising an Altar.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_2_gods}}
The Allegiance bar allows you to track your progress and the effects granted by each god.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_3_gods}}\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_4_gods}}
Click here to access the Manipulations panel.

Four [[img:icon_treacheries]][[/img]]Manipulations are available from the start, with three further Manipulation tiers becoming available below as progress is made towards Sayl's [[img:icon_sayl_dark_ritual]][[/img]] [[sl:campaign_sayl_dark_ritual]]Dark Ritual[[/sl]].

Once a Manipulation and its target have been selected, it may be performed via this button.\\n\\nThis triggers a cooldown time and increases the [[img:dlc27_sayl_attention]][[/img]]Attention of the Gods.

Norscan factions can send their tribesmen into a province to raid, instill fear and prove their devotion to the Chaos Gods.\\n\\nUse the Marauding actions to spend [[img:icon_spoils]][[/img]]Spoils or reduce your own [[img:icon_public_order]][[/img]]Control and receive benefits. Only one Marauding action can be active at a time.

Glory Hunts are non-repeatable hunts specific to certain climate zones.\\n\\nThese hunts capture Regiment of Renown units for recruitment, in addition to providing items, resources and temporary effects upon completion.

Taming Hunts are two-stage hunts specific to certain climate zones, which can provide monster units via the Monstrous Arcanum recruitment panel, in addition to items, resources and effects.\\n\\nThe initial stages and rewards of Taming Hunts are only available once, while the second stage of these hunts can be repeated infinitely to bolster your recruitment pool.

Trophy Hunts are started in specific areas of the map and can only be completed once.\\n\\nSlaying a Trophy Hunt monster provides unique items related to the quarry, in addition to resources and effects upon completion.

Hunts are listed within each Arcanum tab for each hunt type, where you can view an overview of requirements for each hunt.\\n\\nThe tabs for Taming Hunts and Trophy Hunts become available as you progress through the different hunt types.
Selecting a hunt will open its entry page to display further information, objectives and rewards, and allow you to choose a hunting party before it can be started.
At the bottom of the page you can select one of your [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords' armies to lead the hunting party.\\n\\nHowever, any other Lords can assist with the search as part of the hunt.
This is your currently active hunt. You can view its overview page here.
You can now access the Monstrous Arcanum!\\n\\nThis allows you to hunt various monsters to gain resources and other benefits upon completion.

[[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces are your most powerful settlements, providing global benefits and advanced recruitment. Instead of using [[img:icon_growth]][[/img]]Growth or [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]]Favour, they are constructed with [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls from your global pool, which must be harvested using Thrall Camps.\\n\\nAssuming you have enough [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls, you do not need Population Surplus to upgrade buildings.

All [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palace buildings produce [[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence each turn, which increases with higher levels.\\n\\n[[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence can be spent in the Tormentor's Tributes panel to purchase temporary and permanent boons for your faction.

[[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Palaces are limited – the first one is available, but to build a new one, each of your existing [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces must have a {{tr:building_culture_variants_name_wh3_dlc27_sla_dec_palace_settlement_3wh3_dlc27_sla_the_tormentors}}.\\n\\nWhile this is pink, a new [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palace is available to build.\\n\\nConsider carefully between upgrading [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Palaces to their ultimate potential and starting new ones.

[[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces are your most powerful settlement type, only available in major settlements and providing significant military, economic and global bonuses. Constructing and upgrading them requires [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls from the global pool.\\n\\nA Pleasure Palace must be upgraded to a Wing of Indulgence before a new Palace may be constructed.

Dechala does not seduce units like other Slaaneshi characters, preferring a more direct approach. \\n\\n[[b]]Corrupt Units[[/i]] allows you to apply powerful stat reductions to a target unit, reducing their combat ability and morale significantly for the duration of the battle. \\n\\nWeakening key enemy units allows better use of your superior mobility to quickly destroy them in the battle.

You can apply [[i]]Marks of Vindictiveness[[/i]] purchased from the Tormentor's Tributes panel to units in the Pre-battle screen, or alternatively purchase them directly in the Pre-battle.\\n\\nTo apply a purchased Mark, drag it onto a unit card. Units may only have one Mark at a time.\\n\\nMarks will be expended after battle, but your selections will be remembered and reapplied in future battles if available.

Corrupting units requires  [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]]Favour, and can only be used on a limited number at a time.\\n\\nSkills, ancillaries, technologies and Tormentor's Tribute rewards can all improve this ability, allowing you to target higher numbers and higher tier units.\\n\\nUse the button below to confirm the corruption of selected units. If you change your mind, retreating from this battle will refund the spent  [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]]Favour.
This [[img:icon_lord]][[/img]]Lord may perform an Eternal Dance!\\n\\nClick here to select a Dance.

The Eternal Dance allows any [[img:icon_lord]][[/img]]Lord of the Accursed Troupe to perform Dances, allowing them to gain [[img:icon_tempo]][[/img]]Tempo and choose Steps to receive beneficial combat effects.

One of four Dances can be selected via their icons to the left, each with a different theme and effects as viewed in the panel.\\n\\nEach Dance's Steps can be viewed via the icons to the right, offering unique battle abilities and other effects.\\n\\nThe button at the bottom begins a selected Dance.

Once a Dance has started, every won battle increases this Lord's [[img:icon_tempo]][[/img]]Tempo, tracked in this bar.\\n\\nFilling the bar gradually unlocks Steps across four [[img:icon_tempo]][[/img]]Tempo levels – [[i]]Emergence[[/i]], [[i]]Elevation[[/i]], [[i]]Culmination[[/i]] and [[i]]Reckoning[[/i]].

The first three [[img:icon_tempo]][[/img]]Tempo levels have four possible Steps to choose from and are limited to one active Step per level.\\n\\nCompleting the Tempo bar unlocks the [[i]]Reckoning[[/i]], enabling a powerful final ritual that this Lord may target enemies with.

[[img:icon_dechala_thrall_camp]][[/img]]Thrall Camp buildings allow you to modify the transfer rate of [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls to the global pool or convert them to [[img:icon_treasury]][[/img]]Favour.

Thrall Camp settlements slowly transfer their local populations of [[img:icon_region_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls to the [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]global pool to be spent on the construction of [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces or other uses.\\n\\n{{tr:wh3_dlc27_sla_dechala_settlement_type_thrall_camp}}
Occupying this settlement as a [[img:icon_dechala_thrall_camp]][[/img]]Thrall Camp allows you to generate [[img:icon_thralls]][[/img]]Thralls.\\n\\n{{tr:hp_campaign_point_1_thralls}}

Tormentor’s Tributes are purchasable rewards available in return for the [[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence that Dechala garners on her campaigns.\\n\\nTributes are available in three categories.\\n\\n[[b]]Marks of Vindictiveness[[/b]] grant army abilities that can be equipped in the pre-battle screen.\\n\\nMarks are always available, each purchase granting three ability uses. [[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence may be spent to permanently improve abilities for all future battles.

[[b]]Opulent Gifts[[/b]] are powerful single-purchase ancillaries that cost a larger amount of [[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence and can be granted to your [[img:icon_general]][[/img]]Lords or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes.

[[b]]Exquisite Spoils[[/b]] are one-off faction upgrades that cost a high amount of [[img:icon_decadence]][[/img]]Decadence to empower your [[img:icon_dechala_pleasure_palace]][[/img]]Pleasure Palaces and bring permanent benefits to your armies, provinces and characters.

Occupy this settlement to have a starting point for your raid!\\n\\nChoosing to settle here will present the option to give up your lands in Norsca in return for riches.\\n\\nIf so, you can always use [[img:icon_norsca_seafang]][[/img]]Seafang to sail back and reconquer those lands later.
Subjugating a Legendary Lord will add that character to your faction's recruitment pool and convert the subjugated faction into your vassal.
View all your [[img:icon_garden_of_corruption]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Gardens of Corruption[[/col]] at a glance. Nurgle allows only [[col:ui_font_green_light]]seven[[/col]], so place them carefully.

Here you can [[col:ui_font_green_light]]Plant[[/col]] new [[img:icon_garden_of_corruption]][[/img]]Gardens of Corruption or view key details for existing Gardens, including their overall [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls upkeep, brewing [[img:icon_plague]][[/img]]Plague timers, and active [[img:bullet_nur_cyclical_buildings]][[/img]]Cyclical Buildings.

Earn [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls throughout the campaign to increase the [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]][[col:ui_font_green_light]]Tallied Souls[[/col]] bar and unlock more [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_blessings_of_nurgle]][[/img]]Gifts of Nurgle.\\n\\nThey come in three forms that you can access through these tabs:\\n[[img:bullet_point_white]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Grandfather’s Blessings[[/col]] will greatly empower your characters\\n[[img:bullet_point_white]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Rituals of Decay[[/col]] will momentarily help you make the most of any situation\\n[[img:bullet_point_white]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Gardens of Corruption[[/col]] will bring Nurgle units and plagues.

Each [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Tallied Souls threshold will increase the maximum number of [[col:ui_font_green_light]]Grandfather’s Blessings bestowed[[/col]].\\n\\nYou can then attain one to bestow upon a different target based on the [[col:ui_font_green_light]]Blessing’s type[[/col]]: [[img:icon_lord]][[/img]]Lords and/or [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Heroes, or [[img:icon_garden_of_corruption]][[/img]]Gardens of Corruption.

Each Blessing has [[col:ui_font_green_light]]specific Progression Objectives[[/col]] its bearer must complete to reach new thresholds. There are [[col:ui_font_green_light]]3 thresholds[[/col]] in total, with each one improving the Blessing’s benefits. Progression carries over between bearers if the current bearer is killed or replaced.
Here you can see the current benefits of this Blessing as well as the next ones.
You can [[col:yellow]]Attain[[/col]] only one new Blessing for each [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Tallied Souls threshold, so choose wisely.

Here you can see the state of each [[col:yellow]]Ritual of Decay[[/col]]. Out of the five gifted by Nurgle, two are already available while the other three are earned through the [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Tallied Souls threshold.
Rituals affect your bestowed characters, [[img:icon_garden_of_corruption]][[/img]]Gardens of Corruption, or their provinces. Before performing one, make sure it has as many beneficiaries as possible.

After performing a Ritual, you can spend [[img:icon_souls_resource]][[/img]]Souls to [[col:ui_font_green_light]]improve its [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_rotborne_ritual_tier_3]][[/img]]Tier[[/col]] and effects. Higher Tiers usually add more targets, or increase the effects' potency.\\nRituals will also benefit from a [[col:ui_font_green_light]]shorter cooldown[[/col]] with each subsequent improvement.

Such Invasion Fortresses bolster the hordes of Archaon – the Three-Eyed King who has descended from the frigid hem of the world, intent upon the final ruin of the clean-limbed wastrels of the southern realms.\\n\\nSeen from above, the blood-slicked trails that converge upon each of Archaon’s musters resemble an eight-pointed star. Lay waste to these congregations of grim portent, and you will doubtless diminish the foul strength he draws from his dark patrons.
Schemes||Displays effects in the Masterplans, across all [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Schemes.
Event Log||Describes the events that occured in the Masterplan – the latest ones are at the top with older ones at the bottom.

This is the ongoing Masterplan - you can see what [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Schemes are currently present:\\n\\n[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_green_token]][[/img]][[col:green]]Rewards[[/col]] - always positive, you want as many of these as possible.\\n\\n[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_red_token]][[/img]][[col:red]]Complications[[/col]] - always negative, represents the risk of the region's inhabitants learning about the Masterplan and trying to stop it! These increase [[col:red]]Alarm[[/col]], which can force you to end your Masterplan in an unfavourable state!\\n\\n[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_yellow_token]][[/img]][[col:yellow]]Manipulations[[/col]] - usually positive, will try to prevent Complications or add risk in return for more reward.\\n\\n[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_purple_token]][[/img]][[col:subtitle_azazel]]Coincidences[[/col]] - are mostly positive, but are wildcards with effects so varied that you never know what to expect from them!

Your Tricks can be viewed here. Tricks are actions that can be performed during a Masterplan. For example – the Grey Seer Underling has a Trick that swaps out any [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_green_token]][[/img]][[col:green]][[/img]]Reward in the plan for a better one!

A Masterplan has been started! These are the possible [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_green_token]][[/img]]Rewards that can appear in it - a number of them will be added [[col:yellow]]([[i]]at random - the chance for each one to appear is underneath their icon[[/i]])[[/col]].\\n\\nHover on each [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Scheme to read more about its effects.

This is the Underling in charge of the Masterplan. Here you can access their skills, view the region, and plan results.\\n\\nFor [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_military_plan]][[/img]]Kill-Stab Masterplans, you can observe each unit in the army being gathered.\\n\\nIn [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_economic_plan]][[/img]] Steal-Take Masterplans, you can check on how much of each resource the Underling has gathered and determine whether to end the plan now or keep stealing for more turns!\\n\\nDuring [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_magic_plan]][[/img]]Great-Smart Masterplans this area shows the special [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_green_token]][[/img]]Rewards you need for the plan completion, highlighting the ones already gained.

The number at the top is [[col:red]]Risk of Complication[[/col]] - the higher it is, the higher the chance a [[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_red_token]][[/img]]Complication appears in the Masterplan!\\n\\n[[img:wh3_dlc29_icon_red_token]][[/img]]Complications are negative [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Schemes, which will often raise the [[col:red]]Alarm[[/col]] (by 1, 2 or 3) and may have other unwanted effects. Some will come with a Trick to reduce [[col:red]]Alarm[[/col]], but the price for that may be too costly.\\n\\nBelow [[col:red]]Risk of Complication[[/col]] is the level of [[col:red]]Alarm[[/col]] in the region - if it reaches its maximum, you must make a decision: \\n\\n[[b]]Complete[[/b]] the plan immediately [[i]]or[[/i]] [[b]]Abandon[[/b]] it without any refunds.\\n\\n In either case, no further [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Schemes will be added.\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Sometimes going through with a plan is not worth the price or the effort - a smart-wise Lord knows when to give up and start a new Masterplan![[/col]]
On this side you can view the effects provided by all [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Schemes within the Masterplan.
The Summary tab lists any notable occurrences of a Masterplan, listing the oldest [[img:icon_thanquol_schemes]][[/img]]Scheme at the bottom and the newest on top.

Use this button to complete the Masterplan!\\n\\nMasterplans require a few turns to unfold - you cannot complete them immediately.
